plotHtml:
This is the story of Suman, a young orphaned woman, whose dreams of finding family and love come true when she gets a chance to be a part of an extremely lovable and traditional joint family.
Suman lives in a girls' hostel with her best friend Nandini, who hails from a rich, traditional and loving family. Nandini's mother Surabhi meets Suman and decides that this girl will be her future daughter-in-law. Suman meets Surabhi's son Nandan and they take a sudden liking for each other. To Suman's shock, it is revealed that she has been chosen for Anshuman, Nandan's elder stepbrother. Suman is in a dilemma: She has to choose between her love for Nandan and the feelings of a family which has treated her like a daughter.
After facing many difficulties, Nandan and Suman get married. On the way the brakes on their car fail. Nandan shoves Suman out but is unable to get out himself. The car dives into a waterfall and Nandan is presumed dead. After that, the whole family begins to hate Suman, except for Anshuman and his new fiancée Tanya. But even Tanya becomes an enemy when she sees that Anshuman cares for Suman.
Meanwhile, Suman goes through many trials and tribulations. After a long time, she is once again accepted by her in-laws. By now, she and Anshuman are in love. They get married with the blessings of the family.
tagline: This is the story of Suman, a young orphaned woman, whose dreams of finding family and love come true when she gets a chance to be a part of an extremely lovable and traditional joint family.

title: Pishachini
summary: Pishachini (lit. 'demoness') is an Indian Hindi-language television supernatural drama series that aired from 8 August 2022 to 13 January 2023 on Colors TV. It is digitally available on JioHotstar. Produced by Shakuntalam Telefilms and MAJ Productions, it stars Nyra Banerjee, Jiya Shankar and Harsh Rajput.
plot:
The show is set against the backdrop of Bareilly where a beautiful girl (actually a Pishachini) named Rani, seeks revenge from the Rajput family for settling on her land. Rani was an evil and greedy woman when she was a human but due to her misdeeds and murders, she was cursed to become a Pishachini after her death. She wants to destroy the Rajputs and use their blood to bring her child to life, who will become the most powerful Pishacha as it will be a crossbreed of a demon and human. But a divine power rises to stop her from winning. It is the granddaughter of the priest (Pandit Ji or Nanu) who had imprisoned Rani in a box years ago, Pavitra, who now lives in London after Rani's curse killed most of her family except her aunt Kanika, who raised her. Pavitra has the mark of Lord Hanuman on her hand which actually has many hidden powers she is still not aware of. Rani escaped from the box after some tim3 of her imprisonment, by tempting the younger son of the Rajput family, Prateek and manipulated his greed for money as Pishachinis can grant any wish but the price paid for that deal is very horrible, which is the reason why the Rajputs do not speak with him and his wife Amrita anymore. But his daughter, Nikita, is getting married, whose friend is Pavitra and she is forced to come to India, where she meets Rakshit (Rocky), the grandson of the Rajput family, and he takes an instant liking towards her but she does not immediately reciprocate his feelings.
The Rajputs reach Chail for the wedding while Rani enchants Rocky as she wants to impregnate herself with his child and become the most powerful dark entity. Pavitra senses something is wrong and Ayodhya, Rocky's grandfather who knows Rani's truth, is attacked by her and is left paralyzed. Rani manipulates Rocky's sister Shikha and promises to cure the scar on her face if she is taken back to Bareilly where her original land is. Pavitra follows them as she knows about her Nanu's past and his relation with the Pishachini, which claimed her family and she does not want the same fate to be repeated with any other family and hence wants to protect them from the Pishachini, who is disguised as a normal human amongst them. Rani enters the household as a prospective bride for Rocky and he agrees to marry her as he falls for her delusions.
Pavitra collects clues and pieces them together to unearth that Rani is indeed the Pishachini she is looking for and she is the evil entity her Nanu had asked her to destroy before taking his last breathe, and she must stop her from marrying Rocky before it is too late. Pavitra makes various attempts to expose Rani but no one believes her as all her plans fail due to Rani's wicked conspiracies. Rocky does not trust her claims either and asks her to leave India. To protect Rocky from Rani and to thwart all her ulterior motives, Pavitra marries him herself under the veil to everyone's shock. The Rajputs do not accept the marriage, and Rocky, after some initial hesitation, agrees to take Pavitra as his wife. Rani vows to defeat Pavitra and their fight begins. Rani tricks Pavitra and marries Rocky's elder brother Sanchit by enchanting him and faking the death of her parents and sister. She becomes pregnant, and Pavitra must find a way to end her. To her horror, Ayodhya is also transformed into a Pishacha as are Prateek and Amrita, the couple dies but Ayodhya survives and continues to help Rani and fool everyone. Rani starts manipulating everyone against Pavitra to oust her from the house but she retaliates and Rani's truth is exposed to Rocky who apologizes to Pavitra, and agrees to help her defeat Rani. Pavitra starts discovering her powers and learns that she is the only one capable of killing the Pishachini. Rani's plot of acquiring the Maha-Pishacha crown (to become the strongest Pishacha) on Dusshera is foiled by Pavitra who gains the divine powers of the Goddess Durga and uses a trident to break the crown. Rocky becomes invisible and disappears later on into the Pishacha world but Pavitra, who realizes she has fallen in love with him, brings him back and they unite. They free Sanchit from Rani's control and use the unborn child of Rani as a bait to trap her and unveil her reality to the rest of the family. The Rajputs are shocked when they realize Rani's truth and apologize to Pavitra for not trusting her earlier and even humiliating her at many instances, while she was fighting to protect them all this time.
Rani is trapped to a tree and the Rajputs think they won but then Maha-Pishacha comes to the house to take Pavitra and sacrifice her to dark forces so that he can gain infinite powers, in the disguise of Shikha's boyfriend, Veer. Rocky realizes Veer's truth and he rushes to rescue Pavitra who has embarked on a journey with Veer, not knowing that he wants to kill her. Rocky gets help from an unexpected source, the Nashak, who knows about the evil forces and how to stop them, and the Nashak is revealed to be Pavitra's aunt, Kanika. Kanika and Rocky encourage Pavitra when she falls weak in front of Maha Pishacha's power but she rises again and kills him. Shikha is hurt after Veer's death and blames Pavitra even after knowing he was evil and blindly agrees to release Rani to get revenge from Pavitra. Rani returns and pretends to have changed and takes the family to a lava pool to test her purity, which is actually a trap and they get surrounded by Agni Vetaals who are zombie-like creatures. Pavitra gains divine help and defeats the Vetaals to protect her family but Rocky gets bitten by one and is infected and starts becoming an Agni Vetaal himself. Kanika heals him temporarily while Rani is locked inside a cave by Pavitra after the battle. Sanchit dies due to Shikha's mistake and Pavitra takes the blame on herself to save Shikha, who realizes she was wrong for helping Rani as Pavitra did nothing unjust ever. The Pishacha Ayodhya is released as well by Sudhakar and Sapna accidentally and he puts Pavitra under a trance like state through a spell but Rocky's true love brings her back into consciousness. The real Ayodhya is separated from the Pishacha one and the latter is annihilated but Rani returns to the house disguised as Sanchit's friend Shreya to mourn his death, as she gained the powers of a Sarp or a shapeshifting snake from the cave Pavitra had trapped her in. She tricks everyone and transforms Rocky into an Agni Vetaal and he forgets his real self and past memories and agrees to marry Rani, mistreating his family members and denying his love for Pavitra.
Pavitra loses Rocky and her family is also pushed behind a mirror world by Rani, and she feels helpless. But Kanika fills her with confidence and she agrees to revive Rocky into a human again, rescue her family and end Rani. After much struggle, the Rajput family reunites and they trick Rani and kill her helper Mandy, a shapeshifting frog. They are also able to heal Rocky who becomes a human again and he reunites with Pavitra. The family makes a trap for Rani during the wedding rituals. Rani unleashes her terror and her snake ally tries to consume the Rajputs, but then Pavitra takes the form of Goddess Durga and kills the giant snake. Rani's unborn child also does not take her side and turns against her, Rani is forced to escape once she realizes she has been overpowered. Kanika dies while protecting Rocky's younger cousin Vidya and gives her Nashak powers to Vidya. Vidya becomes the next Nashak and helps Pavitra and Rocky to find a way to kill Rani once and for all. Rani kills the Pishacha Devata and becomes a ten-headed Pralaya Pishachini (the ultimate and the most destructive Pishachini) and ends up taking Ayodhya's life. Pavitra will not let Rani take away any of her loved ones again and prepares to fight her, even agreeing to sacrifice herself for their sake. There is one final confrontation between Pavitra, Rocky, Nashak (Vidya), all the remaining Rajputs and the Pralaya Pishachini. Rocky earns magical wings due to Lord Hanuman's blessings and at last Rani is vanquished by Pavitra and the Rajputs after a prolonged battle, when Pavitra attacks the back of Rani's head where her mortal wound was concealed. The Rajputs celebrate their victory over the dark force that has been haunting them for years. Rocky and Pavitra adopt Sanchit and Rani's Pishacha child as their own and are blessed with their own daughter later on. Everything seems to be going good and positive for the family, but dark forces once again descend on earth to claim Rani's daughter.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Nyra Banerjee as Raat Rani Singh Rajput — A Powerful Pishachini; Sanchit's wife; mother of a baby boy; Pavitra's biggest enemy (Dead) * Jiya Shankar as Pavitra "Piku" Singh Rajput — A girl with divine powers; Rakshit's wife; mother of a baby girl; Rani's biggest enemy * Amit Mehra as Sanchit Singh Rajput — Sudhakar and Sapna's son; Rakshit and Shikha's brother; Manohar, Babli, Prateek and Amrita's nephew; Vidya and Nikita's cousin; Rani's husband; father of a baby boy (Dead) * Harsh Rajput as Rakshit "Rocky" Singh Rajput — Sudhakar and Sapna's son; Sanchit and Shikha's brother; Manohar, Babli, Prateek and Amrita's nephew; Vidya and Nikita's cousin; Pavitra's husband; father of a baby girl

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In June 2022, Nyra Banerjee was cast for the title role. Jiya Shankar finalized for a female protagonist.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: On 19 June 2022, the first teaser featuring Nyra Banerjee as Pishachini released.

episodesList.title: Pishachini aka Rani wreaks havoc
episodesList.summary: Pishachini aka Rani intends to wreak havoc in the village with her evil powers. However, the Rajput family then plan to capture Rani in the pious box in order to protect the villagers from her demonic forces. Will the Rajputs succeed?

episodesList.title: The Rajputs visit Chail
episodesList.summary:
The Rajput family decides to visit Chail to attend Nikita's wedding. Meanwhile, London-based Pavitra too plans her trip to the mountainous city. Will Pavitra cross paths with the Rajputs?

Audio:Hindi

episodesList.title: Pishachini follows Pavitra
episodesList.summary: Impressed by Pavitra's charm, Pishachini follows her but retracts quickly upon realising the former's piousness. Later, Pishachini intimidates Pratik to gain his loyalty. Will Pratik sacrifice his family for his greed?

episodesList.title: Rani is enamoured by Rocky!
episodesList.summary: While Rocky meets Pavitra and tries to impress her, Rani is enamoured by Rocky and falls head over heels in love with him. Moreover, she intends to defeat Pavitra and seduce Rocky with her beauty. Will Rani be successful in her evil plans?

episodesList.title: Pavitra tries to recall her past!
episodesList.summary: In order to lure Rocky into her trap, Rani finally enters the mansion and attends the Sangeet ceremony. When Pavitra learns of Pishachini's presence in the mansion, she tries to recall her past with Pishachini. What kind of past does Pavitra have?

episodesList.title: Rocky searches for Rani
episodesList.summary: Rocky and his friends go in search of the Pishachini in the middle of the night. After putting on women's perfume to attract the creature, he treads lightly into the woods. Will he manage to capture Rani?

episodesList.title: Rani begins her retribution!
episodesList.summary: Ayodhya tells Pavitra the whole truth about Pishachini and offers his assistance in capturing Rani. However, Rani discovers Ayodhya alone and decides to exact her revenge on him. Will Ayodhya be able to defend himself from Rani's wrath?

episodesList.title: Pavitra finds the enchanted box
episodesList.summary: While Rocky searches for the enchanted box in the basement, Pavitra finds it hanging on top of the chandelier. However, to her dismay, the box vanishes into thin air when she checks the chandelier again. Where did the box disappear?

episodesList.title: Ayodhya is paralysed!
episodesList.summary: Ayodhya throws the trunk into the bush to get rid of Pishachini, but the latter saves herself and renders him immobile. To demonstrate that Pishachini has left, Pavitra burns her cloth. Will Pishachini go after Pavitra?

episodesList.title: Pavitra notices an odd shadow
episodesList.summary: Ayodhya returns home from the hospital after the treatment. Meanwhile, Pavitra video calls Rocky and notices a strange shadow behind Rocky during the call. Will Rocky see the shadow?

episodesList.title: Pishachini targets Ayodhya!
episodesList.summary: Rocky is given the responsibility of looking after Ayodhya. However, Rocky then decides to meet Pavitra and leaves Ayodhya alone in his room. Meanwhile, Pishachini appears and plans to enter the mansion by killing Ayodhya. Will Pishachini succeed?

episodesList.title: Rani manipulates Shikha
episodesList.summary: Shikha is ecstatic when Rani offers to cure Ayodhya. However, she demands that Shikha invite her into the house so that she may cure him using her powers. Will Shikha fall for Rani's deceit and invite her into the house?

episodesList.title: Pavitra informs Rocky about Rani!
episodesList.summary: Rocky spends some time with Pavitra and decides to express his feelings to her. Meanwhile, Pavitra informs Rocky about Rani's intentions and her desire to enter the mansion. How will Rocky react after learning of Rani's intentions?

episodesList.title: Pavitra to stop Rani!
episodesList.summary: As Pavitra learns a shocking fact about Rani, she becomes concerned about the latter's arrival at the mansion. Meanwhile, Rani forces Shikha to invite her to the mansion. Will Pavitra be able to prevent Rani from entering the mansion?

episodesList.title: Rani gets Ayodhya's blessings
episodesList.summary: When Rocky's family requests Rani to get Ayodhya's blessings, he stares in bewilderment as Rani approaches him. She tricks him into blessing her when he tries to reveal her true form. How will Ayodhya break this alliance?

episodesList.title: Rocky agrees to marry Rani
episodesList.summary: As Rani uses magic on Rocky and makes him give his consent to the wedding with her, Pavitra feels heartbroken. Later, Rani confronts Ayodhya and shares the joy of entering the mansion. How will Ayodhya handle the predicament?

episodesList.title: Rani's identity at stake!
episodesList.summary: Rocky becomes perplexed by his decision to marry Rani and decides to confront her. When Rocky meets Rani, he hears a suspicious voice from Rani's well and decides to investigate. Will Rocky learn the truth about Rani this time?

episodesList.title: Rocky confronts Pavitra
episodesList.summary: Rocky confronts Pavitra and questions her feelings towards him. However, Pavitra grows furious when Rocky requests her to reconsider her decision to leave him. Can Rocky convince Pavitra?

episodesList.title: Pavitra learns Rani's truth
episodesList.summary: Rani cooks up a story as Pavitra confronts Rani after finding Vishal's wallet close to the well. Furthermore, Pavitra learns that Rani is the Pishachini when the latter takes an unburnt cloth piece from her. What will Pavitra do to expose Rani?

episodesList.title: Himani to reveal Rani
episodesList.summary: While Rani and Rocky are busy dancing in the event of Janmasthami, Himani is shocked to discover Vikas's body. As Himani yells in anger to expose Rani, the latter tries to obstruct her. What twist will Rani bring?

episodesList.title: Rani fakes an illness
episodesList.summary: Rani fakes an illness to avoid performing the puja for Lord Krishna. Pavitra grows suspicious of Rani's act and is determined to expose her. She comes across a journal where she finds the answer to her problems. Will she use it against Rani?

episodesList.title: Rani reveals her past
episodesList.summary: Rani shows off her superpowers to Pavitra in an effort to terrify her. Later, Rani tells Pavitra all that happened to her before she was raised from the dead. What could have produced a creature like Rani?

episodesList.title: Pavitra discloses the truth!
episodesList.summary: To make Rocky aware of Rani's true colours before their wedding, Pavitra reveals the reality about Rani. Rocky, however, refuses to believe her. How will Pavitra support her claims?

episodesList.title: Pavitra puts Rani on the spot
episodesList.summary: Rani stands in the way when Himani is about to leave the house with her parents. Subsequently, Pavitra confronts Rani regarding her relationship with the family. Will Rani come clean this time?

episodesList.title: Rani commits a horrible act!
episodesList.summary: Rani kills Himani and her family and then claims it was an accident. Rocky and his family blame Pavitra for the mishap while they are still in disbelief. How will Pavitra prove that the mishap was murder?

episodesList.title: Pavitra seeks Rocky's help
episodesList.summary: Pavitra grows anxious and tries to find a way to reveal Rani's truth. Later, Pavitra devises a plan and seeks Rocky's help to disclose Rani's reality. Will Pavitra be able to bring out Rani's truth?

episodesList.title: Pavitra unmasks Rani
episodesList.summary: Despite Rani's attempts, Pavitra succeeds in clicking pictures of her demonic avatar and rushes to show them to the family. Will Pavitra succeed in her endeavour to unmask Rani?

episodesList.title: Rani unearths the fact
episodesList.summary: Pavitra informs Pratik and Amrita of Ayodhya's recovery without realising that they are two Pishachs. Ayodhya explores Rani's room for a key while she learns about it. Will Ayodhya once more fall victim to Rani's spectral trap?

episodesList.title: Will Rocky believe Pavitra?
episodesList.summary: Rocky becomes sceptical when he spots a strange watch on Rani's brother's photograph during the Sangeet ceremony. Pavitra sees Ayodhya captured and tries to reveal the truth to Rocky. Will the truth ultimately come out?

episodesList.title: A big shock for Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: In her effort to free Ayodhya from the spectral grip, Pavitra learns that he has been turned into a Pishach. She then rushes to expose Rani with the mark on her hand. Now that Ayodhya is not by her side, how will Pavitra combat evil?

episodesList.title: Pavitra stabs Rani!
episodesList.summary: After fervently begging for a sign of hope, Pavitra receives a key from Lord Hanuman that transforms into a sword. She stabs Rani with the sword to put an end to the wickedness forever. Will this finally bring Rani's truth to light?

episodesList.title: Rani turns the tables
episodesList.summary: Rani takes advantage of an innocent girl and murders her to deceive Pavitra. While Pavitra is urged to leave the house, she learns about a mystery that will unfold after Rocky and Rani's wedding. How will Pavitra unravel the mystery?

episodesList.title: Rani's motive horrifies Pavitra
episodesList.summary: While Rocky transforms into a Pishach, Rani knocks Pavitra out in the spooky well by striking her on the head. When Pavitra awakes, she discovers Rani's vicious plan to marry Rocky. Can Pavitra avert the wedding?

episodesList.title: Rani executes her plan!
episodesList.summary: Rani finally carries out her evil plan and prepares to marry Rocky. Meanwhile, Pavitra gets trapped in a spooky well and seeks Rocky's assistance. Will Rocky be able to save himself and Pavitra from Rani's black magic before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Rocky to Pavitra's rescue!
episodesList.summary: While Rocky senses something is off during the wedding, a bunch of Langurs save Pavitra from drowning. Rocky leaves the wedding ritual to come to her aid. Will Rocky learn about the events that transpired?

episodesList.title: Pavitra reveals the truth
episodesList.summary: Pavitra feels burdened as she is about to leave without resolving anything, but Vidya stops her and enquires about her actions. She then reveals the real reason why she is helping them. Will Pavitra be able to stop Rocky's wedding?

episodesList.title: Will Rocky stand by Pavitra's side?
episodesList.summary: Rocky's family questions Pavitra about the change of brides but she is unable to justify herself to them. Thus, they refuse to accept the marriage and Pavitra as their daughter-in-law. Will Rocky stand by Pavitra's side at this difficult time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra confesses her feelings
episodesList.summary: After being greeted at the Rajput house, Pavitra shares her emotions with Rocky and hopes that the family accepts her. Rocky assures her that things will fall into place. Will their wish come true?

episodesList.title: Vidya faces the bitter reality!
episodesList.summary: Rani plans to wreak havoc in Pavitra's life to become Maha Pishachini. Moreover, Vidya encounters Ayodhya and few other family members turning Pishachs and is utterly horrified. How will Vidya cope with it?

episodesList.title: Pavitra's hospitality test!
episodesList.summary: Rani resolves to get the Maha Pishachini crown to become more powerful during Navaratri. Further, Pavitra serves the food and tries to convince the Rajputs to eat it. Will the Rajputs accept her hospitality?

episodesList.title: The Goddess empowers Pavitra
episodesList.summary: Pavitra's prayers are answered when the Goddess transfers a part of the light from the lighted lamp to Pavitra's forehead. Will this power help her defeat Rani?

episodesList.title: Pavitra protects Rocky
episodesList.summary: Pavitra wakes up from a nightmare to find a ball of fire floating in the air. Concerned about Rocky's safety, she aims her hand at the Agni Pataal and produces a protective layer to cover him. Can she hold it long enough?

episodesList.title: Rani runs out of time
episodesList.summary: Pavitra realises her true powers when Rocky throws a knife towards her, and thanks Matarani. Meanwhile, Rani runs out of time and needs to obtain Rocky by nightfall. Will Rani succeed in her mission?

episodesList.title: Rani's next ruse
episodesList.summary: Pavitra and Rocky participate in the holy ceremony, while Rani plots her next evil scheme. She dupes Pavitra by making Rocky invisible and focuses on another family member. Who will be Rani's next prey?

episodesList.title: Rani marries Sanchit!
episodesList.summary: Rocky, who is invisible, realises Rani is a Pishachini. Rani enters the house after marrying Sanchit, and he concocts a tale composed by her. How will Pavitra combat Rani now that she is one step ahead of her goal?

episodesList.title: Rocky gains a special power!
episodesList.summary: Rani prepares to become a Maha Pishachini after marrying Sanchit. However, when Pavitra gets worried about her family, Rocky gains a special power to help her. Will Rocky be able to stop Rani from carrying out her evil plans?

episodesList.title: Rani to become a Maha Pishachini!
episodesList.summary: As Rani's power grows, she begins the process of becoming a Maha Pishachini. However, Pavitra then realises the situation and prays for the family's safety. Will Pavitra be able to prevent Rani from becoming a Maha Pishachini?

episodesList.title: Pavitra destroys Rani's crown
episodesList.summary: Pavitra uses the trident of Goddess Durga to destroy the magical crown of Rani and stops her from becoming the Maha Pishachini. However, she soon realises that Ayodha was turned into a Pishach by Rani. Will she be able to save Ayodhya?

episodesList.title: Rocky receives dreadful news!
episodesList.summary: Rocky encounters mysterious flames after escaping Rani's trap. However, Rocky then discovers that the source of the flames is linked to the Pishach Lok, and the fire wishes for Rocky to become a Pishach. Will Rocky be able to find a solution?

episodesList.title: Rani challenges Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: Rocky's body temperature rises rapidly due to his connection to the Pishach Lok. However, when Pavitra attempts to help Rocky, Rani appears and challenges her. Will Pavitra be able to save Rocky before it's too late?

episodesList.title: A tough situation for Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: Pavitra finally finds a way to safeguard Rocky from the evil powers of the Pishach Lok. However, Pavitra grows concerned when she sees Nikita at the house as well. How will Pavitra protect Rocky and Nikita at the same time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra persuades Nikita
episodesList.summary: Pavitra worries about Rocky and wants to take him away but he refuses to leave Nikita alone. When Nikita sees her parents under Pishachini's control, she feels scared. Pavitra urges Nikita to leave as it is not safe. Will Rocky and Nikita be alright?

episodesList.title: Pavitra feels helpless!
episodesList.summary: Rocky accepts his fate and prepares to enter the Pishach Lok. Meanwhile, Pavitra feels helpless and grows determined to prevent Rocky from entering the Pishach Lok. Will Pavitra be successful in her endeavour?

episodesList.title: Pavitra waits for Rocky
episodesList.summary: While Pavitra and Vidya mourn Rocky's departure to Pishach Lok, Rocky's family notices his absence during the Karwa Chauth celebration. Pavitra gets prepared to perform the ritual and waits for Rocky's return. Will Rocky return to Pavitra ever?

episodesList.title: Rocky is subject to temptation
episodesList.summary: Rocky struggles while Pishachs from Pisach Lok try to lure him to the dark side. Distraught, Pavitra prays to Lord Hanuman for guidance. Will Pavitra manage to help Rocky return to the mortal realm?

episodesList.title: Rani hypnotises Shikha
episodesList.summary: While Rocky and Pavitra were about to consummate their marriage, Rani distracts them, and hypnotises Shikha to jump off the balcony. Hearing a loud scream, Rocky and Pavitra rush outside to find Shikha unconscious. Can they save her?

episodesList.title: Pavitra's plan to find the truth
episodesList.summary: Pavitra realises that Rani will not accept her defeat easily and that she must be planning something to get back at her. Pavitra plans to use Sanjit to find out about Rani's plans and to free him from her spell. Is Rani making any counter plans?

episodesList.title: Rocky intends to save Sanchit!
episodesList.summary: As Shikha invites Veer to her house, Pavitra becomes suspicious of Veer's actions. Meanwhile, Rocky meets Pavitra and intends to save Sanchit from Rani's black magic. Can Rocky do it?

episodesList.title: Pavitra to defeat Rani!
episodesList.summary: Rocky and Pavitra begin the process of rescuing Sanchit from Rani's black magic. Meanwhile, Pavitra needs Rani's belongings to finish the process of defeating her. Will Pavitra be able to obtain Rani's belongings on time?

episodesList.title: Rani attacks Sanchit!
episodesList.summary: Rocky and Pavitra eventually defeat Rani and liberate Sanchit from Rani's clutches. When Sanchit decides to reveal Rani's true identity to everyone, Rani attacks and attempts to kill him. Will Pavitra be able to keep Sanchit safe?

episodesList.title: Rocky-Pavitra's plan goes awry!
episodesList.summary: After Rani's death, Rocky and Pavitra return home, intending to reveal the truth to the family. However, they are shocked to find Rani at home alive. Furthermore, Rani makes a shocking announcement. What does Rani announce?

episodesList.title: Rani is taken aback!
episodesList.summary: When Sanchit's family expresses an interest in viewing Rani's child via sonography, Rani becomes concerned about her secret. Later, Rani is taken aback when Pavitra assists her in this situation. What's on Pavitra's mind?

episodesList.title: Game over for Rani
episodesList.summary: Rocky and Pavitra use Rani's child against her and trap them both in a tree for good. However, Rocky's family is not pleased to learn about the damage that has already been caused by Rani. Will they be able to start a new life after this?

episodesList.title: Vidya becomes suspicious!
episodesList.summary: As Rani is trapped, she gets anxious and attempts to free herself from the shackles. Meanwhile, Vidya becomes suspicious of Veer's unusual behaviour and informs Pavitra and Rocky about it. Will Pavitra and Rocky believe Vidya?

episodesList.title: Veer discovers his prey!
episodesList.summary: After revealing himself as a Maha Pishach, Veer discovers his prey in the Rajput family. Meanwhile, Pavitra finds Veer's nail in the forest and assumes the worst. Will Pavitra be able to discover Veer's true identity?

episodesList.title: Veer spins a yarn
episodesList.summary: Veer convinces Pavitra, Rocky and Vidya that he is the Nashak they have been looking for. Besides, Rani uses her power to melt Sapna's heart, causing her to free herself from the tree's grasp. Will her attempt prosper?

episodesList.title: Rani faces a challenge
episodesList.summary: While Rani devises a plan to free herself, Maha Pishach mocks her feeble attempt and challenges her to a fight. He promises to reward her with the Maha Pishachini crown if she wins the duel. Will she accept his challenge?

episodesList.title: Rocky helps Veer
episodesList.summary: Pavitra and Rocky are shocked to find Veer lying hurt inside Rani's enclosure. While Pavitra confronts Veer with a doubt, Rocky dismisses it and helps Veer get back on his feet. Will Pavitra insist on finding the truth?

episodesList.title: Pavitra gets astounded
episodesList.summary: Rocky gets worried and decides to follow Pavitra when the latter goes alone with Veer to trap the Maha Pishach. Later, Pavitra is astounded to learn about Veer's real identity. What will Pavitra do in such a terrible situation?

episodesList.title: Pavitra-Veer's face off!
episodesList.summary: As Pavitra reveals Veer's true identity, he tries to kill her in order to become a Maha Pishach. Later, Pavitra becomes enraged and attacks Veer. Will Pavitra be able to defeat Veer?

episodesList.title: Veer attacks Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: When Pavitra and Rocky attempt to defeat Veer, Nashak appears and assists them. Meanwhile, Veer uses his evil power to disappear Rocky and Nashak and attacks Pavitra to kill her. Will Pavitra be able to defend herself?

episodesList.title: Shikha seeks revenge!
episodesList.summary: As Pavitra kills Veer, Shikha becomes furious and decides to exact revenge on her. Meanwhile, Shikha approaches Rani, seeking her assistance in destroying Pavitra's happiness. Will Rani agree to help Shikha?

episodesList.title: Rani's manipulative move
episodesList.summary: Rani seeks Shikha's assistance and enters the house with the purpose of destroying the Rajput family. Further, Rani attempts to manipulate the family by making fake promises to live a peaceful life. Will the family believe Rani?

episodesList.title: Pavitra-Rocky are ambushed!
episodesList.summary: The Rajput family finds itself in a horrible scenario when a gang of Agni Betal attacks it. Elsewhere, Ayodhya attacks Sapna and Sudhakar at home. How will the family escape the terrifying situation?

episodesList.title: Rocky-Pavitra in great peril!
episodesList.summary: While Rocky and Pavitra find a safe place for the family, the duo sets off to find water amidst danger from Rani's army of Agni Vetaals. However, they get ambushed by the zombies! Is there a way for Rocky and Pavitra to escape to safety?

episodesList.title: Pavitra fights Rani
episodesList.summary: Rocky and Pavitra devise a plan to manipulate Rani in order to escape her terror. However, when Rani attacks Pavitra's family, Pavitra uses her divine powers to stop her. Will Pavitra succeed?

episodesList.title: Pavitra defends herself
episodesList.summary: Rani gets ready to kill Pavitra and orders the Agni Betals to attack her. Meanwhile, Pavitra defends herself by building a divine shield around herself. How long can Pavitra hold the shield?

episodesList.title: Rocky turns into a Betal!
episodesList.summary: As Rani prepares to kill Pavitra, Rocky takes the shocking decision to transform himself into the Agni Betal in order to save Pavitra. Will Rocky be able to save Pavitra from Rani's clutches in time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra to save Rocky's life?
episodesList.summary: As Rocky struggles to regain consciousness after his battle with the Agni Betals, Pavitra seeks Nashak's help to save Rocky's life by giving him Agni Tal drops. Will Pavitra be successful?

episodesList.title: Pavitra's emotional attempt!
episodesList.summary: While Rocky is unconscious, Pavitra tries to wake him by enticing him with her blood. However, when Rocky regains consciousness and attacks his family, Pavitra becomes emotional and tries to remind Rocky of his past. Will Pavitra's attempt succeed?

episodesList.title: Pavitra takes the blame
episodesList.summary: Shikha feels guilty for killing Sanchit accidentally and decides to confess her crime to the family. Meanwhile, Pavitra saves Shikha and takes the blame for Sanchit's death. What is the reason behind Pavitra's act?

episodesList.title: Pavitra to protect her family!
episodesList.summary: After Rani's departure from the house, Ayodhya wishes to become a Maha Pishach and forces his wish on his family. Meanwhile, Pavitra tries to protect her family through her divine powers. Will Pavitra be able to stop Ayodhya?

episodesList.title: Pavitra in deep trouble!
episodesList.summary: As Ayodhya in a Pishach form attacks the family through his evil powers, Pavitra risks her life to save her family and loses her senses. Later, the family attempts to save Pavitra. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Can Rocky save Pavitra?
episodesList.summary: While Pavitra freezes to death, Rocky embraces her, hoping his undying love will help revive her. With time ticking by, can Rocky succeed in helping Pavitra return to her normal self?

episodesList.title: Rocky completes his transformation
episodesList.summary: Rocky notices the injury spreading faster than expected and chooses to hide it from Pavitra. Meanwhile, Rani enters the house as Sariga and congratulates Rocky on his transformation. What does she have in store for him?

episodesList.title: Vidya gets trapped!
episodesList.summary: As Rani plans to manipulate the Rajput family as Sariga, Vidya gets suspicious of Sariga's actions and decides to confront her. However, Rani then appears in her real form and traps Vidya in the mirror. What will Vidya do in this tough situation?

episodesList.title: Pavitra faces a shocking scenario!
episodesList.summary: Rani executes her plan by trapping the Rajput family members in the mirror. Later, Pavitra is taken aback when she sees Rani and Rocky together and notices her family members showing support for Rani. How will Pavitra deal with this tragic situation?

episodesList.title: Rani prepares to marry Rocky!
episodesList.summary: As Rocky becomes the Agni Betal, Rani is overjoyed and prepares to marry him. Meanwhile, Pavitra becomes perplexed after learning about Rani's wedding to Rocky. Will Pavitra be able to discover the truth behind Rani's sudden move?

episodesList.title: Pavitra becomes powerless!
episodesList.summary: Rani intends to expand her evil powers as Rocky agrees to marry her. Meanwhile, Pavitra feels powerless against Rani's terror and resolves to find her family members at all costs. Will Rani be able to locate them in time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra gets a hope
episodesList.summary: Rani is about to spend quality time with Rocky, but Pavitra's signal interrupts her. Furthermore, Pavitra turns optimistic about freeing the Rajputs from Rani's clutches as her aunt helps her out. Will Pavitra be able to get them released?

episodesList.title: Can Pavitra save the Rajputs?
episodesList.summary: Unable to see or hear her family, Pavitra guides them on how to return to the mortal realm. However, they are overcome with fear seeing the perilous path. Will Pavitra be able to convince her family to take the risk?

episodesList.title: Vidya faces a tough situation
episodesList.summary: Pavitra attempts to rescue her family members from Rani's clutches. Meanwhile, as Vidya prepares to return to the mortal realm, Rani appears with the intention of killing her before she meets her family. What will Vidya do?

episodesList.title: A golden opportunity for Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: Rocky and Rani force the Rajput family members to work as slaves. Subsequently, when Rocky orders Pavitra to heal his wounds, Pavitra notices a divine book and decides to transform Rocky back into a human. Will Pavitra's plan work?

episodesList.title: Pavitra feels hopeful!
episodesList.summary: Pavitra discovers a clue in the divine book and becomes optimistic about transforming Rocky into a human. Following that, Pavitra approaches Nashak and asks for her assistance in her mission. Will Pavitra's efforts be successful this time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra gathers courage
episodesList.summary: Pavita gathers courage to inject the magical dose into Rocky's heart as he sleeps. To transform Rocky into a human, Pavitra seeks the family's cooperation. Will she be able to execute her plan?

episodesList.title: Pavitra faces obstacles
episodesList.summary: Pavitra makes the decision to cure Rocky and persuades her family to support her. While Pavitra manages to control Rocky and prepares to execute her plan, Rani appears before her. How will Pavitra manage the situation?

episodesList.title: Pavitra sets her plan in motion
episodesList.summary: While Rocky and Rani prepare for their wedding, Pavitra worries that he has fallen into a deadly trap. Meanwhile, the entire Rajput family participates in Pavitra's scheme to attack Rani. Will Pavitra's plan bear fruit?

episodesList.title: Pavitra faces a challenge
episodesList.summary: Rani locks Pavitra in her room and locks the doors using magic, but she forgets to lock the windows. Rocky assures Rani that Pavitra has a fear of heights and can't jump out of the windows, but Pavitra decides to overcome her fears. Can she escape?

episodesList.title: Rani becomes aggressive!
episodesList.summary: Pavitra and her family members attempt to cure Rocky by putting him to sleep. However, when Rani discovers Pavitra's intentions, she becomes furious and decides to stop her. Will Pavitra be able to carry out her plan in time?

episodesList.title: Pavitra needs a miracle
episodesList.summary: Pavitra takes help from everyone in the family and manages to acquire the serum that can turn Rocky back into a human. However, she has to inject the serum into Rocky's heart, and if she misses, he will die. Will Pavitra be able to hit the target?

episodesList.title: Rani forms an unbreakable cage
episodesList.summary: Rani forms an unbreakable cage around Pavitra and assigns fire-spitting snakes to guard her and her family against escaping. Later, Rani gets ready for her wedding with Rocky. Will Rocky save his loved ones?

episodesList.title: Pavitra finds a way out
episodesList.summary: Rocky breaks one of Rani's hairs without her knowledge and drops it inside the magical ring where Pavitra is trapped. Pavitra realises that the hair can be used to get out of the ring. Will she be able to stop Rani and Rocky's wedding?

episodesList.title: Pavitra is in trouble
episodesList.summary: While Rani tries to marry Rocky, everybody is shocked to see Pavithra standing with her eyes closed like a statue. The former elaborates on her ingenious plan for the family to destroy their hopes of saving the latter.

episodesList.title: Rocky makes a smart move!
episodesList.summary: Rani finally prepares to marry Rocky by putting Pavitra to sleep. Meanwhile, Rocky astonishes Rani by announcing his intention to marry Pavitra instead of her. How will Rani react to Rocky's shocking move?

episodesList.title: Will Pavitra come out?
episodesList.summary: The Rajput family members attack Rani with their potent weapons to reduce her evil power. Pavitra tries her best to come out from the world of an imaginary dream to save her family from Rani's evil act. Will Pavitra succeed in her effort?

episodesList.title: Pavitra takes a divine form
episodesList.summary: Kanika remains impotent and cries in pain after demon snakes attack her. Further, Pavitra rages in fury and takes a powerful Devi avatar to defeat the evil power. Will Rani be able to fight her divinity?

episodesList.title: Rocky is determined
episodesList.summary: Rocky consoles Pavitra as she has an emotional breakdown after Kanika's death. Later, when the Rajput family grows anxious about Rani's next move, Rocky decides to find her to destroy the evil power. What will happen to the Rajput family after that?

episodesList.title: Rani grows anxious
episodesList.summary: Rani is determined to fulfil her vile motives and summons Kapal Pishach to get a boon. Rani grows anxious when Kapal Pishach informs her about the dire circumstances of the procedure of penance. What will be Rani's decision now?

episodesList.title: Rani confronts Ayodhya
episodesList.summary: Vidya explains to her family the nature of shapeshifting powers and how to distinguish between a real person and an imposter. At the temple, Ayodhya encounters Rani, and she confronts him. Will Ayodhya be able to escape from her clutches?

episodesList.title: A shocker for the Rajputs
episodesList.summary: Rani forces Ayodhya to come out from the temple and swallows him. Later, Pavitra, Rocky, and Vidya are shocked after learning about Rani's evil deeds towards Ayodhya. Will Pavitra be able to avenge Ayodhya's death?

episodesList.title: Rani enters Pavitra's house
episodesList.summary: Pavitra decides to stay away from the family for its safety. However, her family unites to save her, and takes all measures to keep the house protected from Rani. What will they do when Rani breaks all the lines and enters?

episodesList.title: Rani to sacrifice Pavitra?
episodesList.summary: Rani kidnaps Pavitra and takes her to Pisach Devta. To keep her promise, Rani goes ahead to sacrifice Pavitra to please the Devta! On learning about the whole truth, will Rocky reach the place to save Pavitra?

episodesList.title: Rani saves Pavitra!
episodesList.summary: Pavitra gets shocked when Rani saves her from Pishach Devta to fulfil her own evil motive. Elsewhere, Rocky finds a Divya Yantra to bring back Pavitra and Vidya from Rani's clutches. Will Rocky be able to bring them safely?

episodesList.title: Pavitra to fight against Rani
episodesList.summary: The Rajput family confronts Rani to fight against Rani's evil power. Pavitra feels shattered and seeks help from God when Rani swallows the Rajput family members one by one. Will Pavitra be able to fight against this terrifying form of Rani?

plotHtml:
The show is set against the backdrop of Bareilly where a beautiful girl (actually a Pishachini) named Rani, seeks revenge from the Rajput family for settling on her land. Rani was an evil and greedy woman when she was a human but due to her misdeeds and murders, she was cursed to become a Pishachini after her death. She wants to destroy the Rajputs and use their blood to bring her child to life, who will become the most powerful Pishacha as it will be a crossbreed of a demon and human. But a divine power rises to stop her from winning. It is the granddaughter of the priest (Pandit Ji or Nanu) who had imprisoned Rani in a box years ago, Pavitra, who now lives in London after Rani's curse killed most of her family except her aunt Kanika, who raised her. Pavitra has the mark of Lord Hanuman on her hand which actually has many hidden powers she is still not aware of. Rani escaped from the box after some tim3 of her imprisonment, by tempting the younger son of the Rajput family, Prateek and manipulated his greed for money as Pishachinis can grant any wish but the price paid for that deal is very horrible, which is the reason why the Rajputs do not speak with him and his wife Amrita anymore. But his daughter, Nikita, is getting married, whose friend is Pavitra and she is forced to come to India, where she meets Rakshit (Rocky), the grandson of the Rajput family, and he takes an instant liking towards her but she does not immediately reciprocate his feelings.
The Rajputs reach Chail for the wedding while Rani enchants Rocky as she wants to impregnate herself with his child and become the most powerful dark entity. Pavitra senses something is wrong and Ayodhya, Rocky's grandfather who knows Rani's truth, is attacked by her and is left paralyzed. Rani manipulates Rocky's sister Shikha and promises to cure the scar on her face if she is taken back to Bareilly where her original land is. Pavitra follows them as she knows about her Nanu's past and his relation with the Pishachini, which claimed her family and she does not want the same fate to be repeated with any other family and hence wants to protect them from the Pishachini, who is disguised as a normal human amongst them. Rani enters the household as a prospective bride for Rocky and he agrees to marry her as he falls for her delusions.
Pavitra collects clues and pieces them together to unearth that Rani is indeed the Pishachini she is looking for and she is the evil entity her Nanu had asked her to destroy before taking his last breathe, and she must stop her from marrying Rocky before it is too late. Pavitra makes various attempts to expose Rani but no one believes her as all her plans fail due to Rani's wicked conspiracies. Rocky does not trust her claims either and asks her to leave India. To protect Rocky from Rani and to thwart all her ulterior motives, Pavitra marries him herself under the veil to everyone's shock. The Rajputs do not accept the marriage, and Rocky, after some initial hesitation, agrees to take Pavitra as his wife. Rani vows to defeat Pavitra and their fight begins. Rani tricks Pavitra and marries Rocky's elder brother Sanchit by enchanting him and faking the death of her parents and sister. She becomes pregnant, and Pavitra must find a way to end her. To her horror, Ayodhya is also transformed into a Pishacha as are Prateek and Amrita, the couple dies but Ayodhya survives and continues to help Rani and fool everyone. Rani starts manipulating everyone against Pavitra to oust her from the house but she retaliates and Rani's truth is exposed to Rocky who apologizes to Pavitra, and agrees to help her defeat Rani. Pavitra starts discovering her powers and learns that she is the only one capable of killing the Pishachini. Rani's plot of acquiring the Maha-Pishacha crown (to become the strongest Pishacha) on Dusshera is foiled by Pavitra who gains the divine powers of the Goddess Durga and uses a trident to break the crown. Rocky becomes invisible and disappears later on into the Pishacha world but Pavitra, who realizes she has fallen in love with him, brings him back and they unite. They free Sanchit from Rani's control and use the unborn child of Rani as a bait to trap her and unveil her reality to the rest of the family. The Rajputs are shocked when they realize Rani's truth and apologize to Pavitra for not trusting her earlier and even humiliating her at many instances, while she was fighting to protect them all this time.
Rani is trapped to a tree and the Rajputs think they won but then Maha-Pishacha comes to the house to take Pavitra and sacrifice her to dark forces so that he can gain infinite powers, in the disguise of Shikha's boyfriend, Veer. Rocky realizes Veer's truth and he rushes to rescue Pavitra who has embarked on a journey with Veer, not knowing that he wants to kill her. Rocky gets help from an unexpected source, the Nashak, who knows about the evil forces and how to stop them, and the Nashak is revealed to be Pavitra's aunt, Kanika. Kanika and Rocky encourage Pavitra when she falls weak in front of Maha Pishacha's power but she rises again and kills him. Shikha is hurt after Veer's death and blames Pavitra even after knowing he was evil and blindly agrees to release Rani to get revenge from Pavitra. Rani returns and pretends to have changed and takes the family to a lava pool to test her purity, which is actually a trap and they get surrounded by Agni Vetaals who are zombie-like creatures. Pavitra gains divine help and defeats the Vetaals to protect her family but Rocky gets bitten by one and is infected and starts becoming an Agni Vetaal himself. Kanika heals him temporarily while Rani is locked inside a cave by Pavitra after the battle. Sanchit dies due to Shikha's mistake and Pavitra takes the blame on herself to save Shikha, who realizes she was wrong for helping Rani as Pavitra did nothing unjust ever. The Pishacha Ayodhya is released as well by Sudhakar and Sapna accidentally and he puts Pavitra under a trance like state through a spell but Rocky's true love brings her back into consciousness. The real Ayodhya is separated from the Pishacha one and the latter is annihilated but Rani returns to the house disguised as Sanchit's friend Shreya to mourn his death, as she gained the powers of a Sarp or a shapeshifting snake from the cave Pavitra had trapped her in. She tricks everyone and transforms Rocky into an Agni Vetaal and he forgets his real self and past memories and agrees to marry Rani, mistreating his family members and denying his love for Pavitra.
Pavitra loses Rocky and her family is also pushed behind a mirror world by Rani, and she feels helpless. But Kanika fills her with confidence and she agrees to revive Rocky into a human again, rescue her family and end Rani. After much struggle, the Rajput family reunites and they trick Rani and kill her helper Mandy, a shapeshifting frog. They are also able to heal Rocky who becomes a human again and he reunites with Pavitra. The family makes a trap for Rani during the wedding rituals. Rani unleashes her terror and her snake ally tries to consume the Rajputs, but then Pavitra takes the form of Goddess Durga and kills the giant snake. Rani's unborn child also does not take her side and turns against her, Rani is forced to escape once she realizes she has been overpowered. Kanika dies while protecting Rocky's younger cousin Vidya and gives her Nashak powers to Vidya. Vidya becomes the next Nashak and helps Pavitra and Rocky to find a way to kill Rani once and for all. Rani kills the Pishacha Devata and becomes a ten-headed Pralaya Pishachini (the ultimate and the most destructive Pishachini) and ends up taking Ayodhya's life. Pavitra will not let Rani take away any of her loved ones again and prepares to fight her, even agreeing to sacrifice herself for their sake. There is one final confrontation between Pavitra, Rocky, Nashak (Vidya), all the remaining Rajputs and the Pralaya Pishachini. Rocky earns magical wings due to Lord Hanuman's blessings and at last Rani is vanquished by Pavitra and the Rajputs after a prolonged battle, when Pavitra attacks the back of Rani's head where her mortal wound was concealed. The Rajputs celebrate their victory over the dark force that has been haunting them for years. Rocky and Pavitra adopt Sanchit and Rani's Pishacha child as their own and are blessed with their own daughter later on. Everything seems to be going good and positive for the family, but dark forces once again descend on earth to claim Rani's daughter.
tagline: The show is set against the backdrop of Bareilly where a beautiful girl (actually a Pishachini) named Rani, seeks revenge from the Rajput family for settling on her land.

title: Paper Rocket
summary:
Paper Rocket is an Indian drama streaming television web series written and directed by Kiruthiga Udhayanidhi and produced by Sreenidhi Sagar under his banner Rise East Productions. The series stars Kalidas Jayaram and Tanya Ravichandran in the lead roles. Music and background score was composed by Simon K King. Cinematography handled by Richard M Nathan, Gavemic U Ary (one episode) and editing was done by Lawrence Kishore.
The series was premiered on the 29 July 2022 exclusively on ZEE5.

title: Pushpa Impossible
summary: Pushpa Impossible is an Indian television drama series produced by Jamnadas Majethia under Hats Off Productions. The series stars Karuna Pandey Vaidya in the titular role and premiered on 6 June 2022 on Sony SAB and digitally streams on SonyLIV.
plot: The story revolves around Pushpa Randeriya Patel, a 45-year-old woman from Patan, who lives in the Bapodra Chawl of Mumbai with her children: Ashwin, Chirag, and Rashi. The show also focuses the life of Swara, an orphan whom Ashwin and Deepti adopted.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Karuna Pandey Vaidya as Pushpa Randeriya – Ashwin, Chirag, and Rashi's mother; Dilip's ex-wife; Swara's adoptive grandmother (2022–present) ** Hansika Jangid portrayed as young Pushpa in 2022 later Snigdha Suman portrayed as young Pushpa (2022–present) ** Vaidya also portrayed Basanti Gupta: Pushpa's lookalike; Shikhar's ex-girlfriend (2024) * Naveen Pandita as Ashwin Patel – Pushpa and Dilip's elder son; Chirag and Rashi's brother; Deepti's husband; Ansh and Titli's biological father; Swara's adoptive father. (2022–2025) ** Samridh Bawa replaced Pandita as Ashwin (2025–present) ** Abhay Pratap Yadav as young Ashwin (2022; 2023) * Darshan Gurjar as Chirag Patel – Pushpa and Dilip's younger son; Ashwin and Rashi's brother; Prarthana's widower; Shanaya Husband(2022–2025) ** Riyansh Ayer as young Chirag (2022; 2023) * Deshna Dugad as Rashi Patel Trivedi – Pushpa and Dilip's daughter; Ashwin and Chirag's sister; Rishabh's ex-wife; Badshah's wife (2026–present) * Hitul Pujara as Saurabh Trivedi a.k.a. Badshah - Ravi, Badri and Panki's elder brother; Rashi's Second husband (2024–2025) ** Siddharth Vakil replaced Pujara as Saurabh. (2026-present)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Karuna Pandey Vaidya, Naveen Pandita, Deshna Dugad and Darshan Gurjar were cast in the leading characters of Pushpa Randeriya Patel, Ashwin Patel, Rashi Patel and Chirag Patel. In September 2025, Pandita quit the series, replaced by Samridh Bawa. In October 2025, the show took a six year leap following which many actors quit the show which included Garima Parihar, Darshan Gurjar, Indraxi Kanjilal and Deshna Dugad.

articleSections.title: Crossovers
articleSections.text:
Pushpa Impossible had multiple crossovers with Wagle Ki Duniya – Nayi Peedhi Naye Kissey, from 12 September 2022 to 13 September 2022, on 1 July 2023, on 9 September 2024 and on 14 September 2024.
It had a crossover with Itti Si Khushi from 24 September 2025 to 26 September 2025.

episodesList.title: Meeting The Principal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa has a big breakfast order to make and finds out that the gas supply has been shut. She does what she can and completes the order but ends up paying a fine for it to Bapodara. Later in the day, she goes to meet Chirag’s college principal as she was called there but finds out that Chirag has brought somebody else as his father.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Promise
episodesList.summary: Sonal calls Pushpa to her house to cook for the party as she is worried about the food for her guests. Though Pushpa recommends somebody else but ends up going there to fulfil her promise. Meanwhile, Rashi doesn't do well in her school.

episodesList.title: Ladki Wale Aa Rahe
episodesList.summary: Dipti finds out that Pushpa has left without taking money. Pushpa on the other hand is excited to welcome Dipti’s parents home. While she is busy with all the preps she gets tempted to play the last over of cricket as there is still some time for Dipti’s family to arrive.

episodesList.title: Rashi's Results
episodesList.summary: Deepti's parents discourage her from getting married to a family that can't keep up with them financially. Meanwhile, Pushpa goes to Rashi's school to discuss Rashi's results.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Apologises
episodesList.summary: Pushpa goes to meet Deepti in the middle of the night and apologises for what had happened the day before. Meanwhile, Chirag gets in trouble with his friends due to some money-related issues. Will Deepti forgive Pushpa?

episodesList.title: Chirag's Gambling Habit
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out about Chirag's gambling habit and scolds him. She makes it clear that she will forgive him this time but she expects him to repay her by himself. Later, Pushpa and Ashwin go to meet Deepti's family.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Bangles
episodesList.summary: Chirag is worried about returning the money that he lost in gambling and thinks of selling Pushpa's bangles to return the money. Meanwhile, Pushpa gives her bangles to Ashwin for his marriage. How will Chirag repay the money?

episodesList.title: Engagement Ceremony
episodesList.summary: It's Deepti and Ashwin's engagement ceremony in the chawl and Pushpa organizes an entertaining show for the guests. Will the ceremony go as planned?

episodesList.title: Chirag's Police Case
episodesList.summary: After coming to know about Chirag's police case, Deepti's parents wonder if they made the right decision by allowing her to marry Ashwin. Meanwhile, Chirag promises Pushpa that he had nothing to do with the leak of the question papers.

episodesList.title: Kya Chirag Nirdosh Hai?
episodesList.summary: The Police reach the Chawl to give a verdict on Chirag's case. Is Chirag innocent or guilty?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Safety Net
episodesList.summary: Pushpa refuses Deepti's help to pay Rashi's coaching class fees. What route will she take for the sake of her children?

episodesList.title: Pani Ke Liye Ladai
episodesList.summary: Pushpa delivers the money required to Rashi's coaching classes on time. She later takes the fight to the Assistant Commissioner for the shortage of water at their chawl.

episodesList.title: Chawl Mein Adjust
episodesList.summary: Pushpa talks to Rashi about focusing on her future and staying away from boys. Meanwhile, Deepti's parents and Ashwin are worried about Deepti moving into the chawl and struggling to adjust there.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Makes It Right
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tries to find a part-time job to help her family with some extra income. She later visits the Assistant Commissioner to apologise for her behaviour. Will she succeed in solving the water crisis at the chawl?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Takes Up The Challenge
episodesList.summary: Ashwin steps up in the office meeting and promises to deliver the report in 3 days. Will he be able to deliver?

episodesList.title: Nanavati Ji Se Mulaqat
episodesList.summary: Rashi gets inspired by one of the trustees of the school board and Pushpa decides to meet him. Meanwhile, Ashwin is confident about his preparations for his presentation.

episodesList.title: Sab Kuch Pushpa Ki Galti?
episodesList.summary: Rashi is upset that Pushpa went to meet her Principal in private. Meanwhile, Ashwin accuses Pushpa of deleting his important files. Will he be able to present the report on time?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Certificates
episodesList.summary: Pushpa feels nostalgic to visit her home town and meet her teacher. She gets her mark sheets and school leaving certificate with the hopes to continue her education.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Admission
episodesList.summary: Deepti gets a promotion because of the presentation created by Ashwin. Meanwhile, Pushpa is delighted to get her old certificates and have a shot at going back to school.

episodesList.title: Meeting Ke Liye Late?
episodesList.summary: Rashi hides Pushpa's phone so that she misses her meeting with the school trustees. Will she be able to make it on time?

episodesList.title: Iss Umar Mein School?
episodesList.summary: A huge commotion takes place outside Pushpa's chawl as everyone comes to know about her plans to continue her education. Will she be able to convince everyone?

episodesList.title: Meeting The Trustees
episodesList.summary: Pushpa meets the board and the trustees and puts her case forward. Will her dream of being educated be fulfilled?

episodesList.title: Ek Nayi Soch
episodesList.summary: Pushpa bonds with Sharan without knowing who he is. Will his decision get influenced because of this interaction?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Excitement For School
episodesList.summary: Rashi fears the embarrassment she will face when Pushpa joins the same class. Pushpa can't contain her excitement about getting the opportunity to complete her education.

episodesList.title: School Ka Pehla Din
episodesList.summary: It's Pushpa's first day in school and the students are confused to see an adult in their class. Will everything go smoothly for Pushpa?

episodesList.title: Safalta Ki Pehli Seedhi
episodesList.summary: The teachers and the board members wonder if they made the right decision by letting Pushpa study in the school. Pushpa promises Mr Nanavati that she will not let him down and will overcome every obstacle that comes her way.

episodesList.title: Kya Pushpa Ne Maani Haar?
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gives up on her dream of being educated due to external pressure. Her sons are now determined to do whatever it takes to ensure that she returns to school.

episodesList.title: Negotiating With Rashi
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati takes in Pushpa's advice and negotiates with Rashi the way Pushpa had briefed him. Will he be able to crack a deal with her?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Crosses The Line
episodesList.summary: Bapodara accuses Chirag of stealing his shirt and then proceeds to insult Pushpa. Will Pushpa make it to school with all the obstacles on the way?

episodesList.title: Pita Hone Ka Farz
episodesList.summary: Chirag feels guilty for everything that happened to Munna. Sonal and Harish stop by Pushpa's house to discuss Dipti and Ashwin's wedding.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Begins Her Education
episodesList.summary: Bapodara feels insulted because of the slap he received in front of everyone in the chawl and starts plotting revenge. Meanwhile, Pushpa starts doing better in her class and becomes more proactive.

episodesList.title: Eviction Notice
episodesList.summary: Pushpa struggles in class due to the language barrier even though she knows the answers. Later, she receives a shocking eviction notice from Bapodara.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Keeps On Fighting
episodesList.summary: As the wedding day inches closer, Pushpa is put in a fix with the eviction notice. Deepti and Ashwin show trust in Pushpa to save their house. But will managing life, along with school and the wedding prove to be too much for Pushpa?

episodesList.title: Sharan Helps Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Sharan decides to help Pushpa in preparing for her test and motivates her to take small steps towards her success. Meanwhile, Bapodara continues to harass Pushpa and her family.

episodesList.title: The Legal Battle
episodesList.summary: Pushpa receives advice on how to fight her legal battles against Bapodara. Meanwhile, Nanavati tells Pushpa that her verbal knowledge is fine but she needs to work on her written skills.

episodesList.title: Koshish Karte Rehna Chahiye
episodesList.summary: Rashi tries to find a way to deal with Aryan at school. Chirag entrusts Prarthana to come through at the end and support the truth.

episodesList.title: Test Ki Taiyyari
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds an ingenious way to study for her exam and make sure she passes in the limited amount of time given to her. Will her plan work?

episodesList.title: Bappa Pe Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Rashi get late for their test and leave home in a hurry. Meanwhile, Chirag tries to gather concrete evidence against Bapodara.

episodesList.title: Rashi Kaha Hai?
episodesList.summary: Pushpa struggles to find Rashi after discovering that she skipped her classes. Meanwhile, the lawyer informs Pushpa that their appeal for a stay order has been rejected by the court.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ke Khilaaf Saboot
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and her lawyer try and think of ways to make their appeal stronger in court. Meanwhile, Rashi ends up at Aryan's party, where she feels out of place.

episodesList.title: Dubai Mein Naukri
episodesList.summary: Bhaskar suggests that Ashwin move to Dubai and secure his family's finances but Ashwin cites family and personal issues. Later, the family celebrates Asavri and Bhaskar's anniversary.

episodesList.title: The Results Are Out
episodesList.summary: Pushpa barely passes the examination and gets inspired to perform well in her future tests. With Rashi remaining silent about her worries, Pushpa finds another way to inspire her.

episodesList.title: Rishte Mein Nok Jhok
episodesList.summary: Deepti and Ashwin look at Asavri and Bhaskar and become hopeful about their marriage. Meanwhile, Aryan threatens Rashi and demands that she apologises to him.

episodesList.title: Susheela To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Sharan gives Rashi some life lessons in his own cryptic way. Meanwhile, Susheela surprises Pushpa by handing her the property documents. How handy will these papers come in the case?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ki Shopping
episodesList.summary: Susheela gets kicked out of the house by Bapodara and Pushpa holds herself responsible for this. Later, Pushpa and Ashwin go shopping with Deepti and her family for the wedding. Will Pushpa's financial constraints hold her back?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Pushpa goes shopping with her in-laws and gets emotional when she sees the Saree she had sold earlier. Later, Pushpa talks about her moral dilemma in the case against Bapodara.

episodesList.title: Bapodara's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Susheela's absence starts to bother Bapodara but he isn't ready to admit his mistake. Meanwhile, Rashi agrees to apologise to Aryan.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Ikka
episodesList.summary: Chirag goes from home to home to record statements of all the residents in the chawl. Pushpa offers to give away her advantage in court if Bapodra apologises to Susheela and gets her back home.

episodesList.title: Rashi In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rashi reaches Bandra, where Aryan had called her to come and apologise. Pushpa gets informed about this by Rashi's friends, and she rushes to the location. Will Pushpa miss her court date because of this?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Clip
episodesList.summary: Aryan circulates the clip where Rashi seems to be holding an alcoholic beverage. This creates controversy in school and Rashi gets called in to talk with the board members. Will Rashi's name get cleared?

episodesList.title: Rashi Clears Her Name
episodesList.summary: Rashi is proven innocent and Pushpa feels extremely proud of her daughter. But will her decision to skip the court date haunt her in the future?

episodesList.title: Boss Ka Dabav
episodesList.summary: Ashwin finds out that his boss is Aryan's father. He gets pressured to ask Rashi to forgive Aryan. How will Ashwin react to this?

episodesList.title: Court Ki Ladai
episodesList.summary: Bapodara and Pushpa fight it out in court. Will the legal system give Pushpa the justice she deserves?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Eviction
episodesList.summary: The judge rules in Bapodara's favour and orders that Pushpa vacates the house. With a heavy heart, Pushpa and her family pack their belongings and say goodbye to all their neighbours.

episodesList.title: Haq Ki Ladai
episodesList.summary: Bapodara objects to Pushpa staying in Radha Tai's house after her eviction. He threatens Radha Tai not to cross her limits again. Will Pushpa find a way to get her house back?

episodesList.title: No Plan B
episodesList.summary: Pushpa waits outside the chawl with her belongings, waiting to shift it to Ashwin's quarters. However, Ashwin gathers the courage to tell her that he has lost his job and quarter. Will Pushpa find a way?

episodesList.title: A Night Without A House
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and her family spend the night outside without a roof over their heads. However, this doesn't stop the family from keeping a positive approach to the situation. Meanwhile, Deepti tries to convince Rashi to stay at her house.

episodesList.title: Aangan Bana Ghar
episodesList.summary: Ashwin is eager to find out who sabotaged his professional career. Meanwhile, Rashi moves into Deepti's house and receives a warm welcome.

episodesList.title: Suspension Ki Khabar
episodesList.summary: Bapodara creates a scene in the chawl as he tries to humiliate Pushpa and her family for Ashwin's suspension. Meanwhile, Ashwin receives some shocking news from Deepti.

episodesList.title: Choti Choti Problems
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanawati arrives at the chawl and inspires Pushpa and her family not to give up. Pushpa rejoins the school and the rest of her family begins to reclaim their lives.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Aur Damini Ki Mulaqaat
episodesList.summary: Deepti and Ashwin attempt to infiltrate the office and dig up more on the conspiracy against them. Meanwhile, Pushpa bumps into Damini Mehra, one of the best lawyers in town.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ki Tasveer
episodesList.summary: Bapodara finds Prarthana's portrait and asks to meet the artist, putting her in a tricky situation. Meanwhile, Deepti and Ashwin make progress on their investigation.

episodesList.title: Pita Ki Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Rashi's class discuss the role of a father in modern society. Meanwhile, Bhaskar and Asavri dig up more on Mr Bharadwaj.

episodesList.title: Pita Ki Kami
episodesList.summary: Pushpa blames herself for not being able to provide enough for her children but Radha Tai's words of encouragement give her hope. Meanwhile, Pushpa's unique method of remembering mathematical equations amazes the teacher and the class.

episodesList.title: Damini Mehra Offers Help
episodesList.summary: As Damini and Pushpa meet again under strange circumstances, Damini offers to help Pushpa fight her case. How will Pushpa react to this?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Learns New Things
episodesList.summary: Pushpa takes Radha Tai's help and learns about the great reformists who shaped modern society and fought for women's rights.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Decision
episodesList.summary: Ashwin takes a radical step and decides to move to Dubai with Bhaskar for some time. How will Pushpa react to this?

episodesList.title: Damini Fights Back
episodesList.summary: Damini makes some strong arguments against Bapodara in court and invites the person who made the contract for Bapodara 17 years ago, to the witness box.

episodesList.title: Adalat Ka Faisla
episodesList.summary: Damini puts forward all her arguments and makes a strong case for Pushpa. Will the court rule in favour of her?

episodesList.title: Chirag Ki Naukri
episodesList.summary: The family celebrates as Chirag gets a part-time job at the police station as a sketch artist. Meanwhile, Pushpa goes to the police station for Bapodara's bail.

episodesList.title: Judaai Ka Gum
episodesList.summary: Bapodara comes home after getting bailed out by Pushpa. Meanwhile, Ashwin is in a dilemma as he gets a job in Dubai.

episodesList.title: Rishton Mein Daraarein
episodesList.summary: Deepti's and Ashwin's relationship gets bitter after Ashwin considers moving to Dubai. Will their issues get resolved?

episodesList.title: Shadi Postponed?
episodesList.summary: Bhaskar leaves for Dubai, leaving everyone teary-eyed. Meanwhile, Deepti's Parents suggest postponing the wedding.

episodesList.title: Digital Records
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Deepti make progress in their investigation and have a major breakthrough. Will they be able to prove their innocence?

episodesList.title: Family Lunch
episodesList.summary: Pushpa invites Deepti and her family for lunch as the family celebrates the couple. Meanwhile, Chirag goes to Bapodara's house as Chirag Gokhale, the sketch artist.

episodesList.title: Parents Ka Objection
episodesList.summary: The parents of the students object to Pushpa studying in the school. Even Mr Nanavati considers rusticating Pushpa to save the other students. Will Pushpa find a solution to this?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Education in Danger
episodesList.summary: The parents object to Pushpa studying in the school and also demand that Aryan's suspension gets revoked. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Fate
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati gets pressurised by the parents and the board to remove Pushpa from the school. Will he succumb to the pressure?

episodesList.title: Aakhri Ke Do Hafte
episodesList.summary: Nanavati Ji breaks the news to Pushpa that the trustees have decided to revoke her admission. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Mock Papers
episodesList.summary: Pushpa struggles to prepare for her test, but Sharan provides her with all the material she needs. Will she ace her test?

episodesList.title: Mock Test Ka Result
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Rashi attempt a mock test in preparation for the real test. Later, Rashi stands up for her mother in school.

episodesList.title: Surprise Party
episodesList.summary: Pushpa plans a surprise party for Mahendra on the terrace. Will everything go according to plan?

episodesList.title: Terrace Ki Confusion
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Ashwin's plans coincide, which creates a huge confusion in the colony. Will things get resolved?

episodesList.title: Mock Fire Drill
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is surprised to see a mock fire drill in school and starts panicking. Later, she gets an order for laddoos from Dakshesh. Will she be able to deliver?

episodesList.title: Golu Returns
episodesList.summary: Golu returns to the colony, to everyone's relief. Later, Pushpa impresses her in-laws with her clear chain of thought regarding reforms in the education system.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Inspiring People
episodesList.summary: Deepti's mother speaks to her family about how Pushpa has inspired people to pursue their dreams and aspirations. Meanwhile, Bapodara opens up about his history with Pushpa's husband.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Management Skills
episodesList.summary: It's the day of the test and time for Pushpa to prove herself to everyone who doubted her. Will Pushpa pass the test?

episodesList.title: P.C Creations
episodesList.summary: A bunch of students get food poisoning while attempting the exam, and Pushpa decides to miss the exam to help the kids. However, this selfless act puts Pushpa's future in jeopardy.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Retest
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati tries to convince the parents to speak in favour of Pushpa and allow her to sit for the retest. Meanwhile, Bapodara allows Chirag to start his business in the Chawl.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Shop Opening
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the Chawl is excited for Chirag and his Art shop's opening. Will Bapodara create trouble, or will everything go as planned?

episodesList.title: Results Ka Din
episodesList.summary: It's the day that everyone has been eagerly waiting for. Will Pushpa and Rashi pass the test?

episodesList.title: Vriddhashram
episodesList.summary: Rashi gets an assignment on the status of old-age homes in the city. Later, Chirag tricks Bapodara into buying one of his sketches.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ki Taiyaari
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Deepti's families are excited about planning their wedding, but they struggle to find a middle ground. Can this dispute be solved?

episodesList.title: Karma Ka Phal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa struggles to deal with the grief caused by the unfortunate test results. Meanwhile, Bapodara arranges for an art promoter and helps Chirag unknowingly.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Padhai Jaari Rahegi
episodesList.summary: The society members take Pushpa's side and volunteer to help her with her education. Meanwhile, the preparation for Ashwin and Deepti's marriage continues, as the couple considers doing a court marriage.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ka Renovation
episodesList.summary: Sonal decides to redo Pushpa's house and change its aesthetics. Meanwhile, Chirag gets depressed as he struggles to complete the order and finish all the sketches.

episodesList.title: Khushiyon Ki Barsaat
episodesList.summary: Everything starts falling in place for Pushpa as Chirag gets a taste of success with his art assignments. Meanwhile, Mr Nanavati decides to give Pushpa a special project. Will Pushpa accept it?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's New Role
episodesList.summary: Pushpa prepares herself to take over the canteen responsibility in the school. Meanwhile, Aryan meets Pushpa in private and begs for forgiveness. Will Pushpa give him a second chance?

episodesList.title: Helping Aryan
episodesList.summary: Rashi isn't pleased about the fact that Pushpa is helping Aryan. Pushpa talks to Mr Nanavati about reconsidering Aryan's suspension. Will he agree?

episodesList.title: Police Complaint Against Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Aryan goes missing from his home, and his father threatens to file a police complaint against Pushpa. Meanwhile, Pushpa continues preparations for Ashwin's wedding.

episodesList.title: Aryan's Second Chance
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati finds Aryan and brings him to the police station. Meanwhile, Pushpa and the others motivate Neelima to stand up against her abusive husband.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Soft Spot
episodesList.summary: Ashwin yells at Rashi for misbehaving with Pushpa. Meanwhile, Sonal leaves her home after getting into a fight with her husband and arrives at Pushpa's chawl.

episodesList.title: Rishton Ka Santulan
episodesList.summary: Sonal takes advice from Pushpa regarding her fight with her husband. Later, she gets attacked by Nilima's inebriated husband. How will she adapt to the life in the chawl?

episodesList.title: Chawl Ka Ecosystem
episodesList.summary: Sonal experiences the ecosystem that sustains life in the Chawl and gains immense respect for Pushpa for being able to study here. Meanwhile, Mr Nanavati tells Pushpa that she might get an opportunity to go to Canada.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Return
