episodesList.summary: Pushpa's return to school would mean that the school would receive a substantial grant. Will she come back?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Shart
episodesList.summary: Pushpa agrees to rejoin the school only on the condition that she passes the test. Will Pushpa succeed this time?

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Aggression
episodesList.summary: Ashwin beats up two thugs who try to harass Deepti. Meanwhile, Pushpa begins her preparation for the upcoming test.

episodesList.title: Punya Tithi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa celebrates Dussehra with all the other members of the Chawl. Meanwhile, Pushpa's guru pays her a special visit.

episodesList.title: Dussehra Celebrations
episodesList.summary: It's a festive mood at the chawl as everyone prepares for Dussehra celebrations. But things take a sharp turn when Nilima's husband attacks her again in an inebriated state. Who will come to her rescue?

episodesList.title: Ramesh In ICU
episodesList.summary: Ramesh gets rushed to the hospital after being hit on the head by Nilima. Meanwhile, Bapodara blames Pushpa for everything and tries to stay away from the police investigation.

episodesList.title: Court Kachehri Ka Chakkar
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets thrown a curveball because of the court case regarding Nilima's husband. Who will come out to support her during these tough times?

episodesList.title: Nilima's Case
episodesList.summary: Rashi starts to lose herself in the process of punishing Aryan. Pushpa continues preparing for the test while helping Nilima with her case.

episodesList.title: Pranav Returns
episodesList.summary: Radha Tai's son lands up at home with his wife, and he expects to be treated as if nothing has happened. Meanwhile, Deepti tries to convince her mother to give her statement in court.

episodesList.title: Chirag In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Pushpa writes her test and stops worrying about her results. Meanwhile, the police ask Nilima to stand in front of her husband after he gains consciousness.

episodesList.title: Pranav's Divorce
episodesList.summary: Radha Tai gets shocked to hear that Pranav has asked for a divorce from his wife. Meanwhile, Pushpa prepares herself to get her test results.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Result
episodesList.summary: Pushpa prepares herself to get her test results which will determine her future in the school. Meanwhile, Chirag's artwork gets selected for an art competition where Bapodara is the chief guest. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Kya Chirag Ka Bhanda Phootega?
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets into a tricky situation as Bapodara turns up as the chief guest for an award ceremony where Chirag was being awarded for his artwork. Will Bapodara find out that Chirag Gokhale is Chirag Patel?

episodesList.title: Chirag Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets caught by Bapodara at the award ceremony. Bapodara accuses Chirag of stealing Gokhale's identity and taking the award for himself. Will Chirag be able to steer clear of this new problem?

episodesList.title: Buri Sangat
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets upset that Pushpa didn't defend his father when Bapodara was insulting him and calling him a fraud. Meanwhile, Bapodara decides to send Prarthana away to stop her from meeting Chirag.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Celebrates Diwali
episodesList.summary: It's a festive mood in the Chawl as Pushpa and her neighbours celebrate Diwali. Meanwhile, Bapodara pays a visit to Ramesh at the hospital. What could be the reason behind this visit?

episodesList.title: Nilima Ki Sunwai
episodesList.summary: Sonal finally changes her mind and agrees to give her statement against Nilima's husband during the court hearing. Meanwhile, Bapodara decides to send Prarthana to Junagadh and keep her away from Chirag.

episodesList.title: Hostel Ya Pune?
episodesList.summary: Deepti's family thinks of ways to help Prarthana and stop Bapodara from toying with her life. Meanwhile, Radha Tai finds out that her granddaughter has been living in a hostel.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Aur Bapodara Ka Connection
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Nilima find bundles of cash hidden in a drawer and some notes referring to 'Seth Ji'. They also get suspicious when they hear about Bapodara checking on Ramesh in the hospital. What connection do they have?

episodesList.title: Chawl Mein Chor
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati arrives at the Chawl to give some good news to Pushpa. Meanwhile, two strangers target Pushpa's house to steal valuable jewellery.

episodesList.title: Dadi Ka Intezar
episodesList.summary: Bapodara gets convinced to keep Prarthana in Mumbai because of the scholarship. Meanwhile, Deepti and her family prepare for Dadi's arrival.

episodesList.title: Deepti Ki Dadi
episodesList.summary: Dadi arrives for Deepti's wedding. However, chaos ensues when Dadi finds out about Ashwin's background.

episodesList.title: Deepti Aur Ashwin Ki Kundali
episodesList.summary: Dadi wants to see Deepti and Ashwin's kundali, and she threatens to break off the wedding if their kundalis don't match. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Kundali Ka Chakkar
episodesList.summary: Dadi arrives at the Chawl and gets off on the wrong foot with Pushpa. How will Pushpa meet Dadi's never-ending demands?

episodesList.title: Sangeet Sandhya
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Deepti's family come together for the Sangeet ceremony. Meanwhile, two thieves plan to steal all the jewellery from Pushpa's house while everyone is busy with the program.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Sangeet Performance
episodesList.summary: Pushpa puts on a dance performance for all the guests at the Sangeet. Later, the two thieves turn off the electricity supply to attempt to steal the jewellery. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Mein Chori
episodesList.summary: Bhaskar surprises everyone and returns home for Ashwin's wedding. Meanwhile, Pushpa finds out that all the jewellery has been stolen from her house. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Investigating The Stolen Jewellery
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Sonal about the stolen jewellery, and Sonal decides to help her. Meanwhile, Chirag aids the police to catch the thieves.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Baraat
episodesList.summary: Bapodara finds out that jewellery has been stolen from Pushpa's house. Meanwhile, Ashwin's baarat leaves for the marriage hall.

episodesList.title: Daadi Ki Narazgi
episodesList.summary: Bapodara decides to tell Deepti's grandmother about the stolen jewellery. Meanwhile, the jewellery thieves are still at large. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Deepti Ka Grah Pravesh
episodesList.summary: After settling all the misunderstandings, Ashwin and Deepti are married off successfully. Meanwhile, Versha and Pranav prepare to steal Radha Tai's property from her.

episodesList.title: Personal Saat Vachan
episodesList.summary: After all the marriage ceremonies are completed, Ashwin and Deepti recite their vows during the Suhaag Raat. Meanwhile, Pranav and Versha make plans to trick Pushpa and Radha Tai.

episodesList.title: Water Shortage In The Chawl
episodesList.summary: Bapodara's Chawl faces the issue of water shortage the day after Ashwin and Deepti's wedding. Meanwhile, Versha devises a plan to get Radha Tai's signatures on the property papers.

episodesList.title: Stree Dhan
episodesList.summary: Kunjbala sends a lot of furniture and appliances for Deepti. But Pushpa's house has no space to keep all the stuff. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa In A Fix
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets into a tricky situation as Kunjbala's stay in the Chawl creates problems for the newly wedded couple. Meanwhile, Pushpa misses her meeting with the trust and the foreign delegation.

episodesList.title: Privacy Problems
episodesList.summary: Kunjbala's stay in the Chawl makes it difficult for the newlyweds to find some alone time. Meanwhile, Radha Tai's son tries to trick her into going to Pune. Will she agree?

episodesList.title: Daadi Ki Zidd
episodesList.summary: Kunjbala decides to overstay her welcome and puts everyone else in an awkward position. Meanwhile, Radha Tai's son keeps trying to convince her to go to Pune with them.

episodesList.title: Mysterious Letter
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Nilima find a mysterious letter left behind by someone trying to be anonymous. Who could it be?

episodesList.title: Rashi's Attendance
episodesList.summary: Rashi's attendance drops in school and Pushpa receives a phone call regarding her performance. Can Rashi concentrate on her studies with all the drama back home?

episodesList.title: Aryan In Critical Condition
episodesList.summary: Aryan recovers, but he is kept under surveillance by the doctors, putting Rashi in a state of panic. Meanwhile, Pushpa gets closer to finding out who 'Seth Ji' is.

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Bullying
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out about Rashi's bullying which almost cost Aryan his life. How will she react to this shocking revelation?

episodesList.title: Kunjbala Ka Man Badla
episodesList.summary: Kunjbala has a change of heart after listening to Pushpa's advice. Meanwhile, things get serious for Rashi at school as Aryan's father demands Rashi's suspension.

episodesList.title: Naukri Par Khatra
episodesList.summary: A change in management brings in a huge threat of layoffs at Deepti and Ashwin's workplace. Meanwhile, Rashi speaks to Mr Nanavati and explains her side of the story. What will be his decision?

episodesList.title: Pramod's Threat
episodesList.summary: Pramod asks Ashwin to meet him at his office to talk about Rashi's rustication. However, Pushpa intercepts the call and decides to confront Pramod herself.

episodesList.title: Chirag Ki Galti
episodesList.summary: Chirag makes a huge mistake by going to Pramod's office and creating a scene. A police case gets registered against him. Will he be punished?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Saza
episodesList.summary: Pushpa feels guilty about hitting Ashwin in front of everybody, but Ashwin reassures her by telling her that she did the right thing. Meanwhile, Mr Nanavati calls for a meeting to decide Rashi's punishment.

episodesList.title: Deepti Loses Her Job
episodesList.summary: After Deepti loses her job due to a change in management, Ashwin decides to take on his superiors and fight for her. How will the new MD react to Ashwin questioning their decision?

episodesList.title: Bapodara's Secret
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gets into a verbal altercation with his new boss regarding Deepti's termination. Meanwhile, Pushpa's doubts about Bapodara increase after she sees him wear a suit after ages.

episodesList.title: Derso Crore Ka Chakkar
episodesList.summary: The friction between Ashwin and Mansi increases after Ashwin rejects her offer. Bapodara's plan of selling the Chawl for 150 crores to Mansi takes shape as she demands signatures from all the residents. Meanwhile, Pushpa's doubt about Bapodara intensifies when she finds out about his Surat trips.

episodesList.title: Deepti Looks For Jobs
episodesList.summary: After her termination, Deepti desperately looks for work and applies to various places. Meanwhile, Sharan unknowingly meets Radha Tai at an old age home.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ka Surat Connection
episodesList.summary: Pushpa sends Chirag to Surat to find out more about Bapodara's frequent visits. Meanwhile, Sharan digs deeper into Radha Tai's life and tries to find more information about her.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Shak
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets a lot of information about Bapodara's Surat connection. Meanwhile, Deepti tells her parents about the saree-burning incident.

episodesList.title: Radha Tai Gets Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Pushpa recognises Radha Tai as she gets rushed to the hospital from the old age home. Meanwhile, it comes to light that Radha Tai's son sold her property behind her back.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ki Asliyat
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Susheela about Bapodara's frequent visits to Surat. Later, she learns more about the underhanded dealings that took place behind Radha Tai's back.

episodesList.title: Justice For Radha
episodesList.summary: Ashwin's boss rejects his leave application and asks him to serve his notice period and leave the job if he wants a leave. Meanwhile, Pushpa takes it upon herself to give Radha Tai the justice that she deserves.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Her Home
episodesList.summary: Bapodara crumbles under Pushpa's threats and agrees to return Radha's house. Meanwhile, Radha shares her traumatic experience and warns Pushpa to not get dependent on her children.

episodesList.title: Radha Disowns Pranav
episodesList.summary: Pranav and his wife get caught by the police, and Radha officially registers a complaint against him. Meanwhile, Bapodara's family comes to know about the large sum of money in his account.

episodesList.title: Susheela Ka Shak
episodesList.summary: In a turn of events, Ashwin's boss sanctions his leave for his honeymoon. Meanwhile, Susheela expresses her concerns to Pushpa and decides to confront Bapodara about his Surat connection.

episodesList.title: Susheela Pahuchi Surat
episodesList.summary: Susheela decides to investigate more about Bapodara's Surat connection and asks Pushpa to accompany her on a small trip there. What will they find out?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ki Sachchai
episodesList.summary: Susheela finds out that Bapodara has been going to Surat to meet his deceased brother's wife. But why has he been hiding this from Susheela for all these years?

episodesList.title: Approval Of The Tenants
episodesList.summary: Mansi tries to guess who could have been the mastermind behind the attacks. Meanwhile, Bapodara tries to get signatures of approval from all the tenants.

episodesList.title: Suicide Letter Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Susheela confronts Bapodara about the suicide letter. Meanwhile, Mansi finds out about the man who sent the attackers after her.

episodesList.title: Surprise For Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's family surprises her with a loom which takes her back to her childhood. Meanwhile, Bapodara consults his lawyer regarding the suicide note.

episodesList.title: Raidhan Company Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Ashwin forgets his file at home, and he asks Pushpa to deliver it. Meanwhile, Bapodara tells Susheela the truth about his brother's suicide.

episodesList.title: Bapodara's Announcement
episodesList.summary: Bapodara decides to make an announcement about the Chawl's future. Meanwhile, Pushpa learns to operate a computer at school.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Chawl Ki Asliyat
episodesList.summary: Pushpa helps Deepti cook, while Deepti helps her with her assignment. Meanwhile, Sunny calls up Bapodara to confront him about his grandfather's will.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Mansi puts pressure on Bapodara to get the signatures from the tenants and he decides to make the announcement of redevelopment. How will the tenants react to this news?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Chawl Ka Redevelopment
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the chawl wonders whether the redevelopment project is a good thing. Deepti overhears rumours about Bapodra Chawl and rushes to inform Ashwin about it.

episodesList.title: Counter Offer
episodesList.summary: Mansi pays a visit to the Chawl and speaks to the tenants. Meanwhile, Bapodara gets a call from the competitors of the Raidhan group.

episodesList.title: Deepti Pe Shak
episodesList.summary: Bapodara gets pressurized by the directors of the Janani group to cancel his deal with Mansi. Meanwhile, Ashwin accuses Deepti of leaking his professional information.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Apology
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out that it was she who unknowingly leaked Ashwin's professional files and informs him about her mistake. Will Deepti forgive Ashwin for blindly accusing her?

episodesList.title: Fake Passport Scandal
episodesList.summary: The police find out that a fake passport racquet has been running from a warehouse owned by Deepti's parents, but they have nothing to do with it. What steps will the police take to catch the criminals?

episodesList.title: Workshop Pe Chaapa
episodesList.summary: The children prepare food in the canteen as Mr Nanavati and Pushpa watch with pride in their eyes. Meanwhile, the police get extra information about the passport racquet and decide to raid the place.

episodesList.title: Chirag Helps The Police
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets worried sick when Chirag does not return home in time. Meanwhile, Chirag gives the police a major lead in the fake passport scandal case.

episodesList.title: Mansi Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Mansi gets kidnapped by Jogi Dayal and his men. Jogi Dayal calls Dharam Raidhan and convinces him to return to India. Meanwhile, Pushpa gets nightmares of her late husband, Dilip returning to her life.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Bura Sapna
episodesList.summary: Pushpa continues to get premonitions of Dilip returning to her life. Meanwhile, Dharam Raidhan lands in India and gets into a road accident.

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan In Danger
episodesList.summary: Mansi finds out about her father's accident and rushes to the hospital. Ashwin agrees to donate blood for the surgery as his blood group is the same as Dharam's. Meanwhile, Jogi Dayal makes an attempt to kill Dharam at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan's Past
episodesList.summary: The police catch Jogi Dayal red-handed as he attempts to assassinate Dharam. Meanwhile, Dharam comes face to face with his past once again.

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan Ki Kahani
episodesList.summary: The police decide to interrogate Dharam Raidhan about his connection with Jogi Dayal. Meanwhile, Pushpa tells Deepti about her late husband's past.

episodesList.title: Dilip Patel Ka Raaz
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets injured while trying to fix the electric circuit. Meanwhile, the police continue to investigate Dharam Raidhan's past.

episodesList.title: Bhagya Ka Daldal
episodesList.summary: The police DCP asks Pushpa about Dilip and his past activities. Meanwhile, Pushpa is worried that her biggest fear might turn out to be true.

episodesList.title: Probing The Past
episodesList.summary: The DCP digs through Dilip's criminal record to find his fingerprint data. Meanwhile, Dharam confronts Bapodara and tells him off.

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan Ki Kismat
episodesList.summary: Pushpa attempts to write with her left hand and prepare for her exam at the same time. Meanwhile, the police DCP tries to match Dharam Raidhan's fingerprints with Dilip's.

episodesList.title: Unmasking Dharam Raidhan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa scolds Chirag for skipping the college lectures. Meanwhile, Chirag sees Dharam Raidhan's face and realises that it is the same as his father's.

episodesList.title: Unlucky Coincidence
episodesList.summary: Pushpa feels helpless about her situation and thinks that she won't be able to give her exam. Deepti meets with Mr Nanavati and asks him for a second option. Meanwhile, Ashwin sees Dharam Raidhan's real face.

episodesList.title: Police Ka Chakkar
episodesList.summary: Chirag asks Ashwin about their father's truth. Meanwhile, Bapodara gets even more suspicious about Dilip's return.

episodesList.title: Sach Ki Shakal
episodesList.summary: The police bring Pushpa to City Hospital to help identify Dharam Raidhan's face. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan Ka Khel
episodesList.summary: Ashwin agrees to give his DNA sample to confirm Dharam Raidhan's identity. However, Pushpa is worried about what will happen if the DNA test turns out to be positive.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Bloodline
episodesList.summary: The police take Ashwin along with them for the DNA test. Meanwhile, Pushpa warns Dharam Raidhan about staying away from her family.

episodesList.title: DNA Test Ka Result
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and the others wait for the results of the DNA test. Will the results be what everyone hoped for?

episodesList.title: Bhavnao Ki Keemat
episodesList.summary: After getting the good news of the negative DNA test, Pushpa celebrates by inviting everyone for dinner. Meanwhile, Bapodara arrives at Surat to meet with Sunny about property rights.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's New Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Pushpa meets her in-laws to let them know the truth about her situation. Ashwin gets asked to head the operations of Raidhan group. Will he accept the offer?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Ateet
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara confronts Dharam about his past. Meanwhile, Pushpa and Bapodara share a heart-to-heart conversation.

episodesList.title: Sach Ka Dusra Pehlu
episodesList.summary: Mansi gets her hands on the real DNA reports and finds out the truth about Dharam Raidhan. What will Dharam do now?

episodesList.title: Rashi's Search For Truth
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara decides to talk to Pushpa about Dharam. Meanwhile, Rashi leaves early from school to figure out the truth.

episodesList.title: Life Ke Tough Decisions
episodesList.summary: Pushpa encourages Ashwin to take the job offered to him by Mansi. Meanwhile, Sonal calls Deepti to discuss the Dharam Raidhan situation.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Call
episodesList.summary: Rashi confronts Chirag about Dharam Raidhan's sketch. Meanwhile, Vasundhara calls Pushpa to meet her in person.

episodesList.title: Shocking News For Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Prathana's father asks her to stay away from Chirag, but she tries to convince her father that he is not a bad person. Later, Dharam Raidhan's wife meets Pushpa, and asks her to sign divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Azaadi Ki Chaabi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is shocked to find out that Dilip is still alive and is leading his life as Dharam Raidhan. Meanwhile, Vasundhara refuses to go back to Canada till Pushpa signs the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Aur Dilip Ka Sauda
episodesList.summary: Pushpa arrives at Vasundhara's house to sign the divorce papers. Dharam threatens to take action against Pushpa if she snitches to the police about him.

episodesList.title: Dharam Ki Kamzori
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets the results of her preliminary exams. Later, Pushpa meets with Sonal and clears the air with her.

episodesList.title: Double Life Ke Khatre
episodesList.summary: Mansi meets with Ashwin before leaving for Canada. Dharam's health gets worse while on his way to the airport.

episodesList.title: Dharam Ki Bimaari
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara and Mansi take Dharam to the hospital, and they find out that he has a fatal disease. Meanwhile, the police DCP questions Pushpa once again.

episodesList.title: Dharam's Only Hope
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's friends ask why is police coming to her place again and again and Pushpa tells them not to worry. Dharam Raidhan's wife goes to Pushpa's house to ask for her help.

episodesList.title: Insaaniyat Ka Rishta
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara comes to Pushpa's house to ask for her help in saving Dharam's life. Will Pushpa agree?

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Offer
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara tries to lure Chirag into donating his bone marrow. Meanwhile, Ashwin and Deepti are unable to find a job anywhere.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Financial Stress
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets desperate for money after seeing his family's financial condition. Meanwhile, Sonal offers a job to Ashwin.

episodesList.title: Dharam's Worsening Condition
episodesList.summary: Dharam's condition worsens, and he gets taken to the emergency ward. Meanwhile, Chirag agrees to donate his bone marrow for Dharam's operation.

episodesList.title: Real Life Double Role
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is worried about what will happen if Bapodara finds out the truth about Dharam Raidhan. Meanwhile, Rashi and Pushpa are preparing for their debate in school.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ke Sawal
episodesList.summary: Bapodara questions Pushpa about Dilip and Dharam's resemblance. Meanwhile, Chirag gives his DNA sample for testing.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Decision
episodesList.summary: Chirag decides to donate his bone marrow sample, and he tells Prarthana about it. Meanwhile, Pushpa and Rashi prepare for the upcoming debate.

episodesList.title: Jatil Samasya
episodesList.summary: Dharam's bone marrow transplant surgery is successful after Chirag's donation. Meanwhile, Chirag looks for a way to store all the cash.

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ki Nayi Paribhasha
episodesList.summary: Bapodara finds Chirag and Prarthana together in the night. Meanwhile, Deepti and Ashwin celebrate Valentine's day together.

episodesList.title: Chirag Ke Paise
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets a fever after the bone marrow donation. Meanwhile, Bapodara snoops around in Chirag's shop and finds the bag filled with money.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Worst Fear
episodesList.summary: DCP Tejasvi arrives at the Chawl and reveals that Chirag donated his bone marrow to Dharam. What will Dharam do now that his truth has come out?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Dhamki
episodesList.summary: Rashi is angry and heartbroken because no one told her about her father. Pushpa tells Rashi the harsh truth about her father. Pushpa gets extremely worried for Chirag. Pushpa is furious with Vasundhara and Dharam and threatens to reveal his identity to the world.

episodesList.title: Dharam Raidhan's Arrest
episodesList.summary: Pushpa takes revenge on Dharam and Vasundhara by giving her divorce paper to DCP Tejasvi. The DCP arrives at the hospital to arrest Dharam Raidhan. Meanwhile, Pushpa is worried about Chirag and tries to look for him.

episodesList.title: Generation Gap Debate
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's family faces insult and disrespect after news about Dharam Raidhan comes out. Meanwhile, Pushpa and Rashi face each other at the school debate.

episodesList.title: Bhagya Aur Sanjog
episodesList.summary: Sonal comes to Pushpa's house and confronts her about Dharam's case. Ashwin and Deepti try searching for Chirag. Meanwhile, Dharam plans his revenge against Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Jaal
episodesList.summary: Chirag rejects Dilip's offer and decides to stand by his mother. Meanwhile, Pushpa meets Vasundhara and returns the amount she gave to Chirag.

episodesList.title: Advocate Shekhawat
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara approaches advocate Shekhawat and asks her to take up Dilip's case. Pushpa finds out about this, and she decides to meet advocate Shekhawat as well.

episodesList.title: Imaandar Lawyer
episodesList.summary: Advocate Shekhawat denies fighting Dilip's case. Sharan asks Pushpa to attend classes regularly. Later, Guru Bhasin asks Dilip about advocate Shekhawat.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Plan
episodesList.summary: Dilip devises a plan to kidnap Devi's daughter in order to convince her to fight his case. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pinjre Ki Chaabi
episodesList.summary: Guru Bhasin's men arrive at the art fair to kidnap Roshni. Rashi finds out about their plan and decides to stop the criminals. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Guru Bhasin Ki Maang
episodesList.summary: Bapodara suggests that Dilip could be behind Rashi's kidnapping. Meanwhile, the kidnapper tells Devi what he wants from her as ransom.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and the others are worried about how Rashi is being treated by the kidnappers. Meanwhile, Devi Shekhawat decides to meet with Dilip.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Life Jacket
episodesList.summary: Devi makes a deal with Dilip in exchange for getting bailed out of jail. Meanwhile, Mansi decides to help Pushpa and her family.

episodesList.title: Devi Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: Dilip acts to fall sick in jail. Dilip talks to Rashi on call and tells her he will save her. Later, Devi Shekhawat comes up with a plan to save her and Pushpa's daughter.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Bail
episodesList.summary: Devi Shekhawat executes her plan and files for Dilip's bail on medical grounds. However, the question remains, will Dilip fulfill his promise and help in locating Rashi?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Badla
episodesList.summary: Pushpa arrives at the exchange point to meet the kidnappers and take Rashi away. Meanwhile, Dilip is taken to court for his bail plea.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Impossible Mission
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tries to relay the kidnapper's location to the police. Meanwhile, Ashwin arrives at Dilip's and threatens him with serious action.

episodesList.title: Devi's Undercover Operation
episodesList.summary: Devi and Tejasvi reach out to the police commissioner to get Guru Bhasin out of jail. Meanwhile, the kidnappers find the wire placed on Pushpa. How will Pushpa escape this situation?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Takes A Risk
episodesList.summary: Pushpa plans her escape from the kidnapper's lair. Meanwhile, Dilip gives a tip to the police to help catch the kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Holi Ka Tofah
episodesList.summary: Guru Bhasin prepares for his freedom from jail. Meanwhile, the police set their trap to catch the kidnappers and save Pushpa. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Last Wicket Down
episodesList.summary: Devi and the police execute their plan to arrest Guru and his men. Later, Bapodara organizes a Holi party in the chawl to celebrate Pushpa and Rashi's return.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Zindagi Ka Grahan
episodesList.summary: Rashi gets panic attacks after going through a traumatic experience with the kidnappers. Meanwhile, Pushpa arrives at Dilip's house and warns him to stay away from Rashi.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Mind Games
episodesList.summary: Dilip traps Rashi in his mind games and aims to use her against Pushpa. Meanwhile, the residents of Bapodara Chawl celebrate Holi together.

episodesList.title: Rashi's Soft Corner
episodesList.summary: Dilip sneaks into Bapodara Chawl during the Holi celebrations and talks to Rashi. Meanwhile, Rashi hangs Dilip's photo in the house. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Dhoke Ki Tasveer
episodesList.summary: Bapodara's friend asks for Prarthana's hand to marry his son. Meanwhile, Dilip gives Pushpa an open challenge. What will be Pushpa's answer?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Ghar
episodesList.summary: Roshini tells Rashi that Dilip should be given one more chance. Later, Dilip calls Bapodra and tells him he wants ownership of Pushpa's house. Dilip comes outside Pushpa's house to talk to Bapodra in person. What now?

episodesList.title: Dilip's Ego
episodesList.summary: Bapodara tells Pushpa that Dilip intends to acquire her house in order to take his revenge. Prarthana tells Chirag about the marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Rashi decides to meet Dilip at his office. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ke Sawaal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa abandons Dilip's surname to distance her family from him. Meanwhile, Dilip spins an emotional story in front of Rashi and gains her sympathy. Will Pushpa be able to save Rashi from Dilip's influence?

episodesList.title: Dilip's Gift
episodesList.summary: Prarthana pours her heart out in front of Chirag, but he shoots down her proposal. Meanwhile, Dilip arrives at the Chawl once again to stake his claim on Pushpa's house. How will Pushpa respond?

episodesList.title: Rashi's Defiance
episodesList.summary: Rashi begins to defy Pushpa and her family and sides with Dilip after his last stunt. Meanwhile, Prarthana agrees to meet Jai to talk to him about marriage.

episodesList.title: Pita Ka Farz
episodesList.summary: Dilip lands up in school during the parent-teacher meeting and portrays himself as a loving father worried for his daughter. Even though Pushpa objects to his presence, Mr Nanavati tells her that legally they can't do anything because he is still her father according to school records. What drama is Dilip going to cause now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Rashi thinks her father is becoming a better man, but Pushpa disagrees. Sharan asks Pushpa to focus on her studies while he takes care of Radha Kaku. Later, Pushpa asks Dipiti about Ashwin.

episodesList.title: Dharam's New Plan
episodesList.summary: Nilima tells Pushpa about her husband's condition. Sharan advises Pushpa to not get affected by Rashi's behaviour. Deepti is concerned about Ashwin working with her mother in partnership. Later, Ashwin informs Mansi about Dharam visiting Rashi's school for a parent-teacher meeting.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Thinks About Dilip's Intentions
episodesList.summary: Pushpa cancels her school trip when she gets a catering order. Pushpa rushes to the hospital on receiving Dilip's call. Later, Bapodara meets a prospective groom and his family for his daughter's marriage.

episodesList.title: Mansi Confronts Her Father
episodesList.summary: Mansi confronts her father about his visit to Rashi's school for a PTA meeting. Later, a discussion about work during mealtime turns into a heated argument between Ashwin and Deepti.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ki Sagai Te Ho Gayi
episodesList.summary: Sonal gives some advice to Pushpa, requesting her to mull over the same. Later, Deepti confronts Prarthana about her getting married. Sharan tells Pushpa about his wish of living with Kaku.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Aur Rashi Me Doori
episodesList.summary: Bhaskar tells Ashwin that he is planning to move out from the chawl into a newly constructed apartment. After Rashi leaves for a school trip, Pushpa finds it difficult to deal with the distance between them.

episodesList.title: Deepti Ki News
episodesList.summary: Deepti asks Chirag about Prarthana's fiance, Jai. Dilip's Canadian citizenship might get cancelled because of his fake passport, and Vasundhra asks him to stay away from Pushpa and her family. Later, Deepti hesitates to talk to Pushpa about her pregnancy. How will Pushpa take this news?

episodesList.title: Dharam Ke Hukum Ka Ikka
episodesList.summary: Sunny and Bapodara meet with Dharam at his office. Pushpa and Deepti talk about the matter of Ashwin and Deepti moving out. Dharam uses a card up his sleeve to make another move against Bapodara. What is his plan?

episodesList.title: Deepti Confronts Her Mother
episodesList.summary: The rumours about Pushpa looking for a flat spreads across the members of the chawl. Dharam video-calls Rashi while she is out on a trip. Later, Deepti confronts her mother, leaving Sonal in distress.

episodesList.title: Waakri Mein Good News Hain?
episodesList.summary: Ashwin clarifies the misunderstanding regarding moving out of the chawl. Bapodara tells Pushpa about the instance that occurred with Sunny and Dilip. Later, Sunny overhears Prarthana's conversation with Chirag.

episodesList.title: Mahesh Goragandhi Moves In
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's new neighbour moves in and she worries about it being Dilip Patel. Prarthana and Chirag are advised to take some time to think about their actual feelings. Later, Mahesh meets with Dharam, where he is given certain instructions.

episodesList.title: Rashi Returns From Her Trip
episodesList.summary: Nilima awakes Pushpa in the middle of the night. Rashi is welcomed back enthusiastically by her family. Vasundhara overhears her daughter's phone conversation with Dharam and confronts her husband about his intentions.

episodesList.title: Ashwin And Deepti Get Ready
episodesList.summary: Sunny asks Chirag about Pannu and her decision. Dilip slowly tries to remember his past as he asks Nilima about their marriage. Meanwhile, Deepti and Ashwin start mentally preparing for their future child.

episodesList.title: Board Ka Pehla Paper
episodesList.summary: On the day of Pushpa and Rashi's first board examination, Dilip arrives at the chawl and takes all the chawl members by surprise. Pushpa breaks down and refuses to take the examination. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ke Ghar Ki Gruh Shanti
episodesList.summary: Dilip invites the chawl members for a pooja at his residence. Ashwin gets late for his important presentation with his mother-in-law as he helps Pushpa reach her examination centre on time. Will Pushpa be allowed to sit for the examination?

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Impressive Presentation
episodesList.summary: While Pushpa writes her first exam paper, Ashwin reaches for his presentation and impresses Sonal with the same. Later, Sonal encourages Ashwin to think about moving out of the chawl with Deepti for a brighter future.

episodesList.title: Khule Aam Baat Ho Hi Jaye
episodesList.summary: Rashi refuses to sit for the 'havan' even after being requested by her father. Dilip claims to have changed and asks Pushpa to give him another chance at repentance, in front of all the members of the chawl. Ashwin decides to interrupt the 'havan' by pouring water over the sacred fire. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Second Exam
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gives Deepti a promise. Radha Tai gives Pushpa food for thought and asks her to brood over the same after her exam. Later, Pushpa takes her second exam.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Imtihaan
episodesList.summary: Manish and Sonal talk about Ashwin's anger. Pushpa prepares for her exam. Later, an orphan named Sunil helps Pushpa realize the mistakes she made in the exam. Will Pushpa pass her exam?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ka Birthday
episodesList.summary: Rashi gets shocked when everyone throws her a surprise party on her birthday. Later, she receives a birthday gift from Dilip which she hides from Pushpa. How will Pushpa react when she finds out about this?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ki Party
episodesList.summary: Dilip keeps a birthday party for Rashi and sends everyone an invitation to attend the party. Later, Pushpa calls Vasundhra and informs her what Dilip has been up to recently. What will Vasundhra do now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Move Backfires
episodesList.summary: The kids wonder if Dilip is feeling guilty for his sins. Ashwin warns Chirag and Rashi not to fall into Dilip's trap. Later, Pushpa finds out about Dilip's gift to Rashi. How will Pushpa react?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ka Jawab
episodesList.summary: Ashwin receives flowers from an unknown person. Chirag sketches his picture instead of Prarthana's fiancee in the portrait. Later, Pushpa sees Rashi returning the phone to Dilip.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Advice To Chirag
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out about Chirag and Prarthana's feelings. Dilip meets Rashi in Pushpa's absence. Later, Pushpa asks Chirag to stay away from Prathana.

episodesList.title: Chirag Aur Prathana Ka Bhavishya
episodesList.summary: Radha Kaku advises Pushpa to take Chirag's side and speak to Susheela about it. Later, Dilip and Bapodara hold an emergency meeting in the society. What will be the meeting's agenda?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ka Dilip Par Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Susheela talks to Prarthana about Chirag. Pushpa gets scared when she realises Rashi is following Dilip's footsteps. Later, Prarthana asks his cousin to find out about Chriag's feelings.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Talks To Chirag
episodesList.summary: Dilip challenges Bapodara, while Rashi takes Dilip's side in front of everyone. Prarthana asks Chirag if he considers her more than a friend.

episodesList.title: Chirag In A Difficult Spot
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks Susheela to not worry about Prarthana's marriage. Prarthana's cousin asks Chirag to fight for his love. What will he do?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Ghar Par Dinner Party
episodesList.summary: Pushpa invites Bapodara and his family for dinner at her place. Prarthana tells Chirag that she is ready to fight for him. Later, Bapodara finds out that Prarthana was alone with Chirag. How will he react?

episodesList.title: Professional Touch Vs Personal Touch
episodesList.summary: Pushpa wants to keep Rashi away from Dilip while Dilip orders expensive continental food for Rashi's party. Later, Rashi calls Dilip to her party to thank him for the arrangements he made for her.

episodesList.title: Chirag Is Feeling Helpless
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Dilip have a heated argument. Bapodara is busy with Prarthana's engagement preparations, while Sunny asks Deepti's help to postpone the engagement.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Muh Tod Jawab
episodesList.summary: Chirag helps Bapodara catch the rat in his house. Mansi asks Ashwin to give Dilip one chance. Later, Pushpa breaks Dilip's expensive gift, and he raises his hand to hit Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Engagement Day
episodesList.summary: Deepti tells Ashwin that she sent Chirag to meet Prarthana. Prarthana's fiance sees Chirag and Prarthana together. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Hui Lapata
episodesList.summary: Jai sees Chirag and Prarthana hugging each other. Sushila tells Bapodara that Prarthana loves Chirag. Later, Pushpa gets shocked when she hears Prarthana has run away with Chirag.

episodesList.title: Engagement Cancel
episodesList.summary: Deepti and Ashwin tell Deepti's parents that Prarthana has run away with Chirag. Prarthana and Chirag show up with the police at her engagement. Later, Jai cancels his engagement with Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Deepti convince Jai to marry Prarthana. Chirag breaks out seeing Prarthana with Jai. Dilip asks Chirag to fight for his love. What will Chirag do?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ki Zidd
episodesList.summary: Prarthana tells Bapodara that she loves Chirag. Sushila apologizes to Pushpa for thinking wrong about her and Chirag. Later, Bapodara gets furious when he sees Dilip's wedding gift to Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Radha Kaku Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Deepti's mother doesn't want Deepti and Ashwin to live in Pushpa's chawl. Radha Kaku falls and Pushpa gets worried for her because of her age. Later, Chirag tells Prarthana they will always be friends.

episodesList.title: Radha Kaku Ka Beta
episodesList.summary: Vikram agrees to stay with Radha Kaku. Prarthana gets emotional when Chirag tells Jai about Prarthana's likes and dislikes. Later, everyone celebrates Vikram, a new addition to Radha Kaku's family.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Naya Mohra
episodesList.summary: Ashwin tries to convince Pushpa to shift to a better society. Dilip plans to install solar electricity in the chawl. Later, Sunny tells Prarthana that if she sees an opportunity to get back together with Chirag then she shouldn't miss it.

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Treat
episodesList.summary: Chawl people appreciate Dilip. Ashwin and Deepti go to Super Life Constructions to book a flat without knowing that the company could get blacklisted anytime. Later, Dilip arranges a special treat for Rashi and her friends.

episodesList.title: Naye Flat Ka Token
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Radha Kaku she can't leave the chawl. Prarthana tries to cut Chirag off from her life. Later, Ashwin asks Pushpa to give 15 lakh advance for the new flat. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Tough Decision For Rashi
episodesList.summary: Rashi tells Deepti about how Dilip helped her treat her friends, and Pushpa overhears their conversation. Pushpa asks Rashi to choose between her and Dilip. Who will Rashi choose now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Pita Ki Akhri Nishani
episodesList.summary: Pushpa breaks down when she sees the keepsake broken, which was given to her by her father. Later, Pushpa misbehaves with Bapodara because she thinks he broke her father's keepsake.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Needs Proof
episodesList.summary: Pushpa apologizes to Bapodara for insulting him. Bapodara gets angry when he sees Chirag and Prarthana together. Later, Dilip lays down a plan to get in the good books of Chirag.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Police Complaint
episodesList.summary: Bapodara finds Golu's phone and shows Dilip's video to Pushpa. Later, Dilip goes to the police station as Pushpa files a complaint against him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Loses His Token Money
episodesList.summary: Ashwin finds out that the Super Life company's construction is illegal. Doctor tells Pushpa that she needs to find a donor for Mahendra's kidney transplant. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa that Dilip breaking Pushpa's father's keepsake is justified.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets emotional talking to Mahendra. Vasundhra gets angry with Dilip for investing a big amount of money without asking her. Later, Pushpa decides to donate her kidney to Mahendra.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Ehsaan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells everyone how Mahendra helped her in her time of need and wants to donate her kidney for Mahendra but Radha Kaku asks her not to do it. Later, Dilip gets Chirag and Ashwin out of jail.

episodesList.title: Golu Ki Imaandari Ki Dukan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks the chawl people to help run Mahendra's shop while he is in the hospital. Later, Mahendra tells Pushpa about his and Golu's past.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Waits For The Results
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tries to convince her family to let her donate her kidney to Mahendra. Pushpa and Rashi get scared, thinking about their exam result. Later, the doctor tells Pushpa her kidney tissue didn't match Mahendra's.

episodesList.title: Chawl Ki Asli Pehchan
episodesList.summary: Radha Kaku decides to donate her kidney to Mahendra. Later, Deepti's mother gives money to Ashwin to pay back his money lender. Pushpa is stressed about Mahendra's operation and her result.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Fails
episodesList.summary: Rashi scores well in her exams and Pushpa fails. A boy named Pakiya motivates Pushpa to try again. Later, Pushpa demands re-evaluation for her mathematics test. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Aur Rashi Ka Celebration
episodesList.summary: Dilip gets shocked when he sees Pushpa passed her exam. Later, Chirag asks Prarthana to meet him in private to confess his feelings. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Papa Ki Sifarish
episodesList.summary: Pushpa gets worried when Rashi tells her about her dream college. She finds out about Chirag and Ashwin's arrest and scolds them. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa that her father is trying to be a better man.

episodesList.title: Laptop Chor
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Dilip that his kids are capable enough to understand his bad intentions. Chirag decides to tell Jai the truth about him and Prarthana. Meanwhile, Someone steals Dilip's laptop.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ke Office Mein Raid
episodesList.summary: Deepti tells Ashwin she sold her jewellery for money. Police raid Dilip's house and offices in Canada. Later, Prarthana tells Pushpa that Chirag is trying to break her engagement with Jai.

episodesList.title: Laptop Exchange
episodesList.summary: Pushpa doesn't believe that Pakiya has stolen Dilip's laptop. Pushpa scolds Chirag for trying to break off Prarthana's engagement. Later, Rashi brings home Dilip's laptop instead of Ashwin's laptop. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Laptop Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: Prarthana hides from Bapodara as he looks for her. Police come to Pushpa's chawl to search her house for Dilip's laptop. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chori Ka Karan
episodesList.summary: The police decide to arrest Pushpa for stealing Dilip's laptop, but Deepti tells the police about the misunderstanding. Later, Pushpa finds out why Pakiya stole Dilip's laptop.

episodesList.title: Sonal's Demand
episodesList.summary: Sonal is hellbent on making Ashwin and Deepti move out from the chawl. Deepti tries to make her understand but she isn't ready to listen.

episodesList.title: Sonal Ka Decision
episodesList.summary: Dilip talks to Bapodara about Prarthana and Chirag. Pushpa decides to apologise to Deepti's mother. Later, Deepti's mother says that she won't come to Bapodara Chawl again.

episodesList.title: Sabki Alag Problems
episodesList.summary: Prarthana's visa for London arrives which saddens her. Ashwin tells Deepti he doesn't want to take her mother's help. Later, Mahendra comes back home.

episodesList.title: Jai And Chirag's Fight
episodesList.summary: Jai finds out the truth about Prarthana and Chirag's relationship. Dilip talks to the principal of the college to which Rashi wants admission. Later, Jai fights with Chirag.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Loses Control
episodesList.summary: Deepti tries to convince Bapodara that Chirag is right for Prarthana. Chirag decides to become worthy of Prarthana. Will Bapodara ever approve of Prarthana and Chirag's relationship?

episodesList.title: Impossible Love Story
episodesList.summary: Bapodara refuses to accept Chirag and Prarthana's love. Pushpa wants to sponsor Pakiya's education for one whole year. Later, Ashwin gets angry at Sonal.

episodesList.title: Rashi Disregards Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa feels hurt after reading Rashi's diary. Rashi says Dilip did nothing with buying the seat for her favourite college. Later, Pushpa allows Rashi to stay with her father.

episodesList.title: Rashi Misses Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Rashi starts living with Dilip but is still upset because she misses Pushpa. Later, Dilip asks Rashi to go to her college in a rickshaw instead of his car.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Gets A Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Pushpa convinces Deepti to celebrate her birthday. Rashi uses Dilip's laptop and finds Prarthana and Chirag's video in it. Later, Bapodara gets a heart attack. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Aur Rashi Ki Ek Cup Chai
episodesList.summary: Rashi wants to check Dilip's phone. Ashwin's mood is upset because of Deepti's mother. Later, Pushpa takes up a big order to buy a good gift for Deepti's birthday.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ki Badhti Nafrat
episodesList.summary: Rashi's friends tell Pushpa how Dilip broke Prarthana and Jai's engagement. Dilip uses Rashi to get close to Chirag. Later, Pushpa asks Chirag to promise her that he would stay away from Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ka Picha
episodesList.summary: A man follows Prarthana. Rashi picks up Manasi's call on Dilip's laptop and finds out about the problem Vasundhara is in because of Dilip. Later, Dilip helps Chirag with his career.

episodesList.title: Chirag Ki Nayi Job
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out that Dilip helped Chirag get a job. Deepti helps Pushpa prepare her tiffin order. Meanwhile, Vasundhara decides to confront Dilip about his actions in Bapodara Chawl.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Priorities
episodesList.summary: Sonal doesn't like Deepti working with Pushpa. Sonal cancels Deepti's birthday party at her house. Later, Rashi overhears Dilip telling Vasundhara that she and Manasi are his top priorities. What will Rashi do now?

episodesList.title: Deepti Makes Up With Sonal
episodesList.summary: Dilip has to choose between Rashi and Vasundhara. Bapodara decides to catch Prarthana and Chirag red-handed. Later, Ashwin, Pushpa and Chirag give gifts to Deepti on her birthday.

episodesList.title: Sonal's Expensive Gift
episodesList.summary: Rashi comes to wish Deepti along with Dilip. Rashi insists that she will attend Deepti's birthday party only if she can bring Dilip along. Later, Sonal's words hurt Ashwin. How will Ashwin react?

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Wrong Move
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Deepti get into a fight and Ashwin raises his hand at her. Pushpa throws Ashwin out of her house. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sonal Questions Deepti
episodesList.summary: Deepti's father tells Ashwin that domestic abuse is non-negotiable in a marriage. Rashi asks Ashwin to come to Dilip's house. Later, Sonal gets furious and asks Deepti to come back home with her.

episodesList.title: Sonal Ki Complaint
episodesList.summary: Sonal files a complaint against Ashwin. Ashwin talks to everyone and tries to find a way to make things right. Later, the police call Ashwin and Deepti to the police station.

episodesList.title: Rashi Asks Dilip To Apologize
episodesList.summary: Rashi tells Dilip to apologize to Pushpa as he claims to be regretful about his actions. Meanwhile, Ashwin tries talking to Sonal at her office.

episodesList.title: Rashi Doesnt Want To Choose
episodesList.summary: Dilip apologises to Pushpa in front of everyone and Pushpa accepts his apology. Rashi tells Dilip she wants to help him with Vasundhara's problem. Later, Rashi gets emotional and talks to Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Misaal
episodesList.summary: Mr Nanavati praises Pushpa in front of all the students for her dedication to her studies at Rashi's school. Afterwards, Pushpa clearly expresses to Ashwin that Deepti must forgive him before she can even consider forgiving him.

episodesList.title: Patan Connection
episodesList.summary: Pushpa endeavours to decipher the hidden significance behind the visions she has been experiencing regarding Patan and the craft she has been involved in since her childhood.

episodesList.title: Golu's Time To Shine
episodesList.summary: Pushpa sees some musicians in distress and decides to help them by introducing them to Golu. Will they be impressed with Golu's flute performance?

episodesList.title: Mumbai Mein Toofan
episodesList.summary: Rashi and Golu get ready for their respective performances and the cyclone hits Mumbai. Later, Rajesh Wagle helps Pushpa and Golu reach their destination.

episodesList.title: Logo Ki Madad
episodesList.summary: Golu impresses everyone with his performance while Ashwin helps a girl in need. Chirag helps Sushila get home safely. Later, Pushpa refuses to sit in Dilip's car.

episodesList.title: Rashi Is Worried For Dilip
episodesList.summary: Dilip faints and Ashwin brings him home. Rashi informs Vasundhara about what happened with Dilip. Later, Sushila begins to develop a liking for Chirag.

episodesList.title: Chirag's New Job
episodesList.summary: Chirag delivers food to people to earn money. Pushpa plays a confession game with Deepti. Later, Deepti's father talks to Pushpa about Deepti and Ashwin.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Father's Janam Jayanti
episodesList.summary: Prarthana calls Deepti to ask about Chirag's health. Pushpa goes to attend an event which is honouring her father's work. Later, Prarthana secretly goes to meet Chirag.

episodesList.title: Deepti's Grandmother
episodesList.summary: Someone steals Pushpa's father's statue and replaces it with a fake one. Later, Deepti's grandmother comes to her house and sees Ashwin sleeping outside. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Sonal In Bapodara Chawl
episodesList.summary: Deepti's grandmother must not find out about Deepti and Ashwin's fight. She asks about Rashi. Later, Deepti's parents go to Bapodara Chawl.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Aur Deepti Ki Majboori
episodesList.summary: Ashwin and Deepti have to stay together because of Deepti's grandmother. Pushpa and Masterji go out to find the artisan who can fix Pushpa's handloom. Later, Deepti's grandmother keeps a pooja for Ashwin and Deepti.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Childhood Friend
episodesList.summary: Bapodara decides to expose Ashwin in front of Deepti's grandmother. Pushpa and Masterji reach the house of the person who makes handloom and Pushpa asks him to help her. Later, Pushpa sees her father's statue in the handloom maker's house.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Father's Death
episodesList.summary: Deepti's grandmother asks Bapodara what he wanted to tell her about Ashwin and Deepti. Juggal tells Pushpa a secret that he had kept for many years. Later, Ashwin apologizes to Deepti.

episodesList.title: Lalach Aur Vichar
episodesList.summary: Juggal tells Pushpa what happened between her father and Viren's father. Rashi misses Pushpa. Meanwhile, Pushpa feels bad when she learns the truth about her father's death.

episodesList.title: Dilip Is Unwell
episodesList.summary: Manasi tells Dilip that her mother went to jail because of him and Rashi overhears everything. Sonal asks Deepti to come back home with her. Later, Pushpa sees Viren mistreating his driver and gets furious.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Aaroopi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa confronts Viren and blames him for her father's death. Deepti's grandmother wants to taste the barbeque dish that Deepti and Ashwin have made together. Later, Juggal goes to talk to Viren.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Back In Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Pushpa acts surprised when Deepti tells her that her grandmother gave them a surprise visit. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa everything that has been going on with Dilip.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Wants To Join College
episodesList.summary: Viren Setalwad is the trustee of the college which Pushpa wants to join. Rashi realises that someone else deserves the seat Dilip bought for her in her dream college. Meanwhile, Vasundhara plans to go back to India.

episodesList.title: Deepti's Grandmother's Acting
episodesList.summary: Pushpa pushes Bapodara to tell the truth to Deepti's grandmother. Later, Deepti's grandmother creates a scene at Bapodara Chawl when Bapodara tells her about Ashwin and Deepti. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Rashi Does The Right Thing
episodesList.summary: Pushpa shares her feelings with her father. Rashi gives her seat to the student who she thinks deserves it more. Later, Orbit College's principal meets Pushpa at the Bapodara chawl where Pushpa shows her her handloom.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ka Badla
episodesList.summary: Deepti and Ashwin go out on a date but Ashwin still feels guilty for his actions. Bapodara sends Prarthana and Chirag's video to Vasundhara. Later, Deepti's grandmother and Pushpa go to Sonal's house.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Asli Chehra
episodesList.summary: Sonal realises her mistake and apologises to Deepti. Bapodara tries to provoke Dilip to show his real face to the world. Later, Dilip's anger takes over and Rashi gets scared of Dilip's reactions.

episodesList.title: Dilip Ka Asli Chehra
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks Viren to help her get into Orbit College. Rashi sees a glimpse of Dilip's real face. Later, Dilip and Bapodara get into a fight.

episodesList.title: Dilip's Plan To Destroy Bapodara Chawl
episodesList.summary: Bapodara wants to see Dilip behind bars, but Pushpa worries that Dilip will destroy the Bapodara Chawl. Rashi tells Pushpa that Dilip is planning something big and dangerous. What is he planning?

episodesList.title: Dilip Is Finished
episodesList.summary: Dilip misbehaves with Rashi and Vasundhara stops him. Later, the Canadian government seals Dilip's companies, properties and bank accounts and he gets arrested. What will Dilip do now?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ke Jaane Ki Khushi
episodesList.summary: Rashi apologises to Pushpa for not listening to her. Pushpa tells her family that she is happy that Dilip is gone. Later, Ashwin wants to earn money so that Deepti would be proud of him.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Unique Design
episodesList.summary: Pushpa shows the dress she made for Kalavati to her teachers. Ashwin apologizes to Sonal and tells her he wants to do something of his own. Later, Pushpa forgets Kalavati's dress in college.

episodesList.title: Golu Ki Maa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa, Mahendra and Golu go for dinner at Golu's teacher's place. Sushila tries to talk to Bapodara about Chirag and Prarthana. Later, Reena calls Ashwin and tells him about a job offer.

episodesList.title: Viren Steals Pushpa’s Design
episodesList.summary: Viren tells Pushpa she can't use the design she created as he owns it. Deepti has confidence that Ashwin will achieve something great. Later, Ashwin gets an interview with a very big company.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Liye Nyay
episodesList.summary: Kalavati asks Pushpa for her dress. Pushpa's family tries to find clues to prove that the design belongs to Pushpa and not Viren. Later, Pushpa and her family decide to confront Viren. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Kaam Ki Tareef
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and her family prove that the design belongs to Pushpa. Later, Pushpa gives Kalavati her dress and Kalavati appreciates Pushpa's work and gives her more work.

episodesList.title: Asawari's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Asawari's delivery has complications while Viren prepares to defeat Pushpa. Later, Golu gets ready to go to Switzerland while Ashwin goes for his interview.

episodesList.title: Twipple Ka Zamana
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Kalavati that she can't take orders for so many dresses but Kalavati encourages her because she thinks Pushpa is talented. Ashwin tries to get one more chance at the interview he missed. Later, Viren thinks of a plan to keep an eye on Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Parvarish
episodesList.summary: Chirag gets the opportunity to work as an illustrator at a news organisation. Meanwhile, Viren sends some students to Pushpa's house to help prepare the order. What is Viren planning?

episodesList.title: Doosra Setalvad
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gets a job while Pushpa's classmates tell her that Viren has sent them to help her in weaving the dresses. Later, Sonal tells Pushpa she needs time to heal.

episodesList.title: Naye Business Ka Budget
episodesList.summary: Juggal Setalwad doesn't want Pushpa to go against Viren and decides not to get involved. Later, Viren thinks Pushpa is stealing his customers from him while Pushpa talks to Bapodara about renting Dilip's flat.

episodesList.title: Paiso Ka Juggad
episodesList.summary: Ashwin finds out that Reena is his boss' daughter while Pushpa decides to take a loan. An MLA asks Bapodara to run for the Nagarpalika election. Later, Viren asks Pushpa to join hands with him.

episodesList.title: Naye Flat Ki Chaabi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa becomes more confident when she finds out that Viren considers her a threat. Rashi starts getting affected by trolls on her account. Meanwhile, Pushpa decides to take Kalavati's help. Will she get the help she needs?

episodesList.title: Juggal In Mumbai
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells her family how she managed the money to buy Dilip's flat and finds out that Juggal is in Mumbai. Later, Pushpa tells Juggal she needs his help.

episodesList.title: One Thing At A Time
episodesList.summary: Pushpa motivates Sushila. Sonal gives very valuable advice to Pushpa. Later, Chirag's boss motivates him while one of Rashi's followers on social media stalks her.

episodesList.title: Bapuji Ka Sapna
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells her family that she wants to stop her tiffin business. Prarthana makes a survey form for Bapodara. Later, Ashwin gets an opportunity to prove himself in his new office.

episodesList.title: Bapodara In Demand
episodesList.summary: Juggal is worried about Pushpa. Ashwin asks Deepti to help him with his new project while Chirag decides to do a story on Bapodara. Later, Rashi gets another scary message from her stalker.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Rashi's stalker keeps sending her scary messages. Pushpa gets ready to go to Patan. Later, Chandrika and Pushpa get kidnapped. Who kidnapped them?

episodesList.title: Juggal The Kidnapper
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds out that Juggal kidnapped her, Ramila, Kusum and Chandrika. Ashwin shows his presentation to his boss. Later, Pushpa wants to defeat Viren at all costs. Will Juggal support her?

episodesList.title: Brave Women
episodesList.summary: Juggal warns Pushpa and her team. Golu's teacher, Ayushi, wants to adopt Golu. Later, The women in Pushpa's team say they are ready to go against Viren and stand up for themselves.

episodesList.title: Viren Ka Vaar
episodesList.summary: Viren decides to invite Pushpa to his Janmashtami event while Chirag and Susheela plan Janmashtami in Bapodara Chawl. Later, a few dresses get stolen, and three women from Pushpa's team get blamed.

episodesList.title: Baazi Palat Gayi
episodesList.summary: Juggal tells Pushpa that Viren has framed the three women who supported her. Gauri blames Pushpa for whatever wrong happened to the three innocent women. Later, Bapodara doesn't believe his eyes when he sees Susheela getting all the arrangements done on zero budget.

episodesList.title: Doosre Setalwad Ka Vaar
episodesList.summary: Pushpa goes to Juggal to ask for his help and they go to the police station together. The police get a tip that the clothes that were stolen might be at Viren's workshop. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Viren Ka Invitation
episodesList.summary: Viren takes back his complaint and apologizes to the three innocent women. Deepti finds out that someone is stalking Rashi. Viren invites Pushpa to his Janmashtami celebration. What is Viren planning?

episodesList.title: Janmashthami Ka Din
episodesList.summary: Juggal warns Pushpa because he thinks Viren is up to something. Susheela's set-up for Janmashthami is appreciated by everyone while Rashi's stalker clicks her pictures.

episodesList.title: Rashi Takes Action
episodesList.summary: Rashi goes to the police station along with Ashwin to file a complaint against her stalker. Later, Indu backs out from the play and Viren asks Pushpa to take her place as Yashodha. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Injured Hands
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's hands get severely injured. Golu's teacher tells Mahendra she wants to adopt Golu while the doctor tells Pushpa she can't work on the handloom until her hands are healed. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chuppi Kamzori Nahi Hai
episodesList.summary: Juggal calls the police to find out who is responsible for hurting Pushpa while Gaurav tells his wife to forget about her past. Later, Pushpa decides to go back to Mumbai. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Chirag Ke Iraade
episodesList.summary: MLA Prabhakar Jagtap arrives at the Bapodara Chawl as the chief guest at the Janmashtami event. Later, Bapodara slaps Chirag for ruining his dreams of becoming a politician. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Viren Vs. Juggal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells her family what Viren did to her. Later, Juggal threatens the person who helped Viren in hurting Pushpa and takes him to the police station. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai
episodesList.summary: Juggal tells Viren that this time he won't back down. Mahendra tells Pushpa that Golu's teacher, Ayushi spoke to him about adopting Golu. Later, Viren decides to give Pushpa's seat to another student. Is Pushpa dropping out of college?

episodesList.title: Golu Ki Maa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Radha Kaku that Golu is not Mahendra's real son. Golu sees his picture from childhood in Ayushi's room. Later, Rashi tries to catch her stalker. Will she be successful?

episodesList.title: Juggal's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Rashi's stalker tricks her once again. Pushpa finds out that Golu is Ayushi's son while Juggal remembers the reason he doesn't celebrate his birthday. What is the reason?

episodesList.title: Viren Aur Juggal Ki Maa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is worried about Mahendra and Golu. Pushpa tells Viren that she is not going to drop out of the college. Later, Juggal decides to go to Mumbai to help Pushpa while Viren remembers his painful past.

episodesList.title: Juggal Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Susheela offers to help Pushpa. Pushpa finds out that Juggal is coming to Mumbai while Viren gets him kidnapped. When will Pushpa find out that Juggal is in trouble?

episodesList.title: Juggal Ki Missing Report
episodesList.summary: Bapodara sees Chirag with his colleague, Riddhi, and thinks something is going on between them. Pushpa finds out that Juggal is in trouble. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Soch Nahi Marti Hai
episodesList.summary: Juggal tells Pushpa he's going to help her complete her order. Rashi's stalker sends her a bouquet of roses. Later, Viren desperately looks for Juggal and finds him and Pushpa sitting in his office. How will Viren react to this?

episodesList.title: Golu Ki Bachpan Ki Photo
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gets another chance to impress his boss while Deepti's boss scolds her. Juggal starts working on the handloom while Golu tries to tell Mahendra about his childhood photo. Later, Golu tells Ayushi about his childhood picture. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Dosti Ka Dhaga
episodesList.summary: Ayushi reveals that she is Golu's actual mother after looking at his childhood pictures. Bapodara gets the opportunity to stand for the corporator elections. Meanwhile, Ashwin and Deepti meet Rashi's principal to complain about the stalker.

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Himmat Padhi Kamzor
episodesList.summary: Manish and Sonal tell Juggal about the Gayatri Cultural Centre and suggest he should make handicraft items. Chirag tells MLA Jagtap that someone is stalking his sister. Later, Ayushi asks Mahendra to give Golu to her. What will Mahendra do now?

episodesList.title: Mahendra Has Left
episodesList.summary: Everyone wonders who will get Golu's custody and sees a note which says Mahendra is leaving the town and going away. Later, Ayushi finds out that Mahendra ran away with Golu. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Dushyant Jagtap Ki Ego
episodesList.summary: Rashi tells Pushpa that they suspect MLA Jagtap's son is Rashi's stalker. Viren wants to stop Juggal and Pushpa from booking a counter at the cultural centre at any cost. Later, Ashwin tries to stop Mahendra from making a huge mistake.

episodesList.title: Mahendra Wapas Aa Gaya
episodesList.summary: Viren buys all the counters at the Gayatri Cultural Centre. Ayushi tells Pushpa she wants to share Golu with Mahendra. Meanwhile, Mahendra returns with Golu and Pushpa tells him that lawyer Devi can help him. Will Devi help him?

episodesList.title: Sabki Alag Ladai
episodesList.summary: Rashi and her family go to Rashi's college to complain about Dushyant. Later, the lawyer Devi Shekhawat recommended Mahendra refuses to fight his case. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Rashi Follows Dushyant
episodesList.summary: Bapodara attempts to set up his daughter with Jagtap's son. Rashi gets locked in a classroom. Later, Pushpa and Juggal get the opportunity to exhibit the products at the cultural centre where all their products get sold out.

episodesList.title: Rashi's Harrassment
episodesList.summary: Viren gets shocked when he sees Pushpa and Juggal's counter doing so well. Ashwin loses his temper when he finds out what Dushyant did to Rashi. Later, Bapodara decides to talk to MLA Jagtap about Prarthana and Dushyant's marriage. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Viren Ke Phool
episodesList.summary: Viren visits Pushpa and gives her flowers. Susheela tells Bapodara that Chirag dropped her home safely during the storm. Later, Rashi doesn't want Ashwin to come with her to her college. Who will protect Rashi now?

episodesList.title: Dushyant Ka Prank
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Susheela arrive at MLA Jagtap's office to complain about Dushyant. Meanwhile, Dushyant plans to play a dangerous prank on Rashi during the college fest.

episodesList.title: Dushyant Crosses All Lines
episodesList.summary: Organisers at the Gayatri Cultural Centre refuse to give a counter to Pushpa and Pushpa decides to post this injustice on Twipple. Later, MLA Jagtap reaches Rashi's college with Bapodara to stop his son from doing something unforgivable. What is Dushyant planning?

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Himmat Ko Salute
episodesList.summary: Rashi tells everyone the one who has been troubling her is Dushyant Jagtap and MLA Jagtap supports her while Viren creates more problems for Pushpa. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Fake Order
episodesList.summary: Devi Shekhawat decides to fight Mahendra's case. Later, Viren asks Kanhaiya to call Pushpa and pretends to be in the textile business and gives her a big order. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Wants To Take A Big Risk
episodesList.summary: Pushpa wants to keep the house on a mortgage. Devi tells Mahendra that Ayushi has hired a very well-known lawyer while Prarthana is jealous of Riddhi. Later, Juggal gets suspicious about Kanhaiya Shukla.

episodesList.title: Janm Aur Parvarish
episodesList.summary: Ashwin's boss and his business rival meet each other in a meeting set up by Ashwin while Ayushi's lawyer asks very critical questions to Mahendra in court. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Daal Mein Kuch Kala Hai
episodesList.summary: Juggal finds out that Viren made all the ladies sign a contract in Patan and gets suspicious. Later, lawyer Devi requests the court to keep an in-camera session with Golu. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Golu Ko Pata Chala Sach
episodesList.summary: Mahendra is worried about telling Golu the truth about his birth. Deepti is diagnosed with uterine fibroid which would make it harder for her to get pregnant. Later, Pushpa tells the truth to Golu. What will be his reaction?

episodesList.title: Ghar Ke Papers
episodesList.summary: Deepti gets emotional when she sees Asawari's child. Pushpa gives her house papers to Kanhaiya. Later, Mahendra talks to Golu about what will happen in the court. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Golu In Court
episodesList.summary: Ayushi's lawyer shows a video in court where Mahendra is being violent with Golu. Chandrika tells Juggal she also wants to help him and Pushpa. Later, Mahendra tells the court why he lost his anger on Janmashtami. What will the court's decision be now?

episodesList.title: A Game With Golu
episodesList.summary: The court has an in-camera session with Golu. Chandrika decides to leave her job without knowing about the clause that can cost her ten lakh rupees. Later, the judge plays a game with Golu to understand what's in Golu's heart. Who will get Golu's full custody?

episodesList.title: Juggal Aur Pushpa Ko Chahiye Hai Madad
episodesList.summary: Lawyer Devi returns Mahendra's money. Juggal asks Pushpa if they can get help from the students who have passed out from the college. Later, Juggal comes up with a plan to help Tana Bana.

episodesList.title: Deepti Ki Do Maa
episodesList.summary: Deepti's parents and Pushpa find out about Deepti's fibroids issue. Viren's client is impressed by Pushpa and Juggal's design. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Gets A Big Project
episodesList.summary: Mayur's business rival offers a job to Ashwin while Pushpa gives a gift to Juggal. Bapodara finds out about Prarthana and Chirag's date. Later, Prarthana sees Chirag dancing with Riddhi. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Kabiliyat Ka Inaam
episodesList.summary: Bapodara shows Chirag and Riddhi's video to Susheela. Viren has a doubt that the ladies at his workshop might be helping Pushpa secretly while Ashwin has a big day at work. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Success
episodesList.summary: Pushpa celebrates Ashwin's promotion and the new car. Meanwhile, Viren sends his men to Master Ji's house.

episodesList.title: Masterji Ke Ghar Ki Checking
episodesList.summary: Viren goes to Masterji's house and sees something suspicious there. Juggal tells Pushpa they need to find a way to work freely. Later, Ashwin tells Deepti that they can plan for a baby now. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Juggal Aur Pushpa Ka Sath
episodesList.summary: Ashwin finds out that Deepti might never get pregnant. Pushpa's saree catches fire. Masterji tells Pushpa what happened to him. Later, Pushpa gives hope to Ashwin.

episodesList.title: Navratri Ka Pehela Din
episodesList.summary: Deepti wants to handle Tana Bana's export department. Pushpa does Navrati pooja along with her chawl people. Later, Viren's man enters Pushpa's workshop to set it on fire. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Tana Bana Mein Aag
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is devasted when she sees the fire in Tana Bana. Bapodara asks Pushpa to bear all the expenses of the damage in the flat. Viren comes to Bapodara Chawl and Ashwin fights with him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Kya Karegi Pushpa?
episodesList.summary: Pushpa dances in pain and Juggal plays the dhol. Juggal takes Pushpa to Shubhra's house and shows her something which makes her cry. Later, Pushpa tells Juggal they need proof against Viren. What will Juggal do now?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Ka Confession
episodesList.summary: Sonal decides to help Pushpa with money, which makes Ashwin feel awkward. Juggal gets proof against Viren. Later, Pushpa asks Bapodara to install CCTV cameras in the chawl.

episodesList.title: Viren Killed Shubhra
episodesList.summary: Viren decides to make all those women pay, who helped Pushpa. Bapodara overhears Susheela and Pushpa's conversation about Chirag and Prarthana. Later, Juggal finds out that Viren killed Shubhra. What will Juggal do now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Mein Jaga Lalach
episodesList.summary: Ashwin meets his old friend Binesh while Pushpa shows Viren's video to Juggal. Ashwin's friend gives him a shortcut to succeed at work. Later, Pushpa and Juggal make a plan to expose Viren in front of everyone. What is their plan?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ke Ethics
episodesList.summary: Rashi requests Chirag to set up a meeting with Dilip in jail. Rashi finds out Binesh's number for Ashwin. Juggal and Pushpa threaten Viren and ask him to sign their papers. What are these papers about?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ki Dadagiri
episodesList.summary: Ashwin's company gets a big project because of him. Bapodara asks Pushpa to give him the room where Tana Bana is. Later, Susheela fights with Bapodara for Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ne Prarthana Ko Bhadkaya
episodesList.summary: Ashwin returns Sonal money back to her. Prarthana and Chirag get into a fight again. Susheela gives Pushpa her Tana Bana room's stay order application papers. Later, Binesh forces Ashwin to drink with him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Buri Condition
episodesList.summary: Juggal tries to go back to his village. Ashwin ends up drinking a lot with Binesh while Pushpa and Susheela try to solve the issues between Prarthana and Chirag. Later, Bapodara finds Ashwin in an intoxicated state and makes his video.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Se Ho Gayi Galti
episodesList.summary: Deepti and Juggal take Ashwin home and sneak him inside the Tana Bana room. Pushpa doesn't know what Ashwin did and Chirag helps him hide it from her. Will Pushpa find the truth?

episodesList.title: Sabse Purani Dosti
episodesList.summary: Deepti is upset with Ashwin and Ashwin apologises to Deepti's parents. Pushpa, Susheela and Ridhi plan to solve Chirag and Prarthana's issues by reminding them of their friendship. What will happen when Bapodara finds out about this?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Photos
episodesList.summary: Bapodara gets angry when he sees Chirag and Prarthana celebrating together. Bapodara shows Ashwin's drunk photos to Pushpa and tells her that he's following his father's footsteps. What will Pushpa do now?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ki Punishment
