episodesList.summary: Pushpa drinks alcohol to punish Ashwin and forces everyone else to drink. Bapodara tricks Prarthana and plans to take her to Virar with him to get her married. Will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Ashwin And Deepti's Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Susheela tells Pushpa that Bapodara is behaving weirdly. Binesh takes Ashwin to a networking event which makes him late for his anniversary party. Later, Prarthana finds out that Bapodara lied to her. What will Prarthana do now?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Prarthana finds out that Bapodara tricked her to get married. Prarthana escapes and asks Chirag to marry her. What will Chirag do?

episodesList.title: Prarthana And Chirag's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Prarthana tells everyone why she made the decision to get married to Chirag. Bapodara refuses to send Prarthana to Pushpa's house. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: 30-Day Experiment
episodesList.summary: Pushpa says Chirag will stay in Bapodara's house while Prarthana will stay at her place for 30 days. What will be the result of this experiment?

episodesList.title: Bahu Wala Vyavhar
episodesList.summary: Pushpa welcomes Prarthana while Bapodara does Chirag's Grah Pravesh and treats him like his daughter-in-law. How will Chirag react to this?

episodesList.title: Chirag Ka Pehela Test
episodesList.summary: Deepti is upset with Ashwin for coming late to their anniversary party. Bapodara messes with the dishes that Chirag made. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Jawai Ki Rasoi
episodesList.summary: Deepti asks Ashwin if they can adopt a child. Chirag serves the food he has made to his office people while Bapodara tries to insult Chirag in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Chawl Ki Diwali
episodesList.summary: Bapodara asks Pushpa to vacate her Tana Bana workshop. Bapodara Chawl residents prepare to celebrate Diwali together. Meanwhile, some Chawl residents create gossip about Juggal and Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ne Nibhayi Rishtedari
episodesList.summary: Prarthana asks Bapodara to not do anything that he will regret later. Pushpa gives Tana Bana flat to Bapodara and Chirag feels bad about it. What will he do now?

episodesList.title: Chirag Ka Challenge
episodesList.summary: Chirag challenges Bapodara that he will get back Pushpa's Tana Bana flat from him in 72 hours without having any definite plan. Later, Ashwin takes Binesh's help and gets a room for Pushpa where she can set up Tana Bana.

episodesList.title: Sonal Aur Manish Ka Invite
episodesList.summary: Prarthana feels bad when she overhears Rashi complaining to Pushpa about her. Sonal and Manish want to invite Prarthana, her family and Chirag to their place for dinner. Will Bapodara accept their invitation?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Adds A New Twist
episodesList.summary: Chirag impresses everyone with his thoughtful gesture. Bapodara tells Chirag that if he loses his challenge he will have to give up Prarthana forever. What will Chirag do now?

episodesList.title: Sonal Ke Ghar Dinner
episodesList.summary: Everyone arrives at Sonal and Manish's place for dinner. Pushpa makes a plan with Sonal and Susheela to beat Bapodara in the 72-hour challenge. What have they planned?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Masterstroke
episodesList.summary: Pushpa agrees to convince the other chawl members to vote for Bapodara. What is she planning now?

episodesList.title: Dosti Par Utha Sawal
episodesList.summary: Ashwin stops Binesh from meeting Chirag and Chirag gets suspicious. Juggal overhears Hasmukh talking wrongly about his relationship with Pushpa. Will this affect Juggal and Pushpa's relationship?

episodesList.title: Prarthana And Rashi's Fight
episodesList.summary: Juggal decides to go back, but Pushpa and her family stop him from leaving. Rashi and Prarthana get into a fight with each other. Later, Ashwin fights with Deepti for inviting Binesh for dinner.

episodesList.title: Chirag Helps Bapodara
episodesList.summary: Chirag gives an idea to Bapodara for his election symbol while Rashi reminds Chirag she wants to meet Dilip in jail. Later, Binesh goes to Ashwin's house for dinner. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chirag Ki Tehkikaat
episodesList.summary: Juggal tells Pushpa she can't control everything that Rashi does. Chirag decides to meet Ashwin's boss to find out what is Ashwin hiding. What will happen when Ashwin finds out about this?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Nazar Chirag Par
episodesList.summary: Pushpa agrees to send Rashi to meet Dilip in jail. Deepti tells Pushpa about the adoption procedure while Ashwin follows Chirag and keeps an eye on him.

episodesList.title: Chirag Ki Investigation
episodesList.summary: Ashwin confronts Chirag after he goes to meet his boss. Meanwhile, Rashi arrives to meet Dilip in jail.

episodesList.title: Shak Hua Aur Pakka
episodesList.summary: Chirag tells Deepti that Ashwin may be involved in a tender scam and Bapodara overhears their conversation. Later, Bapodara doesn't invite Pushpa and her family to his event.

episodesList.title: Rashi Is Worried For Dilip
episodesList.summary: Bapodara invites Pushpa and her family to his event. Rashi finds out that someone tried to kill Dilip in jail while Ashwin lies to his boss about Chirag being out of town.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ka Special Day
episodesList.summary: Bapodara starts getting soft towards Chirag. Ashwin's boss meets Chirag. Later, Rashi finds out that Dilip is not well and gets extremely worried for him. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Dilip Ho Raha Hai Riha
episodesList.summary: Rashi rushes to Bapodara's event and tells Pushpa that she needs to help Dilip. Bapodara tells Chirag that he won't let Prarthana stay with Dilip under one roof. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Kon Lega Dilip Ki Responsibilty?
episodesList.summary: The doctor emphasizes to Pushpa's family that Dilip requires love and support for recovery. Later, Bapodara informs Rashi that to secure permission for her father to stay in the workshop, she must send his daughter back home. What will Rashi do now?

episodesList.title: Tough Decision For Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa discusses with her family members what she should do about Dilip. Meanwhile, Sharan returns to the Bapodara Chawl.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Defensive Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Bapodara discloses Ashwin's scam to Susheela. In a heated confrontation, Ashwin slaps Chirag, triggering Chirag's determination to expose him at any cost. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Story Bahar Ayegi Ya Nahi?
episodesList.summary: Deepti chooses not to leave Pushpa alone during this challenging period. Chirag presents Ashwin's tender scam story to his boss, and Pushpa works to secure a place for Dilip to stay. What unfolds next in this complex situation?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Ashwin Par Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Binesh tells Ashwin to ask Mayur for help to stop the article. Deepti and Chirag then share Ashwin's scam with Pushpa, leaving her shocked. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Dilip's Influence On Ashwin
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Ashwin that Chirag won't take back his article from his boss while Guru plans to kill Dilip. Later, Pushpa doesn't want Ashwin to be near Dilip.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Sabse Badi Galti
episodesList.summary: Bapodara prints out Ashwin's news, and posts it on the society billboard, causing a public scene. Ashwin faces reprimand from his boss, who fails to offer support to him. Will Ashwin realise his mistake now?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ki Sazaa
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gets suspended from his job after the news about his wrongdoings comes out. Ashwin gets angry at his family members for not supporting him. Meanwhile, Pushpa is worried that Ashwin might commit some other mistake.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ke Aarop
episodesList.summary: Bapodara wants his daughter to file for a divorce and stay away from Pushpa and her family. He alleges that Dilip and his son are criminals and should be thrown out of the chawl along with their family.

episodesList.title: Verdict On Ashwin
episodesList.summary: The investigating team finds Ashwin guilty and fines him 40 lakh rupees for his involvement in the scam. How will Ashwin and his family react to this?

episodesList.title: Saving Ashwin's Freedom
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and her family scramble to gather funds in a desperate bid to prevent Ashwin from facing imprisonment. Will they be able to do so?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Loses Control
episodesList.summary: Ashwin's struggle to maintain control intensifies, casting a shadow of stress over the entire family and straining his relationship with Deepti. Can this challenging situation take a turn for the better?

episodesList.title: Maa Kehne Ka Haq
episodesList.summary: Upset with Ashwin, Pushpa asserts that he must earn the right to address her as mother until she deems him worthy.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Refuses To Live In The Same House
episodesList.summary: Ashwin refuses to live in the same house after his altercation with Pushpa and the other family members. Will a solution be found?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Falls Down The Stairs
episodesList.summary: Chirag finds out about Ashwin and Deepti leaving the house and consoles Pushpa. Bapodara questions Pushpa about Juggal staying back. Later, in a tussle with Chirag, Bapodara falls down the stairs. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: Bapodara gets injured after falling and blames Chirag for it. But Chirag claims that it was an accident. Whose side will the family members take?

episodesList.title: Juggal Leaves The Chawl
episodesList.summary: Juggal bids the chawl members goodbye and leaves. Deepti's father encourages Ashwin to get back to work. Later, Deepti and Sonal visit Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Request To Bapodara
episodesList.summary: Chirag requests Bapodara to let Dilip live in the chawl on a temporary basis. Later, when Dilip arrives to the chawl from the hospital, Bapodara changes his mind about letting him stay in the chawl.

episodesList.title: Rashi's Determination
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Pushpa and the others about Dilip's diagnosis. Sushila questions her husband's behaviour towards Pushpa. Meanwhile, Rashi is determined to help Dilip come out of the state he is in.

episodesList.title: Taking Care Of Dilip
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's family looks after Dilip, who can't care for himself. Meanwhile, Ashwin and Deepti clash over Ashwin feeling neglected, thinking his father-in-law values business more than their relationship.

episodesList.title: Majboor Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Ashwin explodes in anger upon discovering Dilip is residing at Pushpa's house. Manish reveals to Ashwin that he prioritized their relationship over his business. Meanwhile, Bapodara tells Susheela that he wants to evict Pushpa and her family from the chawl as soon as possible.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Crosses His Line
episodesList.summary: Bapodara enraged, plans to hit Dilip with a bat. Meanwhile, Manish seeks help from his friend Naleen to secure a job for Ashwin in his company. Later, Pushpa implores Devi to intervene and prevent Bapodara from evicting her and her family from their house.

episodesList.title: Kanoon Ki Khabar
episodesList.summary: Juggal suggests to Pushpa that she should have pursued a career as a social activist. Bapodara speaks harshly to Rashi, prompting a strong response from Pushpa, while Juggal decides to arrange money for Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Jewellery Chhupani Hogi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa shares with Chirag and Rashi that Dilip wasn't always bad. Meanwhile, Susheela and Prarthana devise a plan to temporarily conceal Susheela's imitation jewellery from Bapodara. Later, lawyer Devi seeks Pushpa's assistance with her work.

episodesList.title: Pushpa‚Äôs New Teacher
episodesList.summary: Rashi wants Dilip and Pushpa to get back together. Ashwin attends a crucial job interview. In a subsequent conversation, Devi shares the complexities of her cases with Pushpa, igniting Pushpa's desire to learn more from her.

episodesList.title: Bapodara Ka Shak
episodesList.summary: Bapodara follows Susheela and Prarthana to the jewellery store. Meanwhile, Pushpa asks for Devi's advice about how she should deal with Dilip and Rashi.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Wapas Aa Rahi Hai
episodesList.summary: Rashi visits Deepti's house and is overcome with emotion upon seeing a picture of Deepti and her father. Pushpa doesn't want to accept money from Juggal. Later, Prarthana shares with Chirag that she will return to live with them again.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Anger Is Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Ashwin erupts in anger upon discovering that Manish obtained a job for him through a favour from his friend. Meanwhile, Bapodara uncovers the truth that all of Susheela's jewellery is fake. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Chirag Par Lagaya Ilzaam
episodesList.summary: Manish advises Sonal not to question Ashwin. Bapodara accuses Chirag of stealing Susheela's jewellery. Later, Deepti attempts to prevent Ashwin from leaving but faints.

episodesList.title: Deepti's Operation
episodesList.summary: The doctor tells Deepti's family about the necessity of an operation, with the potential consequence of Deepti never being able to become a mother. Meanwhile, Bapodara expresses anger towards Prarthana and Susheela for helping Pushpa. Later, Bapodara urges Prarthana to sign divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Deepti Is Awake
episodesList.summary: Ashwin grapples with overwhelming guilt for not being there for Deepti. Deepti wakes up in the hospital and realises how badly Ashwin treated her. Meanwhile, Pushpa invites Prarthana to her home.

episodesList.title: Deepti's Decision
episodesList.summary: Deepti says that she wants a divorce from Ashwin. Meanwhile, Pushpa brings Prarthana back to her house.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Has A Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Deepti she won't force her to change her decision. Bapodara files a police complaint against Pushpa's family. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Sabke Samne Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Susheela tells Bapodara he owes her money while Deepti signs her divorce papers. Later, Susheela extends an invitation for everyone to witness the marriage of Prarthana and Chirag.

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ko Divorce Nahi Chahiye
episodesList.summary: Prarthana and Chirag get married in front of the whole chawl while Ashwin refuses to sign the divorce papers. Later, Bapodara doesn't let Susheela enter his house.

episodesList.title: Susheela In The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Pushpa helps Devi with a new and interesting case. Susheela faints due to weakness while Ashwin asks Devi for help.

episodesList.title: Susheela‚Äôs Heart Problem
episodesList.summary: Bapodara provides care and support for Susheela. The doctor advises Susheela's family to ensure her happiness and minimize stress. Meanwhile, Deepti's lawyer suggests proving in court that Ashwin isn't an ideal husband.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Last Chance
episodesList.summary: Ashwin signs the divorce papers and asks Bhaskar to give them to Deepti. Meanwhile, Prarthana and Chirag come up with a plan to bring Juggal back to the Chawl.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Emotional Support
episodesList.summary: Rashi uncovers Prarthana and Chirag's plan to reunite Juggal with Pushpa. Bhaskar and his wife arrange a meeting for Ashwin and Deepti to resolve their issues. What unfolds next?

episodesList.title: Juggal Is Back
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asserts her independence, expressing that she requires only her family's support, not a man's. The family is taken aback when Juggal unexpectedly appears in Bapodara Chawl.

episodesList.title: Naya Bapodara
episodesList.summary: Pushpa returns Susheela's jewellery, leading to a sincere apology from Bapodara. Makar Sankranti is joyously celebrated at Bapodara Chawl, and Prarthana requests Bapodara's permission for Juggal to stay.

episodesList.title: Rashi Wants Dilip To Get Better
episodesList.summary: Deepti doesn't want alimony from Ashwin. Juggal grapples with feelings for Pushpa as Ashwin returns. Later, Dilip stands on his feet. Is his health improving?

episodesList.title: Aarav's Birthday Celebrations
episodesList.summary: It's Aarav's birthday and the celebrations are in full swing. But just then, Dilip arrives with the thief who stole the entrance papers. Will he expose the truth and shock everyone?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ne Palta Khel
episodesList.summary: As Dilip gets the thief and forces him to name the person who asked him to steal the entrance exam, he blurts out Pushpa's name. How will the colony members react to this lie?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Presentation
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is running late after the chaos caused by Dilip in the chawl. Will she manage to reach on time for her important presentation and make a good impression?

episodesList.title: The Truth Behind The Video
episodesList.summary: When the video of the thief accusing Pushpa circulates widely, the college begins discussing her future. Meanwhile, Rajveer analyses everything and senses that the real story is yet to come out.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Suspension
episodesList.summary: While the students argue about Pushpa's guilt, she receives a suspension order and is asked to leave college. Meanwhile, Kadambari tells the thief to escape after getting bail. Will her plan succeed?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Finds Information
episodesList.summary: Rajveer looks into Kadambari's past, while she informs Pushpa about Jugal wanting to leave the chawl. Meanwhile, Koyal searches for evidence to clear Pushpa's name.

episodesList.title: Deepti's Announcement
episodesList.summary: Rajveer finds a video proving Pushpa's innocence in the phone stealing case. Meanwhile, Deepti gathers her whole family to make a big announcement.

episodesList.title: The Thief's Confession
episodesList.summary: The AC repairman who stole the phone finally confesses in front of everyone, clearing Pushpa's name. Meanwhile, Swara starts feeling insecure about getting less love after the new baby arrives.

episodesList.title: Jugal's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Jugal declares he is ready to leave Tana Bana and might also leave the chawl. How will everyone react to this shocking news?

episodesList.title: Tana Bana Ka Ant
episodesList.summary: Jugal decides to leave Tana Bana, shocking everyone. Meanwhile, Rajveer starts digging into Kadambari's past and begins his investigation.

episodesList.title: Kadambari Isolates Jugal
episodesList.summary: Kadambari learns that Dilip and Rajveer might expose her, so she tries to turn Jugal against them. Will Jugal trust her or see through her plan?

episodesList.title: Toofan Aane Ka Sandesha
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Jugal sign the Tana Bana papers. Meanwhile, Rajveer faces backlash from the board members for defending Pushpa's innocence.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Just as Rajveer is about to expose Kadambari, she gets him kidnapped. Will he manage to escape and reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Exposes Kadambari
episodesList.summary: Rajveer breaks free and hurries to unmask Kadambari's secrets. But will the residents trust him, or will Kadambari twist the story to her favour again?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ka Khel Khatam
episodesList.summary: After Rajveer exposes Kadambari in front of everyone, she begs Pushpa for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Jugal feels deeply hurt and files a complaint against her. How will Kadambari handle this shock?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Fights For Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Rajveer pleads with the college board to bring Pushpa back after clearing her name. Will they admit their mistake and allow her to return?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ne Rakhi Shart
episodesList.summary: Kadambari refuses to let go of control easily and puts forth terms when Jugal tries to reason with her. Will a compromise be possible?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Celebrates Guru Purnima
episodesList.summary: Pushpa wishes Rajveer on Guru Purnima, thanking him for guiding her, as he tells her she can return to college. But Pushpa says she has let go of that dream. Will Rajveer be able to convince her to start again?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ki Agli Chaal
episodesList.summary: Just when the residents thought they were done with Kadambari, she arrives with a new condition. Will they agree to her latest demand?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ke Liye Shart
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks Jugal to move in with Dilip. Dilip and Jugal put forth their condition in front of Pushpa before complying with her demand.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Returns To College
episodesList.summary: Pushpa's dreams revive with her return to college, but Kadambari isn't ready to back down just yet. What's her next move?

episodesList.title: Jugal Files For Divorce
episodesList.summary: Kadambari tries to win the chawl back by helping with Janmashtami celebrations. But to her surprise, Jugal hands her the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Swara Feels Insecure
episodesList.summary: Swara feels left out ever since Deepti's pregnancy has taken centre stage. Will her family sense the change in her and help her cope with this silent emotional struggle before it is too late?

episodesList.title: Swara Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Ashwin learns that Swara is missing from school, leaving him shocked. Meanwhile, the chawl discovers that Golu left with a bag to meet her. Where has Swara gone?

episodesList.title: Rescuing Swara
episodesList.summary: Swara's sudden disappearance throws the family into chaos. While they search everywhere, Swara struggles to escape the rickshaw driver's trap. Can she be rescued?

episodesList.title: Rajveer To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: As the family looks for Swara in a state of panic, Rajveer takes charge of the situation. Will he be able to find her before something goes wrong?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Loses His Cool
episodesList.summary: The stress of Swara's disappearance leads to complications in Deepti's pregnancy, pushing Ashwin over the edge. Can the family calm him down?

episodesList.title: Zimmedari Ya Sapna?
episodesList.summary: Still shaken after Swara's disappearance, Pushpa finds herself torn between returning to college and handling her responsibilities at home. Will she be able to choose what truly matters?

episodesList.title: Swara Ki Chinta
episodesList.summary: Haunted by the memory of Swara's disappearance, Deepti begins to act strangely out of paranoia. Meanwhile, the chawl steps up its security measures. Will peace return to their lives?

episodesList.title: Chawl Ki Security
episodesList.summary: Deepti's paranoia makes her lock the house from the inside. Meanwhile, Jugal sets up digital security for the chawl. Later, Rajveer gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: Kadambari's ploy lands Rajveer in jail, shifting the responsibility onto Pushpa. Will she rise to the occasion and save him?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Wants Alimony
episodesList.summary: As Rajveer's troubles grow, Pushpa tries to stand by him and find a way out. Meanwhile, Kadambari shocks Jugal by asking for alimony. Will he give her what she wants?

episodesList.title: Nyay Ki Jung
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is determined to convince Rajveer to fight for himself and prove his innocence. She's willing to do whatever it takes from outside the prison. Will she succeed in changing his mind?

episodesList.title: Sonam Se Mulaqat
episodesList.summary: Pushpa visits Sonam, the woman who accused Rajveer of harassment. Will this meeting help reveal the truth or create more questions than answers?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ka Doosra Mauka
episodesList.summary: Prarthana's missed deadline breaks her spirit, but Pushpa steps in to turn things around. Will she get a second chance?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Se Doori
episodesList.summary: Koyal confides in Pushpa about the messages she received from Rajveer. Meanwhile, Jugal firmly tells Kadambari that he wants her out of his life. Will Pushpa manage to uncover the evidence needed to save Rajveer?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Investigates The Case
episodesList.summary: Taking matters into her own hands, Pushpa begins searching for the person framing Rajveer. Will she stumble upon a clue?

episodesList.title: Suman Aur Kadambari Ka Connection
episodesList.summary: While connecting the dots, Pushpa learns from Jugal that Suman's call came through Kadambari's phone. This surprising piece of information makes her rethink the entire situation.

episodesList.title: Kadambari's Master Stroke
episodesList.summary: In a bold move, Kadambari appoints Rajveer's ex wife to fight against him. Will Rajveer be able to keep his composure?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Argues His Case
episodesList.summary: Surprising everyone, Rajveer walks into court ready to fight his own case after battling his inner struggles. How will the court react?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Plays His Cards
episodesList.summary: Rajveer shocks the court with his strong arguments and presents crucial evidence that could change everything. Will this be enough for him to finally prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ka Challenge
episodesList.summary: Kadambari challenges Pushpa to a Dahi Handi competition, declaring that she will leave the chawl if she loses. Meanwhile, the court delivers its verdict in Rajveer's case. Will he be able to turn things around?

episodesList.title: Suman Ki Majboori
episodesList.summary: Rajveer changes the game by using his trump card and forcing Suman to take back her accusation. What move does he make to turn the tables?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Aur Pushpa Ka Muqabla
episodesList.summary: The chawl gears up for Janmashtami celebrations but all eyes are on Pushpa and Kadambari. A fiery Matka breaking competition begins as Kadambari throws down her daring challenge.

episodesList.title: Janmashtami Ka Maha Muqabala
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Kadambari go head-to-head in the handi competition during Janmashtami. With pride and respect on the line, who will emerge victorious in this exciting face-off?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ka Bada Khulasa
episodesList.summary: After losing the challenge, Kadambari prepares to leave the colony but not before making one final revelation. What will she unveil before everyone?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ka Ghinona Khel
episodesList.summary: Kadambari cooks up a lie about her pregnancy to gain sympathy. While Jugal doubts her, Pushpa stands by her. Will Kadambari's scheme work or backfire?

episodesList.title: Jugal Ka Dukh
episodesList.summary: Jugal and Pushpa anxiously wait for Kadambari's final pregnancy report. Meanwhile, Rajveer drowns his pain in alcohol after being hurt by his daughter's harsh words.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Helps Rajveer Heal
episodesList.summary: After Rajveer's excessive drinking, Pushpa takes it upon herself to care for him and bring him back on track. Can she truly change his state of mind?

episodesList.title: Naina Digs Deeper
episodesList.summary: Naina goes further into Koyal's past and uncovers shocking secrets. At the same time, Kadambari tries to turn Prarthana against Deepti.

episodesList.title: Naina Ki Jhoothi Dosti
episodesList.summary: Naina pretends to be Rajat's friend and offers to help him impress Koyal, but she hides her true intentions. Meanwhile, Kadambari's poisonous words make Prarthana bitter towards Deepti. Will Naina's fake act be exposed?

episodesList.title: Kadambari's Fake Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: While Kadambari uses a false pregnancy to win over Jugal, Prarthana finds herself distracted from her studies. With exams around the corner, she battles to stay focused amid the family drama.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Ki Padhai
episodesList.summary: The chaos at home makes it impossible for Prarthana to study for her exams. Bapodara suggests a temporary stay at a hotel. But will she have the courage to step away from the family?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Stands Up For Rajveer
episodesList.summary: Rohini confronts Pushpa for reuniting Rajveer with their daughter Riya. Later, Kadambari opens up to Jugal about their baby. How will Jugal respond?

episodesList.title: Sonal Visits The Chawl
episodesList.summary: With Deepti expecting and Prarthana needing to concentrate on exams, Sonal tries to take Deepti home while Bapodara plans to send Prarthana away. Can the family figure out how to manage both at once?

episodesList.title: Rumours About Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Naina hatches a wicked scheme to ruin Pushpa's name by spreading rumours about her and Rajveer. Later, she tries to drag Rajat, Koyal and her husband into drama, stirring up more chaos.

episodesList.title: Koyal In Deep Trouble
episodesList.summary: Naina's plan unfolds perfectly as Koyal's in-laws show up at college right when Rajat tries to confess. Will this stir up chaos or bring out hidden truths?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Compels Jugal
episodesList.summary: While Sonali and Bapodara get into a row, Kadambari compels Jugal to bring home the Ganesh Idol with her. Later, Kadambari puts forth a condition involving Jugal.

episodesList.title: Ganpati Celebration In The Chawl
episodesList.summary: As Ganpati celebrations light up the chawl, Kadambari plays her cards to gain sympathy. The mood shifts when Pushpa prays for Jugal's future child, creating an uncomfortable moment between him and Kadambari.

episodesList.title: Police Arrive To Arrest Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa urges Koyal to inform Raghav about her whereabouts. Later, the police arrive at the chawl to arrest Pushpa for sheltering Koyal. How will Pushpa handle this situation?

episodesList.title: Padhne Ka Adhikaar
episodesList.summary: Pushpa takes a stand for Koyal when her in-laws object to her education and growth. Will Pushpa's support give Koyal the courage to fight back against such regressive thinking?

episodesList.title: Riya Meets Jugal
episodesList.summary: Sonal feels hurt after Bapodara laughs at her, sparking bitterness between them. Meanwhile, Kadambari quietly fuels her next scheme by speaking to Riya about Jugal's fondness for her as a daughter.

episodesList.title: Mr. Kotak's Threat
episodesList.summary: With Sonal and Bapodara finally at peace, the household calms down. But Mr. Kotak is far from happy and threatens Pushpa over the situation with his son Rajat.

episodesList.title: Rajat Fights For His Life
episodesList.summary: Rajat battles for his life in the hospital after a shocking attempt to end it all. As his loved ones stand by, torn between fear and hope. Will he recover from this and find his way back?

episodesList.title: The Weight of Expectations
episodesList.summary: Rajat narrowly escapes death after his failed attempt to end his life. Later, he opens up to Pushpa about his strained relationship with Mr. Kotak and the pressure of being forced into a career he doesn't want.

episodesList.title: Mr Kotak Ki Conditions
episodesList.summary: Mr Kotak permits Rajat to do as he wishes, but with a condition. With Mr Kotak planning to use Rajat's suicide against Pushpa, how will she protect herself?

episodesList.title: Rajat Blames His Father
episodesList.summary: Trying to cover up his son's accusations, Mr. Kotak rejects the police's claims about the suicide attempt. Just then, Rajat makes a dramatic entry and blames his father for it all. Will the police arrest him?

episodesList.title: Sonography Report
episodesList.summary: By faking her sonography results, Kadambari intends to mislead the family. Will they be taken in by her cunning scheme?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Begs For A Second Chance
episodesList.summary: Rajveer breaks down before his daughter, asking for one last chance to show he can truly be the father she has always wanted. Will Riya forgive him?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Made To Choose
episodesList.summary: Ria forces Rajveer to choose between her and Pushpa, while Kadambari escalates matters by faking an injury during her pregnancy. How will everyone react to these shocking twists?

episodesList.title: Ria Apologises
episodesList.summary: Ria realises her mistake and apologises for her actions, while Kadambari struggles as her pregnancy lie inches closer to being exposed. Will she find a way out?

episodesList.title: Rajveer And Ria Unite
episodesList.summary: Rajveer reconciles with his daughter and expresses his gratitude to Pushpa. Later, Pushpa spots Ashwin in Mumbai and decides to follow him.

episodesList.title: Ashwin's Surprise
episodesList.summary: Ashwin shocks everyone by revealing that he had been in town all along but couldn't inform them. Meanwhile, Kadambari pretends with a fake bulge to prove her pregnancy. Will Jugal uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Pushpa’s Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Ashwin's attempts to appear normal only make Pushpa more suspicious. She feels he is concealing something grave about his health. Could it be cancer? Will she finally uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Takes Care of Anjana
episodesList.summary: While Pushpa sets out to find the truth about Ashwin's strange behaviour, Ashwin focuses on looking after Anjana. How long can he keep this hidden from the family?

episodesList.title: Pushpa On Ashwin’s Trail
episodesList.summary: Pushpa grows desperate to uncover what Ashwin is hiding and begins her own investigation. Meanwhile, Kadambari senses something is wrong and becomes curious about Pushpa's behaviour. Will Ashwin's secret finally come out?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Lashes Out At Ashwin
episodesList.summary: Pushpa discovers that Ashwin has been living with Anjana all this while, keeping it hidden from his family. How will she react when she learns the reason behind his secret?

episodesList.title: Ashwin Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Ashwin reveals the truth about Anjana to Pushpa. Meanwhile, the family stands by Deepti in the hospital. How will Pushpa handle it?

episodesList.title: Do Naon Mei Sawaar
episodesList.summary: Anjana confronts Ashwin and pleads with him not to sacrifice his marriage for her, while Pushpa struggles with guilt for hiding the truth from Deepti. Later, Pushpa decides to meet Anjana.

episodesList.title: Garba At Bapodara Chawl
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Dileep about Anjana while Bapodara Chawl prepares for Garba. Amidst it all, will Ashwin's truth come out before Deepti?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Fights With Her Conscience
episodesList.summary: The family celebrates Deepti's anniversary while Ashwin looks after Anjana in the hospital. Meanwhile, Pushpa struggles with her conscience for hiding the truth from Deepti.

episodesList.title: Deepti Gets Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Deepti grows suspicious of Ashwin's odd behaviour and decides to follow him. Will her search uncover the truth about Anjana?

episodesList.title: Godh Bharai
episodesList.summary: Deepti confronts Ashwin, questioning him about a possible affair. Meanwhile, the family gears up for her God Bharai ceremony. Will Anjana's truth finally come out?

episodesList.title: Deepti Ke Doubts
episodesList.summary: Kadambari plants seeds of doubt in Deepti's mind about Pushpa and Ashwin keeping a secret from her. Meanwhile, Ashwin is at the hospital with Anjana. What will happen when Deepti learns the truth?

episodesList.title: Sonal Exposes Pushpa And Ashwin
episodesList.summary: Sonal exposes Ashwin and Pushpa, urging Deepti to leave with her. Will Deepti really believe Ashwin was having an affair?

episodesList.title: Deepti Feels Traumatised
episodesList.summary: Deepti is still in a state of shock after finding out about Ashwin spending time with Anjana behind her back. While Ashwin tries to get in touch with her, her family refuses to let him. Will he be able to prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Makes Amends
episodesList.summary: Pushpa attempts to clear the air with Sonal and make her understand. But will Deepti and her family forgive Ashwin after all that has happened?

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Results
episodesList.summary: Prarthana and her entire family are filled with anticipation as they eagerly check her results online. Will her dreams come true?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Chala America
episodesList.summary: Excitement runs high as Bapodara prepares for his big trip to America. The whole chawl joins in his joy, celebrating his dream come true. But will everything go according to plan, or will unexpected hurdles arise on his way?

episodesList.title: Bapodara Kaha Hain?
episodesList.summary: As Bapodara's flight goes missing, Pushpa and the others try to console Susheela. Later, though the flight lands safely, Bapodara is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

episodesList.title: Karva Chauth In The Chawl
episodesList.summary: Chirag sincerely apologises to Bapodara for his mistake that landed him in trouble with the customs. Meanwhile, the entire colony is caught up in the excitement of Karva Chauth but Deepti remains upset with Ashwin and refuses to forgive him.

episodesList.title: Deepti Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Deepti walks in on Ashwin telling Anjana that he loves her. Why did he say those words, and how will she react?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Gets Her Reports
episodesList.summary: Prarthana receives her medical reports, uncovering a shocking truth that shatters her completely. Meanwhile, Pushpa makes every effort to mend the rift between Ashwin and Deepti. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Pregnancy Belt
episodesList.summary: The family comforts Prarthana and tries to give her strength. Meanwhile, the laundry man questions Chirag about the belt Kadambari accidentally dropped. Will her secret come out?

episodesList.title: Deepti Ka Vaada
episodesList.summary: Deepti promises to give Prarthana one of her children. Soon after, Ashwin opposes the idea when the discussion opens up in the family. Will Deepti change her mind after Ashwin converses with her?

episodesList.title: Anjana Meets Deepti
episodesList.summary: While Prarthana discusses with Pushpa about taking care of Deepti's child, Anjana arrives at Deepti's house to meet her. Later, Ashwin also shows up. What will happen when they come face to face?

episodesList.title: Deepti Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Deepti finally returns home after clearing the air with Ashwin and promising Prarthana one of the twins once the babies are born. How will everyone react to her unexpected decision?

episodesList.title: Water Problems In The Chawl
episodesList.summary: The chawl suffers as shortage of water grips the chawl. Meanwhile, Bapodara tells Chirag to reconsider their decision about taking Deepti's baby. Will Chirag get convinced?

episodesList.title: Rishton Mein Daraar
episodesList.summary: Cracks in relationships begin to surface as Bapodara suggests taking the legal route for adoption, while Ashwin still disagrees with Deepti's decision to give a child to Prarthana. Will the family find a way to mend things?

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Just as Prarthana prepares to leave for her IPS training, Bapodara's words make her change her decision, leaving her family shocked. Will they accept her choice?

episodesList.title: Deepti's Medical Emergency
episodesList.summary: Deepti is rushed to the hospital after experiencing complications in her pregnancy, leaving everyone anxious. What will the doctors reveal, and will she and the babies be safe?

episodesList.title: Kadambari's Act
episodesList.summary: Kadambari pretends to be in labour and gets herself admitted to the same hospital as Deepti. With this risky plan in motion, will she manage to steal one of Deepti's babies or will her lie finally be exposed?

episodesList.title: The Day Of The Delivery
episodesList.summary: As Deepti goes into labour and the doctors attempt a successful operation, Kadambari plots to pull off her act and steal one of the babies. Will her plan succeed?

episodesList.title: The Baby Swap
episodesList.summary: Kadambari executes her wicked plan and secretly swaps the babies. The doctor soon informs the family that one of the babies didn't make it. Will Pushpa and her family discover the truth?

episodesList.title: Caught On Camera
episodesList.summary: The family hides the heartbreaking news of what they believe to be the death of Deepti's baby, keeping it from her as she recovers. Meanwhile, Kadambari lands in trouble when CCTV footage shows the warden she bribed stealing a stillborn. Will her secret be exposed?

episodesList.title: Shattered Hearts
episodesList.summary: Prarthana is devastated after learning about the baby's death, and both she and Deepti are shattered by the loss. Will Kadambari's sinister plan finally come to light?

episodesList.title: Golden Opportunity For Deepti
episodesList.summary: Deepti receives a golden opportunity to work in London, but it means being away from her baby for seven years. Will she take the offer, and will the family support her decision?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Aur Jugal Ka Decision
episodesList.summary: Kadambari gives ten lakh rupees to Rekha to keep her silent. Meanwhile, as the family discusses Deepti's new opportunity, Jugal and Kadambari decide to raise their child in the village.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's New Life
episodesList.summary: Time has passed, and Pushpa is now a lawyer, determined to win her first case. Will she make her mark and fight for justice?

episodesList.title: Chirag Upset With Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Chirag is upset with Prarthana for accusing him of illegally taking money from the chawl members. Will Prarthana's new responsibilities as a police officer create cracks in their relationship?

episodesList.title: Heavy Metal Poisoning
episodesList.summary: Pushpa panics when someone at her workplace suffers a seizure after eating her Puran Poli. The doctors reveal it was caused by heavy metal poisoning. What could have led to this shocking incident?

episodesList.title: Chirag Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: Pushpa reopens Batlar's tea stall but is mocked by the other lawyers. Later, on the day of their wedding anniversary, Prarthana arrives home with the police to arrest Chirag.

episodesList.title: Chirag's Criminal Tendencies
episodesList.summary: Rashi reveals that it was Chirag who beat up her boyfriend Rishabh, and Pushpa presses her for not telling them about him earlier. Can they stop Chirag from getting deeper into illegal activities?

episodesList.title: Rashi Confronts Chirag
episodesList.summary: Swara feels heartbroken, believing her parents have abandoned her. Meanwhile, in jail, Chirag loses his temper and beats up a man who insults Prarthana. Later, Rashi confronts Chirag about his actions.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Witnesses Rajveer In Court
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Dakshesh witness Rajveer argue a case in court. Later, Pushpa drops by at the jail to meet Chirag.

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Mother Steps In
episodesList.summary: As Pushpa apologises for Chirag's actions, Rishabh's mother storms in to defend her son and accuses Pushpa and her family. Will Pushpa be able to resolve the conflict?

episodesList.title: Batlar's Treatment
episodesList.summary: Dilip decides to confront Rishabh and his family, taking a firm stand against them. Meanwhile, Pushpa grows anxious about Batlar's condition, as he urgently needs a transplant. Will she be able to save his life?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Gets Attacked
episodesList.summary: Pushpa faces the fury of the mob outside the court as they pressure her to take back the case. Injured and helpless, will anyone stand by her?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Fight For Justice
episodesList.summary: Radha Kaku inspires Pushpa to take up the cause and fight for justice, and seeing Batlar's health deteriorate motivates her even more. Meanwhile, Swara feels distant because Ashwin and Deepti have not been in her life during her crucial years.

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Family Arrives
episodesList.summary: Rishabh and his family come to the chawl to meet Rashi. How will Pushpa respond when she learns about their visit?

episodesList.title: Batlar Gets A Donor
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is overjoyed to learn that Batlar has finally received a donor, but she cannot shake off the curiosity about how such an unlikely miracle took place. Meanwhile, Kadambari continues to rule over an entire village through fear and intimidation.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Connects The Dots
episodesList.summary: Rishabh's mother overhears Rashi suggesting that they get married behind their families' backs, leaving her shocked and anxious about what the two might be planning. Meanwhile, Pushpa uncovers a company with suspicious connections. What hidden truth is waiting to surface?

episodesList.title: Swara Refuses To Forgive
episodesList.summary: Swara's resentment towards Deepti and Ashwin's London life keeps her from embracing them on their return, while Prarthana starts digging into what appears to be a human trafficking operation.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’s Secret Investigation
episodesList.summary: Pushpa disguises herself as a journalist to dig deeper into the company's illegal activities. Meanwhile, Rashi and Rishabh find themselves cornered, with eloping seeming like their only option. Will they take the leap?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Investigates The Racket
episodesList.summary: While Prarthana works tirelessly to uncover the roots of the trafficking ring, the family faces a crisis of their own as Rashi suddenly goes missing. Has she eloped?

episodesList.title: Rashi And Rishabh Ki Shaadi Pakki
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Madhmati set their differences aside for the sake of Rishabh and Rashi. Later, Ashwin and Deepti sit down with Chirag and Prarthana to talk about the state of their relationship.

episodesList.title: Batlar's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: As Pushpa digs deeper into the company's murky dealings, Batlar's life hangs in the balance when the goons track him down to the hospital. Meanwhile, Ashwin discovers that they have lost their business licence, and Chirag seems to be hiding something crucial.

episodesList.title: Rishabh Lashes Out
episodesList.summary: As Pushpa and her family visit Rishabh's home for dinner, it becomes clear that his mother intends to make things uncomfortable for them. Later, Rishabh suddenly lashes out at a house help for dropping food, leaving everyone stunned. How will they respond to his outburst?

episodesList.title: Search For Rekha
episodesList.summary: Prarthana's investigation reveals a possible tie between Rekha and Kadambari, prompting Kadambari to push Rekha into hiding until the turmoil fades. Can Prarthana find her in time?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Fights For Batlar
episodesList.summary: Despite constant warnings about how messy the case could get, Pushpa stands firm for Batlar and gets ready to take on Rajveer's powerful law firm. Will she pull it off?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Meets Kadambari
episodesList.summary: As Rishabh and Rashi visit an astrologer to match their horoscopes and move forward with their wedding plans, Prarthana travels to Gujarat to question Kadambari about Rekha. Will she find Rekha?

episodesList.title: Madhumati Ki Shanka
episodesList.summary: In the middle of the ceremony, Madhumati accuses Pushpa and her family of being frauds. With the kundlis not matching, how will the wedding move forward now?

episodesList.title: The Hunt For Rekha
episodesList.summary: Prarthana desperately looks for Rekha in Gujarat as Kadambari tries to foil her plans pretending to not know about her whereabouts. Meanwhile, the family notices some toxic traits in Rishabh after he threatens to give his life up. How will the family react to this situation?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Gets Detained
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is detained on charges of bribery and alleged involvement in the blast. Meanwhile, Rajveer argues before the judge that the case should be dismissed for lack of evidence. Will Pushpa clear her name in time and continue her fight for Batlar?

episodesList.title: Rekha Under Arrest
episodesList.summary: Prarthana manages to trap Rekha just as planned. Meanwhile, Titli prepares to slip away to Mumbai to meet Ansh. What will Kadambari do when she realises her secrets are on the verge of coming out?

episodesList.title: Titli Meets Ansh
episodesList.summary: Titli takes a bus to Mumbai to meet Ansh behind Kadambari's back. Soon both families realise they are nowhere to be found and start looking for them. Will they be safe?

episodesList.title: Ansh And Titli Get Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Ansh and Titli are taken away by the goons, while the family only now realises that Titli is in Mumbai to meet Ansh. Will they be able to rescue them in time?

episodesList.title: Kadambari In Disguise
episodesList.summary: Kadambari sneaks into the jail in disguise and confronts Rekha about her daughter. Meanwhile, Titli and Ansh try to break free from the goons. Will they manage to escape?

episodesList.title: Finding Rekha
episodesList.summary: Rishabh's mother brings a saree for Rashi even though Pushpa wanted her to wear hers. Meanwhile, Prarthana continues searching for Rekha. With the engagement coming up, will everything go smoothly?

episodesList.title: Rekha's Warning
episodesList.summary: Pushpa struggles to bring her witnesses to court on time and receives a warning from the judge. Meanwhile, Prarthana continues searching for Rekha after her escape. However, Kadambari already knows her whereabouts and finally confronts her.

episodesList.title: Rashi's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Rekha takes Titli away at knifepoint behind everyone's back. Meanwhile, Rishabh's mother creates a huge scene because Rashi doesn't come out wearing the saree she gave her. Will Rishabh be able to handle the heat?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Confronts Vikram
episodesList.summary: Rajveer finally uncovers the truth about Solgate's role in the kidnapping and confronts Vikram. Meanwhile, Kadambari worries that Titli will spill the beans about what Rekha told her.

episodesList.title: The Case Reopens
episodesList.summary: The Solgate owners soon learn that Pushpa has managed to reopen the case, placing Rajveer in an uncomfortable spot. Meanwhile, Rishabh's mother begins her next move by accusing Rashi's family of gifting counterfeit jewellery. How will everyone respond to this charge?

episodesList.title: Vikram Mehta Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Pushpa questions Rajveer to uncover the truth about Vikram Mehta. Meanwhile, Rishabh's mother taunts Rashi over the fake gold chain. How will Pushpa handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Witness Protection
episodesList.summary: As tension mounts in the courtroom, Pushpa's witnesses are nowhere in sight and the judge's patience is running thin. Can Pushpa outsmart Solgate and ensure her witnesses make it safely before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Solgate Offers Compensation
episodesList.summary: With both sides presenting their arguments, Rajveer senses trouble ahead and pushes Vikram towards a compensation offer. Will Pushpa accept it?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Gets Insecure
episodesList.summary: After Pushpa wins the case, Rashi informs Pushpa about her situation. Later, Kadambari cannot digest how her daughter has been getting close to Deepti.

episodesList.title: Titli Feels Insecure
episodesList.summary: With secrets brewing within the family, Titli raises troubling questions about whether Kadambari is truly her mother. Meanwhile, a mysterious call to Jugal sparks shock and disbelief by claiming Rekha is alive.

episodesList.title: The Manhunt For Lakshman
episodesList.summary: Prarthana searches for Lakshman, believing he could lead her to the real culprit behind Rekha's accident. However, a shocking revelation emerges when the DNA of the deceased does not match Rekha. Will Prarthana uncover the truth behind this mystery?

episodesList.title: Prarthana Interrogates Kadambari
episodesList.summary: Titli hides behind Deepti and refuses to go with Kadambari. Meanwhile, Pushpa receives a call from a woman who wants to meet her. Later, Jugal confronts Kadambari.

episodesList.title: Kadambari Follows Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Pushpa sets out to meet Rekha, unaware that Kadambari is following her. Will Pushpa uncover Kadambari's truth, or will obstacles stand in her way?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Pulls Out A Gun
episodesList.summary: With the truth on the brink of exposure, Kadambari confronts Jugal at gunpoint. Will this confrontation turn deadly?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Kadambari insists that Jugal's death was an unfortunate incident and refuses to accept any blame. Meanwhile, Titli is still unaware of Jugal's death. How long can they keep it hidden?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Closes In On The Truth
episodesList.summary: As Pushpa and Prarthana piece together the clues, they question Kadambari's motive for shooting Jugal. Can Pushpa uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Justice For Jugal
episodesList.summary: Rajveer steps in to support Pushpa in her fight for Jugal's justice. Will this turn the tide?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Fights Her Own Case
episodesList.summary: Kadambari seeks permission to fight her own case, while Rajveer represents Pushpa and requests a DNA test. Will the truth finally come out?

episodesList.title: Titli Testifies
episodesList.summary: Rajveer persuades Titli to speak up in front of the judge and reveal what happened when Rekha held her at knifepoint. Will her testimony alter the fate of the case?

episodesList.title: The DNA Verdict
episodesList.summary: Rajveer presents the DNA test reports of Kadambari and Titli to disprove their relationship. What will the results reveal, and how will the judge react?

episodesList.title: Titli's Custody
episodesList.summary: Viren pleads with the court to grant him Titli's custody while Kadambari is away, but Rajveer argues that his criminal history makes him untrustworthy. Will The judge hand over Titli to Viren?

episodesList.title: Titli Ki Chinta
episodesList.summary: Pushpa worries about Titli's future, knowing they cannot hide the truth about Jugal's death from her for much longer. Meanwhile, Prarthana digs deeper into Kadambari's connection with Dhiren and how she managed to contact him from behind bars.

episodesList.title: Verdict On Kadambari
episodesList.summary: It is judgement day for Kadambari as the court examines all the evidence against her. Meanwhile, Pushpa is upset by Ashwin's demand to live separately and confronts Rashi about it.

episodesList.title: Jugal's Death Certificate
episodesList.summary: Ashwin hands over Jugal's death certificate as she struggles to find a way to tell Titli the truth. Later, Pushpa tells Dileep and the others that Rashi and Rishabh should be married.

episodesList.title: Titli Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Titli finally learns about Jugal's death before the family can ease her into the truth and breaks down. Meanwhile, Kadambari is hell-bent on doing whatever it takes to ensure Dhiren gets Titli's custody.

episodesList.title: Doosra DNA Test
episodesList.summary: Convinced the first DNA test was tampered with, Pushpa orders a second one. At the same time, Swara fears Rashi is being misled about the flat by Rishabh, yet her concerns are dismissed.

episodesList.title: Flat Ki Sachchai
episodesList.summary: In return for money, a fellow inmate promises Kadambari a secret lead. At the same time, suspicions grow as Pushpa investigates whether Rishabh has been misleading Rashi about the flat.

episodesList.title: Rashi Aur Rishabh Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: The wedding day of Rashi and Rishabh arrives, filling the family with joy. Yet, Swara continues to feel unheard and isolated, while Titli longs to meet Kadambari.

episodesList.title: Titli Meets Kadambari
episodesList.summary: Titli slips away from the wedding to meet Kadambari in prison. Meanwhile, emotions run high as Rashi bids farewell to her family and prepares to begin a new life with Rishabh.

episodesList.title: Worrying For Titli
episodesList.summary: Titli gets upset and refuses to stay with Pushpa, until Prarthana steps in to calm her. Meanwhile, Rishabh feels irritated with Rashi on their first night together. Later, a custody order for Titli arrives in Pushpa's name.

episodesList.title: Rashi Ki Nayi Zindagi
episodesList.summary: Rashi is taken aback by the regressive, old-fashioned mindset of Rishabh's family and his failure to stand up to them. Meanwhile, Pushpa leaves no stone unturned to prevent Dhiren from getting Titli's custody.

episodesList.title: DNA Report Ka Khulasa
episodesList.summary: One crisis after another hits the family as Pushpa is attacked, Ansh falls sick, and Ashwin is targeted, all orchestrated by Dhiren. Amid the chaos he creates, Pushpa realises the DNA report is missing. Will she find it?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ko Aya Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Dhiren's sinister scheme takes a shocking turn when Pushpa collapses with a heart attack just before heading to court. Will she survive this ordeal?

episodesList.title: Pushpa Ka Brahmastra
episodesList.summary: The judge examines the DNA report but demands further verification of its authenticity. Just when the case seems to stall, Pushpa unveils her final trump card, producing a document that turns the courtroom on its head. What secret has she been holding back?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Ke Jhooothe Waade
episodesList.summary: The family is left wondering about Titli's real parents after discovering that Jugal was not her father. Meanwhile, Rashi learns that Rishabh has been lying about the flat all along to convince her to marry him. How will Rashi react?

episodesList.title: Chirag Tries To Enter Central Jail
episodesList.summary: Chirag tries to enter the jail to investigate the matter. Later, Ashwin visits Rashi's home and learns that she has an upcoming shoot. Will Chirag find out about the jailer and Kadambari's connection?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Rishabh causes a scene on the set after growing jealous of the director's private conversation with Rashi. Meanwhile, Pushpa unexpectedly meets Rishabh's mother while she attempts to sell her jewellery.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Relieved and happy after discovering that Chirag has had her suspension revoked, Prarthana chooses to come back and stay with him. Elsewhere, Rashi finds herself increasingly frustrated by Rishabh's conduct on set.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Gets Tailed
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Dilip catch one of Dhiren's men tailing them and secretly tracking their every move. Meanwhile, Rishabh's mother tries to sell Rashi's jewellery behind her back. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Gehno Ki Hera Pheri
episodesList.summary: The follower who had been tailing Pushpa suddenly dies in the lockup, throwing the case into chaos. Soon after, Pushpa becomes suspicious when she sees Rishabh's mother attempting to sell something at a jewellery shop.

episodesList.title: Makar Sankranti Celebrations At The Chawl
episodesList.summary: Rashi and Rishabh join the Makar Sankranti celebrations at the chawl, where things take a dark turn when Rishabh is keen on delaying Rashi's plan of leaving early. Meanwhile, Prathana looks forward to the lead she has received in the trafficking case.

episodesList.title: Rashi Ke Gehne
episodesList.summary: Pushpa questions Rishabh and Madhumati about Rashi's jewellery. Meanwhile, a man dies in the lockup under Prarthana's watch. How will Rashi react to this?

episodesList.title: Rashi Gets Locked In
episodesList.summary: Rashi is thrown into panic when Rishabh locks her in the bathroom and walks out. Meanwhile, Pushpa discovers that Kadambari tried to flee and has been shot in the leg.

episodesList.title: Rishabh Par Uthe Sawaal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa rescues and consoles a shaken Rashi. When Rishabh returns, Pushpa and Dilip confront him about Rashi being locked inside the house. Meanwhile, Kadambari makes a daring attempt to escape the hospital. Will she get away?

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Manipulative Tactics
episodesList.summary: Prarthana senses that the jailer has been compromised and is working for Kadambari. Meanwhile, Rishabh threatens to set himself on fire after Rashi questions and doubts him. Will he go through with it?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Ki Gawahi
episodesList.summary: As Pushpa tightens her watch on Rishabh by installing hidden cameras in the house, Kadambari finds herself backed into a corner and agrees to help the police expose the racket.

episodesList.title: Kadambari Backstabs Dhiren
episodesList.summary: Kadambari turns against Dhiren and gives her testimony to protect herself. But Dhiren soon hears of it. What will his next move be?

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Secret Meeting
episodesList.summary: Prarthana records the constable's confession. Meanwhile, Chirag informs Dileep about Rishabh taking money from him. Later, Pushpa and Prarthana go to meet a man to learn more about Titli's parents.

episodesList.title: Viren Fights Back
episodesList.summary: After securing anticipatory bail, Viren takes a bold stand by testifying against Kadambari. Elsewhere, Rishabh's discovery of the cameras makes him increasingly cautious around Rashi.

episodesList.title: Viren's Offer
episodesList.summary: Viren reaches out to Pushpa, ready to disclose the truth about Titli's real parents in return for her support. At the same time, Rashi makes the difficult decision to quit acting. How will Rishabh take this?

episodesList.title: Broken Bonds
episodesList.summary: Rashi discovers that Pushpa secretly installed cameras in her house behind her back and asks her to stop interfering in her life. How will Pushpa react?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Escapes
episodesList.summary: Heartbroken by Rashi's demand to stay out of her life, Pushpa struggles to cope. At the same time, Prarthana and the department are stunned by Kadambari's escape from the lock-up. How did she pull it off?

episodesList.title: Kadambari Fakes Her Death
episodesList.summary: Kadambari stages her own death and disappears under a false identity, but Pushpa refuses to believe the lie. Determined to prove the truth, she begins her search. Will she uncover what is being hidden?

episodesList.title: Kadambari's Plan To Get Titli
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Prarthana try their best to track down Kadambari, while Viren warns Pushpa that if he lands in jail, Titli's truth will remain hidden. Meanwhile, Kadambari sets her plan in motion to flee the country.

episodesList.title: Kadambari Kidnaps Titli
episodesList.summary: Kadambari kidnaps Titli under false pretences and attempts to flee the country using a fake passport. As time runs out, will Pushpa be able to trace them and stop her plan?

episodesList.title: Rishabh’s Dark Deception
episodesList.summary: Consumed by jealousy, Rishabh hides his dark intentions behind a facade of love as he plots against Rashi. Will she sense the danger before it is too late?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Poisons Rashi
episodesList.summary: Consumed by jealousy and suspicion, Rishabh loses his sense of right and wrong and poisons Rashi, believing she has betrayed him. As her life hangs in the balance, will Pushpa be able to save her in time?

episodesList.title: Titli Ke Asli Mata Pita
episodesList.summary: Kadambari's return to lockup brings Pushpa one step closer to revealing who Titli's real parents are. How will this revelation change everything?

episodesList.title: Titli’s Truth
episodesList.summary: Pushpa drops a shocking revelation by announcing that Titli is Ashwin and Deepti's daughter. How will this news change everything for Titli and the family?

episodesList.title: Titli's Health Condition
episodesList.summary: Dipti and Ashwin decide to hand over Titli to Prarthana and Chirag, but Pushpa strongly objects. Later, Titli's health deteriorates and she is rushed to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Concerning News About Titli
episodesList.summary: Titli's doctor urgently calls Pushpa with concerning news about Titli's health. What awaits Pushpa?

episodesList.title: Titli Is Critical
episodesList.summary: While the chawl celebrates the occasion of Mahashivratri, Pushpa and her family pray for Titli's speedy recovery. Meanwhile, Titli encourages Chirag to participate in and win a competition.

episodesList.title: Kadambari Escapes Again
episodesList.summary: Kadambari and the other inmates succeed in escaping police custody. Meanwhile, Chirag is unable to focus on his match and finishes second in the tournament.

episodesList.title: Chirag In The Finals

episodesList.summary: Kadambari poisons the kheer to harm Pushpa's family, but Shanya uncovers her plan. Will Pushpa save her family?

episodesList.title: E1300. Kadambari's Hidden Move
episodesList.summary: Kadambari deliberately sabotages Shanaya's work to bring her down. What will Shanaya do next?

episodesList.title: E1301. Attack On Ashwin
episodesList.summary: Kadambari plots a deadly attack on Ashwin and frames his own father. Will Ashwin survive the deadly ambush before it's too late?

episodesList.title: E1302. Shanaya's Difficult Decision
episodesList.summary: Kadambari's men attack Ashwin, but a masked stranger saves him. Meanwhile, Shanaya chooses to step away from Chirag's life despite her love.

episodesList.title: E1303. Kadambari's Blackmail Game
episodesList.summary: Dilip is forced to support Kadambari after her blackmail, while Pushpa fights for justice after Ashwin's attack. Their disagreement creates a major family conflict.

episodesList.title: E1304. Pushpa's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Dipti urges Pushpa to drop the case in hopes of reclaiming their house, but Pushpa refuses to surrender to Kadambari, while Manwa grapples with a life-changing opportunity in Canada.

episodesList.title: E1305. Shanaya And Rashi Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Shanaya and Rashi raise money to save Pushpa's house, but Kadambari kidnaps them. As Rashi goes into labor, can Shanaya save her?

episodesList.title: E1306. Rashi's Critical Moment
episodesList.summary: Rashi's labour pains intensify as Shanaya struggles to find a way out. Pushpa agrees to Kadambari's terms, but will Rashi return safely?

episodesList.title: E1307. Pushpa Saves Rashi
episodesList.summary: Pushpa rescues Rashi and Shanaya from kidnappers with her family. Chirag thanks Shanaya, but seeing their closeness, Manva becomes angry and jealous.

episodesList.title: E1308. Shanaya’s Selfless Gesture
episodesList.summary: Pushpa learns about Shanaya’s sacrifice to save her home, while Kadambari refuses the property sale, strengthening the bond between Pushpa and Shanaya.

episodesList.title: E1309. Kadambari In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Shanaya and Chirag find a mobile in Kadambari’s room and show it to Pushpa. Will this discovery expose Kadambari’s secret?

episodesList.title: E1310. Rashi And Baadshah’s Wedding
episodesList.summary: Rashi and Baadshah get married, while Pushpa folds her hands before Baadshah, adding an emotional twist to the wedding celebrations.

episodesList.title: E1311. Pushpa’s Big Move
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds strong evidence against Kadambari, with Dilip by her side. Will Kadambari finally be caught this time?

episodesList.title: E1312. Pushpa Questions Deepti’s Trust
episodesList.summary: Pushpa is happy to see the children but soon asks about Deepti, fearing that Deepti has lost faith in her.

episodesList.title: E1313. Pushpa Gets Her Home Back
episodesList.summary: Pushpa reclaims her home after winning the court battle, but she feels true justice won't be served until Kadambari is held accountable.

episodesList.title: E1314. Chirag Blames Shanaya
episodesList.summary: Manva's note about leaving sparks tension, as Chirag blames Shanaya for keeping her plans a secret, leaving Shanaya hurt and isolated.

episodesList.title: E1315. Radha Kaku’s Powerful Message On Freedom
episodesList.summary: Radha Kaku delivers an inspiring Independence Day speech. Later, the children organise refreshments to help those in need.

episodesList.title: E1316. Shanaya’s Emotional Divorce Decision
episodesList.summary: Shanaya breaks down after receiving the divorce notice. When Pushpa questions her decision, Shanaya recalls her wedding day with Chirag.

episodesList.title: E1317. Shanaya’s Presentation Masterclass
episodesList.summary: Kids ask Shanaya for help with their presentation. She agrees and teaches them how to create and present it effectively.

episodesList.title: E1318. A Mother's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Pushpa never imagined she would have to file for her own son’s divorce, making the court visit emotionally difficult.

episodesList.title: E1319. Pushpa’s Love for Shanaya
episodesList.summary: Chirag considers leaving home, as Radha Kaku reminds Pushpa that Shanaya already has her greatest gift, the love of a mother.

episodesList.title: E1320. Pushpa Lands In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Pushpa secretly enters a judicial warehouse with an advocate to find old court files, but her mission takes a turn when the police arrest her.

episodesList.title: E1321. Chirag’s Unexpected Rakhi Drama
episodesList.summary: After bringing Pushpa home from the police station, Chirag argues with her and leaves. Shanaya forces him to return and get a Rakhi tied by Rashi.

episodesList.title: E1322. Pushpa Discovers A Big Clue
episodesList.summary: Pushpa learns about Shanaya and Chirag’s plan and finds Shanaya’s mother’s new address in the letterbox.

episodesList.title: E1323. The Truth Finally Comes Out
episodesList.summary: Pushpa reaches Shanaya’s mother and finally gets the answers she has been looking for, as Shanaya’s mother reveals the truth about her past.

episodesList.title: E1324. Will Shanaya Meet Her Mother?
episodesList.summary: After the naming ceremony, Pushpa receives a call from Shanaya’s mother, who waits outside to meet Shanaya and leaves the decision entirely to Shanaya.

episodesList.title: E1325. Shanaya's Emotional Reunion
episodesList.summary: Pushpa brings Shanaya and her mother together. Will this emotional reunion help heal their strained relationship and bring them closer?

episodesList.title: E1326. Shanaya's Gesture Questioned
episodesList.summary: Shanaya prepares a tiffin for Chirag and personally delivers it, but he questions her sudden concern and asks why she is pretending to care for him.

episodesList.title: E1327. Shanaya Ends Her Marriage
episodesList.summary: Shanaya fights with Chirag and angrily ends their marriage by continuously walking around the sacred fire before deciding to leave Pushpa's family.

episodesList.title: E1328. Raashi Stops Shanaya
episodesList.summary: Shanaya leaves Pushpa's home but refuses to return to her parents. Raashi learns of her decision and rushes to stop her. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: E1329. Shanaya Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Shanaya is kidnapped as her father's deal remains unsettled. Chirag sets out to rescue her, but will he reach her before it's too late?

plotHtml: The story revolves around Pushpa Randeriya Patel, a 45-year-old woman from Patan, who lives in the Bapodra Chawl of Mumbai with her children: Ashwin, Chirag, and Rashi. The show also focuses the life of Swara, an orphan whom Ashwin and Deepti adopted.
tagline: The story revolves around Pushpa Randeriya Patel, a 45-year-old woman from Patan, who lives in the Bapodra Chawl of Mumbai with her children: Ashwin, Chirag, and Rashi.

title: Playground
summary:
Playground is an Indian Hindi-language reality web series, primarily available on Amazon miniTV. Premiered in May 2022, Playground series blends entertainment, live gaming, and esports.
Rusk Media claimed that the show had garnered 200 million+ views following the first season.
reception: The series was well received, especially by the gaming community in India, for its innovative format that integrates gaming into the reality show genre.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: The series follows "players" competing in teams under the mentorship of leading gaming influencers and content creators. It involves a group of contestants who participate in various online games, competing individually and in teams, with eliminations based on performance, challenges and voting.

episodesList.title: Playground Episode 1
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 1, our contestants finally get to know their mentor and teammates. As they get to know this, they make their entry to the real Playground and start this amazing journey with some crazy fun with their mentors CarryMinati, Triggered Insaan, Mortal and Scout. What’s better to end this crazy day with a great party?

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 2, as our contestants start their journey to win Playground trophy, in no time they are set to take other teams down. Catch them fighting with the crew and not just this, to find out who is the real player, watch match day 1.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 3, our contestants share their problems with the production team. As we start, Triggered insaaan takes a moment to interact with his team and quickly guide them for upcoming week.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 4, as contestants get to speak to their mentors, they make new strategies for gameplay. As no contestant wishes to be benched, contestants try their best to be safe.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: As contestants' first week at house is about to end they put their best in their gameplay to make their mark in the world's first gaming entertainment show, Playground. With their first physical task in the game, they bring the best out of them. So join me, and let's see what happens next!

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 6, contestants finally get to know the results of the votes and will see who among all 20 is the winner for this week. Moreover mentors connect with their teams to discuss new game strategies.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 7, the game gets intense as the deadly 4 comes to life and Sakshi Sood replaces Varnikaa. AAA werewolves tops the chart and Adit Minocha becomes hero of the week.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: With Playground episode 8, contestants start their new week at the arcade of Playground. With new captains comes new strategies so let's see what this week holds for us in the world of gaming + entertainment but one thing we are sure of that it will be full power for you.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 9, we will see how CarryMinati gives a surprise virtual visit to our players and how he motivates his team, Dare Dragons with the lowest Paods. Also, RJ Mahvash drops a big bomb of transfer window on our contestants.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 10, 8bit Thug makes his entry to Playground arcade and make contestants do some major rethinking on their decisions as a team. Leaving all the teams behind, Power Phoenexies win LIVE gameplay 7 of world war z aftermath.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 11, mentors finally make the use of transfer window. Carry in his team, replaces Foram with 8bit Rebel. With this new change, we see a positive ray for Dare Dragons.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 12, contestants fear 8bit rebel's skills and plan to vote him out together. With physical day, teams expect to look at a major change in the team leadership board.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 13, watch how Power Phoenixes fall apart and what is Sakshi Keswani's reaction after being benched by her team. Also watch how OP Unicorns finally reach #1 on leadership board.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: As new week is all set to start at the Playground arcade, watch how contestants plan benching and captaincy for this week. Also, as week 3 starts, stay tuned to know what new turns the story takes at the Playground arcade.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: In Playground Episode 15, watch contestants selecting their captains for week 3. Also, watch Scout and Mortal together at Playground live gameplay together for the first time.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: In this episode, watch how contestants perform in MAAC's Reel Challenge and ultimately who won this challenge. Also, find out what will be our team's strategies for Championship Day 5.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 17, watch how best performing contestants get a chance to win 2M PAODS and turn the tables around for contestant ranking. Also watch how India's one of the biggest gamers, Mythpat take over Playground Arcade for a day.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 18, watch how black ball turns the table around at Playground arcade. Also watch how Anjali finally takes a stand for herself and saves herself from being benched.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 19, it is the Physical day today. Watch how all the teams compete with their best to win 1M PAODS.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: In Playground episode 20, watch how Dare Dragons give a best birthday gift to their leader, CarryMinati. Also watch, how new stories start to build with Harshita and Udit's new friendship.

episodesList.summary: Chill Gamer returns to Playground with unfiltered insights and honest feedback, bringing excitement, laughs, and a reality check for all.
