episodesList.summary: As Rishita insults Dhara during the Aarti ceremony, Shiva gets angry and spews venom at her. Later, Suman indirectly takes a stand for Dhara.

episodesList.title: Gautam Defends Dhara
episodesList.summary: Raavi accuses Shiva of marrying her intentionally and the duo argues. Later, as Suman accuses Dhara, Gautam takes a firm stand for her.

episodesList.title: Prafulla Starts Cribbing
episodesList.summary: Gautam defends Dhara in front of Suman. Later, Prafulla cribs about the presents gifted to Raavi as shagun.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Dreams are Shattered
episodesList.summary: As Rishita expresses her love for Dev, Raavi's dream of marrying him comes to an end. Later, Rishita creates a fuss about the size of her bedroom in the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Dev Gets Defensive
episodesList.summary: Raavi loses her composure and requests Rishita to stop insulting her at every point. Later, Dev gets defensive when Rishita calls Raavi a baggage.

episodesList.title: Love Colours For Gautam, Dhara
episodesList.summary: Gautam apologises to Suman for his past behaviour. Dhara gives important advice to Shiva about life. Later, Gautam gets romantic with Dhara.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Mischevious Prank
episodesList.summary: Rishita smears lipstick on Dev's face to make others believe in their successful wedding night. Later, Dev shares a moment with her.

episodesList.title: Is Shiva Alright?
episodesList.summary: Dhara consoles an emotional Raavi while Janardhan's sister requests Rishita to come home. Elsewhere, Shiva falls unconscious while fighting some deadly goons.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi Get Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Shiva and Raavi are attacked and get kidnapped by a gang of goons. Later, Dev screams at Rishita for an insensitive comment about Shiva and Raavi.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Shiva get kidnapped. While they face immense danger, Krish informs Dhara and the others about the abduction.

episodesList.title: Gautam Warns Janardhan
episodesList.summary: Gautam threatens Janardhan with legal action and demands that he return Shiva. Elsewhere, Suman, Dhara and Prafulla worry about the situation at hand.

episodesList.title: Raavi Misunderstands Shiva
episodesList.summary: Raavi is shocked when Shiva abandons her to fight the goons. While she misunderstands his intentions, a huge brawl breaks out.

episodesList.title: Gautam Threatens Janardhan
episodesList.summary: Gautam issues a stern warning to Janardhan for orchestrating the kidnapping. While Raavi conveys her hatred to Shiva, the family leaves to visit a Haveli.

episodesList.title: Dev, Shiva's Heated Spat
episodesList.summary: Dev and Shiva get into an intense argument during a fun game of Antakshari. Later, Gautam and Dhara advise them to mend their differences.

episodesList.title: Rishita Falls Sick
episodesList.summary: While Rishita suffers from food poisoning, Shiva questions Raavi for mistreating Dhara. Later, the Pandyas reach the haveli.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi Share a Room
episodesList.summary: Dhara shows Raavi her new room and tells Shiva that he has to share it with her. While Shiva and Raavi come up with rules, Rishita likes their room.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Gautam Get Romantic
episodesList.summary: The family prepares for the Puja. Elsewhere, Dhara and Gautam get romantic with each other. Later, everyone attends the Kul Devta Puja.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Bad Behaviour!
episodesList.summary: Dhara requests Rishita to participate in the kitchen ceremony, but she decides to ignore it. Later, Rishita prepares food only for her and Dev, shocking everyone.

episodesList.title: Rishita Walks Out
episodesList.summary: Seeing Gautam feeding his brothers, Rishita feels disgusted and walks out, which upsets him. Later, Dev apologises for her behaviour.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Important Lesson
episodesList.summary: As the family sets up the bonfire, Shiva arrives in a new look and stuns all. Later, Gautam shares a valuable lesson about the family with the brides.

episodesList.title: Rishita is Frightened
episodesList.summary: Krish and Shiva distract everyone in order to carry their plan forward to scare Rishita. Later, Rishita is traumatized upon seeing a woman in white.

episodesList.title: Rishita Gets Horror-stricken!
episodesList.summary: Late in the night, Rishita beholds a woman in a white saree and gets frightened to death. Later, Raavi grows suspicious of Krish seeing make-up on his face.

episodesList.title: Dhara’s Mature Move
episodesList.summary: Dev apologises as Dhara makes Rishita understand their limits in public space. Later, Dhara tries to calm down Dev while he feels agitated by Rishita’s misconduct.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Emotional Outburst
episodesList.summary: A protective Shiva tries to find out what's bothering Raavi but she rebukes him harshly. When Dhara has a heart-to-heart conversation with her, she bursts into tears.

episodesList.title: Dev Apologises to Shiva
episodesList.summary: Dhara consoles an emotional Raavi while Dev apologises to Shiva. Elsewhere, Gautam warns Krish to focus on his studies and secure good marks.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Fatherly Act
episodesList.summary: A heartbroken Dhara tells Gautam about Raavi and Rishita's rift, and he decides to resolve the issue. Later, he explains to Rishita about her mistakes.

episodesList.title: Rishita Apologises to Raavi
episodesList.summary: While Gautam helps to resolve the issues between Raavi and Rishita, Raavi and Shiva continue their arguments. Later, Rishita apologises to Raavi.

episodesList.title: Krish Runs Away
episodesList.summary: Krish finds Raavi's cosmetics and runs away with them. On the other hand, Suman decides to teach Prafulla a lesson for ruining the peace in her house.

episodesList.title: Gautam Sides With Rishita
episodesList.summary: While Dev leaves for the market, Krish yells at Rishita for questioning Gautam. An enraged Gautam lashes out at him and justifies Rishita.

episodesList.title: Krish Feels Embarrassed
episodesList.summary: Flustered, Krish apologises to Rishita reluctantly. However, Rishita decides to go back to her parent's house as she feels Dev is not concerned about her.

episodesList.title: Rishita Falls Unconscious!
episodesList.summary: Krish groomed as a woman, dances and tries to scare Rishita. Startled, she falls unconscious on Krish's resemblance.

episodesList.title: Dhara Punishes Shiva, Krish
episodesList.summary: Dhara learns from Gautam about Shiva and Krish's cruel prank on Rishita and beats them. Later, she declares a harsher punishment for them.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Staunch Decision
episodesList.summary: When Gautam tries to reason with Dhara about her decision to divide the households, she refuses to change it. Later, Dhara breaks down for hurting the boys.

episodesList.title: Shiva Refuses to Change
episodesList.summary: Shiva and Krish try their best to win Dhara's heart but their efforts go in vain. Later, Shiva argues with Raavi and informs her that he won’t change.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Dev Get Punished
episodesList.summary: Shiva and Dev secretly share a meal with Gautam and Krish and get punished by Dhara. Later, Suman feels some tension in the family upon her arrival.

episodesList.title: Prafulla Gets On The Job
episodesList.summary: Prafulla instigates Rishita and tries to find out what Dhara and her boys are hiding from the family. While Gautam explains to Dhara about her decision, Suman has a hidden agenda.

episodesList.title: Anita Begins Conspiring
episodesList.summary: Suman baits Krish and finds out that the boys are hiding something from her. Elsewhere, Anita tells Prafulla of her evil plan to marry Gautam.

episodesList.title: Trouble Ahead For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara lands in trouble when Suman forces her to tell the truth about the past incidents. Later, Prafulla tries to instigate Suman but in vain.

episodesList.title: Suman's Venomous Words
episodesList.summary: During the Shagun ceremony, Rishita creates a scene about the gifts. Agitated by her behaviour, Suman uses cold words to put Rishita in her place.

episodesList.title: Will Dhara Spill The Beans?
episodesList.summary: While Dhara's plan brings Raavi and Shiva together, Gautam makes her swear to tell Suman the truth. Later, Dhara has a nightmare.

episodesList.title: Shiva Behaves Rashly
episodesList.summary: Dhara's cold behaviour makes Shiva emotional and he burns his hand. While a shocked Raavi stops him, Gautam loses his cool at Dhara's heartless demeanour.

episodesList.title: Dhara is Worried
episodesList.summary: A nervous Dhara hallucinates about failing to unite the family and falls sick. While she tries to tell Suman the truth, Krish stops her.

episodesList.title: Raavi Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: When Rishita mistakes Shiva’s shirt for a rag, a furious Raavi confronts her. Later, she supports Shiva when Rishita insults him.

episodesList.title: Shiva Opens Up to Raavi
episodesList.summary: When Raavi tells Shiva the reason behind supporting him, he confides in her about his past. Later, Dhara musters up the courage to tell Suman the truth.

episodesList.title: Rishita Fights With Dev
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Dhara have a fallout over the latter's actions towards the family. Elsewhere, a triggered Rishita fights Dev after he sides with Dhara.

episodesList.title: Rishita Tells The Truth
episodesList.summary: A triggered Rishita confronts Suman and tells the truth about Dhara. Shocked at the revelation, Suman fumes with anger.

episodesList.title: Suman Confronts Reality
episodesList.summary: Rishita unveils the truth about Dhara to Suman. Later, Suman witnesses the scars Dhara inflicted on Krish and consoles him.

episodesList.title: Suman Reprimands Dhara
episodesList.summary: Suman confronts Dhara for hiding the truth and lashes out at her. While Dhara stands frozen, Shiva leaves with Raavi to get the holy water from Mukteshwar.

episodesList.title: Shiva Protects Raavi
episodesList.summary: As the temple crumbles in Mukhteshwar, Shiva does his best to shield Raavi from harm. When she distrusts him, he emotionally expresses himself.

episodesList.title: Rishita to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: As Mukhteshwar crumbles, Rishita goes to rescue everyone. Meanwhile, a distraught Shiva tries his best to revive Raavi who starts giving up.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Banished
episodesList.summary: Suman punishes Dhara for breaking her family and asks her to leave. Later, she is shocked to learn how Rishita saved everyone's lives.

episodesList.title: Suman Stops Dhara
episodesList.summary: Gautam and the family plead with Suman to stop Dhara from leaving. Later, Dhara complies with Suman, and the Pandya family unites again.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Prafulla Lock Horns
episodesList.summary: While Dhara and Gautam get romantic, Dev and Rishita share a moment. The next morning, Shiva bumps into Prafulla and gets into an argument with her.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Change Of Heart?
episodesList.summary: Shiva finds himself getting attracted to Raavi. Later, Gautam gives a piece of big news to his brothers.

episodesList.title: Shiva Threatens Prafulla
episodesList.summary: After Suman exposes Prafulla before the family, Raavi asks her to leave. Later, a triggered Shiva threatens Prafulla with a sickle.

episodesList.title: Anita's Evil Move
episodesList.summary: An envious Anita plans a wicked move for Dhara to injure her. Elsewhere, Rishita spots Shiva partaking in suspicious activity.

episodesList.title: Will Dhara Fall In The Trap?
episodesList.summary: When Prafulla taunts Dhara, the latter gives a befitting response. Meanwhile, Raavi faces the consequences of Anita's devious plan instead of Dhara.

episodesList.title: Shiva Confronts Prafulla, Anita
episodesList.summary: Suman holds a family meeting to detect the culprit, and everyone shares their suspicions. Later, Shiva confronts Prafulla and Anita with evidence.

episodesList.title: Anita Frames Prafulla
episodesList.summary: When Anita frames Prafulla for the accident, Shiva says hurtful words that instigate Raavi. But what will Raavi do upon learning the truth?

episodesList.title: Rishita Gets Snooping
episodesList.summary: A distracted Shiva makes Rishita suspicious during the Pagfere ritual. Her doubts come true when she finds him at the money lender's office.

episodesList.title: Raavi and Shiva Bond
episodesList.summary: Away from Raavi, Shiva ends up texting her, and they share a friendly banter. Later, Raavi defends him against Rishita's accusations.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Shocking Condition
episodesList.summary: During the Pagphere Ki Rasam, Shiva demands Prafulla’s Kangan as Shagun, but she rejects it. Later, he gives a shocking ultimatum to her.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Explicit Condition
episodesList.summary: As Shiva puts forth a condition to Prafulla, a heartbroken Raavi makes a shocking declaration. Later, Dhara stops Rishita from revealing the truth.

episodesList.title: Raavi Gets a Surprise
episodesList.summary: Gautam asks for an explanation from Shiva for pawning the property. Later, Raavi is thrilled as she receives a surprise birthday party from the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Shiva Achieves His Task
episodesList.summary: At the party, Shiva threatens Prafulla with suicide but she refuses to budge. When Raavi attempts to do the same, Prafulla gives away the kangan to Shiva.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Nobel Act
episodesList.summary: Shiva takes the Kangan from Prafulla but gets her a new set to make up for it. Later, everyone finds the reason behind Shiva mortgaging his land.

episodesList.title: Shiva is In a Happy Space
episodesList.summary: Shiva is elated to have Raavi back but refuses to show it. While things start normalising for the Pandyas, Janardhan plans a dirty move.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Into Trouble
episodesList.summary: Shiva gets caught with a large amount of money, and the police try to arrest him. But Raavi manages to help him escape while Dhara asks them to go underground.

episodesList.title: Shiva Grows Protective
episodesList.summary: Shiva gets protective about Raavi and they have a silly banter. Elsewhere, Gautam and Dev find out that Janardhan is behind framing Shiva.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Shiva escapes from the clutches of the police and returns to Somnath with Raavi. Later, he goes to meet a lawyer and makes an unexpected request.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: To save the Pandya Stores, Shiva decides to confess to the police. Out of desperation, Dhara and Krish abduct him.

episodesList.title: Is This The End For Pandya Stores?
episodesList.summary: The police search for Shiva, but Dhara hides him safely. The Pandyas fight to protect their shop while the police come to close it with a warrant.

episodesList.title: Rishita to The Rescue?
episodesList.summary: As Shiva is about to be arrested, Rishita arrives with proof and saves him along with Pandya stores. Later, Shiva finds himself gravitating towards Raavi.

episodesList.title: A Celebration At The Pandyas'
episodesList.summary: Dev reveals to Shiva his idea of building a separate room for Dhara. Later, the Pandyas organise an event to celebrate the wedding reception of the newly-weds.

episodesList.title: Kamini, Kalyani Insult The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Dev protests when Prafulla taunts Dhara for not becoming a mother. Later, Kamini and Kalyani bring expensive gifts at the reception, insulting the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Rishita is Insulted
episodesList.summary: Dev does not allow Rishita to accept Kamini's gift and sends them away. Later, Kamini insults Rishita and uses hurtful words to demean her.

episodesList.title: Raavi Fights For Shiva
episodesList.summary: Raavi meets her old friend Sneha who insults Shiva before her. While Shiva misunderstands the situation, Raavi takes a stand for her husband.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Drunk
episodesList.summary: Shiva ends up drinking with Kaka and shares his woes with him. Later, a drunk Shiva looks at Raavi and wonders about her reason of choosing him.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Emotional Outburst
episodesList.summary: After reading Raavi's diary, Shiva gets emotional and misbehaves with her. Later, Raavi burns her diary and bids goodbye to her past.

episodesList.title: Dhara Feels Dejected
episodesList.summary: Anita manipulates a house help to instigate Suman against Dhara. Later, Dhara gets upset when the maid taunts her for being childless.

episodesList.title: Hardik's Concern For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara comforts Raavi when she shares her worries about Shiva. Later, a concerned Hardik demands a separate bedroom for Dhara.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Come Closer
episodesList.summary: Suman requests Dhara to use her bedroom instead of sleeping outside. On the other hand, Raavi and Shiva draw closer while supervising the store.

episodesList.title: Janardhan Insults Gautam
episodesList.summary: Janardhan taunts Gautam for not having a child, and they get into an altercation. When Dhara consoles Gautam, Shiva and Dev overhear them.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Gautam rejects the proposal to make a bedroom for him and Dhara due to a lack of funds. Later, he laments to Dhara about his problem.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Egotistic Demand
episodesList.summary: Krish accidentally walks in on Rishita as she is changing. Dev loses his cool when she creates a scene and demands a new bathroom.

episodesList.title: Pandya Boys Get to Work
episodesList.summary: Dev, Shiva and Krish announce that they will construct Gautam and Dhara's bedroom. Later, the Pandya boys get working on the same.

episodesList.title: Anita Makes a Bad Move
episodesList.summary: Shiva goes to retrieve the property papers but faces Janardhan and his men. Elsewhere, Anita gets an evil idea to ruin Dhara's room.

episodesList.title: Raavi Gets Hurt
episodesList.summary: An insecure Shiva fights with Raavi and pushes her away with harsh words. When Raavi gets injured, Shiva rushes to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Anita Causes Chaos
episodesList.summary: Anita narrowly escapes from getting caught by Suman at midnight. Later, Anita causes hindrance to prevent the room from being constructed.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandya brothers and Dhara receive a shock to see that someone ruined the cement. Meanwhile, Anita pretentiously laments about their loss.

episodesList.title: Suman Makes a Revelation
episodesList.summary: As the Pandya brothers search for Suman, she makes a shocking revelation to Shiva. Later, Raavi enquires Prafulla regarding Anita.

episodesList.title: The Pandya Boys Plan a Surprise
episodesList.summary: The Pandya boys work day and night to complete the room for Dhara and Gautam. Later, they plan to surprise the couple with their decorated new bedroom.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Raavi At Odds
episodesList.summary: Raavi drops Dhara at Hardik's place while Rishita tries to manage the house. Without Dhara, the girls get into a fight as they are unable to do their chores.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Dhara, Gautam
episodesList.summary: Raavi saves Rishita from a terrible accident and blames her for not being careful. Later, Dhara and Gautam come home to a pleasant surprise.

episodesList.title: Dhara Portrays Her Feelings
episodesList.summary: Gautam romantically carries Dhara to their bedroom but gets shocked to find his brothers sleeping on their bed. Later, Dhara gets insulted for not having kids.

episodesList.title: Shiva Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: Rishita takes a stand for Dhara when the neighbourhood women humiliate her. Dev consoles Shiva as he creates a scene during the gathering.

episodesList.title: Suman is Insulted
episodesList.summary: Dhara scolds some children when they play mischief. Seeing this, the neighbours attack her and Suman with harsh words. The taunts hurt Suman, and she has a breakdown.

episodesList.title: Dhara has a Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Gautam and the others save Suman with difficulty. Later, Dhara gets emotional about not having a child.

episodesList.title: Anita's Vile Plan
episodesList.summary: Anita fakes her concern for Suman and finds out that her sons are planning a Mannat for Dhara. Later, she tampers with the ritual pots to break Dhara's morals.

episodesList.title: Shiva Grows Jealous
episodesList.summary: Furious to see Raavi's friends flatter her, Shiva decides to leave her with them. Elsewhere, Gautam comforts Dhaara as she breaks down.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Terribly Emotional
episodesList.summary: Despite Raavi's attempts to bridge the gap in their relationship, Shiva pushes her away. He misunderstands her words and has an emotional outburst.

episodesList.title: Festivities At The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Prafulla and Anita join the celebrations as the Pandyas prepare for their Mannat. Later, the family chants God's name during the procession.

episodesList.title: Gautam Rescues Suman
episodesList.summary: During the Mannat, Suman’s wheelchair slips on the water dropped by Anita and goes out of control. She is saved in time by Gautam.

episodesList.title: Miracle For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: As the Pandyas rush towards the temple with their leaking pots, Dhara and Suman pray to Mahadev. Later, they family finishes their mannat miraculously.

episodesList.title: Anita, Kamini Team Up
episodesList.summary: Anita and Kamini join hands to bring the Pandyas down. Unaware of Anita’s plotting, the family thanks her for helping them to fulfil their Mannat.

episodesList.title: The End Of Raavi, Shiva?
episodesList.summary: Raavi gets into a violent altercation with Shiva when he accuses her of being characterless. Enraged at the allegations, she slaps him and they break apart.

episodesList.title: Raavi Fumes With Emotions
episodesList.summary: An emotional Raavi reveals to the family how Shiva humiliated her in public by questioning her character. When the Pandyas lash out at Shiva, he decides to leave.

episodesList.title: Raavi Leaves The House
episodesList.summary: Raavi decides to go away despite everybody's efforts to stop her. Dhara tries to convince Shiva to apologise to Raavi, but he refuses to do so.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Strange Illusion
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas miss Raavi's presence in the house while Shiva hallucinates about her. Elsewhere, Raavi vows not to head back to the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Practical Advice
episodesList.summary: Rishita advises Dhara to give space to Raavi and Shiva, so that the couple can fix their differences in private. However, Dhara refuses to acknowledge the advice.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi Break Up
episodesList.summary: Dhara tries to unite Shiva and Raavi but fails when they lash out at each other. As the couple breaks up, a hurt Dhara weeps inconsolably.

episodesList.title: Raavi Returns to Shiva?
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets emotional when she finds out that Shiva is hungry and serves him food, letting go of her anger. Later, Raavi returns to the house for a shocking reason.

episodesList.title: Will Shiva Change His Decision?
episodesList.summary: Raavi's family receives a letter while Shiva gets a strange dream. As Dhara tries to convince Shiva to patch up with Raavi, will he accept the latter?

episodesList.title: Raavi Divorces Shiva
episodesList.summary: After a nasty altercation, Raavi and Shiva sign their divorce papers and end their marriage on a bitter note. A heartbroken Dhara collapses and is rushed to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Good News For The Pandyas!
episodesList.summary: Shiva rushes to the hospital and tries to meet Dhara. The Pandyas celebrate Dhara's discharge and host a party at home while Raavi learns about the same.

episodesList.title: Raavi Misunderstands The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The excited Pandyas celebrate after getting the news of Dhara's pregnancy. Raavi misunderstands them and creates chaos.

episodesList.title: Shiva to Forget Raavi?
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Gautam share some special moments and discuss their unborn baby. Meanwhile, Shiva attempts to remove all traces of Raavi from his life.

episodesList.title: Shiva Apologises to Dhara
episodesList.summary: Shiva seeks forgiveness from Dhara for his immoral behaviour. While Rishita prepares for an interview, Dhara and Gautam are called to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Gautam Take a Decision
episodesList.summary: Dhara finds out that she cannot stress as her pregnancy is a tricky one. To alleviate her worries, Gautam decides to fix Raavi and Shiva's marriage.

episodesList.title: Suman Faces Embarrassment
episodesList.summary: While Rishita attends a job interview on her phone, Suman faces an awkward situation. Elsewhere, Gautam and Dhara take a challenge.

episodesList.title: Dev Berates Rishita
episodesList.summary: Dev finds Suman in an embarrassing situation and scolds Rishita, ignoring her apology for causing it. Later, Dhara is shocked to learn about the incident.

episodesList.title: Rishita Justifies Herself
episodesList.summary: Anita makes an appeal to Suman when the latter faces an awkward situation in front of the family. Meanwhile, Rishita stands her ground as Dhara berates her.

episodesList.title: Hardik Visits The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: A heated argument erupts between Rishita and Dev while Hardik visits the Pandyas. Later, Suman gets ignored by the family.

episodesList.title: Rishita Apologises to Suman
episodesList.summary: While Suman makes a demand to Dhara, the latter receives a gift from Gautam. Later, Rishita seeks forgiveness from Suman for her irresponsible act.

episodesList.title: Raavi Misbehaves With Dhara
episodesList.summary: An adamant Raavi refuses to accept the gift by Gautam and misbehaves with Dhara. Irked, Dhara ends up rebuking Raavi for her attitude.

episodesList.title: Shiva Creates a Scene
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Krishna Janmashtami, the Pandyas celebrate the festival on a grand note. Meanwhile, Shiva creates a scene by insulting Prafulla before the crowd.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Extreme Step
episodesList.summary: Krish tricks Raavi into ruining her dress so that she has no option but to wear the outfit gifted by Gautam. However, Raavi takes an extreme step to wreck his plans.

episodesList.title: Raavi Hurts Dhara
episodesList.summary: Raavi burns the Lehenga gifted by the Pandyas and ends up hurting Dhara. Later, she prepares for the Dahi Handi competition against Shiva.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Raavi
episodesList.summary: Raavi wins the Dahi Handi competition against Shiva. When Dhara almost faints during the chaotic situation, Raavi learns a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Raavi to Return Home
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are advised to take precautions for Dhara's well-being. Later, Raavi informs Prafulla about her decision to stay at the Pandya Niwas.

episodesList.title: Raavi Returns Home
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get a shock when Raavi returns to them. While Dhara and Suman try to throw her out, she stubbornly refuses to leave.

episodesList.title: Gautam Warns Shiva, Raavi
episodesList.summary: When Shiva wonders about the keys, Gautam warns him and Raavi and asks them to stop fighting. Later, Raavi and Shiva decide to compromise.

episodesList.title: Raavi Rescues Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara behaves coldly with Raavi in the kitchen. However, when her sari catches fire, Raavi rushes to put it out and saves her.

episodesList.title: Anita's Wicked Move
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Dhara reconcile after the former offers a heartfelt apology. Elsewhere, Anita makes a nasty plan to get rid of Dhara.

episodesList.title: Prafulla In Danger!
episodesList.summary: Shiva surprisingly meets his childhood friend, Rakhi at Krish's college. Meanwhile, Prafulla is hypnotised after two burglars enter the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Rishita Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Shiva notices Raavi taking a stand for him in front of her friends. Elsewhere, Rishita rescues the Pandyas by trapping the criminals.

episodesList.title: Dhara Feels Left Out
episodesList.summary: Krish spends the night being pampered by Prafulla while Raavi prepares a culinary surprise for the Pandyas. Later, Dhara faces an awkward situation.

episodesList.title: Dhara Grows Insecure
episodesList.summary: While Shiva and Raavi come closer, Dhara enters the scene. After witnessing them, Dhara grows insecure about her relationship with Gombi.

episodesList.title: Dhara Bursts Into Tears
episodesList.summary: Dhara breaks down into tears as Suman adds fuel to the fire. Meanwhile, Anita is back in form with her antics.

episodesList.title: Gautam In a Fix
episodesList.summary: Gautam makes a silly statement and bears the brunt of Dhara's mood swings. However, he handles it maturely and wins her over.

episodesList.title: Rishita Lands a Job
episodesList.summary: In a desperate need to be financially independent, Rishita accepts a tele-marketing job. Later, Janardhan is furious as he loses his market to the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Face Failure
episodesList.summary: Dhara, Gautam, and Dev try to coax Shiva to hold Raavi back by checking the fault. Later, the Pandyas fail to make Rishita happy after a conversation.

episodesList.title: Krish Gets Embarrassed
episodesList.summary: Keerti assumes Krish to be a servant when she sees him washing dishes, but Raavi clears the misunderstanding. Later, Raavi asks Krish to drop Keerti home.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Janardhan Seth registers a false complaint against Krish. While saving him from fake accusations, Dhara falls unconscious due to exhaustion and gets kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva In a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Janardhan tells the Pandya brothers that he is behind Krish getting arrested. Meanwhile, Raavi and Shiva head to the court in a dilemma regarding their divorce.

episodesList.title: Shiva Loses His Cool
episodesList.summary: Shiva misbehaves with the counsellor when she asks him to reconsider his divorce with Raavi. Later, he loses his cool after finding out that she has demanded money.

episodesList.title: Janardhan Faces Shiva's Wrath
episodesList.summary: As Dhara gets abducted, the Pandya brothers barge into Janardhan Seth's home and beat him up. Meanwhile, Krish is released from prison.

episodesList.title: Dhara is Rescued
episodesList.summary: While Shiva, Dev and Krish get into a brawl with Janardhan, the latter spots Dhara in a moving car. Later, they save Dhara from the kidnappers and bring her home.

episodesList.title: Raavi In a Pickle!
episodesList.summary: Rishita apologises to Krish for the misunderstandings. Later, Suman reveals that she has arranged Shiva's marriage with Shivani as Raavi insisted on a divorce.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Hilarious Gesture
episodesList.summary: Shiva grows concerned to see Raavi slipping from the bed in her sleep. As he helps her, she wakes up, leading to a hilarious situation.

episodesList.title: Dhara Advises Shiva
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas catch Shiva and Raavi together, Dhara urges Shiva to reconsider divorcing Raavi. Later, Raavi performs a ritual for Shiva.

episodesList.title: Suman Challenges Dhara
episodesList.summary: As the Pandyas celebrate Rishita’s new job, Suman grows overconfident. Furthermore, she challenges Dhara about ending Raavi and Shiva’s marriage.

episodesList.title: Dhara Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Shiva shocks everyone when he comes to the party wearing his old clothes. While Dhara takes a stand about Shiva's marriage, Anita saves her life from an accident.

episodesList.title: Shiva Refuses to Remarry
episodesList.summary: While Gautam and Dhara come closer, Prafulla creates a matrimonial profile for Raavi. Meanwhile, Shiva refuses to remarry when Suman asks him about it.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Anita's Ugly Tiff!
episodesList.summary: Raavi's doubts about Anita's intentions get confirmed when she catches her with Gautam's photo. She warns Anita to put an end to her ugly plans.

episodesList.title: Kirti Faces Suman's Wrath
episodesList.summary: As Raavi questions Anita's intentions, Rishita stands by her firmly. Later, Suman is infuriated upon Kirti's visit.

episodesList.title: Dhara Makes a Request
episodesList.summary: After Disha is introduced to the family, Rishita and Dhara try to avoid Disha's meeting with Shiva. Further, Dhara requests Suman to reconsider Shiva's remarriage.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Uncontrollable Breakdown
episodesList.summary: After Disha takes the family's leave, Shiva accompanies her to her house. Elsewhere, Dhara has an uncontrollable breakdown and experiences pregnancy spotting.

episodesList.title: Suman is Perplexed
episodesList.summary: While Raavi turns jealous seeing Krisha and Shiva's relationship, Anita and Gautam get together. Meanwhile, Suman worries about the play.

episodesList.title: Kamini's Plan Works?
episodesList.summary: Suman announces the celebration of the Ram Leela program for the entire Pandyas. Later, an innocent Rishita gets the loan amount as per Kamini's plan.

episodesList.title: Dhara Teases Raavi
episodesList.summary: As Shiva and Disha are drawn to each other, Raavi gets jealous and expresses her anger. Meanwhile, Dhara incites her to express her true feelings.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Get Closer
episodesList.summary: Raavi gets happy and confused to learn that Krisha will not come to the Ramleela celebration. Later, Shiva and Raavi share a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Dhara has Gautam Worried
episodesList.summary: Gautam, Dhara, Dev, and Shiva give a brilliant performance in their portrayal of the Ramayana. Later, Gautam gets worried about Dhara when her doctor calls him.

episodesList.title: Gautam is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: As Gautam gets the doctor's call, he rushes to meet her in the middle of the play. He gets heartbroken to learn about the abnormal development of the baby.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Create a Blunder
episodesList.summary: During the Ramlila performance, the Pandyas make a blunder in front of the crowd. However, the family gets bothered by Gautam since he is missing.

episodesList.title: Dhara is In For a Shock!
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Rishita rock the stage with their dance performance while Shiva ties Prafulla to a pole. Elsewhere, Dhara notices Gautam talking to a lady.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Dhara demands answers from Gautam for his sudden disappearance. During the Ravan Dahan, the Pandyas are worried as Gautam's life is at stake.

episodesList.title: Gautam to Convince Dhara
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are relieved when Gautam and Suman are out of danger. Later, Gautam tries to justify his actions to an infuriated Dhara.

episodesList.title: Dhara Demands Answers
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas decide to participate in the best couple competition, Anita visits them. Later, Dhara demands answers from Gautam.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Ready to Rock
episodesList.summary: Despite Suman's opposition, the Pandyas take part in the best couple challenge. Later, Rishita and Dev rock the stage with their charming character.

episodesList.title: The Return Of Disha!
episodesList.summary: Suman hunts for Disha while Raavi and Shiva walk the ramp. Later, the Pandyas are shocked as Disha arrives and joins Shiva on stage.

episodesList.title: Gautam Proposes to Dhara
episodesList.summary: Gautam accepts Dhara's challenge and proposes to her in front of the crowd. Elsewhere, Shiva takes a stand for Raavi by doing the unimaginable.

episodesList.title: Shiva's New Look
episodesList.summary: As the competition continues, Shiva makes a grand entry with a makeover. However, Raavi thinks that Shiva changed for Disha and insults them out of jealousy.

episodesList.title: Dhara Slaps Shiva
episodesList.summary: Gautam distracts Dhara when she reads her medical reports. Dhara slaps Shiva when he makes an offensive statement regarding Raavi.

episodesList.title: Raavi Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Raavi gets filled with jealousy to see Disha and Shiva get close to each other. Later, Raavi and Shiva share a romantic moment when Shiva burns his finger.

episodesList.title: Gautam, Dhara's Emotional Moment
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets instigated against Dev by her mother. While Dhara questions Gautam when he comes home drunk, the two share an emotional moment.

episodesList.title: Gautam Expresses His Love
episodesList.summary: Gautam and Dhara spend a romantic morning together while Rishita asks Dev to do chores for her. Later, Dev causes a blunder and gets embarrassed by Suman.

episodesList.title: Dhara Confesses to Suman
episodesList.summary: Krish flirts with Kirti at the college cafeteria while Raavi gets jealous seeing Shiva with Disha together. Later, Dhara confesses to Suman about suspecting Gautam.

episodesList.title: Suman has an Eventful Day
episodesList.summary: When Dhara tries to call for assistance in Raavi's absence, Suman steps in to help her. Later, much to Suman’s delight, the Pandyas open a branch of their store.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Caring Gesture
episodesList.summary: Suman objects to Raavi leaving her hand imprints on the board, but Shiva makes it happen. Later, Krish finds a secret document.

episodesList.title: Dhara Misunderstands Gautam
episodesList.summary: Gautam manages to save Dhara's reports from Krish and gives them to Anita for safekeeping. However, Dhara doubts Gautam about having an affair.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Shower Love
episodesList.summary: While Dhara questions Gautam about meeting another girl, he reveals that he met with Anita. Later, Shiva and Raavi have fun riding a bike.

episodesList.title: Shiva Worries For Raavi
episodesList.summary: Raavi meets with an accident, and a concerned Shiva confesses his love for her. While Suman confronts them, Dhara gets suspicious of her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Suman Announces Her Decision
episodesList.summary: While Suman declares her decision about the fate of Raavi and Shiva's marriage, Dhara loses consciousness. Later, Gautam blames Shiva for Dhara's condition.

episodesList.title: Suman Rebukes Gautam
episodesList.summary: Gautam brings Diwali gifts for the family, but Suman chastises him for not purchasing anything for Disha. Later, Anita makes her move against Dhara.

episodesList.title: Rishita Feels Insulted
episodesList.summary: Suman loses her temper at Rishita, humiliating her for bringing gifts for the Pandyas. Later, Dhara feels giddy as she performs a Puja.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva to Divorce?
episodesList.summary: Gautam hides the truth about Dhara's medical condition from everyone. Elsewhere, a tense Raavi shares a moment with Shiva after Suman asks them to get divorced.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva At Court
episodesList.summary: To stop Shiva's divorce, Dhara and Rishita see a marriage counsellor. Later, Shiva and Raavi arrive at the court.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva to Part Ways?
episodesList.summary: Suman gives Rishita a stern warning. While Gautam loses his temper at Dhara, Raavi and Shiva sign the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Request to Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman berates Dhara for conspiring to keep Raavi and Shiva together. Dhara requests her to keep Raavi in the house until her baby is born.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Promise to Shiva
episodesList.summary: Raavi promises Shiva that she will get married on the same day as him. Gautam learns about Krish not paying the electricity bill, Dhara carries out her plan.

episodesList.title: Raavi Spills The Beans
episodesList.summary: Dhara fails to stop Shiva and Disha’s engagement after Suman makes her swear to Gautam. However, Raavi spills the beans about the court’s statement.

episodesList.title: Disha is Shattered!
episodesList.summary: After learning the truth about Shiva and Raavi's relationship, Disha lashes out at them. Later, Suman expresses her unhappiness about the incidents.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi Reconcile
episodesList.summary: As Shiva places the ring on Raavi's finger, the Pandyas breathe a sigh of relief. However, Suman is displeased with the course of events.

episodesList.title: Suman Accepts Raavi
episodesList.summary: Suman wants to leave the Pandyas but Dhara persuades her otherwise. Later, everyone is relieved when Suman accepts Raavi and Shiva's relationship.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi Wed Again
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Raavi ask Rishita to retrieve the latter's Mangalsutra from Suman's cupboard. Later, Shiva puts the sacred thread around Raavi's neck once again.

episodesList.title: A Tough Call For Gautam
episodesList.summary: Suman fails to realise that Raavi and Shiva have patched up. While Dhara collapses, Gautam is left with limited choices at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: While Rishita tries her best to shift Dhara to a better hospital, Gautam decides to save the latters life over the baby's. However, Suman disagrees with him.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Ultimate Verdict
episodesList.summary: Worried about Dhara's health, Gautam takes a final call. However, Suman is not pleased with his choice and does the unimaginable.

episodesList.title: Will Dhara Give Her Consent?
episodesList.summary: Gautam informs Dhara about his decision to terminate the pregnancy. Later, Dhara gets discharged from the hospital and returns home.

episodesList.title: Gautam is Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Suman expresses her distress over Gautam's sole decision of aborting the baby and slaps him! Later, Gautam gets disheartened and apologises to Dhara.

episodesList.title: Dhara Refuses to Forgive
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas strike a dazzling idea to cheer Dhara's mood at midnight. However, their plan flops when Dhara refuses to forgive Gautam.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Appeal to Gautam
episodesList.summary: Rishita faces trouble at her office after getting late. Meanwhile, Dhara puts forth a special request to Gautam. Will he accomplish it?

episodesList.title: Dhara Turns Inconsolable
episodesList.summary: Gautam gets worried when Dhara becomes inconsolable. Elsewhere, Shiva apologises to Raavi for his lame behaviour.

episodesList.title: Gautam Offers an Apology
episodesList.summary: Dev vents his anger out on Rishita as she talks about the Pandya store. Later, a heated argument erupts when Gautam apologises to Dhara.

episodesList.title: Dhara Finds Hope
episodesList.summary: Suman consoles a heartbroken Dhara and asks her not to lose hope. Further, Anita comes to meet Dhara with yet another conspiracy in mind.

episodesList.title: A Ray Of Hope For Dhara
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are taken aback when they realise that Rishita's boss has betrayed them. Elsewhere, Dhara receives good news.

episodesList.title: Dhara Forgives Gautam
episodesList.summary: The police officers arrive when the Pandyas wreak havoc at Janardhan's mansion. Later, Dhara forgives Gautam and ignores the past.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Celebrate!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas prepare to host a party since Dhara has forgiven Gautam. Meanwhile, Janardhan and Kamini vow to seek revenge against them.

episodesList.title: Rishita to Reveal The Truth
episodesList.summary: After Dhara misunderstands the debt payment money with her IVF, she is kept out of the loan issue. Later, Rishita decides to tell Dhara the truth.

episodesList.title: Dhara Learns The Truth!
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets the last warning from her boss to pay the debt in the next 24 hours. When she informs the family, Dhara overhears the conversation.

episodesList.title: Suman's Firm Step
episodesList.summary: Despite Gautam's protests, Suman mortgages their home for Dhara to undergo IVF. Rishita, on the other hand, decides to confront Kamini and Janardhan.

episodesList.title: Dhara Defies Suman
episodesList.summary: Dhara is shocked to learn about Suman's plan to arrange the money for her treatment. However, she goes against Suman and suggests paying off the loan first.

episodesList.title: Dhara Strikes a Deal
episodesList.summary: The Pandya brothers hunt for Dhara while Rishita gives Krish a stern warning. Elsewhere, Dhara strikes a tremendous deal and becomes dizzy.

episodesList.title: Shiva Offers Help
episodesList.summary: The women of the Pandya family realise that Dhara has got tricked and decide not to inform the men. Later, Shiva offers unexpected help to Dhara.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Bold Step
episodesList.summary: Shiva tricks and thrashes the jeweller before the police officers arrest him. Later, he and Raavi share a romantic moment in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Arrested!
episodesList.summary: The police arrest the Pandya brothers for a fraudulent case. Later, the women of the family seek help and create chaos outside the police station.

episodesList.title: Dhara Confronts Kamini
episodesList.summary: Dhara assures the Pandya brothers that she would do everything she can to get them out of jail. Later, Dhara hands Kamini a cheque to pay off her debt.

episodesList.title: Suman In a Fix!
episodesList.summary: Janardhan and Kamini put forth a condition in exchange of saving the Pandya brothers. However, Suman lands in a fix, worried about the family's fate.

episodesList.title: Rishita to Leave The House
episodesList.summary: A heated argument erupts between Dhara and Rishita while the Pandya brothers are freed from prison. Later, Rishita decides to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Dev Leave Home
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas grow dejected when Rishita and Dev bid goodbye to them and leave the house. Later, the Seths warmly welcome the couple home.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Truth Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Gautam questions Dhara for letting Dev leave the house with Rishita so easily but she refuses to answer. However, Suman hears Dhara and Shiva's shocking conversation.

episodesList.title: Raavi Falls In Danger
episodesList.summary: Raavi goes to Janardhan's house where his enemies assume her to be his daughter and abduct her. Meanwhile, Janardhan catches Dev sneaking around in the house.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Dhara informs Gautam about her secret plan while Shiva races against the clock to save Raavi from peril. Later, Rishita overhears Dev's telephonic discussion.

episodesList.title: Dhara Breaks Her Promise
episodesList.summary: Gautam forces Dhara to promise him that she will not help Dev. However, Dhara breaks her oath when she aids Dev to steal documents from Janardhan.

episodesList.title: Rishita Catches Dhara
episodesList.summary: Rishita finds Dhara and the Pandya brothers trying to steal Janardhan's documents when he sees them together. Later, Gautam arrives to rescue them.

episodesList.title: Dhara Brings Good News
episodesList.summary: Dhara delivers the news of their victory over Janardhan Seth and tells Suman how they retrieved the papers. Later, Raavi gets angry at Dhara for lying to her.

episodesList.title: Raavi Demands Answers
episodesList.summary: As Shiva arranges a surprise for Raavi, she gets angry and avoids the party held at her house. Later, she confronts Shiva for not including her in the plan.

episodesList.title: Dhara Fears The Worst
episodesList.summary: Dev takes Rishita away from Janardhan's house while Raavi is heartbroken. On the occasion of the new year, Dhara fears the separation of the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Shiva Confronts Raavi
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Gautam consider opening personal bank accounts for everyone to deposit the profit. Elsewhere, after receiving a video of Raavi, Shiva confronts her.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Shocking Announcement
episodesList.summary: Gautam persuades his brothers to open individual bank accounts. Later, Raavi makes an unexpected decision to boost sales at the store.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Face Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Shiva prevent Raavi's scheme for the Pandya shop. However, they are late since her scheme has already harmed their market image.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Gautam Await Ivf
episodesList.summary: Raavi talks to her alter ego who asks her to propose to Shiva who is angry on her. Meanwhile Dhara expresses her happiness to Gautam about the IVF.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Suman!
episodesList.summary: Dev slaps Shiva when he dreams about getting romantic with Raavi. Meanwhile, Suman is in for a massive shock upon reaching the hospital.

episodesList.title: Anita, Kamini's Vicious Idea
episodesList.summary: Suman turns suspicious after spotting Anita and Kamini at the hospital. While Suman seeks Shiva's help, Anita and Kamini prepare to execute their agenda.

episodesList.title: Shiva Arrives At The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Suman and Gautam slap Krish for his silly behaviour at the hospital. Meanwhile, Shiva visits the hospital during a catastrophic disaster!

episodesList.title: Anita Destroys Dhara's Last Hope
episodesList.summary: After picking up Kamini's phone call, Shiva discovers her nasty plans. Later, Anita knocks the embryo container in front of Dhara, causing it to spill.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Outrageous Act
episodesList.summary: Shiva accuses Raavi and Anita of planning against Dhara. Later, everyone is stunned as Shiva accomplishes the unimaginable.

episodesList.title: Shiva is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Raavi slaps Shiva and calls the cops after he assaults Anita. Dhara later goes missing from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Dhara Finds a Baby
episodesList.summary: Dhara discovers an abandoned newborn baby in the garden. Meanwhile, Shiva expresses his dislike for Raavi by writing it on the prison's wall.

episodesList.title: Dhara Goes Into Hiding
episodesList.summary: Dhara tries to feed the baby when she gets spotted by Prafulla. While Hardik confronts Anita about her actions, Dhara hides inside Pandya Stores.

episodesList.title: Prafulla Humiliates Suman
episodesList.summary: Helpless about the situation of her family, Suman feels sad for Gautam. Later, Prafulla arrives with a drum to insult Suman about her condition.

episodesList.title: Suman Meets Shiva
episodesList.summary: Suman throws Prafulla out of her house and decides to go to the police station to meet Shiva. Later, Rishita helps Suman convince the police to let her meet Shiva.

episodesList.title: Suman Threatens Anita
episodesList.summary: Suman tries to free Shiva from the lockup but the police ask her to prove his innocence first. Later, Suman threatens Anita to take her complaint back.

episodesList.title: Meet Inspector Durgachandi
episodesList.summary: Rishita disguises as Inspector Durgachandi and arrests Anita. As she threatens to encounter her, Anita takes the complaint back and releases Shiva.

episodesList.title: Shiva Creates a Fuss
episodesList.summary: Krish bumps into Gautam while an infuriated Shiva demands Prafulla and Anita for Raavi. Later, Shiva vows to bring Dhara and Raavi home.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Arduous Task
episodesList.summary: Rishita manages to track Raavi's location and informs Shiva about it. Later, Shiva takes up the challenge to bring Raavi back home safely!

episodesList.title: Joyful Moments At The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get delighted after Dhara and the baby return home safely. Meanwhile, baby Tara's real parents show up.

episodesList.title: Dhara Turns Paranoid
episodesList.summary: A visibly fearful Dhara holds the baby tightly and refuses to give it to anyone. Later she apologises to the baby’s parents for her mistake.

episodesList.title: Shiva Rescues Raavi
episodesList.summary: Shiva saves Raavi from the traffickers. Later Suman states that Raavi cannot stay in her house as she may go against her sons.

episodesList.title: Suman Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Shiva brings Raavi home, and she clarifies her deeds. While Suman allows Raavi to stay in the house, she refuses to accept her as a part of the family.

episodesList.title: Raavi Gets Tricked
episodesList.summary: Suman chastises Raavi and insists that she prove her honesty to the Pandyas. Eventually, Prafulla dupes Raavi into signing the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Raavi Grows Determined
episodesList.summary: Raavi signs the divorce papers, unaware of Prafulla's trick. Later, she decides to prove her innocence and win Shiva's heart.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Shocked
episodesList.summary: Gautam discusses Pandya Store's monthly profit while sharing the money with his brothers. However, the Pandyas are shocked on receiving a letter from the court.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Shocking Confession
episodesList.summary: While Shiva shows the signed divorce papers to Raavi, the latter confesses her love for him. Unconvinced by her words, he decides to send her out of the house.

episodesList.title: Raavi Stands For Her Rights
episodesList.summary: As Shiva’s wife and the Pandyas' daughter-in-law, Raavi wants her rights to stay in the house. She confesses her love by writing on walls.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Surprise For Shiva
episodesList.summary: Raavi plans to surprise Shiva with his favourite dishes, but the latter decides to spend the night at the store. Refusing to give up, she goes to the store.

episodesList.title: Raavi Seeks Dhara's Advice
episodesList.summary: While Gautam discovers the ruined products in his store, Dhara finds Krish with Kirti. Later, Raavi seeks Dhara's advice to make Shiva fall for her.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Hardwork Pays Off
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets a car from her company and Dhara stops Shiva from damaging it. Later, all the family members join Rishita in celebrating her success.

episodesList.title: Bad Luck Strikes Rishita
episodesList.summary: Rishita's car gets damaged, when the Pandya family goes out. Later, Suman worries about Shiva and Raavi’s relationship.

episodesList.title: A Witty Initiative By The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The family tries to gather customers at the Pandya Store with an innovative play to describe the shop’s credibility. Learning about this, Janardhan gets furious.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Plan Bears Fruit
episodesList.summary: Dhara and the Pandya brothers are delighted as customers start pouring into their store once again. Later, Dhara catches Krish confessing his feelings to Kirti.

episodesList.title: Hard to Please Suman!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are happy as Raavi and Rishita bring huge grocery orders to the store. However, Suman feels that the duo still has to work hard like Dhara.

episodesList.title: Kirti, Krish's Secret Meeting
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas grow concerned when Shiva misbehaves with them. Meanwhile, Kirti and Krish share a romantic moment after meeting secretly.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Ardent Plea
episodesList.summary: Kamini and Prafulla destroy the grains from the Pandya house using cows. On learning about this, Dhara requests the sage to give her a second chance.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Get Hope
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas face difficulties getting grains, Dhara's brother comes to their rescue. Meanwhile, Raavi finds that the snake in the box is missing.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Courageous Task
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are petrified as the snake moves freely in the house. Later, Rishita is put to test with a challenging task for Suman's sake.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Dev's Midnight Romance
episodesList.summary: While Raavi pretends to have been bitten by the snake, Shiva catches her lying. Later, Dev and Rishita share a romantic moment at midnight.

episodesList.title: Raavi Faces a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Shiva challenges Raavi to prove that she didn't sign the divorce papers, and she accepts it. Later, the Pandyas face a problem with food delivery.

episodesList.title: Krish Receives a Challenge
episodesList.summary: When Krish reveals that he saw Kamini Seth doing something suspicious, Rishita challenges him to prove it. Elsewhere, Raavi gets blamed for trying to kill Suman.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: The CCTV footage shows Raavi taking the snake from Prafulla. Later, she decides to leave the house to find evidence to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Raavi Leaves The House
episodesList.summary: To prove her innocence, Raavi leaves the house but Prafulla is elated to see her. Later, Rishita spots Krish and Kirti at a cafe.

episodesList.title: Prafulla Invites The Pandyas

episodesList.summary: Suman realises her mistake and apologises to Raavi. However, she gives her approval and the Pandyas celebrate as Shiva and Raavi get hitched.

episodesList.title: Will Dhara’s Plan Work?

episodesList.title: Dhara Supports Raavi

episodesList.title: Raavi's Emotional Outburst

episodesList.title: Raavi Hopes For The Best!

episodesList.title: A Close Shave For Shiva

episodesList.title: Shiva Confides In Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets emotional when she sees Shiva alive. While he tells her about how he survived the accident, Shiva asks Dhara to keep this a secret.

episodesList.title: Raavi Meets Shiva
episodesList.summary: Prafulla comes to the Pandya house and expresses her concern about the paranormal activities. Later, Raavi gets surprised to see Shiva.

episodesList.title: Raavi In Trouble

episodesList.summary: Raavi panics when Suman visits Prafulla to find out about the paranormal activities in her house. Will Raavi be able to handle the situation?

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Suman

episodesList.title: Pandyas Make Suman Angry
episodesList.summary: After getting the prize money, Suman grows enraged to see Pandya's lifestyle. Later, she decides to punish them for their behaviour.

episodesList.title: Suman Punishes The Pandyas

episodesList.title: Krish's Confession About Kirti

episodesList.title: Shocking Condition For Krish

episodesList.title: Rishita Confronts Janardhan

episodesList.title: Rishita Blames Krish

episodesList.title: Kirti Rebukes Krish
episodesList.summary: Krish gets violent when the Pandya brothers come to convince him. Denying marrying Krish, Kirti criticises him and his family.

episodesList.title: Krish's Shocking Confession

episodesList.title: Dhara's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Dhara refuses to give any advice to Shiva as she blames herself for Krish's actions. Later, Shiva and Krish argue about Dhara.

episodesList.title: Krish's Heartfelt Apology
episodesList.summary: After realising the mistakes, Krish apologises to the Pandyas for his previous deeds. Later, Dhara gets stuck in a problem to help a sick woman with her newborn baby.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Polite Gesture
episodesList.summary: Amidst the heavy rainfalls, Dhara takes the baby to the hospital. With no luck, she brings the newborn kid home, stunning the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Tend to The Baby
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas take care of the baby, but Dhara's attachment becomes an issue. When Gautam decides to return the baby, the ailing mother requests them to tend to him.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Agitated
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets furious when the Pandyas plan to keep the baby away from her. Later, she chastises Kriti for making fun of Krish in college.

episodesList.title: Raavi Gets Her Salary
episodesList.summary: Raavi is delighted to get her first payment from her social media account. Elsewhere, Gautam gets worried when the baby's mother escapes from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Dhara Makes a Plea
episodesList.summary: An anxious Dhara bursts out at the Pandyas for keeping the baby away from her. Later, she pleads with Gautam when he decides to send the baby to the orphanage.

episodesList.title: Rishita In Labour?
episodesList.summary: When Rishita visits the hospital to attend a workshop, she feels pain. Later, Gautam fears getting exposed after the Pandyas arrive at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Plan is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Gautam gets caught in front of Suman by the doctor, who reveals the truth. Dhara is enraged when she learns of Gautam's plan to keep the baby away from her.

episodesList.title: Raavi Faces Wild Allegations
episodesList.summary: Suman learns from the residents of Somnath about Raavi's addiction. Later, the Pandyas confront Raavi for blocking them on social media.

episodesList.title: Raavi Apologises to The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Raavi seeks forgiveness from the Pandyas for secretly uploading videos of the house. Rishita becomes irritated when Suman supports Raavi's efforts and earnings.

episodesList.title: Shiva Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Shiva doubts Raavi's intention when he finds her secretly meeting an unknown person. Later, Dhara leaves the Pandya house in search of the baby's real mother.

episodesList.title: Shiva Loses His Cool
episodesList.summary: When Raavi informs Shiva about her deal with the bank, he gets angry at her. However, Suman gets delighted to learn about Raavi's remuneration.

episodesList.title: A Job Offer For Raavi
episodesList.summary: Shweta wakes up abruptly from her sleep and senses uneasiness. Elsewhere, the Pandyas learn about an anchoring offer proposed to Raavi.

episodesList.title: Dhara Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Suman is glad to see Gautam bring Dhara back home and reveals her plan to make Chiku a part of the Pandya family. Later, the Pandyas watch Raavi's show together.

episodesList.title: Raavi is Castigated
episodesList.summary: Shiva is offended when Raavi asks him to bring her a glass of water after she returns home. Later, Suman berates Raavi and accuses her of being egocentric.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Plan a Party
episodesList.summary: After receiving the news that they can legally adopt Chiku, Gautam decides to celebrate the occasion. Later, Shiva gets angry at Raavi for suggesting what he should wear.

episodesList.title: Shiva Attends The Party
episodesList.summary: After Raavi's request, Dhara convinces Shiva to attend the party. At the same time, Suman makes an important announcement.

episodesList.title: An Operation By The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The women of the Pandya family help Rishita deliver her child when she goes into labour. Later, when Chiku goes missing, Shiva spots the kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Good News For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandya women are delighted after Rishita's successful delivery. On the other hand, Raavi gets shocked when she learns that the brothers are in jail.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Worried
episodesList.summary: Shiva feels concerned about Dhara's attachment to Chiku as Shweta's parents want the child back. Gautam tells Dhara not to interfere in Rishita's upbringing of her baby.

episodesList.title: Dhara has an Outburst
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets shocked when Shweta and her parents visit the Pandya house. After learning about their demand, Dhara gets furious and gives them a befitting reply.

episodesList.title: Dhara Cries Out In Anguish
episodesList.summary: Dhara bursts into tears as Shweta takes Chiku away from her. While Dev tries to console Dhara, Kami peeks inside the Pandya home and learns about Rishita's baby.

episodesList.title: Kamini Mocks Suman
episodesList.summary: Rajjo visits the Pandyas and invites them to a fair organised in her village. Later, Kamini takes a jibe at Suman questioning her offering for Rishita's baby.

episodesList.title: A Tough Choice For Dhara
episodesList.summary: The Dwivedis put forth a condition to the Pandyas before leaving their house. Later, Dhara encounters an unexpected situation concerning Chiku's fate.

episodesList.title: Dhara Makes a Commitment!
episodesList.summary: Dhara offers to take good care of Chiku when the Pandyas turn reluctant. Later, they host a function at their residence.

episodesList.title: Rishita Halts The Ritual
episodesList.summary: Rishita is overjoyed as Chutki's naming ceremony begins. After learning that the priest is performing two naming traditions, Rishita cancels the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Rishita Creates a Scene
episodesList.summary: After the naming ceremony, Rishita gets furious and questions Pandyas' love for Chutki. Later, Dhara gets shocked when a conflict ensues between Raavi and Shiva.

episodesList.title: Suman Gives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Suman tells Shweta's mother to make a final decision about Chiku's future. Later, Shiva and Raavi misunderstand each other when the Pandyas plan to send them on a date.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas comfort Rishita when she suffers an emotional breakdown. Elsewhere, danger lurks around Raavi.

episodesList.title: Shiva Locates Raavi
episodesList.summary: Shiva finds Raavi unconscious in a hospital after searching the entire city. After Raavi narrates the incident, Dhara suggests buying a car for the family.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gives Up On Chiku
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get shocked to learn about the shocking request of Shweta's parents. Later, Dhara has an emotional breakdown after giving Chiku's responsibility to Shweta.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi's Romantic Interaction
episodesList.summary: Shiva returns home in an injured state which worries the Pandyas. Later, Shiva and Raavi exchange gifts and express their feelings for each other.

episodesList.title: Rishita Faces Suman's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Suman grows agitated when Rishita arrogantly refuses to obey the Pandya's rituals. Later, when Rishita questions Shweta's intention, the latter gives an apt reply.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Ecstatic
episodesList.summary: Suman cuts the ribbon at the grand opening of Rishita's new shop. Later, the Pandyas celebrate the purchase of a new car while Rishita performs the rituals.

episodesList.title: Rishita Lashes Out At Dhara
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Shiva get interrupted when Rishita accuses Dhara of caring for Chiku more than Sachi. However, the rest of the Pandyas stand by Dhara.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Terrible Decision
episodesList.summary: When Rishita insults Dev, Dhara gives her an apt reply. The Pandyas get anxious as Rishita grows agitated and takes a shocking decision.

episodesList.title: Raavi In Dire Straits
episodesList.summary: Raavi's unsettling images are used as ransom demands after her account gets hacked. Before she has a chance to fix it, the cops show up.

episodesList.title: Rishita Discovers Shweta's Ruse
episodesList.summary: Shweta heats the baby oil to provoke Rishita against Dhara. However, Rishita learns about Shweta's evil plot and vows to teach her a lesson.

episodesList.title: Rishita Begins to Execute
episodesList.summary: To trace Shweta's movements, Rishita plans to install a CCTV camera in the Pandya house. Elsewhere, Raavi is hopeful of finding her social media account hacker.

episodesList.title: Dhara Denies Chiku's Duties
episodesList.summary: Dhara asks Shweta to care for Chiku after she declines the responsibility. Further, Shweta devises a sinister plan to stage Chiku's kidnapping.

episodesList.title: Suman's Special Day
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas neglect Suman on her birthday as she is unaware of their surprise party for her. Elsewhere, Rishita doubts Shweta's weird movements.

episodesList.title: Suman's Sweet 60th Birthday!
episodesList.summary: The Pandya family plans a nice surprise and makes it memorable for Suman's birthday. In the meantime, Shweta implements a cunning plan.

episodesList.title: Shweta Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Shweta's strategy starts working on the Pandyas. Unfazed Raavi meets Arnab for the photos before she realises the cause of the mayhem.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Cunning Tactics
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas worry over Chiku's abduction, the police take blood samples. Meanwhile, Shweta creates a false scenario to avoid giving her blood sample.

episodesList.title: Dhara is Distraught
episodesList.summary: Due to Chiku's abduction, Dhara is left inconsolable and becomes unwell. While Chiku's sickness puts Forum in trouble, Rishita hatches an idea.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Acquire Help
episodesList.summary: Shweta is set to run away, but her mother walks in and thwarts her plans. Meanwhile, Raavi's video circulates widely, and the family receives assistance.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Condition Worsens
episodesList.summary: After Forum abducts Chiku, the Pandyas try to track him down with the help of the police. Meanwhile, Dhara's health deteriorates as she awaits Chiku's return.

episodesList.title: Shweta Shares Her Feelings
episodesList.summary: As Krish stops Shweta from getting intoxicated, she breaks down and opens up to him. Elsewhere, Dhara feels heartbroken and prepares to stay without Chikoo.

episodesList.title: Krish Proposes Shweta For Marriage
episodesList.summary: Shweta attempts to escape from the Pandya house at midnight. However, Krish boldly puts forth a proposal in front of her, which leaves everyone startled.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Confront Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara faces questions after she supports Krishs wish to marry Shweta. Elsewhere, Shweta is in a dilemma when her father puts forth a condition before her.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Face Suman's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Following Mr. Patel's condition, Shweta agrees to marry Krish. However, Suman lashes out at the Pandyas and refuses to permit Krish to wed Shweta.

episodesList.title: Krish's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Krish grows anxious and decides to marry Shweta at the temple without Suman's permission. Later, the Pandyas get worried when Shweta meets with an accident.

episodesList.title: Shweta Plots to Frame Krish
episodesList.summary: Shweta devises a sinister plan to set up Krish and the Pandya family in the case of domestic violence. Later on, Rishita grows suspicious of Shweta’s actions.

episodesList.title: Rishita Plans to Expose Shweta
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas commence with the preparations for Shweta and Krish's engagement. In the meantime, a suspicious Rishita vows to expose Shweta's ill intentions.

episodesList.title: A Glimmer Of Hope For Raavi
episodesList.summary: When Rishita continues her hunt and arrives at Shweta's house, the latter makes a scene. Moreover, Arnav informs Raavi that he has obtained consent to track the hacker.

episodesList.title: Who is Blackmailing Shweta?
episodesList.summary: A stranger demands Chiku from Shweta in return for not releasing her video to the public. In the meantime, Arnav drives Raavi to the hacker's lair.

episodesList.title: Raavi Thrashes The Hacker
episodesList.summary: Raavi apprehends the hacker and beats him before handing him over to the cops. Later, Shiva accuses her and Arnav of entering the hotel room.

episodesList.title: Shiva Apologises to Raavi
episodesList.summary: After Shiva's apology, Raavi gives him an apt reply, and he ends up feeling guilty. Elsewhere, Shweta gets shocked to see Deven in front of the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Dhara Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets suspicious when she finds Shweta taking Chiku out of the Pandya house. Elsewhere, Shweta gets caught when she tries to steal money from Suman's locker.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Shweta
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are delighted to celebrate Dandiya night in the house. Later, Shweta gets shocked when Krish brings Deven to Pandya's house at their engagement party.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi At Odds
episodesList.summary: The Pandya house catches fire amid Shweta and Krish's engagement event, and Raavi becomes the victim. Even after Shiva saves her, she doesn't accept his apologies.

episodesList.title: Festivities At The Pandya House
episodesList.summary: Celebrations continue at Pandya's house as everyone gathers on the dance floor. Meanwhile, Shweta steals the keys from Suman and Deven robs her locker.

episodesList.title: Rishita Doubts Shweta
episodesList.summary: Shweta gets attacked by Deven. She then hears that the Pandyas want to splurge on the wedding. Later, Rishita tells Dev that Shweta is the root of all troubles.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Vile Motive
episodesList.summary: Shweta devises a vile plan to make duplicate jewellery to replace with the originals. Elsewhere, Rishita grows suspicious of seeing Shweta and Deven in the market.

episodesList.title: Rishita Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: While Dhara takes Shweta's side, Rishita gets furious and decides to search the latter's room. Elsewhere, Shweta is preparing for her next move.

episodesList.title: Shweta Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: As per Shweta's plan, Deven takes on the guise of a waiter to steal the jewellery from Suman. However, Shweta grows anxious when Rishita gets evidence from her phone.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets shocked when Rishita informs her about Shweta's plan to make duplicates of the jewellery. When Rishita confronts Shweta, the latter grows anxious.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are rocking the stage with a glimpse of their outstanding performances. Later, the Pandyas get shocked when Rishita accuses Shweta in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: A Dead End For Rishita and Dhara?
episodesList.summary: Rishita apologises to Shweta for the allegations. Meanwhile, Suman orders Rishita and Dhara to stay silent until Krish and Shweta's wedding.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Rishita's Request to Raavi
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Rishita plead with Raavi to help them in taking away the jewellery from Suman. However, Deven intends to replace the gold jewellery with fake pieces.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Ill Intentions
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas celebrate Garba beside the swimming pool, Shweta thinks it is the perfect opportunity to throw the ornaments in the water. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Dhara Notices Deven
episodesList.summary: Dhara grows anxious to learn about the exchange of wedding jewellery as Shweta has the original one. Later, Dhara gets shocked when she finds Deven at the resort.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Suman unknowingly asks Raavi to marry Gautam. Elsewhere, when Dhara fails to catch Deven after several tries, she attacks him.

episodesList.title: Rishita Devises a Plan
episodesList.summary: Before Dhara reaches the wedding venue, Rishita tries to stop Krish and Shweta's wedding using various excuses. Later, Dhara is shocked to learn Shweta's truth.

episodesList.title: Dhara to Reveal The Truth
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets worried as she fails to call off Krish and Shweta's wedding. Later, Dhara visits the wedding venue to reveal the truth of Shweta's ill intentions.

episodesList.title: Shweta Faces Dhara's Wrath
episodesList.summary: After gaining consciousness, Dhara lashes out at Shweta for betraying the Pandyas. An anxious Shweta tries to convince Dhara not to reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Shweta Manipulates Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets adamant about exposing Shweta, but the latter manages to convince her with a lie. As Rishita declares the truth about the false jewellery, Dhara changes her statement.

episodesList.title: Gautam Feels Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Rishita befriends Shweta before the Pandyas but holds a desire to expose her true face. Gautam suspects Dhara and questions her.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Plan Falls Apart?
episodesList.summary: Shweta intends to seize the precious items from the gifts to facilitate her escape. However, in an interesting twist of events, her parents offer her an unexpected gift.

episodesList.title: Shweta Questions Her Parents
episodesList.summary: Shweta confronts her parents over their decision to select Dhara as Chiku's custodian. Unable to locate Shweta in the house, Krish assumes that she must have fled.

episodesList.title: Krish Learns Of Shwetas Secret?
episodesList.summary: Krish gets nervous as he discovers Shweta's tickets to Dubai in her suitcase. Meanwhile, feeling irritated by Arnab's presence, Shiva argues with Raavi.

episodesList.title: Krish Fumes In Anger
episodesList.summary: Krish gets shocked when he learns about Shweta's intention to marry him. Later, Krish is enraged when Shweta gets furious with Dhara for losing Chiku's custodian.

episodesList.title: Shweta Decides to Play Nice
episodesList.summary: Krish reveals that he married Shweta only because of Chiku and puts forth a shocking condition. Later, Shweta plans to play smooth until she gets the money.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Villainous Ploy
episodesList.summary: Shweta tries to manipulate Raavi to create an unrest atmosphere in the Pandya house. Elsewhere, Rishita devises a plan to reveal Shweta's reality in front of the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Rishita undertakes all the possible efforts to expose Shweta. On the other hand, Shweta waits to execute her own course of action upon Raavi's return.

episodesList.title: Shweta Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: As Shweta creates a mess in the kitchen, Rishita gives an update to Devan. The Pandyas discover Shweta's true intent with the help of Rishita's plan.

episodesList.title: Suman Kicks Shweta Out
episodesList.summary: Devan attacks Dhara as she holds him by the collar and goes ahead to complain to the police. While Devan gets arrested, an infuriated Suman kicks Shweta out of the house.

episodesList.title: Shweta's New Plan
episodesList.summary: An emotional Dhara gets confronted by Rishita. On the other hand, Shweta injures herself and manages to sneak in to the Pandya mansion at midnight.

episodesList.title: Shweta Spins a Yarn
episodesList.summary: By pleading and apologising to Rishita, Shweta deceives Dhara and wins their hearts. Will Suman pardon Shweta and allow her to live in the Pandya household?

episodesList.title: Shweta's Vicious Plan
episodesList.summary: Shweta comes up with an evil plan against Dhara to frame the latter regarding the misuse of Chiku's money. Later, the Pandyas are shocked when Shweta tries to harm herself.

episodesList.title: Dhara Agrees to The Request
episodesList.summary: Dhara agrees to withdraw the money from Chiku's account for the Diwali celebration at Shweta's father's request. Later, Shweta plans to put Dhara in trouble with the amount.

episodesList.title: Shweta Creates a Conflict
episodesList.summary: Shweta purposely speaks to Dhara about Raavi and Shiva's Goa trip so that Rishita is aware of it. Rishita gets furious at the unfair treatment and wants to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Diwali Prep Of The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Shweta gets emotional after recalling her previous Diwali and desires to become rich. Later, the Pandyas get engaged in decorating the house for Diwali.
