episodesList.title: Dhara is In a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: While Dhara tries to fix Raavi and Shiva's issues, Shweta creates a plan to increase their problems. Later, Dhara lands in trouble and gets questioned for using Chiku's money.

episodesList.title: Shiva Understands Mind Games
episodesList.summary: Suman lashes out at Dhara for making use of Chiku's funds. Meanwhile, Shiva realises that Shweta is creating misunderstandings between him and Raavi.

episodesList.title: Shweta Rekindles The Flames
episodesList.summary: Shweta stokes the misunderstanding between Raavi and Shiva, who then turns it ugly in front of the Pandyas. Later, Gautam tries to comfort Shiva as he is troubled.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Wicked Intent
episodesList.summary: To destroy Raavi and Shiva's relationship, Shweta makes the former consume some pills. Elsewhere, Raavi gets ready to leave for Mumbai with Arnav.

episodesList.title: Shweta Makes a Mistake
episodesList.summary: After seeing Arnav's shirt, Raavi understands the reason for Shiva's anger. Shweta gets into trouble after eating the Halwa that Dhara asks her to serve to Chutki.

episodesList.title: Raavi is Pregnant?
episodesList.summary: Dhara is thrilled when Raavi shows signs of pregnancy and decides to undergo a test. While Raavi feels uncertain, Shweta eavesdrops on them.

episodesList.title: Raavi is In Pain
episodesList.summary: Dhara rushes Raavi to the hospital after she complains of severe abdominal pain. Further, Shweta asks the doctor to do the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Raavi to Get Operated
episodesList.summary: Dhara fails to reach out to the Pandyas as Raavi needs to undergo surgery. Meanwhile, Suman asks the brothers to search for the pregnant lady's husband.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Shweta replaces Raavi's surgery reports by taking guise of a nurse. Later, Rishita questions Shweta upon finding a pregnancy test kit in her bedroom.

episodesList.title: Shweta Announces Raavi's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: After Rishita's forceful interrogation, Shweta makes a suicide attempt to win the sympathy of the Pandyas. When she informs about Raavi's pregnancy, the Pandyas are overjoyed.

episodesList.title: Shiva Fumes In Anger
episodesList.summary: Upon learning of Shweta's evil plan, Shiva gets aggressive about Raavi's abortion. Later, Gautam furiously slaps Shiva when he misbehaves with Dhara.

episodesList.title: Shiva Demands The Truth
episodesList.summary: Shiva charges Dhara for assisting Raavi in her abortion. Things take a dramatic turn when he shows the medical report bearing Dhara's signature.

episodesList.title: Dhara Defends Raavi
episodesList.summary: As Dhara tries to make Shiva understand Raavi's innocence, she loses her cool and slaps him. However, Shweta makes an unexpected move and ignites the fire.

episodesList.title: Suman Criticises Dhara
episodesList.summary: Suman accuses Dhara of the consequences in her sons' life and asks Dhara and Raavi to leave the house. Shweta informs her parents about the incident.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Raavi Leave The House
episodesList.summary: While Dhara decides to leave the house, Gautam wants to accompany her, but she stops him. Dhara decides to take Chiku with her and leaves the house with Raavi.

episodesList.title: Rishita Takes a Disguise
episodesList.summary: Rishita tells Dhara not to leave the house until she returns. To watch the CCTV footage of the hospital, Rishita takes on the disguise of the ward boy.

episodesList.title: Shiva Faces The Heat
episodesList.summary: Shweta learns about Rishita's intentions to find the truth and sabotages her plan. Later, Shiva takes a drastic step after he is cast out by Gautam and Krish.

episodesList.title: Dhara Connects The Dots!
episodesList.summary: Dhara discovers that Shweta is to blame for the family feud after learning that Dr. Nitin is Shweta's friend. Later, she decides to catch Shweta ingeniously.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Smart Strategy
episodesList.summary: Rishita issues an indirect warning to Shweta to get Dhara and Raavi home. Later, Rishita decides to go on strike in order to force Shweta to do the chores.

episodesList.title: Pandyas Unite Against Shweta
episodesList.summary: Dhara reveals Shweta's plot to the Pandya brothers and seeks help to expose her. On the other hand, Shweta's father assists her in attaining her next goal.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Dhara On a Mission
episodesList.summary: Krish overhears Shweta discussing her entire plot against the Pandyas with Nitin. Meanwhile, Rishita and Dhara gather details about Nitin at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Rishita In a Fix
episodesList.summary: Rishita finds herself in a quandary while gathering evidence against Shweta. On the other hand, Gautam and Dev arrive at Nitin's location to apprehend him.

episodesList.title: Rishita Executes Her Idea
episodesList.summary: In order to expose Shweta's evil deeds, Rishita hatches a plan to create a scene of Dhara's fake murder. Shiva gets furious as Arnav visits the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Crocodile Tears
episodesList.summary: While Shiva returns to the ring, the Pandyas prepare their final act to expose Shweta. Later, Shweta tries to deceive her mother with fake tears.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Stabbed!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas devise a plan to capture Shweta and assign Dhara to work inside the house. However, Dhara gets into trouble when a thief breaks into the house.

episodesList.title: Shweta is Accused
episodesList.summary: Rishita and the others continue their plan of action unaware that Dhara has been murdered. Gautam then disguises himself as a cop and comes to arrest Shweta.

episodesList.title: Shweta Falls Into a Well
episodesList.summary: Afraid of being arrested, Shweta contacts her parents, but she accidentally falls into a well. Meanwhile, Dhara awakens as Suman makes her way home.

episodesList.title: Shweta Comes Clean!
episodesList.summary: When Suman returns home, Shweta insists she didn't kill Dhara, but Suman slaps her hard. Soon, distraught by the allegation, Shweta admits the truth.

episodesList.title: Shweta Loses Her Sanity
episodesList.summary: In a fit of rage, Shiva attempts to strike Shweta realising that he has lost everything because of her. Later, Shweta runs to the roof to commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Shweta claims that she was coerced into marrying Krish after her parents rejected Deven. Furthermore, she accuses Dhara of being greedy and blames her entirely.

episodesList.title: Shweta Creates a Ruckus
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas confront Shweta over her arrogant behaviour. As a result, she creates a fuss to beg on the streets with Chiku to earn quick money.

episodesList.title: Raavi to Leave The Pandya House?
episodesList.summary: Taking a firm stand for herself, Raavi decides to move out of the Pandya house. Later, Dhara breaks down in tears when Rishita blames her for all the mishaps.

episodesList.title: A Rift Among The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Dhara grows anxious thinking about the breakdown in the familial relationship of the Pandyas. Elsewhere, Shweta vows revenge against the Pandya family.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Shocking Request to Arnav
episodesList.summary: Dhara requests Arnav to fire Raavi from her job. On the other hand, the Pandyas get shocked to see Shweta begging in front of their house.

episodesList.title: Pandyas Feel Humilated
episodesList.summary: As Shweta begs on the streets with Chiku, the Pandyas find themselves in an unpleasant situation. Later, Arnav startles Raavi with his request.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Reunite
episodesList.summary: After beating Shiva in the ring, Raavi resolves their differences. Later, she makes Shiva undertake a bunch of commitments before leaving.

episodesList.title: Raavi Blames Dhara
episodesList.summary: Upon returning home with Shiva, Raavi accuses Dhara of being the cause of her job loss. On the other hand, Krish decides to divorce Shweta.

episodesList.title: Vile Accusations At Dhara
episodesList.summary: After having a nightmare about Chiku, a frail and frightened Dhara rushes to the ghetto to meet him. As she embraces Chiku, Shweta calls her an abductor.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets a Choice
episodesList.summary: Shweta's mother lies to Suman about her illness as the latter comes to return the custodian paper. Suman puts a choice before Dhara for bringing Chiku back home.

episodesList.title: Dhara Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Shweta gets frightened as Chiku's body temperature suddenly drops and no medical facilities are available. Further, Dhara declares her decision to forget Chiku.

episodesList.title: Dhara Loses Her Control
episodesList.summary: Dhara furiously loses control when Raavi blames her for all the mishaps in the family. Shweta comes up with a devious plan and creates a scene in front of the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Gautam In a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Gautam and Dhara face humiliation when Shweta creates a scene in front of the Pandya house. Gautam confronts Shweta and gets shocked to learn her shocking condition.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Shocking Condition
episodesList.summary: When Gautam asks Shweta to leave the city, she demands a large ransom. Later, Gautam finds it difficult to obtain such a large sum of money.

episodesList.title: Gautam Takes a Wrong Decision
episodesList.summary: Suman is shocked when Dev and Shiva officially take their names after Dhara! Later, Gautam ties up with the brand that sells duplicate goods and throws Krish out of the shop.

episodesList.title: Gautam Realises His Mistake
episodesList.summary: Gautam informs the Pandyas that he restrained himself from any wrongdoing against the Pandya store. When Suman agrees to give the money, Dhara refuses to take it.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Hopeful
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas prepare to welcome Chiku and visit the registrar's office. Meanwhile, Shweta plans to cheat them by taking their consent to give the Pandya store to her.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Welcome Chiku
episodesList.summary: To divert the attention of the Pandyas and make them sign the paper, Shweta creates chaos. Later, the Pandyas welcome Chiku to the house in a grand way.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas' Grand Party
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Chiku's homecoming, the Pandyas throw a lavish feast. Meanwhile, Krish feels relieved to have Shweta sign the divorce papers and end their relationship.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Shocking Retaliation
episodesList.summary: Shweta makes an appearance and demands Pandya Store, shocking the Pandyas. Adding to their dismay, she comes with all the legal papers.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Shattered
episodesList.summary: After disclosing the sly strategies she used to damage Pandya Store, Shweta kicks everyone out. Later, Dhara and Gautam get blamed.

episodesList.title: Dhara Makes a Blunder
episodesList.summary: Gautam promises his family of getting back the Pandya Store from Shweta. Dhara realises her mistake of not collecting Chiku's papers when Rishita asks for them.

episodesList.title: Dhara is Held Responsible
episodesList.summary: Shweta barges into the house and shows Chiku's legal documents to Dhara. Later, Rishita blames Dhara for the loss of the Pandya store and the insult they faced.

episodesList.title: Shweta to Sell Pandya Store
episodesList.summary: On the streets of Somnath, Shweta announces her intent to sell the Pandya store. The Pandyas are taken aback by the announcement and plan to get back to the shop.

episodesList.title: Dhara Refuses to Take Help
episodesList.summary: Dhara refuses to take financial help from Shweta's parents to buy the shop. She keeps the plan of trapping Shweta over the sale of Pandya house.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Disagree With Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara declares her idea about the fake sale of the house, but the Pandyas reject it. Shweta raises the price of the shop as Krish states his desire to buy it.

episodesList.title: Raavi Refuses Arnav's Offer
episodesList.summary: Raavi refuses to take Arnav's job offer after learning about his feeling for her. The Pandyas face difficulties finding job opportunities and remain depressed.

episodesList.title: Dhara Pleads The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Dhara begs the Pandyas to give her one final opportunity to reclaim the store. The Pandyas are afraid of taking risks and refuse to support Dhara.

episodesList.title: Krish Gets a Responsibility
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get into trouble as their father's death certificate is hung in the Pandya store. Dhara assigns Krish the task of stealing the photo frame.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: As Krish's quest fails, Dhara goes to the store to bring the picture. However, Shweta accuses Dhara of theft and asks the police to arrest her.

episodesList.title: Rishita Criticises Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dev and Rishita request Shweta to share Dhara and Chutki's whereabouts. Rishita condemns Dhara as the police deny releasing Chutki from the station.

episodesList.title: Shweta Gets Anxious
episodesList.summary: Krish blackmails Shweta that he will not divorce her unless she withdraws the case against Dhara. Fearful, she goes to the police station and withdraws the case.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Heavy-hearted Decision
episodesList.summary: Dhara feels hopeless when Rishita admonishes her for troubling Chutki. Later, the Pandyas worry as Chutki's medical care demands a lot of money.

episodesList.title: Dhara's New Initiative
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas applaud Dhara when she opens a food shop. Later, Dev informs Dhara about the urgent need for fifty thousand rupees for Chutki's injection.

episodesList.title: Raavi to Stop Shiva?
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas try their best to raise money for Chutki's treatment. Raavi anxiously tries to make Shiva reconsider when he informs her about his shocking decision.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Life At Stake
episodesList.summary: To save Chutki, Shiva suffers a severe head injury after being viciously beaten inside the ring. After learning his treatment cost, he flees the hospital.

episodesList.title: Shweta to Make a Purchase
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas make a secret plan and play a clever trick on Shweta. Later, she attempts to buy the Pandya mansion and offers the family money.

episodesList.title: Shweta Convinces Hari
episodesList.summary: Shweta persuades Hari to purchase the Pandya house as he rushes to the hospital to meet her. Elsewhere, Dhara gets help to reclaim the Pandya store.

episodesList.title: Will Shweta be Trapped?
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas instruct Mansukh to convince Shweta and help them to execute their scheme. Mansukh visits Shweta and tries to trap her in accordance with the plan.

episodesList.title: Rishita Finds The Documents
episodesList.summary: Shweta grows agitated when Mansukh gets exposed executing the Pandyas' plan. Elsewhere, Rishita gets overjoyed after finding the documents of the store.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Win Against Shweta
episodesList.summary: While Shweta tries to destroy the Pandya store, the Pandyas arrive and give her a befitting reply. The Pandyas grow anxious when Shiva's surgery gets delayed.

episodesList.title: Joyful Moment For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas prepare for the Uttrayan festival and want to start a new beginning. The brothers reopen the Pandya store and participate in the kite competition.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Sinister Move
episodesList.summary: Shweta disguises herself and sneaks into the Pandya house to steal Chiku. However, when Krish tries to save Chiku, Shweta kidnaps Chutki and runs away.

episodesList.title: Dhara Prepares For Uttarayan
episodesList.summary: Dhara and Chiku work together to make preparations for celebrating Uttarayan. However, Suman is still furious at them for causing the family to break apart.

episodesList.title: Mayhem In The Pandya Household!
episodesList.summary: The Pandya family feels shattered as they leave the house one by one, blaming Dhara. Things worsen when Dhara slaps Krish for the entire fiasco.

episodesList.title: A New Chapter For The Pandyas!
episodesList.summary: While some members of the Pandya family have moved out, Gautam and Dhara remember them and fly kites on Uttarayan. Will the Pandyas reunite again?

episodesList.title: Suman Suffers a Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Suman collapses, writhing in anguish after getting a heart attack. Elsewhere, Raavi lands in a tough situation.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Plan a Pilgrimage
episodesList.summary: After learning about Suman's condition, Dev, Shiva, and Krish prepare to leave for Somnath. Later, an intoxicated Gautam accuses Dhara of the split in the family.

episodesList.title: A Family Reunion
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas return to Somnath and get emotional after recalling past events. Seeing the family together, Chiku and Gautam feel overjoyed.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Absurd Request to Suman
episodesList.summary: When the Pandyas return to the hospital, Dhara gets surprised. In order to prevent the family from leaving, she asks Suman to pretend as dead.

episodesList.title: Shiva Gets Overwhelmed
episodesList.summary: Suman berates her sons for staying away from her for all these years, but Shiva fails to remember anything. Later, he gets overwhelmed when all the memories come back.

episodesList.title: Raavi's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas return home with Suman while Rishita tells Dhara that they are only there temporarily. Later, Raavi tells Dhara about what will happen after Suman's death.

episodesList.title: Dhara Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Dhara takes a firm oath to reunite the Pandya family members no matter what. Later, Dhara breaks down in tears and gives an apt reply when Rishita and Raavi accuse her.

episodesList.title: Krish Makes an Announcement
episodesList.summary: Krish announces a free blood donation camp owing to Suman's fast recovery. Suman fumes in anger when she discovers that the kids have broken her television.

episodesList.title: Suman Feels Delighted
episodesList.summary: While Chiku questions Suman about his relationship with her, the latter gets infuriated. Later, Suman feels delighted to have all the Pandyas with her.

episodesList.title: Prerna Meets The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Krish brings Prerna to the Pandya house and introduces her as his fiancee to the family. Rishita demeans Krish by bringing up his past relationship with Shweta.

episodesList.title: Suman Feels Shattered
episodesList.summary: Suman is devastated when Raavi shares Shiva's mental condition and her struggles after the accident. Elsewhere, upon Prerna's request, Krish agrees to visit the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Dhara Feels Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Gautam gets intoxicated and makes a scene for not having the family together. Meanwhile, Dhara feels dejected after all attempts to reunite the Pandyas fail.

episodesList.title: Prerna Hatches a Plan
episodesList.summary: Krish gets emotional remembering his painful memories. When Dhara and Suman team up with Prerna, the latter makes a plan with the Pandya kids to reunite the family.

episodesList.title: Can Prerna Impress The Pandyas?
episodesList.summary: Dhara encourages Prerna to unite the family and helps her in preparing Gujarati dishes. Prerna summons everyone to her room. Why?

episodesList.title: Dhara Fights a Tiger!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas tremble in fear when the tiger enters the house, and the kids remain in the courtyard. As Dhara gets the courage to overpower the tiger, others join her too.

episodesList.title: Dev Stands By Gautam
episodesList.summary: Soon after uniting, the Pandyas abruptly part ways, and their joyous moment is short-lived. However, when a customer harasses Gautam, Dev stands up for him.

episodesList.title: Prerna Melts Krish's Heart
episodesList.summary: Prerna convinces Krish to begin their new life and get married soon. While Dhara is thrilled about their wedding, Rishita and Raavi prepare to leave.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Love and Affection
episodesList.summary: Dhara showers Krish with her affection and gives him some cash for the Roka ceremony. However, Raavi and Rishita continue to despise Dhara.

episodesList.title: Dhara to Make Plan
episodesList.summary: Dhara wants to stop Rishita and Raavi from leaving the Pandya house. Prerna's parents arrive and ask Krish and Prerna to go back with them.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Vile Motive
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets concerned as Krish has not arrived at the Pandya house for his engagement ceremony. Later, Shweta devises a vile plan to re-enter the Pandya house along with Chutki.

episodesList.title: Dhara Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas feel overjoyed for Krish and Prerna's engagement. On the other hand, Dhara finds a document and learns that Krish and Shweta are not divorced yet.

episodesList.title: Shweta Confronts The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are shocked to see Shweta visit the Pandya house during Krish's engagement. Later, Dev and Rishita yell at Shweta and demand Chutki's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Shweta Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: After meeting Chutki, the kids decide to bring her to the Pandya house. Elsewhere, Shweta stirs trouble and threatens the Pandyas not to return Chutki.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Hide Shweta
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas break down as Shweta informs them about Chutki's medical condition. Upon Shweta's demand, the Pandyas hide her from the police to learn about Chutki.

episodesList.title: Rishita In Distress
episodesList.summary: The Pandya kids bring a girl home while everyone is frantic to rescue Chutki. Later, Rishita breaks down when she learns about Shweta's escape.

episodesList.title: Rishita Gets Restless
episodesList.summary: Rishita pleads with Krish to hand over the money to Shweta and save Chutki. Meanwhile, Shiva and Gautam go in search of the girl's mother.

episodesList.title: Dhara Fears The Worst
episodesList.summary: Dhara feels shattered as Rishita is determined about selling the Pandya house. Later, Shweta sneaks into the house to take Chutki back with her.

episodesList.title: Shweta Confronts The Pandya Kids
episodesList.summary: Shweta runs into the Pandya kids and manipulates them. Later, the Pandyas get shocked as the little girl goes missing from the house.

episodesList.title: Rishita Fumes In Anger
episodesList.summary: Rishita disrespects Dhara as the latter takes down the posters from the Pandya house. Later, she gets stunned when Dhara arranges the money to save Chutki.

episodesList.title: Shweta Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: Rishita, Dhara and the Pandya kids arrive at the hotel to bring Chutki home. Later, Shweta starts to panic as Chutki goes missing from the room.

episodesList.title: Can Dhara Save The Pandya Kids?
episodesList.summary: Dhara spots the Pandya kids in a passing truck and rushes to save them. Meanwhile, Shweta learns a shocking truth about her marriage.

episodesList.title: Dhara Rescues The Kids
episodesList.summary: After Chiku leaves a trace, Dhara follows the truck and rescues the Pandya kids. Shweta gets into trouble when she arrives at the Pandya house to return Chutki.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are overjoyed when Chutki returns to the Pandya house. Later, Rishita gets emotional after seeing Chutki's behaviour towards her.

episodesList.title: Shweta Plays Her Master Card
episodesList.summary: Shweta returns to the Pandya house and reveals her wish to stay with them. The Pandyas get shocked when Shweta discloses Krish and her present legal marital status.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Krish
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas are concerned about Shiva when Rishita decides to keep Shweta in their house. Later, Krish arrives and is shocked to see the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Prerna Questions The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Prerna stands firm when Rishita forces her to leave Krish to get Chutki back. Elsewhere, Shweta continues to build Rishita's excitement with an evil motive.

episodesList.title: Krish's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Krish has an emotional breakdown and requests Dhara to fix his problems. Dhara ponders about a way to send Shweta out of the house for everyone's sake.

episodesList.title: Rishita Feels Jealous
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets infuriated when Dhara scolds Chutki for her mischievous plan. Later, Rishita gets jealous to see the bond between Dhara and Chutki.

episodesList.title: Rishita to Win Chutki's Heart
episodesList.summary: Dhara asks Rishita to spend time with Chutki and win her heart. Further, Dhara and Prerna hatch a plan to keep Krish away from Shweta.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Dhara's Argument
episodesList.summary: Rishita feels upset as Chutki gets disappointed with her because of Shweta's wicked move. Meanwhile, Raavi argues with Dhara after she pays the house rent.

episodesList.title: Prerna In Pandya House
episodesList.summary: While Dhara spots Prerna, the latter manages to enter the Pandya house. When Raavi sees her coming out of a box, Prerna requests her to remain silent.

episodesList.title: Dhara Puts Her Plan In Action
episodesList.summary: Dhara intoxicates Shweta's food and persuades her to consume it. While Prerna hides in a room, Krish fetches food for her.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Get Romantic
episodesList.summary: Raavi and Shiva ignite romance as they spend quality time together. Elsewhere, Shweta waits for Krish in her decorated room.

episodesList.title: A Scary Prank On Chutki
episodesList.summary: At night, a drowsy Shweta wanders around the house and spots Prerna. Meanwhile, the kids dress up as ghosts to scare Chutki, making her feel sick.

episodesList.title: Rishita Grows Restless
episodesList.summary: As Chutki's health deteriorates, an enraged Rishita blames Dhara. Later on, Shweta arrives and gets into an argument with Rishita.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas are Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Suman asks Prerna to take Chiku away from home. The Pandyas are dismayed after learning about the complications regarding Chutki's health.

episodesList.title: Shweta Brings a Bad News
episodesList.summary: Krish assures Rishita that he will do his best for Chutki's treatment. Later, Shweta informs the Pandyas that the doctor failed to get a donor for Chutki.

episodesList.title: Dhara Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Dhara decides to tell Chutki and Chiku about their biological parents. Later, amidst the mess created by the kids, the Pandyas spend a quality moment.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Stand United!
episodesList.summary: When everyone steps forward to donate a kidney for Chutki, the Pandya family's hope starts to rise. Later, they start preparing for the Holi festival.

episodesList.title: Krish-prerna Get Worried
episodesList.summary: Prerna and Krish become concerned as Shweta confronts them. After seven long years, everyone in the Pandya family celebrates Holi again.

episodesList.title: Chutki Learns The Truth?
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas grow anxious thinking about their reports. Elsewhere, Dhara and Rishita get worried when they discover that Chutki overheard their conversation.

episodesList.title: Shweta Threatens Dhara, Rishita
episodesList.summary: While arguing with Dhara and Rishita, Shweta threatens to tell Chiku the truth. As Shweta roams the area looking for Chiku, Shiva joins the event.

episodesList.title: Chiku Learns The Truth!
episodesList.summary: While Dhara unwittingly discusses Chiku, the latter learns that he is her adopted child. How will Chiku react now that he knows Dhara is not his mother?

episodesList.title: Chiku is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Chiku has an emotional breakdown after learning about his adoption. On the other hand, Krish panics when Shiva and Shweta confront each other.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Past Resurfaces!
episodesList.summary: Shiva stumbles upon Shweta and falls unconscious as he begins to recollect his past. Elsewhere, Chutki joins the kids as they leave the house.

episodesList.title: Trouble For The Kids
episodesList.summary: The kids fall into the trap of an evil woman as they roam around the street. Meanwhile, an inebriated Shweta observes Prerna entering the house.

episodesList.title: The Kids Get Mischievous
episodesList.summary: The children enter a cemetery and scare the evil lady and the bakery owner into fleeing. A masked man dressed as a superhero appears to rescue them.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Condition Improves
episodesList.summary: Dhara and the others rejoice as Shiva's health condition improves. Elsewhere, Chiku contacts Dhara from the superhero's phone to seek help.

episodesList.title: Shweta Manipulates The Pandya Kids
episodesList.summary: When the kids find Shweta, she manipulates them with false information about their biological parents. Dhara gets worried to see the kids with Shweta.

episodesList.title: A Confusing Time For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The kids begin to doubt their real parents, which causes uncertainty among everyone. Suman later comes with Shiva and lifts their moods.

episodesList.title: Dhara Threatens Shweta
episodesList.summary: Shiva grows irrational when he fails to recognise anyone at home. Furthermore, Dhara threatens to get rid of Shweta from the lives of the kids.

episodesList.title: Shiva Creates a Ruckus
episodesList.summary: Shiva refuses to acknowledge Raavi as his wife and recalls only a portion of his past, causing an uproar in the house. Meanwhile, Sheesh goes missing.

episodesList.title: Chutki Defies Shweta
episodesList.summary: Rishita gets frightened after getting nightmares about Sheesh. When the other Pandya kids take Shweta's side, Chutki refuses to stay with her.

episodesList.title: Game Over For Shweta!
episodesList.summary: Shweta catches Prerna inside the house, but the Pandyas outsmart her before she can take any action. Later, the police take Shweta into custody.

episodesList.title: Krish's Romantic Proposal
episodesList.summary: Dhara consoles Shiva by assuring him that she will assist him in regaining his memory. Elsewhere, Krish makes a romantic proposal to Prerna on their outing.

episodesList.title: Shiva Loses His Control
episodesList.summary: Shiva gets angry and slaps Shivank when the latter addresses him as his brother-in-law. Later, the Pandyas get shocked to see Shivank in the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Shivank Blackmails Dhara
episodesList.summary: Shivank intimidates Dhara into lending him money by threatening to reveal a secret otherwise. Further, Rishita grows adamant about leaving with Chutki.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Dev Bid Goodbye
episodesList.summary: Dev and Rishita leave the house despite Dhara's best efforts to stop them. On the other hand, Shiva lashes out at Shivank over an old feud.

episodesList.title: Dhara Attempts to Stop Dev
episodesList.summary: Dhara brings out the tickets that she removed from Dev's pocket when Suman criticises her. Later, Dhara gets good news from the doctor.

episodesList.title: Gautam Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: At Dhara's request, Gautam makes a promise to never touch alcohol in his life. Later, Shivank meets with Krish and gives him Shweta's letter.

episodesList.title: Good News For Dev, Rishita
episodesList.summary: Dev and Rishita are overjoyed to learn about Chutki's donor from the doctor. Further, Krish goes to the police station to meet Shweta.

episodesList.title: Dev, Rishita Return Home
episodesList.summary: Dhara is elated when Dev and Rishita return to the house with the kids. Rishita feels low for misbehaving with Dhara and apologises to her.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Shocking Declaration
episodesList.summary: Krish gets into a problem when Shweta refuses to divorce him. Later, Dhara explains Shivank's weird demand, while Dev fails to find the money.

episodesList.title: Shivank Turns The Tables
episodesList.summary: Dhara says that she gave the money to Shivank to avoid trouble. However, Shivank pretends to be unaware of the situation and claims he did not take the money.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Trapped
episodesList.summary: Dhara faces the Pandyas' question after getting trapped by Shivank. Later, the Pandyas get shocked when Krish refuses to give money for Chutki's surgery.

episodesList.title: Rishita Grows Worried
episodesList.summary: Suman gets worried when Krish informs her about the turmoil in his life because of Raavi. Elsewhere, Rishita grows worried about the funds for Chutki's surgery.

episodesList.title: Shivank Manipulates Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets manipulated by Shivank and she misunderstands the Pandyas. Elsewhere, the Pandyas face trouble visiting the hospital due to an emergency curfew.

episodesList.title: Rishita Takes a Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: After finding no way to raise money, Rishita decides to illegally sell her kidney. The Pandyas get into trouble when Chutki creates chaos in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Gautam Worries For Dhara
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas decide to release Shweta from jail when Chutki gets stubborn. On the other hand, Gautam gets worried when Dhara's condition deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get shattered when Dhara's heart stops beating. Later, Shweta confronts the Pandyas and blackmails them into letting her inside the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Chutki Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Gautam breaks down in tears upon seeing Dhara in the hospital. Elsewhere, Chutki returns to the Pandya house and gets stubborn about staying with Shweta.

episodesList.title: Gautam Meets With an Accident!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas feel elated as they learn that Dharas recovery. But their happiness is short-lived as Gautam meets with a deadly accident.

episodesList.title: Dhara Questions The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get shattered when they learn about Gautam's accident. Meanwhile, a disappointed Dhara returns home and questions the family about their behaviour.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas decide to arrange a surprise party for Dhara. However, a heartbroken Dhara decides to break all ties with the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Gautam is Taken Aback
episodesList.summary: Gautam gets shocked as Dhara expresses her hatred towards him. Meanwhile, Shweta and Shivank get ready to execute their new plan against the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: A Special Moment For Dhara
episodesList.summary: To make Dhara feel special, the Pandyas host a party and express their gratitude. Meanwhile, a phone call promises troubles for Shivank.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Unwavering Efforts
episodesList.summary: While Dhara remains depressed, Gautam tries to uplift her mood and make amends. On the other side, Prerna strikes a shocking deal with Shweta.

episodesList.title: Chiku Learns a Shocking Truth!
episodesList.summary: Chiku discovers that Shweta is his mother, and she handed him to Dhara to exact revenge. Eventually, misunderstandings seep in between Dhara and the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Foul Motive
episodesList.summary: While Prerna searches for Krish, Shweta takes him to a hotel room to carry out her evil plan. Later, Shweta and Krish get into an intense argument.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Learn The Truth
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas uncover the truth after watching Krish's video that Prerna sends them. Shivank brings Shweta home and informs the family about her suicide attempt.

episodesList.title: Good News For The Pandyas!
episodesList.summary: Krish impatiently seeks Dhara's help, while a distraught Prerna refuses to talk to him. Later, the Pandya family is relieved when they receive some good news.

episodesList.title: Shweta Faces Backlash
episodesList.summary: Chiku and Chutki reject Shweta and choose to stay with the Pandyas. An irritated Shweta invites Dhara to join her plot against the family.

episodesList.title: Krish Loses His Mind
episodesList.summary: Krish suffers a mental breakdown before leaving for Canada. Later, he and Prerna lose their passports.

episodesList.title: Prerna to Wed Krish!
episodesList.summary: Dhara persuades Prerna not to misinterpret Krish. Prerna's parents arrive at the Pandya house and inform them of Prerna's choice to marry Krish.

episodesList.title: Suman Calls Off The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Prerna's parents bring non-vegetarian dishes and champagne from Canada to the wedding. Offended, Suman cancels the marriage.

episodesList.title: Dhara Finds Shweta
episodesList.summary: Dhara is astonished to find Shweta under the veil and is sceptical about her move. The Pandyas and Shweta's parents get into a tiff over selecting dishes.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Wicked Plan
episodesList.summary: While Shweta places duplicate notes in Prerna's purse, Shivank calls the police to the wedding venue. To keep an eye on Shweta, Dhara takes a disguise.

episodesList.title: Dhara, a Secret Saviour
episodesList.summary: While everyone enjoys the big day, Dhara notices that Ganpath is planting bombs across the venue. She remains veiled and reports the matter to the cops.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Appearance is Unveiled
episodesList.summary: Dhara disrupts Shweta and Shivank's plan by stealing the passports from the bag. Meanwhile, Dhara's face is exposed and everyone identifies her.

episodesList.title: Shivank's Wedding Proposal
episodesList.summary: Shivank requests Suman to arrange his wedding with his girlfriend on the same day and location as Krish. Dhara smells fishy and soon comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Dhara Abducts Krish, Prerna
episodesList.summary: Dhara disguises herself as a goon and takes Prerna and Krish from the wedding venue. Shivank gets suspicious of Krish's presence and informs Shweta about it.

episodesList.title: Dhara Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas arrange a surprise for Krish by bringing Falguni Pathak to his wedding. Elsewhere, Dhara gets anxious when her plan backfires and it causes chaos.

episodesList.title: Falguni Pathak Graces The Event
episodesList.summary: Falguni Pathak graces Krish and Prerna's wedding with her performances. On the other hand, Dhara decides to take Rishita and Raavi's help to fix the problems.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Plan Goes Awry!
episodesList.summary: At the wedding Mandap, Rimjhim sits down next to Krish instead of Prerna. Meanwhile, Dhara runs after Kajal and Anurag but gets caught by their parents.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Into a Predicament
episodesList.summary: Dhara gets abducted and a couple accuses her of abducting their son. Meanwhile, the couple takes part in the wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: As Dhara removes Krish's bride's veil, the Pandyas are shocked to discover Shweta. Later, Suman blames Dhara for ruining Krish's life with her foolish plan.

episodesList.title: Shweta's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Suman blames Dhara for the bitter consequences, as Shweta once again outwits them. Meanwhile, Shweta announces that she is expecting Krish's baby.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Make a Promise
episodesList.summary: When Suman allows Shweta to enter the house, Krish firmly objects. After Dhara realises her mistake, the Pandyas promise to fight against Shweta together.

episodesList.title: Raavi Offers a Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Raavi requests that Dhara use a different approach when dealing with Shweta. Meanwhile, Suman urges Prerna and Shivank to give their marriage another shot.

episodesList.title: Krish's Distrust In Shweta
episodesList.summary: Krish calls a doctor to do a pregnancy test for Shweta and ties her up to prevent her from messing with the result. Prerna blames Dhara for ruining her life.

episodesList.title: Gautam, Dhara Reconcile
episodesList.summary: Gautam clarifies Dhara's misunderstandings and they sort out their differences. The following day, everyone awaits Shweta's medical test results.

episodesList.title: Shweta Gets Overjoyed
episodesList.summary: Shweta feels happy and provokes the Pandyas after her pregnancy is confirmed. Meanwhile, Gautam and Shiva visit the clinic to cross-check the result.

episodesList.title: Prerna is Inconsolable
episodesList.summary: Krish kneels before Prerna and pleads with her not to leave. Despite his efforts, a heartbroken Prerna departs from the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Shiva Creates a Mess
episodesList.summary: Shiva bumps into Arushi while carrying cow dung, and they both end up doused in the muck. Raavi gets shocked as Shiva receives Arushi's marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Prerna Changes Her Decision
episodesList.summary: Prerna agrees to stay in the Pandya house and seeks Dhara's help to reunite with Krish. Shiva and Raavi get into a tiff about his decision to marry.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva's Squabble
episodesList.summary: When the notion of marriage drives Shiva insane, Raavi aggressively opposes him, resulting in a brawl. In the meantime, Dhara encounters Arushi.

episodesList.title: Shivank Instigates Raavi
episodesList.summary: After the marriage bureau matches him with Arushi, Shiva heads off to meet her mother. Elsewhere, Shivank provokes Raavi against Dhara.

episodesList.title: Prerna In a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Prerna finds herself in an odd situation when Shivan walks in on her conversing with Krish. Meanwhile, Gautam decides to celebrate Dhara's birthday.

episodesList.title: A Birthday Surprise For Dhara
episodesList.summary: At the temple, Dhara stumbles into her mother but pays no heed to her. Later, the Pandyas surprise Dhara with a cheerful birthday arrangement.

episodesList.title: Realisation Hits Arushi Hard
episodesList.summary: While Shiva introduces Arushi to the Pandyas, she discovers Dhara's connection to her mother. Furthermore, Raavi tries to remind Shiva of his past.

episodesList.title: Dhara Hatches a Plan
episodesList.summary: Dhara devises a strategy to expose the real truth about Shweta's pregnancy. Elsewhere, Raavi meets Arushi to tell the truth about her marriage with Shiva.

episodesList.title: Arushi, Raavi Reach a Settlement
episodesList.summary: After striking an understanding with Arushi, Raavi begins her quest to revive Shiva's memory. Meanwhile, Dhara, Krish, and Prerna set out on a mission.

episodesList.title: Dhara and Team In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dhara, Krish and Prerna land in jeopardy as the vigilance officials arrive at the hospital. While they get arrested, Suman makes a crucial decision.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Krish Visit The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Krish tries to warn Prerna, but she misunderstands him. Later, Dhara and Krish take on the guise and enter the hospital lab to collect Shweta's blood sample.

episodesList.title: Shiva Loses His Sanity
episodesList.summary: Shiva gets angry when Arushi informs him about Dhara's refusal to the marriage. Later, he threatens the Pandyas of killing himself.

episodesList.title: Prerna Discloses The Truth
episodesList.summary: While Raavi tries to cause trouble for Shiva at Arushi's house, Prerna tells Krish about her pregnancy. Meanwhile, Dhara tries to get Shweta's blood sample.

episodesList.title: Shiva In an Awkward Situation
episodesList.summary: Rishita tricks the children to stay with Shiva to derail his wedding plans. Meanwhile, Shivank keeps an eye on Krish as he checks the blood samples.

episodesList.title: Dhara Bumps Into Her Mother
episodesList.summary: Dhara and her mother collide on the road and begin remembering their terrible pasts. Meanwhile, Shivank does something heinous to Prerna.

episodesList.title: Shivank Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Shocked by Shivank's horrific conduct towards Prerna, everyone beats him up. But what happens when Suman and Raavi support him?

episodesList.title: Shweta Shocks Dhara
episodesList.summary: Krish grows impatient to get his medical reports. Dhara is shocked when Shweta stands against Shivank for his terrible behaviour towards Prerna.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Rush to Catch Shivank
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas rush to capture Shivank as he tries to escape with Shweta. Further, Dhara saves Shweta from a life-threatening accident.

episodesList.title: Shivank Gets The Punishment
episodesList.summary: Shivank threatens the Pandyas after he faces public humiliation. Elsewhere, Prerna falls down while trying to comfort the kids.

episodesList.title: Pandya Kids to Save Prerna?
episodesList.summary: When Prerna's condition worsens, the Pandya kids rush her to the hospital. Elsewhere, a heated argument ensues when Dhara confronts Arushi.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Arushi tries to manipulate Shiva after she gets a strict warning from Dhara. Later, Dhara cries while she thinks about keeping her past hidden from the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Arushi Reveals Dhara's Truth!
episodesList.summary: When Raavi issues a warning to Arushi, the latter discloses her relationship with Dhara. She continues to poison Raavi's mind against Dhara.

episodesList.title: Rishita Devises a Plan
episodesList.summary: Dhara breaks down in tears after getting humiliated by Raavi. Later, Rishita comes up with a plan to recreate an incident to trigger Shiva's memory.

episodesList.title: Raavi, Shiva Get Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Dev and Rishita grow anxious as Raavi and Shiva get abducted by the real kidnappers. Elsewhere, the Pandyas get shocked when Shweta agrees to divorce Krish.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dev and Rishita follow the kidnappers to save Raavi and Shiva. Later, Dhara gets shocked as Arushi unveils the truth about their relationship in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Dhara In a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Raavi makes Shiva recall the past, but he gets furious. Meanwhile, Dhara's intention gets questioned when she saves Arushi and Malti from the neighbour's rage.

episodesList.title: Dhara Makes a Shocking Promise
episodesList.summary: Suman stands for Dhara when Arushi tries to manipulate her. On the other hand, Dhara agrees to Shivas shocking condition to stop him from taking drastic steps.

episodesList.title: Dhara Comes Up With a Plan
episodesList.summary: When Raavi accuses Dhara of ruining her life, the latter breaks down in tears. Later, the Pandyas get shocked when Dhara explains her absurd plan.

episodesList.title: Shwetas Change Of Heart?
episodesList.summary: Shweta feels overwhelmed looking at Chiku and attempts to win his affection as a mother. Later, she hands over the divorce papers to Krish.

episodesList.title: Shiva Sympathises With Raavi
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas continue their planned activities, making Shiva feel empathetic towards Raavi. On the other side, Shweta makes a startling request to Dhara.

episodesList.title: Shweta Comes Clean
episodesList.summary: After making an honest demand to Dhara, Shweta comes clean about her lie concerning Krish. Later, the Pandyas engage in some amusing banter.

episodesList.title: A Bitter Awakening For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Upon realising Chiku's state of mind, Dhara faces the sour reality of her life. Later, she resolves to set things right for Chiku and Shweta.

episodesList.title: Emotional Moment For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get emotional when a puppeteer narrates a story during the Haldi. Later, Raavi gives Shiva his previous wedding attire to restore the latter's memory.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas' Hilarious Event
episodesList.summary: The three Pandya brothers take part in the second marriage which turns out to be a hilarious mess. Meanwhile, Raavi makes a suicide threat.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Strategy Pays Off!
episodesList.summary: Dhara recreates another moment from the past and convinces Shiva to marry Raavi. However, when Raavi gets ready for the marriage, Shiva makes an escape.

episodesList.title: Shiva Regains His Memory
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas anxiously rush to prevent Shiva and Arushi's wedding. On the other hand, Shiva gets his memory back while performing the wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: A Touching Moment For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Raavi's life is restored to happiness as Shiva empathises with her and they embrace each other. Eventually, ecstasy warms the Pandya family's hearts.

episodesList.title: Dhara Apologises to Malti
episodesList.summary: Dhara goes to Malti and apologises for misunderstanding her upon realising her mistake. When Dhara remains upset at Chiku's behaviour, Suman gives her advice.

episodesList.title: Shiva, Raavi's Quality Time
episodesList.summary: After seven years, Shiva and Raavi enjoy some quality time together. Meanwhile, Arushi decides to apologise to Dhara for her misdeeds.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Get Worried
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas anxiously rush to find Chiku and Chutki when they visit the restricted area. Meanwhile, Arushi is all set to execute her vile plan against Dhara.

episodesList.title: Chutki-chiku In Grave Danger
episodesList.summary: As Chiku and Chutki fall into a manhole, Dhara gets injured while trying to save the kids. Later, Shiva gets shocked when Malti informs him about Arushi's plan.

episodesList.title: Malti Falls Prey
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas put their lives in danger to save Chiku and Chutki from the manhole. On the other hand, Malti is subjected to Arushi's jealous rage.

episodesList.title: A Major Shock For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Malti succumbs to the toxins and passes away in Dhara's arms, giving her the biggest shock of her life. While Arushi feels guilty, Dhara is crushed.

episodesList.title: Dhara Performs The Last Rites
episodesList.summary: Heartbroken and with tears in her eyes, Dhara carries out Malti's last rites. Meanwhile, Chutki regains consciousness and Chiku looks after her.

episodesList.title: Dhara Feels Dejected
episodesList.summary: Suman tries to console an emotional Dhara. Later, Dhara feels dejected when Chiku misunderstands the former's intention and refuses to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Dhara Tries to Convince Chiku
episodesList.summary: Dhara tries to convince Chiku by telling him the story of Lord Krishna and his mothers. Rishita and Prerna stop Dhara from interfering in their matters.

episodesList.title: Chiku, Sheesh Fight For Mithu
episodesList.summary: When Mithu's classmates tease him, Chiku and Sheesh furiously fight for him. Later, Dhara gets shattered to see Chiku's shocking behaviour towards her.

episodesList.title: Rishita's Shocking Insistence
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get shocked when Rishita makes a shocking insistence. Later, when Raavi objects to Rishita's demand, an argument happens between Shiva and her.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Mischievous Plan
episodesList.summary: Dhara devises a mischievous plan to make the Pandya kids happy. Later, the Pandyas get shocked when a heated argument ensues between Rishita and Raavi.

episodesList.title: Suman's Emotional Burst Out
episodesList.summary: Suman has an emotional burst out when a conflict ensues between the Pandyas. Later, Dhara and Chiku come up with a plan to keep the whole family together.

episodesList.title: Dhara Hides The Kids
episodesList.summary: Dhara knits a plan with Chiku and hides the kids inside her room by leaving a letter for the family. The Pandyas are shocked after reading the letter.

episodesList.title: Dhara's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Dhara breaks down in tears and requests everyone to change their decision about the apportionment. Later, Gautam bursts out in rage and takes a shocking step.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: An emotional Gautam takes a firm decision to sell the Pandya house. Elsewhere, Chiku determines to leave the house along with Shweta.

episodesList.title: Chiku's Unexpected Decision
episodesList.summary: Shweta decides to leave the Pandya residence and settle at a new location. However, things take a turn when Chiku decides to go with her.

episodesList.title: Dhara Gets Rigid
episodesList.summary: When Chiku wants to leave the house with Shweta, Dhara stays firm in her decision not to stop him. The kids wish to give a farewell party to Chiku.

episodesList.title: Suman is Upset
episodesList.summary: Dhara breaks down after handing over Chiku's responsibility to Shweta. Suman feels dejected as she witnesses the separation in the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas to Sign The Deed
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas come together for the farewell party and get emotional seeing the decorations. When Nargesh arrives, Dhara asks the Pandyas to sign on paper.

episodesList.title: Rishita Comes Up With a Plan
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas get nostalgic during their farewell party. Later, Rishita seeks Sheesh's help to execute her plan to stop Chiku.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: While spending time with his brothers, Gautam takes a stroll down memory lane and cries about the separation. The Pandyas go through a roller coaster of emotions.

episodesList.title: Suman Bids Goodbye
episodesList.summary: The Pandya brothers and their wives gather around Suman as she bids farewell with a parting gift. Later, Gautam makes a request to his brothers.

episodesList.title: Dhara, Gautam Console Suman
episodesList.summary: While Suman decides to shift to an old age home, Dhara and Gautam comfort her. Later, Chutki blames herself and decides to fix everything between the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Rishita, Dev Get Worried
episodesList.summary: Chutki devises a plan to convince Chiku to meet her. On the other hand, Rishita and Dev grow anxious when Sheesh and Chiku go missing from their house.

episodesList.title: Chiku-natasha Get Lost
episodesList.summary: Chiku comes to meet Natasha near the highway and they get scared when a stranger starts chasing them. Later, the Pandyas look for Chiku and Natasha but can't find them.

episodesList.title: Good News For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Dhara's happiness knows no bounds when she learns of her brother Hardik's wedding. On the other side, Arushi releases Shivank from prison.

episodesList.title: Pandyas Regret Their Decision
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas brothers feel sorry over their separation and their unfairness to Dhara and Gautam. On the other hand, Shweta finds Chiku unmanageable.

episodesList.title: Shivank, Arushi's Plan In Motion
episodesList.summary: While the Pandyas arrive at Hardik's location, Shivank and Arushi put their plan into action. Meanwhile, Dhara shares the news of Malti's demise with Hardik.

episodesList.title: Suman Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: On Hardik's request, Dhara asks the Pandyas to stay together until the party ends. An intoxicated Suman reveals the truth of the separation in the Pandya family.

episodesList.title: Gautam Alerts His Brothers
episodesList.summary: The wedding party is a blast, with the Pandyas dancing and enjoying themselves. Meanwhile, Jayshankar informs Gautam of Shivank's release from jail.

episodesList.title: Dhara Offers a Solution
episodesList.summary: After learning about Arushi and Shivank's presence, Dhara drives away the guests. She gets emotional when the Pandyas decide to stay by her side.

episodesList.title: Pandyas Get Emotional
episodesList.summary: Kajal's father dedicates a symbolic act to the Pandyas to emphasise their unity and bond, leaving everyone in tears. Meanwhile, Shivank's plan causes turmoil.

episodesList.title: The Pandyas Find a New Home!
episodesList.summary: After a disagreement, the Pandyas decide to get a new house and move in together. On the other side, Chiku shares a heartwarming moment with Shweta.

episodesList.title: Chiku, Shweta In a Quandary
episodesList.summary: Shweta and Chiku reach the wrong destination while Dhara anxiously waits for them at the bank. Later, the Pandyas feel happy as their home loan gets approved.

episodesList.title: Tragedy Strikes The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandya family gets trapped inside the bank when a massive earthquake hits the city. They embrace each other while trying to accept their fate.

episodesList.title: Natasha Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: The Pandya kids are grown up. While Natasha takes charge of the Pandya Store, Amresh plans to demolish the Bazaar in the name of development. What lies ahead?

episodesList.title: Suman Refuses to Sell
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets excited about selling the Pandya Store, but Suman spoils her plans and says that it's not for sale ever. Elsewhere, Amresh seeks Dhawal's help.

episodesList.title: Amresh Assigns a Task to Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Amresh reveals that he wants Natasha's signature and asks Dhawal to bring her to the engagement. Meanwhile, Natasha changes her mind about selling Pandya Store.

episodesList.title: Suman Questions Natasha
episodesList.summary: Suman likes Dhawal when she sees him with Natasha and asks her if she is romantically involved with him. Later, Amresh tells Dhawal about the importance of Natasha.

episodesList.title: Mithu In Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Natasha realises that she dropped her bracelet somewhere at the party and decides to go back in. Later, Mithu gets caught while trying to get the bracelet.

episodesList.title: Suman Confronts Amba
episodesList.summary: An enraged Suman confronts Amba when she addresses Mithu as a thief. Later, Amresh gets shocked to see the chaos created by the Makwanas and Pandyas in the fest.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Shocking Demand
episodesList.summary: Natasha tells Amresh to pay the bill for the fest as he had declared that he sponsored it. Later, Amresh's mother insults Natasha and Suman.

episodesList.title: Suman Proves Natasha's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Suman shows the pictures of the Pandyas inside the bracelet and proves that it belongs to Natasha. Later, Dhawal finds evidence against Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Gets Caught?
episodesList.summary: Dhawal sneaks into the house to show the video to Natasha. When the Pandyas assume Dhawal to be a thief, Natasha lies to the family to save him.

episodesList.title: Amresh Threatens Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amresh shows the video to Natasha and threatens to expose Mithu. Later, Natasha shares her intentions with Suman.

episodesList.title: Natasha Falls Sick
episodesList.summary: Natasha refuses to sell the Pandya store. Amresh assigns Dhawal to get it from her at any cost. The Pandyas get worried when Natasha suddenly becomes unwell.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Makes a Grave Mistake
episodesList.summary: Dhawal unknowingly lets Dolly know that her father's deal with Amresh is in jeopardy. Dolly informs her father about it, and they call off the wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Locked In
episodesList.summary: Suman locks Natasha in her room and tries to find an ideal match for her. Elsewhere, Dhawal plans to provoke Natasha against him.

episodesList.title: Natasha Outwits Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Dhawal pretends to be terribly injured by Natasha, but he has to drop his act when Suman decides to fake a heart attack. Later, Natasha spoils Dhawal's plan.

episodesList.title: Suman Refuses to Sell
episodesList.summary: When the Makhwanas apologise to Natasha for their act, Suman refuses to sell the Pandya store. Later, Natasha and Dhawal get locked inside the library.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal Remain Locked
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal yell for help and tries to get out from the library as they are locked inside. Pranali tells Amresh about Dhawal's act in the Pandya store.

episodesList.title: Suman Visit The Makhwana House
episodesList.summary: Natasha shares her future aspirations with Dhawal. Suman assumes the Makhwanas behind Natasha's disappearance and visits their house with the police.

episodesList.title: Dhawal, Natasha Return Home
episodesList.summary: Dhawal breaks the door and brings out Natasha from the library after she falls ill. Suman bursts out her anger as Dhawal brings an unconscious Natasha home.

episodesList.title: Amresh Decides Dhawal's Future
episodesList.summary: Suman brings the police to Dhawal's house but Natasha reveals that he saved her. Later, Amresh declares that Dhawal will get married to Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Romantic Gesture
episodesList.summary: Dhawal remembers the sacrifices Amresh made for his sake and decides to obey his wish. He surprises Natasha with a romantic gesture and proposes to her.

episodesList.title: Suman's Conditions For Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Suman asks Dhawal if he loves Natasha, and she presents two shocking conditions in front of him. Later, Dhawal makes a fake promise to Suman.

episodesList.title: Suman is In Danger
episodesList.summary: Dhawal seeks Nitu's help to execute his plan to impress Natasha. On the other hand, Suman gets scared to see the serial killer in front of her.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Search For Suman
episodesList.summary: Natasha discovers some clues about the clown and follows the trail. Meanwhile, the psycho-killer tortures Suman with his wicked demands.

episodesList.title: Suman Gets Rescued
episodesList.summary: Natasha tries to find clues about Suman's presence in the isolated place. The Makhanas and Natasha break the door and rescue Suman from the killer's grasp.

episodesList.title: Natasha has a Realisation
episodesList.summary: Natasha decides not to sell the Pandya shop after remembering Rishita and Dhara's advice. Dhawal's mother gets infuriated seeing his condition.

episodesList.title: Natasha Sneaks Into Dhawal's House
episodesList.summary: Natasha decides to speak to Dhawal about their feelings and sneaks into his house at night. Later, Amba spots Natasha's footprints and searches for her.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Proposes to Natasha
episodesList.summary: When Natasha enters Dhawal's house to thank him, he proposes marriage to her. Meanwhile, Sheesh finds the Pandya store's papers and hands them to Amba.

episodesList.title: Suman to Fix Natasha's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Suman and the Makhwanas gather to fix Natasha and Dhawal's wedding. Amba informs Amresh that Natasha is not the owner of the Pandya store.

episodesList.title: Amresh Denies Suman's Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Natasha tells Dhawal that she wants her family to receive the income from Pandya Store. Later, Amresh decides not to host Sangeet at the wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha Proposes to Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets down on one knee to confesses her profound love to Dhawal. As the engagement approaches, Amba devises a plan to sabotage it.

episodesList.title: Amba Carries Out Her Plan
episodesList.summary: As the Sangeet bash begins, Natasha insists on having a dance performance. She eventually falls prey to Amba's scheme and gets inebriated.

episodesList.title: Amba's Plan Backfires!
episodesList.summary: The cops show up when Amresh is being insulted for making Natasha drink. Meanwhile, Mithu takes an unexpected action to sabotage Amba's plan.

episodesList.title: Mithu Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: After Natasha and Dhawal decide to part ways, Mithu admits to having hidden the bottles in the car. Meanwhile, Amresh sets out to punish Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Into a Problem
episodesList.summary: In her quest to find the truth, Natasha runs into danger. While Dhawal rescues her from the goons, Amresh makes a shocking announcement.

episodesList.title: Amresh Apologises to Suman
episodesList.summary: Amresh comes to the Pandya house and asks Suman to give the Makwanas one more chance. Elsewhere, he convinces Dhawal to make amends with Natasha.

episodesList.title: Chiku Comes Home
episodesList.summary: As Natasha gets confused about her wedding attire, Suman presents her with a new one. Meanwhile, Chiku arrives at the Pandya house, leaving everyone surprised.

episodesList.title: Natasha Denies Amba's Request
episodesList.summary: Pranali tries to tell Natasha the truth about the Makwanas but gets interrupted. Later, Natasha refuses Amba's request to wear the Lehenga given by them.

episodesList.title: Dhawal to Call Off The Wedding?
episodesList.summary: Amresh firmly objects when Dhawal requests him to call off the wedding. Suman and Natasha grow suspicious after hearing Chiku's comment on Dhara.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: Chiku tries to steal the jewellery but sees that Natasha is already wearing them. So he decides to abduct her, but Chirag spots him leaving with Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Learns About Chiku's Imposter
episodesList.summary: Natasha learns the truth about the person impersonating Chiku and forges an escape plan. Elsewhere, the wedding begins without Natasha. Will she reach in time?

episodesList.title: Dhawal Rescues Natasha
episodesList.summary: With Natasha and Chirag missing from the Mandap, Dhawal is compelled to reveal the truth. Later, he rescues Natasha from the clutches of Chiku’s imposter.

episodesList.title: Chiku Plans to Return
episodesList.summary: Chiku learns that he has to supervise the demolition of Sadar Bazar and the Pandya Store. While he plans to return to Somnath, Natasha and Dhawal get married.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Vidaai Ceremony
episodesList.summary: During Natasha's Vidaai ceremony, her family becomes emotional as they bid her farewell. Elsewhere, Chiku has finally returned to Somnath after many years away.

episodesList.title: Amba's Plot Against Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amba tries to spoil Natasha's Griha Pravesh using various ill tricks. Amresh fumes in anger to learn about Pranali's attempts to reveal his plan to Natasha.

episodesList.title: Chiku Meets Suman
episodesList.summary: Chiku enters the Pandya store and gets emotional after confronting Suman. Natasha gets shocked to see Amba's gift during her post-wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: Natasha Asks For a Promise
episodesList.summary: Amresh confronts Pranali and lashes out at her for trying to ruin his plan. Elsewhere, Dhawal gets shocked when Natasha asks for a promise on their first night.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas are shocked by Natasha's unexpected first-day move. Later, Amresh and Amba get furious over Natasha's startling request to Pranali and Hetal.

episodesList.title: Hetal Apologises to Amresh
episodesList.summary: Amresh gets angry at Hetal because she sat at the dining table with him, while the latter tries to apologise to him. Later, Amresh plans to keep Natasha busy.

episodesList.title: Suman Takes a Firm Stand
episodesList.summary: When Chiku arrives to demolish the Pandya store, Suman stands against her. Meanwhile, Natasha get shocked to learn about Amresh's order to demolish her store.

episodesList.title: Amba Proves Her Point
episodesList.summary: Amba executes her plan and proves that Natasha's idea is bad for the family. Later, Natasha apologises to Amba after she failed to prepare lunch.

episodesList.title: Natasha Faces Disappointment
episodesList.summary: Natasha promises to consult Amresh or Amba before making any decisions. Later, Natasha gets upset when Amba stops her from celebrating Raksha Bandhan.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: Natasha executes her plan with Hetal and they flee from the house to tie Rakhi to their brothers. Amba becomes suspicious of Natasha's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Questions Natasha
episodesList.summary: Natasha helps Hetal celebrate Rakhi with her brother, but unfortunately, they get spotted by Dhawal. Later, Dhawal confronts Natasha for breaking her promise.

episodesList.title: Natasha Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Natasha is relieved to learn that Dhawal hasn't told Amresh anything, and she apologises to Dhawal. Later, Dhawal and Natasha have an awkward encounter.

episodesList.title: Chiku Protects Mitthu
episodesList.summary: Chiku steps in to protect Mitthu from a bike rider's harrasment. Elsewhere, Bhaven and Pranali's fight gets out of hand and the latter suffers an injury.

episodesList.title: Amresh Issues a Warning
episodesList.summary: Natasha visits home for the post-wedding ritual, oblivious of Pranali's health condition. Later, an enraged Amresh confronts Bhaven and Pranali and warns them.

episodesList.title: Suman Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Suman gets worried about Dhawal and Natasha's tiff. Further, she takes matters into her hand after the Makwanas celebrate Janmashtami without Natasha.

episodesList.title: Suman Questions Amba
episodesList.summary: Suman questions Amba about her decision to keep Natasha away from their celebration. Later, Amba grows anxious when Natasha joins them despite her best efforts.

episodesList.title: Suman Smells Something Fishy
episodesList.summary: Suman observes a disparity in the way Amba treats Natasha at a ceremony. Later, Suman gets wary and tries to foster romance between Natasha and Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Natasha Hears Bhaven's Confession
episodesList.summary: Natasha is shocked to see the Makwanas at the competition, but she is relieved when Amresh commends her. Later, Natasha overhears Bhaven's confession.

episodesList.title: Amresh Teams Up With Chiku
episodesList.summary: Chiku gets furious hearing Suman talk about him and decides to burn down the Pandya Store. However, Amresh stops him and tells him about his plans.

episodesList.title: Suman Gives a Befitting Reply
episodesList.summary: While Amba blames Natasha, Suman gives her a befitting reply. Later, Suman devises a plan to strengthen the budding relationship between Natasha and Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Natasha Confronts Chiku
episodesList.summary: After seeing him speak to Amresh, Natasha warns Chiku to stay away from Pandya Store. Later, Amba gets furious when she learns about Dolly's honeymoon plan.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: After Chiku gives false information about Natasha's abduction, the police arrest Dhawal. Natasha tries to convince the police, but they refuse to believe.

episodesList.title: Hetal Faces Amresh’s Wrath
episodesList.summary: Chiku sneaks into Suman's room to execute his vile plan. Meanwhile, Amresh explodes in anger when Hetal hides the news about Natasha and Dhawal's arrest.

episodesList.title: Dhawal’s Gesture Impresses Natasha
episodesList.summary: Dhawal's timely arrival helps save Suman from a mishap and leaves Natasha impressed. Meanwhile, Amba grows anxious about Dhawal and Natasha's budding romance.

episodesList.title: Will Amba's Plan Work?
episodesList.summary: To bring Dhawal home, Amba pretends to get injured. After learning about Amba's condition, Dhawal and Natasha hurry back home.

episodesList.title: Is Natasha Pregnant?
episodesList.summary: As Natasha feels nauseous, Hetal assumes her pregnancy and shares it with the Makwanas. Amresh grows happy and asks Dhawal to make Natasha sign the papers.

episodesList.title: Dhawal is Not Ready For Commitments?
episodesList.summary: Natasha wishes to progress in her relationship with Dhawal, but he deals with a dilemma. Meanwhile, Amresh grows confident about taking over the Pandya Store.

episodesList.title: Amresh Rushes Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Dhawal comes to meet Natasha at a site and saves her from a terrible accident. Later, Amresh tells Dhawal that he needs to get Natasha's signatures as soon as possible.

episodesList.title: Makwana's Unfortunate Capture
episodesList.summary: The labourers put a shocking condition in front of the Makwanas and held them in the factory. Elsewhere, Natasha tries to find out a way to rescue the Makwanas.

episodesList.title: Natasha Knits a Plan
episodesList.summary: Natasha wants to rescue the Makwana brothers in Pandya style and prepares tea for the labourers. Amresh gets enraged seeing the Makwana ladies in the office.

episodesList.title: Natasha Emerges As a Hero
episodesList.summary: Natasha stands out as the saviour, using a substantial payment to resolve the entire dispute. Later, she witnesses something profoundly startling.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Faces Natasha's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Dhawal gets dumbfounded when Natasha bursts out in rage after learning the truth. Chiku fears exposure as Kanta unknowingly mentions his name in front of Suman.

episodesList.title: Natasha Takes a Bold Step
episodesList.summary: Amresh fumes with rage as Dolly hosts a women's empowerment party at home. Later, Natasha plans to leave and confronts him about the Pandya Store takeover.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Admits The Truth
episodesList.summary: Upon being questioned by Natasha, Dhawal admits his true intentions regarding their marriage. Later, Natasha firmly resolves not to let go of Pandya Store.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Firm Stand
episodesList.summary: Natasha remains determined to leave the Makwana home. Upon returning, she finds it challenging to disclose the truth to Suman.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas feel shattered as Suman suffers a heart attack over Natasha's revelation about Dhawal's scheme. Dhawal faces trouble while searching for Natasha.

episodesList.title: Chiku's Bold Move
episodesList.summary: Natasha feels restless upon seeing Suman's condition. Chiku attempts to comfort her. Later, Chiku visits the Makwana house and reveals his true identity.

episodesList.title: Natasha is Concerned About Suman
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets worried as Suman's health deteriorates. When Dhawal approaches Natasha, she gets infuriated on seeing him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Seeks Amresh's Help
episodesList.summary: Amresh and Amba get astonished as Dhawal seeks the former's aid for Suman's treatment. Later, Dhawal confronts Natasha with the truth, but she refuses to believe him.

episodesList.title: Good News For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The news of Suman's recovery makes the Pandyas happy. Later, Suman gets suspicious of Natasha and Dhawal's unity and decides to uncover their hidden conflict.

episodesList.title: Suman Questions Natasha!
episodesList.summary: Amresh confronts Chiku and tries to tempt him with money to achieve his goal. Natasha is taken aback when Suman demands the truth about her and Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Amresh Advises Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Chiku makes a shocking decision regarding the Pandya store. Elsewhere, Amresh plans and advises Dhawal to end his relationship with Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Seeks Hetal's Help
episodesList.summary: Upon Natasha's request, Hetal comes to meet her at the college. Natasha tells Hetal to help her so that she can return to Makwana House.

episodesList.title: Suman Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Chiku gives Natasha the official papers of the Pandya Store, making her the owner. Suman gets emotional after learning the truth about Chiku's return.

episodesList.title: Natasha Requests The Makwanas
episodesList.summary: Amba stops Natasha from entering the house. Natasha shows her the Pandya Store paper and requests the Makwanas to give her a chance.

episodesList.title: Chiku In Makwana House
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas are shocked at Amresh's decision to allow Natasha into the house. Chiku visits the Makwana house and questions Natasha about her decision to return.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas are Ready For Pooja
episodesList.summary: Natasha asks Chiku to leave the house as she intends to reside with her in-laws. The Makwanas prepare for the Bhoomi pooja, while Dhawal waits for Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Stands For Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amresh is humiliated when the priests furiously call off the pooja and asks him to atone. Later, Dhawal stands for Natasha to protect her from Amresh's rage.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Punished
episodesList.summary: While Natasha tries to take a stand for Dolly, Amresh gives her a punishment. Later, Natasha takes care of Dhawal when he hurts himself trying to protect her.

episodesList.title: Natasha is In Danger
episodesList.summary: Suman questions Chiku about the reason behind the indifference in his behaviour. Elsewhere, the Makwanas become worried when Natasha gets into danger.

episodesList.title: Natasha Questions Hetal
episodesList.summary: Chiku encounters a girl who has connections with the Makwana family. Elsewhere, Natasha questions Hetal when the latter refuses to visit her mother's house.

episodesList.title: Natasha Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Natasha vows to reconcile Hetal with her brother. Later, on the Dandiya night, Natasha gets shocked to overhear Heatal and her brother's conversation.

episodesList.title: Amba Insults Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman takes a stand on Natasha's behalf when Amba insults her for suggesting that Natasha should dance at the festival. Later, Natasha and Hetal look for Golu.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Request to Hetal
episodesList.summary: Hetal gets worried about Amresh's reaction when the latter asks her to bring Golu to the ceremony. Later, Natasha makes a shocking request to Hetal.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Amresh
episodesList.summary: Natasha asks Dolly and Pranali to keep Amresh and Amba distracted so that she can try to find Golu. Later, Amresh and Amba are shocked to see Hetal dancing.

episodesList.title: Natasha Rescues Golu
episodesList.summary: Amresh learns about Golu's kidnapping and blames Hetal for keeping it a secret from him. Later, Dhawal helps Natasha rescue Golu from a dangerous situation.

episodesList.title: Dhawal, Natasha Play Garba
episodesList.summary: Amresh wants Hetan out of the room for her irresponsible behaviour. Dhawal surprises Natasha with beautiful decorations and asks her to perform Garba.

episodesList.title: Amresh's Firm Determination
episodesList.summary: Amresh heeds Amba's counsel, determined to gain control over Natasha. On the other hand, Dhawal plans a surprise date for Natasha to express his apology.

episodesList.title: Natasha Faces Serious Allegations
episodesList.summary: Dhawal learns that the police have apprehended a suspect for Golu's kidnapping. Later, the kidnapper accuses Natasha of being the mastermind.

episodesList.title: Amresh Frames Natasha
episodesList.summary: Natasha pleads for trust, but Amresh's cunning scheme proves her guilty in front of all. Moreover, she is shocked as Dhawal lashes out at her.

episodesList.title: Natasha Rushes to Find Evidence
episodesList.summary: Amresh grows anxious about the real kidnapper's intention. After facing the Makwanas' wrath, Natasha preps to find evidence to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Natasha Resolves Herself
episodesList.summary: Upon Dhawal's criticism, Natasha is determined to prove her innocence by collecting evidence. Later, the kidnapper seeks sympathy from Chiku.
