episodesList.title: Natasha Learns The Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Natasha confronts Amresh after learning about his vile conspiracy to frame her. Later, Dhawal lashes out at Natasha when she tries to tell him Amresh's truth.

episodesList.title: Isha's Return Shocks Suman
episodesList.summary: Amresh pretends to be nice and manipulates Dhawal into discussing the Pandya Store with Natasha. Elsewhere, Suman is stunned as Chiku brings Isha home.

episodesList.title: Natasha Faces Amresh's Questions
episodesList.summary: Hetal discovers her mother's critical condition and the financial needs for her treatment. Meanwhile, Amresh confronts Natasha about her job search.

episodesList.title: Amresh's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Amresh allows Natasha to work in the office to be in the good books of Dhawal. Hetal asks for monetary help from Amresh for her mother's treatment.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets a Clue
episodesList.summary: Isha weaves a tale as Chiku inquires about her escape from the police. Natasha checks the CCTV footage and finds a crucial clue to prove her innocence.

episodesList.title: Natasha Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Natasha is shocked after finding the kidnapper's bag. Natasha grows suspicious of Amresh and Amba's unsettling response to the kidnapper's belongings.

episodesList.title: Amba is Haunted By Her Past
episodesList.summary: Amba notices the kidnapper's belongings and realises that it is someone she knows. Later, using one of the items, she asks Amresh to find the kidnapper.

episodesList.title: Amba Encounters Isha
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal face an awkward situation when they are stuck in the shop's trial room. Elsewhere, Amba is shocked to see Isha in the shop.

episodesList.title: Natasha Confronts Isha
episodesList.summary: Isha grows anxious as Natasha confronts her to learn her motive for Golu's kidnapping. Elsewhere, Dhawal requests Amba to bring Isha to their house.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets emotional on learning the reason behind Isha's decision to leave the Makwanas. She decides to bring Isha back to the house.

episodesList.title: Natasha Seeks Help
episodesList.summary: Chiku confronts Isha when she tries to escape from the Pandya house. Natasha seeks Hetal, Pranali, and Dolly's help to bring Isha to the Makwana house.

episodesList.title: Natasha to Bring Isha Back
episodesList.summary: Natasha plans to get Isha home and seeks the help of the female folk in the house. Elsewhere, Suman asks Isha to accompany her to the Makhwana house to distribute Diwali gifts.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Mischievous Plan
episodesList.summary: Hetal, Dolly, and Pranali are ready to execute Natasha's plan to unite Isha and the Makwanas. Elsewhere, the Makwanas get trapped by some masked mobsters.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas Show Courage
episodesList.summary: The Makwana brothers fight with the bandits and lock them up in a room. Later, Natasha brings Isha to the Makwana house, but she gets blamed.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For The Makwanas
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas are stunned when Isha unexpectedly appears in front of them. Later, Dhawal apologises to Natasha as Amresh exposes Isha as Golu's kidnapper.

episodesList.title: Amresh Gives His Consent
episodesList.summary: Isha firmly stands her ground when Amresh lashes out at her for disobeying his rules. Later, the Makwanas rejoice as Amresh allows Isha to reside in their home.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas' Happy Moment
episodesList.summary: The Makwana family joyfully unites for the festival of lights, leaving behind all their past grievances. Later, Amresh's furious act leaves Isha in tears.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Stays Beside Natasha
episodesList.summary: Isha gets confused by Natasha's behaviour when she asks Chiku to stay away from her. Dhawal supports Natasha in taking the interview as Amba opposes her.

episodesList.title: Natasha Apologises to Amresh
episodesList.summary: Amresh rejects Natasha's apology and blames her for turning Dhawal against him. Later, Amresh gets worried about Isha's reaction when he learns that Natasha got a job.

episodesList.title: Amba Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: Amresh pretends to be innocent instructing his partner to take Suman's signature. Amba causes turmoil by toppling the cupboard to distress Natasha.

episodesList.title: Suman's Request to Chiku
episodesList.summary: Dhawal reveals his plans to go on a dinner date with Natasha, while Amresh makes a clever plan. Later, Suman requests Chiku to suppress his feelings for Isha.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal's Delightful Date
episodesList.summary: Amresh's deceitful move might jeopardise Dhawal and Natasha's marriage. Later, Natasha and Dhawal share a delightful moment together on their date night.

episodesList.title: Dhawal, Natasha's Romantic Date
episodesList.summary: A romantic poolside escapade turns chaotic as Dhawal rescues Natasha. Meanwhile, Chiku's property discussion leads to an unexpected kidnapping mix-up.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal Get Abducted
episodesList.summary: The goons abduct Natasha and Dhawal upon Amresh's order. Later, Suman is shocked to see the legal papers when the Pandya Store is about to get demolished.

episodesList.title: Natasha Faces The Pandyas' Wrath
episodesList.summary: Chiku informs Natasha about the Pandya Store's demolition and criticises her. Later, the Pandyas burst out at Natasha when she arrives at the spot.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Faces Natasha's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Natasha explodes in anger at Dhawal which sparks an intense argument between them. Later, Dhawal grows anxious for Natasha when she falls sick abruptly.

episodesList.title: Dhawal is Outraged
episodesList.summary: Natasha wishes to get separated from Dhawal for his acts. Later, while the Makwanas prepare to welcome Mansukh, an infuriated Dhawal confronts him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Argues With Amresh
episodesList.summary: Amresh admits his involvement in the demolition of the Pandya Store. Consequently, Dhawal confronts him for his malicious intent against the Pandyas.

episodesList.title: Tough Time For The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: Natasha refuses to take Dhawal's help and breaks into tears upon seeing her family. Meanwhile, the Pandyas pack their possessions, overwhelmed with sadness.

episodesList.title: Amresh Leaves The House!
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas embark on a fresh start with their new stall. On the other hand, the Makwanas feel devastated after receiving Amresh's letter.

episodesList.title: An Emotional Moment For Makwanas
episodesList.summary: Amresh hands over the business to Dhawal and gets emotional while leaving the house. Amba criticises Dhawal for going against Amresh because of Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Finds Amresh's Car
episodesList.summary: Dhawal finds blood spots in Amresh's car but doesn't find anyone inside. Later, he manages to locate Amresh, but the latter refuses to return home.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Promise to Amresh
episodesList.summary: Natasha has a nervous breakdown when Amba accuses her of breaking the Makwana family. On the other hand, Dhawal makes a shocking promise to Amresh.

episodesList.title: Dhawal to Divorce Natasha?
episodesList.summary: Natasha is shocked as Dhawal serves divorce papers to her. While Hetal and Isha try to stop Dhawal, Amresh and Amba ask them not to interfere.

episodesList.title: Suman Makes a will
episodesList.summary: Bhaven discovers Amresh's role in Dhawal and Natasha's divorce, while Dhawal forces Natasha out of the house. Elsewhere, Suman decides to make a will for the house.

episodesList.title: Suman's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Suman gets concerned when Natasha chooses to seek shelter in her college hostel. Later, Suman comforts Natasha and decides to fight against the Makwanas.

episodesList.title: Dhawal is Inebriated
episodesList.summary: Natasha decides to end the relationship, leaving Dhawal devastated. Meanwhile, Amresh schemes to widen the gap between Dhawal and Natasha.

episodesList.title: A Bold Step By The Pandyas
episodesList.summary: The Pandyas, along with women from NGOs and police officers, conduct a raid at the Makwana house. Amresh lands in a predicament as Amba is taken into custody.

episodesList.title: Suman, Amba's Open Challenge
episodesList.summary: Suman and Amba vow to find the most eligible partners for Natasha and Dhawal. Meanwhile, Dhawal and Natasha cry over the uncertainty of their relationship.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal's Emotional Strain
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal experience intense emotions as they navigate the divorce process. Furthermore, they get stunned by the lawyer's revelation.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Strong Refusal
episodesList.summary: Natasha expresses her unwillingness to remarry. Meanwhile, the Makwanas arrange the marriage of Arvind's children with Isha and Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Sandip Meets Suman
episodesList.summary: Dhawal refuses to get married to Suhani as her father brings a proposal. Sandip arrives at the Pandya house to reconstruct the store and meets Suman.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Gives His Consent
episodesList.summary: Dhawal agrees to marry Suhani but is preoccupied with thoughts of Natasha. On the college excursion, Dhawal feels envious of seeing Natasha with Sandip.

episodesList.title: Chiku Longs For Dhara
episodesList.summary: Chiku steals Dhara's bracelets, driven by his yearning for her. Meanwhile, Natasha and Dhawal find themselves stranded together during the camping.

episodesList.title: Chiku Proposes to Isha
episodesList.summary: Chiku expresses his love for Isha and makes a marriage proposal. Natasha and Dhawal's forest adventure takes a scary turn, putting them in grave danger.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal In Grave Danger
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal fight to escape a life-threatening crisis. Elsewhere, Amresh and Amba burst out in rage as Isha informs them about Chiku's marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Isha Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Natasha tries to escape from the villagers' grip after discovering the wicked plan. Isha feels dejected as Amresh refuses to accept Chiku and her relationship.

episodesList.title: Natasha Rushes to Save Dhawal
episodesList.summary: When Dhawal gets shot, Natasha rushes to the hospital to save him. Later, Pandyas and Makwanas get relaxed after discovering Natasha and Dhawal in the forest.

episodesList.title: Natasha Finds a Clue
episodesList.summary: Natasha discovers a lead about the forest attack when Rohan meets Dhawal. Later, Amresh reassures Dhawal that he won't meddle in his relationship with Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Visits The Makwanas
episodesList.summary: Natasha's visit stuns the Makwanas, sparking unexpected tension. Rohan panics when Natasha questions him about his involvement with the forest hunter.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Attacks Sandip
episodesList.summary: Isha returns Dhara's bangles to Natasha, claiming Chiku gave them to her during his proposal. Dhawal lashes out at Sandip for his ill intentions towards Natasha.

episodesList.title: Chiku Blackmails Isha
episodesList.summary: Isha rushes to stop Chiku as he blackmails her with a suicide threat. The Makwanas are devastated when Isha mysteriously vanishes from their house.

episodesList.title: Chiku, Isha Get Married
episodesList.summary: Isha agrees to marry Chiku to save his life, while the latter marries her by putting his blood on her forehead. Later, the Makwanas refuse to accept the marriage.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Gives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Natasha stops Dhawal from taking Isha back to the Makwana house. Dhawal declares that he will annul his marriage. Elsewhere, Amba pretends to be sad about Isha.

episodesList.title: Amba's Desperate Step
episodesList.summary: Amba takes an excessive amount of sleeping pills in order to prevent the Makwanas from severing ties with Isha. Later, Natasha grows distressed over her future.

episodesList.title: Natasha-dhawal's Marriage Over?
episodesList.summary: When Amba consents to Chiku and Isha's marriage, Chiku's shocking demand infuriates Amresh. Later, Natasha and Dhawal agree to annul their marriage at court.

episodesList.title: Natasha Confronts Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Dhawal tries to ignore Natasha during his Haldi, but the latter confronts him and asks him to look into her eyes. Later, Natasha confesses her feelings.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Warns Chiku
episodesList.summary: Dhawal gives Chiku a warning when the latter starts dancing around Amresh and tries to provoke him. Elsewhere, Natasha hatches a plan with the Makwana wives.

episodesList.title: Chiku Demands an Apology
episodesList.summary: Chiku finds sand in the sweets offered to him by the Makwanas and demands an apology from them. Later, Dhawal and Natasha apply haldi to each other.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Accused
episodesList.summary: Amba accuses Natasha of scheming against Suhani to ruin the latter's Haldi ceremony. Later, Dhawal's rage intensifies on witnessing a man embracing Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Desparte Move
episodesList.summary: Chiku is shocked when Natasha questions the reason behind his decision to marry Isha. Later, Natasha desperately plots to ruin Suhani's Mehendi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Natasha Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Natasha disguises herself as a Mehendi artist and damages Suhani's Mehendi in the dark. However, Suhani notices Natasha while she tries to flee.

episodesList.title: Amresh Gets Enraged At Chiku
episodesList.summary: Putting his vile plan into action, Sandip drugs Natasha’s drink to fulfil his evil intentions. Amresh fumes in anger as Chiku dances with Isha.

episodesList.title: Chiku Provokes Bhaven
episodesList.summary: Sandip lays a trap for Natasha. On the other hand, Chiku successfully instigates Bhaven as the latter creates a scene amidst the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Sandip’s Plan Goes In Vain
episodesList.summary: Sandip seethes in frustration as his plot against Natasha fails. Meanwhile, Amresh blames Amba for all the ongoing mishaps.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Warns Natasha
episodesList.summary: Dhawal asks Natasha to stay away from Sandip and reveals the truth to her. Further, he makes a shocking decision which pleases Amba but upsets Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Charges On Sandip
episodesList.summary: Sandip comes to harass Natasha, but she revolts back. While Dhawal feels disheartened, Natasha wants him to call off the wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha to Stop Dhawal-suhani's Wedding?
episodesList.summary: Pranali stuns Natasha with news of Dhawal's sacrifices to reclaim the Pandya Store for her. Natasha makes a firm decision to stop Dhawal and Suhani's wedding.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Shocking Confession
episodesList.summary: Dhawal comes to meet Suhani before their wedding and tells her that he can't go through with the wedding. Elsewhere, Sandeep drugs Natasha and tries to abduct her.

episodesList.title: Will Chiku Find Natasha?
episodesList.summary: Chiku adamantly refuses the wedding rituals, insisting on finding Natasha first. Elsewhere, Dolly, Pranali, and Hetal kidnap Suhani to stop the wedding.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Sees Natasha, Sandip Together
episodesList.summary: Dhawal's world crumbles as he witnesses Natasha and Sandip's distressing encounter. Later, Pranali plans to ensure Dhawal and Natasha's wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha Faces Amba's Questions
episodesList.summary: Dhawal and Natasha's wedding is almost over when Natasha loses consciousness, and everyone sees her face. Later, Amba questions Natasha about Suhani.

episodesList.title: Natasha Catches Sandeep
episodesList.summary: Natasha beats up Sandeep and reveals to everyone how he drugged her and tried to take advantage of her. Later, Dhawal apologises to Natasha, but she pushes him away.

episodesList.title: Natasha Cuts Ties With Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Natasha tells Dhawal he means nothing to her and cuts ties with him. While Chiku and Isha get married at the Pandya house, Dhawal refuses to marry Suhani.

episodesList.title: Amresh Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Dhawal is determined to prove his love for Natasha. Elsewhere, Amresh gets shocked when Chirag and Bhaven blame him for ruining Dhawal and Natasha's life.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Humble Apology
episodesList.summary: Dhawal secretly enters the Pandya house to seek forgiveness from Natasha. Later, he proposes to Natasha and earnestly urges her to accept him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Life In Peril
episodesList.summary: Natasha rejects Dhawal's apology, and he gets injured while trying to pursue her. Later, the Makwanas rush an unconscious Dhawal to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Natasha Receives a Legal Notice
episodesList.summary: Natasha is stunned when the court demands triple repayment for a contract breach with Sandip. Elsewhere, the Makwanas fret as Dhawal escapes from the hospital.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas Find Dhawal
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas are shocked to find an unconscious Dhawal on the road. Amresh decides to bring Natasha to him. Elsewhere, the Pandyas go on a mission.

episodesList.title: Amresh has an Offer For Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amresh tells Natasha that she can repay his money later and asks her to take care of Dhawal in return. Natasha rushes to the hospital to be with Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Amresh's Shocking Demand
episodesList.summary: Natasha is astounded when Amresh insists she stay in the Makwana house until she repays his money. Elsewhere, Sandip pledges to ruin Natasha's life.

episodesList.title: Isha Helps to Save Pandya House
episodesList.summary: Isha offers her jewellery to Chiku and asks him to save the Pandya house. Later, Natasha makes a request to Amresh for the sake of Dhawal's happiness.

episodesList.title: Dhawal’s Miraculous Recovery
episodesList.summary: Seeing the Makwanas and Natasha enjoying, Dhawal stands on his feet and starts dancing. Further, Sandeep lures Natasha into the kitchen and ignites a fire.

episodesList.title: Pranali is Labelled As a Fake Doctor!
episodesList.summary: While Natasha forges a rescue plan, Amresh’s error leaves Chiku trapped in the burning room. Further, Bhaven bars Pranali from treating Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Chiku Charges On Amresh
episodesList.summary: Natasha supports Pranali, urging her to save Dhawal's life overlooking past allegations. Later, Chiku accuses Amresh of attempting to kill him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Finds Natasha-amresh’s Contract
episodesList.summary: Dhawal gets his hands on the contract signed by Natasha and Amresh. However, Natasha tries to distract him and issues a warning to Amresh.

episodesList.title: Suman Confronts Chiku
episodesList.summary: Suman rejects Isha's request to participate in a dance contest and confronts Chiku for using Isha against the Makwanas. Later, Dhawal sees Amresh burning the contract.

episodesList.title: A Plan For Natasha, Dhawal’s Reunion
episodesList.summary: Hetal, Pranali, and Dolly's plan to reunite Natasha and Dhawal goes in vain. Elsewhere, Suman worries about Chiku's revenge plot against the Makwanas.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal to Help Pranali
episodesList.summary: Natasha learns how Pranali is stuck with Bhaven because of her family's financial situation and informs Dhawal about it. Together, they plan to help Pranali.

episodesList.title: Suman's Plan For Natasha's Remarriage
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal's fundraiser is a success as they collect enough money for Pranali's sister. Suman's plan to get Natasha married again leaves Dhawal upset.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Amresh faces a dilemma as he realises his mistake of letting Natasha out of Dhawal's life. Further, Dhawal learns about Amresh's plan for Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Plans to Outwit Amresh
episodesList.summary: Dhawal learns how Amresh is trying to set up Natasha with Shashank. He plans to teach a lesson to Amresh and makes a demand to him.

episodesList.title: What is Dhawal Planning?
episodesList.summary: Dhawal tells Natasha that he has planned a surprise for her, while the latter questions him about it. Later, he restricts Amresh from cancelling the picnic.

episodesList.title: The Makwana Wives Get In Trouble
episodesList.summary: The Makwana wives, preparing for a party, mistakenly find themselves in a bar, facing unexpected trouble. Meanwhile, Shashank escapes captivity and alerts Amresh.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Confronts Amresh
episodesList.summary: Dhawal publicly reveals Amresh's interference in Natasha's future, confronting him. Later, he decisively severs ties with Amresh.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Dhawal storms out of the party, and the police arrest him because of a misunderstanding. Later, Natasha rushes after Dhawal but fails to find him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Rejects Amresh's Help
episodesList.summary: On his arrival at the police station, Amresh offers to bail Dhawal, but he declines. Later, Natasha intervenes, appealing to Dhawal on behalf of Amresh.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Leaves The House
episodesList.summary: Natasha convinces Dhawal to return home, but he only comes back to leave the house for good. Later, Natasha tells Dhawal that he is making a mistake.

episodesList.title: Natasha Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: Amba blames Natasha for persuading Dhawal to leave the house, while Natasha assures to bring him back. Meanwhile, Dhawal struggles to find both shelter and food.

episodesList.title: Natasha to Convince Amresh
episodesList.summary: Natasha lies to Dhawal and asks him to attend Pranali's clinic opening. Meanwhile, as Natasha endeavours to secure Amresh's approval, Amba voices her dissent.

episodesList.title: Pranali's Joyful Moment
episodesList.summary: Pranali gets emotional and expresses deep gratitude to Natasha. On the other hand, Amba and Bhaven devise a vile plan to shut down Pranali's dispensary.

episodesList.title: Natasha Instructs Amresh
episodesList.summary: As Dhawal arrives for Pranali's clinic opening ceremony, Amresh intervenes. Natasha gives instructions to Amresh that escalate the argument with Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Plan Succeeds
episodesList.summary: Suman punishes Chiku and Isha for trying to trick her. Natasha successfully reunites Dhawal with Amresh and convinces him to return to the Makwana house.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas Get Into Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amba, elated after speaking with Bhaven, tries to shut down Pranali's clinic. The Makwanas face trouble as the media accuse Amresh of having fake medicines.

episodesList.title: Amresh Faces Accusation
episodesList.summary: Natasha misinterprets Dhawal's actions and confronts him for contacting the police. Amresh demands evidence when the police attempt to arrest him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Confronts Amresh
episodesList.summary: Dhawal seeks Pranali's aid to help Natasha gain consciousness. Upon learning the reason for Natasha's sickness, Dhawal confronts Amresh.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas In Crisis
episodesList.summary: When Natasha meets Dhawal outside the house, she urges him to reconcile with Amresh. The Makwanas face a crisis as food inspectors close down their companies.

episodesList.title: Amresh's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts when Natasha suggests the Makwana ladies participate in a modelling contest. Additionally, Amresh approves the idea due to public pressure.

episodesList.title: The Makwana Ladies' Gala Time
episodesList.summary: Amresh stops Bhaven when he proceeds to resolve the issue with Shalini. While the Makwana women register for the contest, Dhawal doubts Amresh's move.

episodesList.title: Isha Feels Dejected
episodesList.summary: Isha feels disheartened as Natasha reveals their plan to participate in a beauty pageant. Later, Natasha is stunned when Suman asks about her return to the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Helps Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amresh panics as the Makwana boys forget to pick up Golu from school. Dhawal helps Natasha tackle the contest's swimsuit challenge.

episodesList.title: The Ladies Face a Problem
episodesList.summary: When the Makwana ladies prepare for the first round, the authority opposes their swimsuit getup. Amresh plans to sabotage the ladies' participation.

episodesList.title: The Makwana Ladies In Trouble
episodesList.summary: The Makwana ladies face trouble as Juhi locks them in the green room. Dhawal struggles to prevent the Makwana family from hindering the ladies' contest entry.

episodesList.title: Grand Entry Of The Makwana Ladies
episodesList.summary: The Makwana ladies stun the crowd with their grand entrance. Later, Amresh and Amba's rage erupts as the Makwana ladies confidently grace the stage.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Amba, Amresh
episodesList.summary: Amresh and Amba are astounded to see the Makwana ladies and Natasha participating in a fashion show. Later, Dhawal takes a stand against Amresh.

episodesList.title: Bhaven Makes Amresh Furious
episodesList.summary: Natasha is thrilled when her team is chosen to design costumes for the beauty contest. Later, Amresh's anger flares when Bhaven makes an unexpected demand.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Surprise Date
episodesList.summary: As Ishaani decides to seek revenge, Amresh urges her to move on in life. Dhawal plans a surprise Valentine's date for Natasha to spend quality time with her.

episodesList.title: Natasha Feels Dubious
episodesList.summary: Natasha confronts Chiku after learning about his conspiracy with Bhaven against Amresh. Despite the Makwana ladies' calm response, Natasha feels suspicious of Chiku

episodesList.title: A Difficult Situation For Amresh
episodesList.summary: Amresh faces trouble when everyone he owes money to comes to his house, demanding payment. Later, the Makwanas are shocked to see Shalini at the event.

episodesList.title: Natasha Grows Concerned
episodesList.summary: Dhawal frets over Natasha's participation after the couple round announcement. Meanwhile, Natasha worries about Chiku's next scheme upon spotting him with Bhaven.

episodesList.title: Natasha Wins Everyone's Hearts
episodesList.summary: Natasha captivates everyone's hearts with her open-mindedness and strong personality. Later, Chiku becomes anxious after finding the documents with Natasha.

episodesList.title: Chiku Waits For The Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Chiku discovers a crucial document lying on Natasha's dress and attempts to retrieve it. Isha and Natasha clinch the top two positions as models.

episodesList.title: Chiku's Shocking Announcement
episodesList.summary: Natasha wins the contest by finding the tiara, but Isha pleads with her for a chance to claim victory. Chiku's unexpected announcement leaves everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Natasha has an emotional breakdown as Amba pins their crisis on her. Meanwhile, Suman condemns Chiku for his actions and demands he return all to Amresh.

episodesList.title: Natasha Challenges Chiku
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas are shocked when the Pandyas visit their house. Furthermore, Natasha goes against Chiku and vows not to let him evict the Makwanas from the house.

episodesList.title: Chiku Evicts The Makwanas
episodesList.summary: Amresh promises to get his house back from Chiku before the latter evicts the Makwanas from their house. Later, Dhawal offers to shelter the Makwanas.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Emotional Gesture
episodesList.summary: Chiku emotionally breaks down as Suman refuses to stay in the Makwana house with him. Elsewhere, Amresh is deeply touched by Dhawal's heartfelt gesture.

episodesList.title: Amba Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Shesh arrives at the Makwana house to support Chiku and claims Amresh's room for himself. Later, Amba refuses to eat the food brought by Natasha.

episodesList.title: Amresh Faces Obstacles In Business
episodesList.summary: Natasha takes charge, aiming to resolve the Makwanas' plight. Meanwhile, Amresh struggles to attract customers in his new venture.

episodesList.title: Bhaven Takes a Drastic Step!
episodesList.summary: Bhaven feels guilty for causing the suffering of the Makwanas and decides to commit suicide. Elsewhere, Dhawal and Natasha dress up as ghosts to scare Chiku.

episodesList.title: Amresh Apologises to Bhaven
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas grew concerned upon discovering Bhaven unconscious in the bathroom. Later, Amresh apologises for his harshness and urges him against such actions.

episodesList.title: Natasha Teams Up With Sesh
episodesList.summary: Natasha allows Sesh to return home but asks him to find the papers for the Makwana house in exchange. Further, she trains him to accomplish the task.

episodesList.title: Chiku Questions Natasha
episodesList.summary: Natasha tells Chiku that she has moved on from Dhawal, but the latter refuses to believe. Later, Chiku asks Natasha about her eagerness to help the Makwanas.

episodesList.title: Natasha-dhawal's Enchanting Dance
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal grace the Shivratri festival with their mesmerising performance. Later, Natasha feels humiliated as Amba disgraces her in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Rebukes Amba
episodesList.summary: Dhawal's fury erupts when Amba humiliates Natasha and questions her character. Later, Natasha gets emotional as she realises Dhawal's profound love for her.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Natasha confesses her feelings to Dhawal and the two share a romantic moment. Later, Natasha informs Dhawal about her plan to marry Shashank.

episodesList.title: Shashank Convinces Chiku
episodesList.summary: Shashank tells Chiku that he wants to marry Natasha because they are in love. Later, Chiku and Shashank bring the proposal to Suman, but she reacts furiously.

episodesList.title: Dhawal, Natasha Make a Plan
episodesList.summary: Natasha stages an argument with Dhawal about their marriage in front of Chiku. Later, Chiku announces his decision to the Makwanas about Natasha's wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Request to Amresh
episodesList.summary: Natasha urges Amresh to bring the Makwanas to the Pandya house for Golu's well-being. Despite his reluctance, Amresh agrees, considering Golu's welfare.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Disguised Appearance
episodesList.summary: Chiku's decision to return Amresh's property documents shocks everyone. Meanwhile, Natasha's anxiety spikes when Dhawal comes to the Pandya house in disguise.

episodesList.title: Amresh Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Dhawal fret as Isha's suspicion towards him intensifies. Elsewhere, Amresh devises a plan against Chiku, vowing to reclaim all his property.

episodesList.title: Chiku Becomes Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Chiku spots the makeup artist he hired for Natasha and suspects she may be concealing something. Later, Chiku reconsiders his agreement with Amresh.

episodesList.title: Chiku Puts Forth a Condition
episodesList.summary: Chiku agrees to transfer the property papers to the Makwanas post Natasha's wedding. Afterwards, Natasha instructs Suman to manage the situation.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Search For The Papers
episodesList.summary: Chiku catches Natasha in his room after she fails to find the property papers. Later, she requests Shashank to feign fainting to stop the wedding.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets a Hint
episodesList.summary: Natasha pretends to be worried about Shashank in front of Chiku. She schemes to disrupt her wedding but overhears Chiku and Isha discussing property papers.

episodesList.title: Isha to Return The Papers?
episodesList.summary: When Amba requests Isha to give the papers, she agrees. Natasha returns to the wedding venue, while Dhawal gets stuck inside the Pandya store.

episodesList.title: Natasha Refuses to Marry Shashank
episodesList.summary: Natasha shocks everyone by firmly declining to wed Shashank. Later, Chiku's discovery of the missing property documents leads to the Makwanas' arrest.

episodesList.title: Chiku's Change Of Heart
episodesList.summary: Natasha persuades Chiku to release the Makwanas from jail, but a fight erupts due to Amresh's provocation. Later, Natasha decides to marry Dhawal at the police station.

episodesList.title: Natasha's Proposal Thrills Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Dhawal is elated as Natasha arrives on a horse and proposes to him. When Amba furiously objects, Dhawal confronts Amresh and Amba.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Suman persuades the Makwanas for Natasha and Dhawal's wedding. Shalini's unexpected appearance stirs tension as Amresh asserts his family loyalty.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas Return Home
episodesList.summary: Suman warmly welcomes the Makwanas as they return home, filling them with joy. The post-wedding game for Natasha and Dhawal commences with Amba's rituals.

episodesList.title: Dhawal, Natasha's First Night
episodesList.summary: The Makwana brothers vow to make all future decisions jointly. Dhawal and Natasha's romantic nuptial night is interrupted by a condition she imposes.

episodesList.title: Natasha Puts Forth Her Conditions
episodesList.summary: Dhawal tries to stop Natasha from confronting the Makwanas. Later, the Makwanas are stunned by Natasha's unexpected and shocking conditions.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas Sign The Paper
episodesList.summary: Out of fear of losing Dhawal, the Makwanas sign the document, agreeing to Natasha's terms. Later, Natasha recalls Amba's threats upon spotting her in the garden.

episodesList.title: Amba Threatens Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amba warns Natasha of tearing her family apart if she refuses to comply. Later, Natasha tries to buy raw materials from Amresh by issuing threats.

episodesList.title: Isha Executes Amba's Plan
episodesList.summary: Amba sets a shocking condition as Natasha rushes to aid the Makwanas' in-laws. Elsewhere, Isha executes Amba's plan to sow discord between Chiku and Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Receives Criticism
episodesList.summary: Amid criticism from Chiku and Shesh, Suman insists Natasha stay out of family matters, causing her to leave. Hetal receives a parcel from Shalini for Amresh.

episodesList.title: Natasha Remains Perplexed
episodesList.summary: Amba insists Natasha celebrate Holi at her home and plans to create chaos. After getting the invitation, Natasha gets puzzled and gets into an argument with Amresh.

episodesList.title: Natasha Confesses to Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman accuses Natasha of uniting the Pandyas and the Makwanas, but Natasha discloses Amba's blackmail. Meanwhile, Chiku and Amresh clash in an argument.

episodesList.title: Chiku Feels Betrayed By Isha
episodesList.summary: Isha blames Amba for provoking Chiku to the extent that he attacked Amresh. Later, Chiku learns about Isha's betrayal when he overhears her conversation with Amba.

episodesList.title: Chiku Confronts Natasha
episodesList.summary: Chiku tells Natasha that he fought for her against the Makwanas and she betrayed him by helping them. Later, Chiku declares that he will go away for good.

episodesList.title: Natasha Vows to Prove Chiku Wrong
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Suman plead desperately to stop Chiku from leaving their side. Later, Natasha firmly vows to prove Chiku wrong, determined to set things right.

episodesList.title: Natasha Finds an Unconscious Suman
episodesList.summary: Amba falls ill when Isha decides to leave everyone for Chiku. On the other hand, Natasha feels devastated upon finding Suman unconscious, fearing the worst.

episodesList.title: Tragic News For Natasha
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs Natasha that there’s no possible treatment to help cure Suman. While Shesh plans to bring Suman back home, Natasha opposes his decision.

episodesList.title: Amba Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Natasha comes to the Makwana house and blames them for having a party while Suman is fighting with death. Later, Amba confesses to blackmailing Natasha.

episodesList.title: Is Suman Dead
episodesList.summary: Natasha returns home and is shocked to see her brothers mourning Suman’s death. However, Suman regains consciousness but doesn't recognise Natasha.

episodesList.title: Dhawal to Stay At The Pandya House?
episodesList.summary: Dhawal blames Amba for blackmailing Natasha and leaves the house. Further, he tells Natasha that he will stay with her at the Pandya house to take care of Suman.

episodesList.title: Amba Seeks Shalini's Help
episodesList.summary: Amba meets Shalini and asks her to help save Dhawal from Natasha. Shalini realises that Amba might be her stepping stone to get closer to Amresh and agrees to help.

episodesList.title: Shalini Forges a Plan
episodesList.summary: Amresh is furious to see Dhawal doing household chores at the Pandya house. Meanwhile, Shalini plans to use Dhawal in her imminent move.

episodesList.title: Natasha Blames Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets furious at Dhawal for not being there for Suman during the need. Later, Amresh meets Natasha and blames her for taking advantage of Dhawal.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Dhawal's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Natasha suggests that Dhawal help Amresh at work, but he ignores her advice. Later, she gets romantic with Dhawal in the rain.

episodesList.title: Dolly Faces an Attack
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas go to the temple, leaving Dolly alone in the house. Natasha comes to Dolly's rescue when she gets attacked by burglars.

episodesList.title: Shalini Enters The Makwana House
episodesList.summary: Dhawal and Shalini come to the Makwana house and save Natasha and Dolly from the goons. Later, Shalini secretly injures herself so she does not have to leave.

episodesList.title: Amresh's Order to Natasha
episodesList.summary: Amresh returns home and orders Natasha to reduce the salary she is giving to the lady labourers. Later, the Makwanas find out that Shalini is living in their house.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Romantic Gesture
episodesList.summary: Shalini convinces Amba that she will be helpful if she stays in the house. Later, Dhawal decorates his room to give a romantic surprise to Natasha.

episodesList.title: Natasha Questions Amresh
episodesList.summary: Shalini schemes against Amresh by capturing their intimate moments. Natasha confronts Amresh when she sees him coming out of Shalini's room.

episodesList.title: Amresh Requests to Eject Shalini
episodesList.summary: Amresh requests Dhawal to expel Shalini from the Makwana house. Elsewhere, after discovering Amresh's plan, Shalini enlists Golu in her strategic countermove.

episodesList.title: Shalini Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: While the Makwanas embark on a jungle safari together, Shalini bribes their guide to sabotage their trip. Subsequently, Dhawal saves Natasha from an accident.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gives Good News to Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Natasha informs Dhawal about her pregnancy. Later when Pranali gets criticised for infertility, Natasha discloses the truth.

episodesList.title: The Makwanas In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amba and Bhaven refuse to believe Natasha's claims about his infertility. Amidst the chaos, the Makwanas get stranded in the forest.

episodesList.title: Amresh Risks His Life
episodesList.summary: Natasha learns about Amresh and Shalini's past, and she promises to keep it a secret. Later, Amresh risks his life to save Shalini and Mitthu.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Hatred For Natasha
episodesList.summary: The Makwanas attend Amresh's cremation ceremony, and Dhawal participates in the Pooja. He harbours contempt towards Natasha and blames her for Amresh's death.

episodesList.title: Natasha Meets Naveli
episodesList.summary: Hetal resolves to seek revenge against Dhawal and Natasha. Meanwhile, Natasha has an unexpected encounter with Naveli in Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Shantanu's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Golu threatens to call Dhawal when Naveli refuses to leave her room. Later, Natasha has a panic attack during her engagement ceremony upon hearing a baby cry.

episodesList.title: Naveli Comforts Natasha
episodesList.summary: Naveli is frightened when Golu furiously locks her in a resort bathroom. While Natasha has a nervous breakdown, Naveli helps soothe her anxiety.

episodesList.title: Natasha Takes Care Of Naveli
episodesList.summary: Naveli runs out of her room at night in panic and gets injured. Natasha tends to her and takes her to the hospital with Shantanu's help.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Recalls The Past
episodesList.summary: Dhawal reminisces about the days of Natasha's pregnancy and Naveli's birth. Hetal vents in anger as Golu blames Naveli for the troublesome situation.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Searches For Naveli
episodesList.summary: Natasha convinces Shantanu to let her participate in the art competition with Naveli. Later, Dhawal comes looking for Naveli when she is with Natasha.

episodesList.title: A Blast From The Past For Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Dhawal remembers Amresh's tragic death when he spots Natasha at the art competition. However, Dhawal loses her sight before he can see her face.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Searches For Natasha
episodesList.summary: Pranali feels shattered as Hetal punishes Naveli severely. Later, while Shantanu frets over Natasha, Dhawal frantically looks for her.

episodesList.title: Naveli to Meet Bittu!
episodesList.summary: Naveli enrages Hetal by making her juice bitter. Hetal wants to put Naveli in boarding school. Meanwhile, Naveli wants to meet Bittu.

episodesList.title: Dhawal's Request to Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Dhawal informs Shantanu about Naveli's illness and asks him to bring Bittu to Somnath. However, Shantanu is concerned about Natasha and decides not to take her along.

episodesList.title: Natasha Returns to The Pandya House
episodesList.summary: Natasha experiences flashbacks from her past when Shantanu brings her to the Pandya house. Later, Dhawal becomes confused when Natasha does not recognise him.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Fights Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Dhawal questions Shantanu about his and Natasha's relationship and the two get into a fight. Later, the Makwanas are shocked to see Natasha in their home.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Dhawal tells Shantanu that Natasha will stay in the house until she gets better. Later, Shantanu learns from Dhawal that Natasha is his wife.

episodesList.title: Naveli Learns a Startling Truth
episodesList.summary: Amba decides to use Natasha to achieve her hidden agenda. Later, Naveli is devastated by Amba's accidental confession about Natasha being her real mother.

episodesList.title: Naveli Demands Answer
episodesList.summary: Pranali is dumbfounded when Naveli inquires about her biological parents. Dhawal regrets his past mistreatment of Natasha and Naveli upon witnessing their plight.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Naveli's Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: Naveli learns of Pranali's plan to send Natasha away and persuades the latter to flee from the Makwanas' residence. Unexpectedly, they find themselves at the Pandya house.

episodesList.title: Natasha Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Mitthu is taken aback to see Natasha and Naveli in his house when they try to steal food from the kitchen. Later, Dhawal arrives to take Natasha and Naveli home.

episodesList.title: Mitthu Questions Dhawal
episodesList.summary: Mitthu asks Dhawal about the reason behind Natasha’s behaviour. Meanwhile, Natasha notices an old photograph of herself in the Pandya house and gets curious.

episodesList.title: Hetal Stands Against Natasha
episodesList.summary: Pranali tells Dhawal that she will not let him or Natasha take Naveli away from her. Hetal claims that according to the law, Natasha is no longer Dhawal's wife.

episodesList.title: Pranali Offers to Help Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Pranali helps Shantanu sneak out of the house with Natasha so that she can keep Naveli with her. However, Dhawal catches them in the act.

episodesList.title: Dhawal Requests Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Shantanu intends to take Natasha from the Makwana house. However, Dhawal urges Shantanu to prolong his stay for Naveli and Natasha's well-being.

episodesList.title: Did Natasha Regain Her Memory?
episodesList.summary: Naveli tries to deceive Dhawal into taking Natasha to the Pandya house. Looking at old photographs, Natasha experiences flashbacks.

episodesList.title: A Happy Ending For Natasha-dhawal
episodesList.summary: Natasha tells Hetal how Amresh died because of Shalini's actions. Emotions flare as Amba and the Pandyas stop Natasha from leaving the house with Naveli.

soundtrack.title: Pandya Store: Tracklisting
soundtrack.composer: Pandya Store's soundtrack is composed by Nakash Aziz and Sargam Jassu. The first song "Yaadon Ki Baarat", is an original track but its name is inspired from the 1973 film Yaadon Ki Baaraat's title song. It is the theme song of the show and is sung by Mukund Suryawanshi. The female version of the song is sung by Pamela Jain.

plotHtml: The Pandyas are a middle-class family residing in Somnath. The family comprises Darshan and Suman Pandya and their four sons, Gautam, Dev, Shiva and Krish. Their daily life is dependent on their only source of income, their grocery store named Pandya Store. Dhara marries Gautam, the eldest son of the Pandya family, when Anita refuses to marry him as his store is in debt. She raises her brothers-in-law like her sons and they consider her like their mother. Initially she is not accepted by Suman, but after facing several tribulations, Dhara is finally accepted by her mother-in-law. Dhara and Gautam get the store back, after they find legal papers left by Darshan and decide to work together to free their store from all debts.
tagline: The Pandyas are a middle-class family residing in Somnath.

title: Punyashlok Ahilyabai
summary: Punyashlok Ahilyabai is an Indian Hindi-language historical drama television series that aired from 4 January 2021 to 27 October 2023 on Sony TV. It's digitally available on Sony LIV. It is based on the life of queen Ahilyabai Holkar, who reigned over the region of Malwa from 1767 to 1795 and Produced by Dashami Creations.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Aetashaa Sansgiri as Queen Ahilyabai Shinde Holkar: Mankoji and Sushilabai's daughter; Mahadji and Vitthoji's sister; Khanderao's first wife turned widow; Malerao and Muktabai's mother (2021–2023) ** Aditi Jaltare as young Ahilyabai Holkar (2021) * Rajesh Shringarpure as Subedar Malhar Rao Holkar: The King of Malwa region under the Maratha empire; Gautamabai, Dwarkabai, Banabai and Harkubai's husband; Khanderao and Seetabai's father; Malerao and Muktabai's grandfather (2021–2023) (deceased) *Snehlata Tawde Vasaikar / Shruti Ulfat as Queen Gautama Bai Holkar: Malwa's Chief Queen; Malharrao's first wife; Khanderao's mother; Malerao and Muktabai's grandmother (2021-2022) / (2022–2023) (deceased) * Gaurav Amlani as Khanderao Holkar: Malharrao and Gautamabai's son; Seetabai's half-brother; Ahilyabai and Parvatibai's husband; Malerao and Muktabai's father (2021–2022) (deceased) ** Krish Chauhan as young Khanderao Holkar (2021) and Male Rao Holkar: Ahilyabai and Khanderao's son; Muktabai's brother; Mainabai's husband (2023) (deceased) ** Diaan Talaviya as Child Malerao Holkar (2022–2023)

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was announced by Dashami Creations and was confirmed in December 2020 by Sony TV.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Marathi actress Aetashaa Sansgiri was cast to portray the elder version of Ahilya Bai. Kinshuk Vaidya was supposed to play the elder version of Khanderao, but he opted out and was replaced by Gaurav Amlani.

episodesList.title: EARLY LIFE OF AHILYABAI HOLKAR
episodesList.summary: We travel 300 years in the past to a time when the Maratha Empire was flourishing. A young Ahilya is seen working on her embroidery, as her parents observe and criticize her. Soon, it gets apparent how society was driven by gender roles when Gautama explains the throne's significance to Khanderao. Later, Ahilya finds out that her newlywed friend, Renu is finding it difficult to live with her in-laws.

title: Paurashpur
summary: Paurashpur is an Indian Hindi-language fictional historical period original web series which was streamed on ALTBalaji and ZEE5. The web series is conceptualised by Baljit Singh Chaddha,  directed by Sachindra Vats and produced by Sachin Mohite under the production company Jaasvand Entertainment. It stars Annu Kapoor, Milind Soman, Shilpa Shinde and Shaheer Sheikh. The series was released on 29 December 2020. It received a mostly mixed critical reception, with reviewers criticising the show's writing and the excessive use  of sexual content.In season 2, this series was released on 28 July 2023 and was directed by Yogesh Ojha and written by Rahul Ranjan. Also in season 3, this series was released on 21 May 2024 as the directed by Kaycee and written by Chital Tripathi and Rajesh Tripathi. Its stars in season 2 and 3 are Sherlyn Chopra, Payel Raha, Muskan Agrawal, and Kajol Tyagi.
reception:
Archika Khurana of The Times of India has given 2/5 stars stating that the plot unfolds to draw out the state of women in society and addresses some significant issues like patriarchy, gender politics and power. However, it ends up being a tedious watch due to its weak endeavour. Directed by Shachindra Vats, this seven-part series bought together many ingredients—good setup, great casting, and strong background score— but the final dish turns out to be not-so-inviting.
Anvita Singh of The Indian Express criticise that "The script is abysmal, and the dialogues are just plain bad. It is a groundbreaking epic drama about lust, revenge and patriarchy. However, it comes across as soft porn. There are unnecessary sex scenes, which, by the way, have not been shot aesthetically."
Dyuti Gupta or SheThePeople.TV criticised that "This Ekta Kapoor Series Is Just Glitter, No Gold". The plot had ample potential to turn out to be a Bahubali-sized blockbuster, but a below-average script added with an equally poor direction makes it something you'd be better off skipping. There are so many loopholes and loose ends that the entire show feels like a half-hearted effort on part of the makers. The CGI and VFX are lousy, the screenplay is preposterous and the dialogues are downright cringeworthy.
Ravi Bule of ABP News Live criticise that the web series with Gender Discrimination Raises Cheaply Series and rather focuses on Kama Sutra like content.
TV9 Hindi criticise that Story has been focused on bold scenes, no character could leave impression.

articleSections.text: On 15 October 2020, ALTBalaji announced about the web series and it has released on 29 December 2020. The web series logo was launched on 2 December 2020 on ALTBalaji's official Instagram profile with 16 different Indian languages. Teaser was launched on 6 December 2020.

episodesList.title: Thrones and Deceit
episodesList.summary: The treacherous nature of Paurashpur, where rulers and rebels collide in a game of power and survival. A significant element introduced is the mystery surrounding which queen is pregnant, a development that creates much intrigue and potential conflict within the royal household. Prophecies hint at future chaos, adding a layer of suspense and a sense that hidden betrayals are set to emerge and potentially shatter the kingdom's fragile stability.

episodesList.title: Paurashpur - Kingdom of Patriarchy
episodesList.summary: Paurashpur is celebrating the sixth marriage of King Bhadrapratap. But it is marked by some dark moments. Boris warns new queen Umanglata, whose handmaiden Rukma is speared by Chandrasen, and an intruder arrives at the palace.

episodesList.title: Nakaabposh – The Mysterious Kidnapper
episodesList.summary: The intruder has slain dozens of guards and kidnapped Umanglata. Queen Meeravati wants Kala to replace Umanglata and approaches her with the offer of becoming queen.

episodesList.title: Kala Ranveer - Not A Love Story
episodesList.summary: Meeravati tricks Kala into marrying King Bhadrapratap instead of Prince Ranveer. Boris is greeted by an acquaintance. Meanwhile, Prince Aaditya enters the King's private chambers dressed as an assassin.

episodesList.title: Boris – The Gender Politics
episodesList.summary: Kala is sentenced to death after being caught with Prince Ranveer. As she is to be executed, she is saved. Prince Ranveer looks for Kala among corpses but finds someone else. Bhanu stops Prince Aaditya from killing King Bhadrapratap.

episodesList.title: Ujale Baaz – The Secret Hawk
episodesList.summary: Boris tries to humiliate the king, but he insults Boris instead. Kala wakes up at Boris' place. She tries to escape to reunite with Ranveer. Meeravati slits Bhanu's throat. Ranveer returns to the castle in a trunk and reveals things.

episodesList.title: Nayantara – Legend of the Missing Queen
episodesList.summary: Prince Aaditya grieves for Bhanu. Meeravati is about to be burnt alive by Bhadrapratap for preserving queen Nayantara's corpse. The news reaches Boris' haven and the former queens decide to save Meeravati.

episodesList.title: Vidroh – The Uprising
episodesList.summary: Boris and his army attack Paurashpur to save the queen. When Boris finds out that Meeravati killed Bhanu, he decides to avenge his death, but fails when he gets stabbed in the back.

title: Prem Bandhan
summary:
Prem Bandhan (transl. The Bond of Love) is an Indian dramatic television series which aired from 30 November 2020 to 9 June 2021 on Dangal.
Produced by Ekta Kapoor for Balaji Telefilms, it stars Chhavi Pandey and Manit Joura.

articleSections.title: Plot
articleSections.text:
Janki agrees to an arranged marriage at the insistence of her father. Not meeting the groom before their wedding night, she discovers that he is mentally challenged and is at an eight-year-old level. Janki realizes she has been tricked into marrying him by her in-laws, but hesitates to endanger her father's health by telling him. Harsh (her husband) is childlike, which annoys her. Despite their marriage's rocky start, however, Janki and Harsh become close.
Janki's brother learns about the situation, and wants Janki to return home. Harsh and Janki want to stay together, however, and she consults a doctor to help him. Janki becomes suspicious that someone in the family does not want Harsh to improve, despite their surface affection. Harsh receives a head injury, for which Janki is blamed.
She wants to protect Harsh from his stepmother Savita, who is responsible for his mental instability and killed his grandfather to acquire his property for herself and her children (Rajesh, Shekhar and Roohi). Janki decides to celebrate their three-month anniversary with Harsh in Darbhanga, only telling Savita. They have an accident on the way, but both survive. Harsh needs a kidney transplant, and Janki donates one of her kidneys. Harsh awakens with no memory of the past five years, and does not recognize Janki. He remembers his love for Shweta (his old girlfriend), and Janki does not want to come between them at first. Advised by Rangili (a friend), she refuses to sign divorce papers sent by her father-in-law and decides to save Harsh from Shweta and Savita.
Shweta tries to kill Harsh, and Janki comes home; her father-in-law tries to stop her. Harsh keeps Shweta from slapping Janki, remembering that she saved his life. Janki has allies in Shekhar, Harsh's grandmother and his sister-in-law. Savita schemes to make it appear that Harsh had sex with Shweta to pressure him into marrying her, and his father wants them to marry.
Harsh develops feelings for Janki. On Mahashivratri, Janki's name appears on a ritual invitation instead of Shweta's. Janki's in-laws ask her to leave the house, but Harsh stops her. She prepares the mehndi, but Savita poisons it and Janki is blamed; her father-in-law has her arrested. Shekhar bails Janki out; she refuses to return home, and is kidnapped by a moneylender who threatens to sell her unless Savita's debt is paid.
Janki stops Harsh and Shweta's wedding; she knocks Shweta out, disguises herself and marries him. Harsh thinks she married him for money, but stops Shweta from killing her. Rajesh has false papers saying that Janki married Harsh for money, and Harsh orders Janki out; she burns the papers as she leaves.
Janki goes to the hospital where Harsh was born, and a nurse tells her about Harsh and why Savita wanted to kill him. She is attacked by Savita and Rajesh, who put her in a box and bury her.
Six months later, Harsh still loves Janki but has been forced to marry Shweta. Rajesh has mortgaged the resort to the owner of J Industries, Jaya Kapoor. They meet with Jaya, who looks like Janki; Janki was saved by Akshay, who helps her avenge Savita and Rajesh. Savita and Rajesh realise the error of their ways, and the family reunites.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Chhavi Pandey as Janki Srivastava Shastri/ Jaya Kapoor: Harsh's wife; Nitin and Nisha's sister; Brij's daughter from his first marriage; Asha's stepdaughter (2020–2021) * Manit Joura as Harsh Shastri: Janki's mentally challenged husband; Ram's son with his mistress; Savita's stepson; Rajesh's younger brother (step brother); Roohi and Shikhar's stepbrother (2020–2021)

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was initially entitled Koshish - Rishton Ki. The initial storyline of the show is adapted from Zee TV's 2000 drama series Koshish - Ek Aashaa, which was too produced by Balaji Telefilms. The series' first trailer was released on 14 November 2020 with Chhavi Pandey, a deepak in her hand. The series' first promo was released on 22 November 2020. The series premiered on 30 November 2020 on Dangal TV and aired from Monday to Saturday at 7:30 pm. On 27 April 2021 the timeslot of the series was changed to 10 pm IST. From 28 March 2021, entire episodes of the show were streaming on YouTube. The series wrapped up its shoot in June and the last episode was broadcast on 12 June 2021.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Manit Joura was selected by producer Ekta Kapoor to play male protagonist in the series, Harsh Shastri. Joura stated, "This role is radically different from all the other shows that I have done so far. Here I need to play a character that doesn’t come easy to me, I need to work on it, so to play this character is tough!"
Chhavi Pandey was cast to play the female protagonist 'Janvi Srivastava' in the show. On her role, Chhavi stated, "The character of Janvi is simple and loving girl yet strong and independent. She belongs to a middle-class family and has a lot of responsibilities of her family but never cribs about it. She can do anything to make her family happy. Her character will be very relatable to the girls in small towns!"
Mohit Hiranandani was brought in to play male antagonist whereas Ariah Agarwal was cast as the female antagonist in the show. On her role, Ariah stated,"I loved that Shweta is out and out negative. She is completely a mean girl. I was always fascinated by such roles and wanted to try playing one."

title: PubGoa
summary: PubGoa is an Indian Tamil-language virtual reality-based thriller web series that is streaming on ZEE5 platform from 27 November 2020. The 8-episodes web series is written and directed by Lakshmi Narayan Raju. It stars Vimala Raman, Dev Ramnath, Sampath Ram, Leo Sivadass, Ayra, Sarah Annaiah, and Abishek Joseph George.
plot: PubGoa has two different stories running parallelly, one story is of a female police (Vimala Raman) who is investigating a violence and bloodshed shootout that happened at a new year's rave party which was held in Goa. And, second story is of a man who somehow escapes from the shootout alive and he is searching for his lost girlfriend.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Pakaoo has given the web series 6/10 stars stating that "if you like the Sci-fi movies, can be watched once". Movie joins all the pieces together slowly and each character and situation reveal to the story. The narration gets little chaotic and predictable somewhere, call it as intended sometimes. Revealing or unfolding of the movie is very predictable at times, which is a weak point of movie. Connecting the subplots, investigation by cop, and suspense makes the movie watchable. Laxmi narayan direction is good and Cinematography by kartik thillai is good.
Binged Bureau of the Binged platform has given PubGoa a 5/10 stars rating stating that "One of the critical subplots is boringly executed for a long time. The other which is a proper thriller leads to a routine outcome". The other subplot throws a surprise and merging of both into a single incident is one of the best aspects of the series, story-wise. The web series is a passable thriller. The convoluted narrative and predictable end make it weaker. Give it a try if you love the genre and have lots of patience.

episodesList.title: Sun, Beach, Drugs, and Crime
episodesList.summary: Adira is taken on a guilt trip when the Siolim drug party case continues to haunt her. This case had a blend of rave party, shootout and a politician’s conspiracy. Will Kavya and Varun be able to help Adira go on the road to redemption?

episodesList.title: Two Bullets, One Lie, and A Mask
episodesList.summary: Adira is suspicious about everyone around as she has to believe in her instinct. Kavya and Varun are already haunted by their past. In between all this, a familiar stranger crosses Varun’s path and an unexpected guest arrives at Kavya’s place.

episodesList.title: When Desperation turns Unlucky!
episodesList.summary: Kavya is trying her best to move on from her past as it keeps appearing again and again. Varun, on the other hand, finds a key to open his memory vault. Meanwhile, Adira is desperate and gets closer to solve the puzzle, but she runs out of luck at the last minute.

episodesList.title: Maya and Murphy's Law
episodesList.summary: Adira tries her best deception tactics but the odds still stay against her. Kavya manages to escape from the clutches of death, and Hade follows her. Varun, on the other hand, is caught in a death trap when he tries to find Maya.

episodesList.title: A Key to the Puzzle?
episodesList.summary: Adira begins to solve one piece of the puzzle at the time, starting from Kavya. Meanwhile, Varun is trapped between the 4 walls and his lost memory. He finds and uses the secret key to open the memory vault. Adira catches the beast in her booby trap.

episodesList.title: Love, Sex, and Games
episodesList.summary: Varun opens the memory vault and realizes that Maya was more than a game for him. Adira manages to duck the bullet, but her target is spot on. The game starts to intensify, and the real players come to the front.

episodesList.title: The Game Begins
episodesList.summary: Varun learns and starts to play the game. Adira has put every puzzle piece in place and still cannot solve it. Maya, on the other hand, opens Pandora’s box of unpleasant memories for Varun.

episodesList.title: Game Over
episodesList.summary: The monster of the game comes out once again. Varun and Adira realize that they should play the game to survive and not to win. Will they be able to survive, or a new twist would ruin everything they did so far to survive?

title: Padatha Painkili
summary: Paadatha Painkili is an Indian Malayalam television soap opera that aired on Malayalam Entertainment Channel Asianet and is available on the digital platform Disney+ Hotstar. The show is produced by Merryland Studio of P. Subramaniam. It is a remake of the Bengali serial Ke Apon Ke Por. The show premiered on 7 September 2020 and ended on 24 March 2023.
plot:
The plot focuses on the story of Kanmani. Both Ananda Varma and his wife Susheela treat Kanmani as their own daughter, but their daughters-in-law Swapna, Ananya and Tanuja who is also Anand's eldest daughter worry that Kanmani will inherit part of the family property, reducing their own shares. They mistreat Kanmani. Deva is Anand's youngest son. Deva takes a stand against the difficulties Kanmani faces.
Deva's girlfriend Madhurima comes from Dubai to visit his family. Ananya's brother Bharat attempts to kill Kanmani and is stopped by Deva. Deva has the idea that Kanmani should marry and decides to get her married to Ranjith. Ranjith and his family comes to visit and fixes the marriage. However, on the day of marriage, it is revealed that Ranjith is a criminal who marries wealthy women to take away their wealth and the police arrest Ranjith.
Meanwhile, Deva and Madhurima are planning to get engaged on Kanmani's wedding day. Madhurima gets the news that her father is ill and decides to go to her house. Kanmani's marriage is stopped, and Anand is blamed by everyone for Kanmani's pitiable position. Anand, who is in a devastated state, persuades Deva to marry Kanmani to mitigate the disaster of the failed wedding. Madhurima arrives at the last moment, just in time to see the wedding become official. Madhurima asks Deva whether he married Kanmani only out of pity, but Deva remains silent, and she leaves, angrily.
After Madhurima leaves, Deva allows himself to show his anger by throwing things. Susheela realises for the first time that her son has been sacrificed. She too becomes furious and turns against her husband, and eventually against Kanmani. Kanmani does not expect Deva to treat her like a real wife, so she continues to work as a maid. One day Susheela's sister comes to meet Deva's wife, not knowing the history, and she criticises the family for marrying a maid to their son. Humiliated, Susheela is persuaded by Swapna and Ananya to call Madhurima back. Meanwhile, Anand plans to hold a reception for the newlyweds. No one supports his decision except his youngest daughter Avantika.
Madhurima comes to the reception of Deva and Kanmani and creates drama when Deva accepts Kanmani as his wife. Then the couple prepares to spend their first night together. But Susheela suddenly begins to have chest pains. Deva panics and stays with his mother. Since she is not allowed to see Susheela, Kanmani sleeps alone in the room that she was to share with Deva. This event is a turning point, as Susheela and Deva begin to appreciate Kanmani. Swapna, Ananya and Bharat all try to undermine Kanmani and make her leave the house, but the result is that Deva begins to fall in love with her.
Deva entrusts Kanmani with documents relating to his confidential project hon topics to do with his work. Swapna, Ananya and Bharat steal the documents and put the blame on Kanmani. Deva is angry and says humiliating things to Kanmani. Kanmani finds the documents and reveals that Bharat was the thief but is so humiliated that she leaves the house. Deva later finds her and brings her home. Deva and Kanmani's relationship becomes stronger, and Deva confesses his love to Kanmani and she accepts.
reception: The show is premiered on Asianet on 7 September 2020 at 8:30 PM IST. Initially, the show earned good viewership, but it dropped when Sooraj Sun appeared as main protagonist left the show due to some health issues. Later the show moved to 10:00 PM IST due to low TRP ratings. On 28 March 2022, the show moved to 2:30 PM IST in respect to the timing of Bigg Boss season 4.From 28 November 2022, the show is again shifted back to 10:00 PM IST and went off-air on 24 March 2023 .

title: Phulala Sugandha Maticha
summary: Phulala Sugandha Maticha (transl. Flower Has the Fragrance of Soil) is an Indian Marathi language television series that aired on Star Pravah. It premiered on 2 September 2020 and ended on 4 December 2022. It stars Harshad Atkari and Samruddhi Kelkar in lead roles. The show is an official adaptation of the StarPlus series Diya Aur Baati Hum. Both shows are produced by Shashi and Sumeet Mittal under the banner Shashi Sumeet Productions.
plot:
Set on backdrop of Shirdi. The story centers upon a 20-year-old college student, Kirti, whose dream is to become an Indian Police Service officer and Shubham, a sweetshop owner and sweetmaker. Kirti's dreams and aspirations are destroyed as she loses her parents in a terrorist attack. Planning to move abroad, her brother Sagar fixes her marriage to Shubham whose strict mother Jiji Akka wants her daughter-in-law to be simple and not well-educated, with the excellent skills of a housewife.
After discovering this, Sagar lies about Kirti's education level to both his family and the Jamkhedkars in order to ensure her settlement. Kirti gives up her education and dreams, accepting her roles as a wife and the elder daughter-in-law of the family. Soon, as her truth of being educated and not knowing cooking is revealed, Jiji Akka banishes her. The story shows and further describes how Shubham becomes her full-strength and helps her to fulfil her dreams.

title: Pinjara Khubsurti Ka
summary: Pinjara Khubsurti Ka (transl. Cage of Beauty) is an Indian Hindi-language television romantic drama series that aired from 24 August 2020 to 6 August 2021 on Colors TV for two seasons. Season 1 starred Riya Sharma and Sahil Uppal as Mayura Dubey and Omkar Shukla, while season 2 they played Mayura Goswami and Omkar Vashisht, respectively.
plot:
Mayura Dubey, an aspiring doctor hates how people only like her beauty and not her skills or accomplishments. Omkar Shukla, the king of marble business industry wishes to marry her, and pressures her family to coerce her. They marry. Mayura befriends his brother Piyush. Later, Omkar scars her face with marble and kills Piyush. Mayura wants revenge. Omkar chooses Aishwarya over her. Aishwarya kidnaps Omkar and escapes. Mayura and Omkar are left hanging on from a tree by the cliff after she rescues Omkar from the car's trunk.
Omkar realizes Mayura's love for him and expresses his gratitude towards her. She falls off the cliff and is presumed dead. Distraught, Omkar realizes his mistakes, reforms and accepts his love for Mayura. She is alive but loses her memory.
Six months later, Omkar searches for Mayura and meets Dr. Neel who saved and loves her. Omkar finds Mayura, and her father Akhilesh begs Neel to marry her. Neel kidnaps Mayura and coerces her to marry his brother, Kundan. Omkar is revealed to be the groom and marries Mayura. Neel shoots him, but Omkar survives.
Mayura is pregnant and eventually delivers a girl named Tara. Omkar keeps her away from Mayura because Guru Maa tells him her scar is a bad omen for the baby. Omkar forces Mayura to have plastic surgery. She fakes her surgery, and Omkar kicks Mayura out and forbids her from seeing her daughter.
Five years later, Mayura has schizophrenia and celebrates Tara's 5th birthday while hallucinating about her and Omkar. Tara faints during the celebration. While Omkar tends to her needs, Tara sneaks out to play with the other kids. Mayura notices Tara helplessly standing in middle of road and rushes to save her. When Omkar unleashes his wrath upon the doctor, Tara is terrified and escapes. Mayura chases her and they are trapped inside a pipe tunnel while escaping heavy winds. Mayura soon learns that Tara is her daughter. Having been forced to stay away from her daughter for five years, Mayura resolves to get her daughter back.
Mayura disguises herself as a nurse for Tara's treatment and enters Omkar's house. When Mayura rescues Tara. Mayura bonds with Tara as Omkar investigates Mayura's identity.
Mayura plans to escape with Tara after finding her passport. In an attempt to take Tara away from Omkar, Mayura convinces her to go on a trip. When Mayura and Tara are caught by the police, Omkar refuses to lodge an FIR against her, but warns her to stay away from his daughter.
Omkar's mother learns that Mayura is not in the hospital and warns her son. When Omkar takes Tara to the hospital for a checkup, Mayura plots to kidnap her child. Omkar accuses Mayura of Tara's disappearance and plans to have her arrested. Mayura removes her disguise and leaves Omkar in utter shock. As Omkar takes Tara away, Mayura sits on a strike in front of his house. Later, Mayura reveals images of her marriage in front of the media, one of which is found by Tara.
With the start of a 14-day trial for custody, Tara reciprocates the emotional bond for her mother. Mayura wants Tara to enroll in school, but Omkar wants Tara to take online classes to protect her from the outside world and tries to scare her from enrolling. When Omkar and his goons invade Mayura's house, she stealthily escapes with Tara, but falls unconscious from an injury. After Mayura secures Tara, she seeks help from Vishakha, who advises her to work on herself and improve her lifestyle. Omkar visits Vishakha and asks her to reveal Mayura's address, but she refuses. Enraged by her refusal, Omkar threatens to burn down Vishakha's office. Omkar tries to warn Mayura but fails miserably. He pretends to be blind and tries to convince Mayura about Vishakha. The police find Vishakha's body, and despite all the clues pointing towards Omkar's involvement, Mayura defends him. Megha, Mayura's sister goes to the house disguised as a maid and plans to help Omkar to get paid. But Mayura suspects her and later finds out about Omkar's plans to recapture Tara. When Omkar is found with suspicious objects at the crime scene, he is arrested by the police. He escapes from the police station but is hit by the ACP's car. Mayura lashes out at Raghav when he tries to keep her away from Omkar, which infuriates him. Vishakha is revealed to be alive and conspiring with Raghav. When Omkar tries to fight back, Vishakha threatens him with his family being held hostage. Mayura and Omkar escape from captivity and flee, but Vishakha kills Omkar and Mayura with a sword.
20 years later, Mayura and Omkar are reincarnated as Mayura Goswami and Omkar Vashisht. After a rocky start, Omkar and Mayura meet again when the former works as a waiter in a hotel that belongs to Mayura's father. When Omkar begs Mayura for a second chance, she fires him. On a trip with her friends, Mayura takes Omkar with her as her bodyguard to teach him a lesson.
Mayura goes against her father's will and sneaks out of the house to participate in a fencing competition. She loses the sword-fighting competition against Omkar, and gets into a heated argument with her father and plans revenge against Omkar. Mayura bets with her friends to make Omkar fall in love with her and exact revenge on him. Later Vishakha comes backs into Omkar and Mayura's life. Mayura then remembers her past birth and tries to make Omkar remember. Vishakha plans that when Ishaan and Mayura marry she will send them to London and get her killed in a staged car accident. Omkar goes to Jabalpur and finds out about his past birth.
Bela gets Mayura ready for her haldi ceremony. Vishakha slips and falls, spilling the haldi and ruining the ceremony. Mayura is then taken to the mandap and pretends to faint. Omkar stops the wedding and Mayura is happy to see him. Vishakha reveals her plan and challenges Mayura to a sword fight with a talented fencer. Omkar saves Mayura and Vishkha holds everyone hostage, planning to burn Mayura and Omkar alive. The police arrests Vishakha for her crimes, and Mayura's father allows her and Omkar to marry.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Shivangi Khedkar was originally cast as Mayura and was featured in a promo for the show, but due to creative differences, she quit the show and Riya Sharma was later cast to play Mayura.
The series switched time slots with Bawara Dil on 1 July 2021, moving to a later broadcast time. The change was made after the Broadcasting Content Complaints Council stated there was too much violent content in the show. Its last episode was telecasted on 6 August 2021 attributed to low ratings and was replaced by Balika Vadhu 2.
