episodesList.title: The Storm Is Here
episodesList.summary: The India of 10th Century Era was divided by a small estate. They used to fight with each other often and this enmity was not limited to two Rajyas. India was divided into two parts, Malwa in North and Manyakheta in South. There was a mission to rule, the soldiers are brought from Africa and China to fight the wars and for one such war, a ship loaded with rented soldiers departed from Africa.

episodesList.title: Attack on Prithvi
episodesList.summary: Mrinalvati is surprised by Prithvi Vallabh's skills after they are caught off-guard on the Battlefield. Prithvi apologizes for the lives he couldn't save during the battle. There's an unexpected attack on Prithvi.

episodesList.title: Mrinal Secretly Goes To Malwa
episodesList.summary: Malwa’s neighboring king Gohil enters Malwa with an excuse. Tailap tells Mrinal that she shall not go Malwa and says it is dangerous. Sulochana tells Mrinal that Malwa has organized Rangutsav where big poets will come and they can enter easily. King Gohil tell his soldier to get a 1000 girls for his entertainment.

episodesList.title: Mrinal Enters The Palace
episodesList.summary: Mrinal plans a bomb attack on the palace wherever there is less public and says she will only kill Singhdant. Rasniti asks Mrinal her to play her instrument-Veena. Prithvi consoles Mrinal and asks her to share her pain with him.

episodesList.title: Prithvi Thrown Out Of Malwa
episodesList.summary: Mrinal kidnaps Singhdant and takes him to some place. Prithvi takes responsibility of the blast.

episodesList.title: Another Attack on Prithvi
episodesList.summary: Maha Kay asks Sindhu to get Prithvi killed. Kosha dances in the palace in front of Tailap and Maharani Jakkave. Mrinal gets restless hearing the song. Prithvi is in the jungle when someone attacks him. Mrinal tells Tailap that she will leave the political life after she conquers Malwa.

episodesList.title: Mrinal's Hatred
episodesList.summary: Guru Aditya asks Mrinal to promise him something. Singhdant tells Maharani that he has hidden the fact of Mrinal’s hatred towards him from Prithvi. A fire breaks out at Kosha’s brothel. Prithvi seeks an old woman in the jungle.

episodesList.title: Prithvi Seeks Some Answers
episodesList.summary: Prithvi is finally able to find the old lady in the jungle and seeks some answers from her. Mrinal tells Gurudev that she has decided to live her entire life without a man. The old lady in the jungle gives answers to Prithvi's questions.

episodesList.title: The War Is Here
episodesList.summary: Tailap and Sindu fight in the war place. Prithvi wants to join the war but the old woman stops him and tells him not to go. Sindu defeats Tailap and keeps him captive. Mrinal reads Malwa’s letter. Prithvi saves Malwa and defeats Tailap in war.

episodesList.title: Prithvi's Promise
episodesList.summary: Tailap is welcomed back by his people after winning the war. Singhdant asks Prithvi to end the enmity between Malwa and Manyakheta. Sulochna reaches Africa with Mrinal and they both are surrounded by African soldiers. Mrinal faints after being surrounded by the soldiers.

episodesList.title: Signs of War
episodesList.summary: Mrinal is determined to attack Malwa once again in order to exact revenge. She informs Tailap to prepare for battle with Malwa. Meanwhile, in Malwa, Prithvi is advised by Kalari to keep aside his feelings as it might prove detrimental, not only for him but also to Malwa, in the war to come. Then, the old Woman, who had the vision of Gajkesari, informs Prithvi that he has Gajkesari's blood in him.

episodesList.title: The War Begins
episodesList.summary: Once again, the forces of Malwa and Manyakhet face-off on the battlefield. Mrinal is determined to win in this war and attacks Malwa with full force. In an attempt to put an end to the war, Prithvi tries to propose a peace treaty to Mrinal but she declines to consider peace with Malwa. Prithvi decides to fight Mrinal one-on-one to prevent thousands of their men from dying on the battlefield. Who will emerge victorious on the battlefield?

episodesList.title: Mrinal Is Imprisoned
episodesList.summary: Never in her wildest dreams, Mrinal would have thought that the place she despises the most: Malwa, will provide her shelter, albeit momentarily. Prithvi carries an injured Mrinal to treat her. Thinking that Mrinal is unconscious, Singhdant arrives in the chamber only to be stabbed by Mrinal. Before Mrinal can slay Singhdant, Prithvi arrives and imprisons Mrinal. What will happen now that Mrinal has tried to kill Singhdant? Will Prithvi succumb to the pressure and order her execution?

episodesList.title: The Masked Man
episodesList.summary: Prithvi disguises himself by wearing a mask and saves Mrinal and sneaks her out of Malwa before anyone kills her. He fights off Muni Raj and his men and also cuts off Muni Raj's hand when he tries to touch Mrinal. Then, Prithvi treats Mrinal by preparing some medicines.

episodesList.title: Prithvi's Plan
episodesList.summary: Mrinal is still in chains with Prithvi in disguise. Prithvi plans to get the truth out of Mrinal about the traitors in Malwa who were sending information to Mrinal. Tailap is worried as he didn't get any news about Mrinal after she went to the war with Malwa. Will Prithvi be able to get the truth out of Mrinal?

episodesList.title: Attack on Mrinal
episodesList.summary: Mrinal sends Prithvi to meet her infiltrator in Malwa, Sulochna to get her help and sends a letter with him. Moolraj informs Sindhuraj that he has found Mrinal and they should kill her and put the entire blame on Prithvi. Moolraj's soldiers attack Mrinal and Prithvi in the cave.

episodesList.title: Kallari Is Captured
episodesList.summary: Sindhuraja tells Maha kay that they need a proof of Prithvi and Mrinal's death so they go to the cave only to find out that Prithvi and Mrinal have already escaped. They get frustrated and capture Sena Adhyaksh Kallari with Mool Raj's men. Meanwhile, Mrinal gets to know that the masked man is actually Prithvi Vallabh and gets furious.

episodesList.title: Tensions Arise
episodesList.summary: Prithvi takes Mrinal to Rasnidhi and Princess Amrusha and tells them to take care of Mrinal at any costs before he takes her to Malwa. Prithvi gets worried about Sena Adhyaksh Kallari as there are no whereabouts of him. King Tailap is attacked in his room and is killed. Will King Tailap's death add to the already risen tensions between Malwa and Manyakhet?

episodesList.title: Prithvi and Mrinal Arrested
episodesList.summary: King Singhdhant is dead and Mrinal is arrested as a suspect in his murder. Guru Aditya informs Jakala about Mrinal's defeat in the war. Prithvi and Kalari are arrested on their way back to Malwa by Malwa soldiers. Tailap recovers from his wounds and comes to know about Mrinal's defeat and decide to gather his army and attack Malwa.

plotHtml:
Mrinalvati (Mrinal) is the Princess of the Manyakhet Kingdom and her younger brother Tailap is the King of Manyakhet, who are advised by Guru Vinayaditya. Due to the treachery of King Singhdant of the Malwa Kingdom, which killed the entire royal family except Mrinal and Tailap, Mrinal has dedicated her life to getting revenge against Singhdant. She sends some African mercenaries to attack Malwa, but they are stopped by Prithvi Vallabh (Munj), the adopted son of Singhdant and the Yuvraj of Malwa.
After a successful alliance with the King of Devgiri, Bhilam, Mrinal decides to secretly attack Malwa with foreign explosives and also kill Singhdant during the anticipated Rang-Utsav of Malwa. There she meets Prithvi, who immediately falls in love with her and uses him to get to Singhdant. Their plan is successful, but she is not able to kill Singhdant. Prithvi follows Mrinal and throws his sword at her, but she escapes. There is huge loss of life and property in Malwa and because of this, Prithvi is banished from the Kingdom.
He goes to the place where Singhdant had found him in order to know the truth about his birth. An old lady informs Prithvi that she had found him in the forest and when she shouted whose child that was, the legendary Gajakesari appeared. Meanwhile, Tailap is in love with a courtesan named Kosha, because of which, his wife, the Queen of Manyakhet, Jakkala gets very jealous. Mrinal fixes the marriage of Bhilam-Raj's daughter, Vilas with Tailap's son, Prince Satyashray.
Mrinal asks Tailap to attack Malwa as it is in a weak state. In the battle, the son of Singhant, Yuvraj Sindhuraj is about to lose against Tailap, but the Commander of Malwa, Kallari, and Prithvi come to his aid. Malwa wins the battle. War prisoner Tailap is released by Prithvi, whom Singhdant has made the new King of Malwa. Mrinal is unable to bear this humiliation and goes to Africa and hires a very strong army including giants. Meanwhile, Prithvi invites Sindhu's son, Prince Bhoj back from his Gurukul in order to participate in the next battle.
The battle starts as Mrinal refuses to accept peace. Prithvi and his men are successful in killing all the giants and major part of Manyakhet's army during the night. The next day, Prithvi and Mrinal engage in a duel in which Prithvi beats Mrinal and takes her as Malwa's hostage. In Malwa, Mrinal again tries to kill Singhdant, but is unsuccessful. Mahakay and Sindhu, along with Mulraj, plot to have Mrinal kidnapped when she would be taken to the prison. Prithvi decides to do something in order to change Mrinal's heart. Thus, he kidnaps her with the assistance of Daku Dharti Singh.
During the kidnapping, Prithvi cuts Mulraj's hand. News reach Mahakay and he asks Mulraj to kill Mrinal and put the blame on Prithvi, but Mrinal and Prithvi both escape. They again meet that old lady who gives them shelter in the forest where Prithvi saves Mrinal from a snake. By looking at his bravery and kindness, Mrinal falls in love with Prithvi. Prithvi believing Mrinal, takes her to princess Amrusha and thereafter a new friendship between Amrusha and Mrinal begins. Leaving Mrinal to Amrusha, Prithvi sets out to Malwa to convey the good news to his father. On his way, he learns that Kalari had been captured and sets out to free him. Mrinal, on the other hand, reveals to Sulochana that it was all her plan to kill Singhdant by trapping Prithvi. Meanwhile, Sindhu, led astray by Mahakay, decides to invite Mrinal to Malwa in Prithvi's absence and succeeds in his mission. The same night, he kills Singhdant and blames Mrinal for the same. Rajmata Vatra, believing the same, orders to arrest both Prithvi and Mrinal, after which both are imprisoned. During the funeral for Singhdant, Sindhuraj is made the next king of Malwa after which he insults Mrinal and sentences her to death.
When Sindhu is about to light the funeral pyre, Rajmata asks him to stop and asks Prithvi to do the same. Later she reveals the actual truth of Singhdant's murder, shocking everyone. Prithvi gets his post back and saves Mrinal from execution and takes her to Malwa as she falls unconscious. Tailap, on the other hand, knowing about his sister's state sets out to free her with the help of the neighbouring kingdoms. Later, Prithvi forgives Sindhu and refuses to punish him for his crime. Tailap reaches Malwa where he is welcomed by Prithvi to his surprise with the proposal of peace and friendship and takes him to Mrinal. She wakes up recalling the insult to her and refuses to accept Prithvi's proposal of peace and, in anger, slaps Prithvi. As she is about to leave, Amrusha intervenes and try to persuade Mrinal, but in vain. Meanwhile, Prince Satyashraya returns from his Gurukul and is introduced to his would-be wife Vilas, after which he tortures her emotionally.
Back at Malwa, Sindhu tries to kill himself, but is saved by Prithvi after which everyone forgives him. Mrinal, on the other undergoes emotional trauma thinking about Sindhu's insulting words, but is comforted by Guru Aditya. After this, Prithvi goes to meet Van Amma to learn the secret of his birth and identity who advises him to go to Mrinal to know the truth of Gajakesari. Everyone refuses to let Prithvi go to Manyaket, but he is stubborn and so left with no other option, Rajmata tells that she would let Prithvi go if Kalari gives permission. Kalari challenges Prithvi to a duel if he wants his permission. Satyashraya tortures Vilas again, but this time is caught by Sulochana who promises Vilas that she would not reveal the truth to Mrinal until she wishes to. The very next day, he tries to misbehave with Vilas for which he is brutally punished by Mrinal and is made to apologise to Vilas and her family. Prithvi defeats Kalari in the duel and sets off to Manyakhet and is accompanied by Bhoj and Rasiniti. Back in Manyakhet, Vikramjeet, the brother of Bhilam Raj, makes his entry. Prithvi, on reaching Manyakhet, proposes marriage to Mrinal, shocking everyone and is insulted by Mrinal again. After this incident, Prithvi stays in Manyaket. It is then that Bhoj meets Vilas, who had actually come to meet Prithvi, and is instantly drawn to her. That very day, Mrinal comes to meet Prithvi in his tent and puts forward the condition of beheading his family members in exchange for her marriage with him. Prithvi, undeterred by her words, asks her permission to stay until Diwali to which she agrees and also invites him for dinner at the palace.
On the night of royal dinner Satyashray poisons food which affects Bhoj, but saved by Sulochana's timely intervention. Manyakhet asks for forgiveness from Prithvi and Mrinal asks what she can do to restore trust, for which Prithvi asks permission to build a statue. Meanwhile Vilas comes to see Bhoj with Jakkala and Laxmi. They develop close friendship. Prithvi sends Rasnidhi and Bhoj back because he don't want them to get harmed further.
On the eve of Diwali the statue is unveiled in front of public, which shows Mrinal and Prithvi together. This offends Mrinal to warrant Prithvi's arrest, later in court furious King Tailabh awards death sentence to Prithvi. Meanwhile Kosha is pregnant from Tailabh and is on the run with Mosi for her life. She hides in Prithvi's camp and eventually Prithvi finds out. He gives her a separate guest tent to live comfortably, and inspires her to ask for her rights. Kosha breaks into royal court and is given place to stay in palace as she is pregnant on Mrinal's order. This does not sit well with Jakkala and Satyashray and their resentment and hatred for Mrinal deepens.
Before executing Prithvi publicly, Tailabh asks for his last wish to which Prithvi replies he wants to be dead by Mrinal's hands. According to which next day Mrinal goes forward to put rope around his neck, but realises that this might be last she will see of Prithvi. Seeing her in emotional turmoil, Prithvi unconsciously pulls her and kisses her. Emotional Mrinal kisses back for split second but soon realises the situation and stabs him with Sulochana's sword.
The kiss sprouts all kinds of reaction in Manyakhet's ordinary people since all witnessed what happened. On one hand who wanted to see Prithvi and Mrinal together (Sulochana and Vilas) are upset seeing Mrinal's state of shock and anger. Vikramjeet takes advantage of this and manipulates Tailabh into berefting Mrinal of all the important Political and Social posts. Slowly he gains hold of Mrinal's Post by helping to win the war against Chola kingdom.
Meanwhile after getting stabbed Prithvi falls down and before anyone could react, he is saved by HimRaj. It is revealed that HimRaj is Organiser of GajKesari sect and is here to save Prithvi because it's their responsibility to look after wellbeing of GajKesari of that time. He warns Guru Vinayaditya, Tailabh and Mrinal that killing GajKesari will bring curse upon Manyakhet kingdom.
Slowly Prithvi is brought back to life and left to heal as he is still unconscious. Slowly Prithvi gets his conscience back and Mrinal begins to torture him with new tricks every time without killing him. She is furious with Prithvi's action and empties all of her hatred over him. Prithvi accepte this without saying a word. For final blow she puts him into Bazar crossroads and provoke people to stone him as he is the son of King Singhdant of Malwa who killed her King Father and Queen mother. Mrinal is shunned by everyone who she holds dear and near slowly making her realise that hating Prithvi is no use when her own people don't respect her. Queen Jakkala brings forth the final nail calling her state is worse than Kosha the prostitute. This hurts Mrinal to the core, and she decides to leave the Kingdom forever.
Meanwhile Bhoj comes to find out about Prithvi in garb of common man and bumps into Vilas. Vilas is happy to see him, promises to help him. After knowing about Mrinal's decision with help of Bhoj's advice she calls Guru Vinayaditya to stop her from leaving as she listens to only him. This further makes Jakkala resent Mrinal more and Satyashray and Vikramjeet to plot Prithvi's murder by poisoning his medicines.
Guru Vinayaditya visits Prithvi's chamber and Prithvi is given idea of what his actions did to Mrinal. He is deeply saddened as this wasn't his motive at all. He asks forgiveness of Mrinal and is told by her that a Woman's Pride is not so much delicate thing that could be broken by mere touch of a man. Her reply makes him admire her more and when he is put into Bazzar tells people it was his fault alone, not Mrinal's, unknown that Mrinal is listening to him.
Vilas hears Vikramjeet and Satyashray plotting and rushes to tell Mrinal but is stabbed by Vikramjeet- her own uncle. Still she manages to reach Mrinal and tells her to stop Killing of Prithvi as he is the only one who loves her. Seeing Vilas into pain and suffering and still caring for her Mrinal blurts out that she also loves Prithvi and she won't let anything happen to him or Vials, both. Leaving her into care of Sulochana's associates she runs for his chamber only to find HimRaj and Guru Vinayaditya already there. HimRaj calls out Vikramjeet and all other kings of whole India for their small mindsets and tells about GajKesari's Legend.
It is revealed that GajKesari is Living Legend who births as human to save whole Bharat (Indian subcontinent) from outer evil forces with help of all the king's of India. Also, Mrinal's father, King Shivdutt, was GajKesari of his time. The war that GajKesari wins is to protect the Golden Sparrow which keeps the whole Indian Subcontinent spiritually and economically empowered. The enemy is Subukabdin Gajhni who wants that sparrow for himself and was defeated by King Shivdutt 30 years ago. Legend also tells that Sparrow has to be saved by GajKesari as only he has those special powers and will be left vulnerable after war and completion of his task. Which is why Singhdant took opportunity to kill him, and later changed his way to peace in wake of repentance.
Eventually All kings are called into Manyakhet and decide to meet with their respective forces into Vindhya mountain range for Grand Battle. Mrinal is chosen by Prithvi as Chief Commander of whole Indian collective army, HimRaj supporting this as she is daughter of former GajKesari. This upsets Vikramjeet and few King's male ego. Later in Malwa's camp, Mrinal confess to Prithvi and asks for forgiveness. He is happy to have her with him. Prithvi leaves for malva and Mrinal prepares to leave for Vindhya with her army. Meanwhile Vikramjeet plots with Tailabh to attack Malwa behind Prithvi's back so they can bring it down once for all. While Prithvi and Mrinal are battling in Kabul they attack on Malva and Kallari is badly injured. Tailabh and Vikramjeet runs like cowards back to Manyakhet. Kallari wants to see Prithvi before death, and Vazda sends Bhoj to Prithvi with urgent call. While Manyakhet attacks Maalva, Mrinal meets Prithvi and both leave with whole army to Kabul. Kabul's King Jaypal asks his son to find GajKesari and bring him into Kabul. He finds them in midway to Kabul and tells them that Subukabdin Gajhni has laid siege to Kabul Palace. Only plus point is Subuk's two sons wants throne for themselves. Prithvi has to leave for Kabul with few choice warriors as there is Blizzard making their progress slow. Asking Guru Vinayaditya to bring whole army later he goes further to inspect to what can be done to win the war.
Once reaching the Gajhni camp, they infiltrate the camp, but Mrinal is captured; day is saved as she pretends to local liquor supplier. Gajhni wants her for himself and takes her to his tent. To save Mrinal, Prithvi kidnaps one of Gajhni's son and reaches to palace through secret tunnel. The news break-out and search begins to find Ismael. Eventually with different twist and turns Mrinal is rescued and brought back to palace. There, Prithvi shows her the Golden Sparrow and puts it back into ground with all of his powers. Once done, he is left weak, and brought back to their camp, as army has reached. Once in camp, Kings bribed by Vikram try to kill Prithvi in sleep but are slaughtered by Mrinal. Eventually, Gajhni is killed, and Mahmood goes back his land, never to return. Bhoj reaches to Kabul just as Prithvi is about to leave for Malva, and is told what happened after he left for Kabool. Once reaching, he meets Kallari and Kallari dies into his arms. In Manyakhet, Mrinal confronts Tailap about invasion on Malva but has to keep quiet in front of Vikramjeet's logics as she and Prithvi are not yet out into open.
Prithvi comes to Manyakhet, to complete wishes of his both late father's, King Singhdant and Guru Kallari to finish enmity between two kingdoms, forever. Vikramjeet provokes him but Prithvi shows his real face to royal family and puts forth marriage proposal for Mrinal to end the war. Satyashray wants to continue the war, Tailap is as usual indecisive but Queen Jakkala opposes this war mindset. Agreeing with Jakkala, Mrinal asks Prithvi if he would marry her. Prithvi replies by filling her hair parting (maang) with vermillon (sindoor).
tagline: Mrinalvati (Mrinal) is the Princess of the Manyakhet Kingdom and her younger brother Tailap is the King of Manyakhet, who are advised by Guru Vinayaditya.

title: Pushpavalli
summary: Pushpavalli is an Indian television comedy drama series created by Sumukhi Suresh. It is an Amazon Prime Video original series and premiered on 15 December 2017.
plot:
Season 1: Pushpavalli is the story of a girl (named Pushpavalli) who meets a charming man, Nikhil Rao in an event in Bhopal. Nikhil who finds Pushpavalli cool and kind spends time with her, thinking she doesn't have many friends. While there is nothing between the two, Pushpavalli feels that Nikhil also likes her. Finding out that Nikhil is from Bangalore, she takes up a job in a children's library located close to Nikhil's office, which is run by one of her school friends named Pankaj. In Bangalore, she stays in a PG run by Vasu. She hires a tea vendor called T-Boy to stalk Nikhil and get all the information about his arrival back to India. In exchange she steals and shares the information from the contacts database of the library, to help for his upcoming CCTV camera business. What follows is a flurry of lies from Pushpavalli to get close to Nikhil without making it apparent to him. The show nears to an end with Nikhil finding out about and confronting it, and it concludes with Pushpavalli accessing visuals to Nikhil's house via a CCTV camera that the T-Boy has installed.
Season 2: The story continues with the premise of Pushpavalli's engagement with Vidyuth, a sweet, caring and considerate guy, who is Pushpavalli's mother's choice. The event is held in Bangalore where it is revealed that Pushpavalli wishes to take revenge on Nikhil for humiliating and rejecting her, enlisting T-Boy's help. She relocates to Bangalore on the pretext of spending time with her fiancé, and impressing his family, but ends up getting back her old job at Pankaj's library, where it is revealed that he and Swati are pursuing a relationship. She also starts living secretly in Vasu's PG, without the latter's knowledge, creating a new phase of challenges for her. The story continues as Pushpavalli furthers her saga of lies to regain Nikhil's trust and confidence in her, while simultaneously seeking vengeance and manoeuvring her oblivious fiancé and Pankaj away from her intentions.

The event is held in Bangalore where it is revealed that Pushpavalli wishes to take revenge on Nikhil for humiliating and rejecting her, enlisting T-Boy's help. She relocates to Bangalore on the pretext of spending time with her fiancé, and impressing his family, but ends up getting back her old job at Pankaj's library, where it is revealed that he and Swati are pursuing a relationship. She also starts living secretly in Vasu's PG, without the latter's knowledge, creating a new phase of challenges for her. The story continues as Pushpavalli furthers her saga of lies to regain Nikhil's trust and confidence in her, while simultaneously seeking vengeance and manoeuvring her oblivious fiancé and Pankaj away from her intentions.

title: Partners Trouble Ho Gayi Double
summary: Partners (also known as Partners Trouble Ho Gayi Double) is an Indian buddy cop-comedy series. The series was produced by Paritosh Painter. The show premiered on SAB TV on 28 November 2017.
plot: Aditya Dev and Manav A Desai are two policemen who work under Commissioner Gogol Chatterjee. They are very different but slowly start to become good friends. Dev falls in love with Ayesha Nadkarni, who is a lawyer and Desai is in love with Ayesha's younger sister Dolly Nadkarni. They both live with Neena Nadkarni, their mother, a widow, and an old friend of Chatterjee. The story revolves around these characters and the different cases the policemen solve, with a focus on the comedic and entertaining situations which ensue. Later both men fight over Gogol's niece, Chamko

episodesList.summary: Adi receives a call from Gogol who informs him to arrest Girish Kumar, a puppeteer. Adi and Manav arrive at Girish’s house to arrest him but find that he is missing. A DVD left at the scene reveals that Girish has been kidnapped by a puppet!

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 79 - 16th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Manav wakes up to discover a puppet on his bed. While investigating the kidnapping of the puppeteer, Adi goes missing. Now, Manav has to rescue Adi from the mysterious kidnapper, who is posing as a puppet.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 80 - 19th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Adithya gives Bittu his brother back and surrenders his weapon to him in order to search for Girish Kumar. Manav finds a suspicious truck on the road and decides to follow it.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 81 - 20th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya assures Kalavathi that she will receive justice. Kalavathi warns Krishnadevaraya that the kingdom will be cursed and attacked by shape-shifting snakes if justice is not served. Then, seeing Chandrakala, Kalavathi gets astonished. What happens next,

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 82 - 21st March 2018
episodesList.summary: Adi suspects that the criminal has hidden diamonds inside the puppets. The criminal arrives at Neena’s restaurant. Dolly and Aisha arrive at the same time ans suspect that the criminal is in the shop. Will Adi be able to nab the criminal?

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 83 - 22nd March 2018
episodesList.summary: The kidnapper reveals himself to Girish. Adi and Manav arrive at the kidnappers hideout and make an arrest. As they solve one case another opens. Neena accidently hits a woman with her car. The woman’s spirit begins to haunt Neena. How will Adi and Manav solve this paranormal case?

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 84 - 23rd March 2018
episodesList.summary: Manav switches his report with Adithya and steals his glory. Meanwhile, there is a ghost terrorizing Dolly, making her lose her grip on sanity.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 85 - 26th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Bulbul’s ghost keeps haunting Dolly’s restaurant. She is stricken in panic and fear. In her state she calls the commissioner and asks for his help. Manav and Adithya are put on the case and Bulbul gets new victims.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 86 - 27th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Neena decides to take the religious path and conduct a ritual to get rid of the ghost. Meanwhile, Manav calls up Gogol and informs him that Adi is missing. Adi, on the other hand, is busy solving the case. Will Adi turn a ghostbuster?

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 87 - 28th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Neena sells her cafe in order to get rid of the ghost. After she signs the property papers, Adi makes an entry and reveals that the hauntings were staged by Vicky, who owns a real estate company. Watch this episode to find out how Adi busted the ghost.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 88 - 29th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Adithya and Manav gets a case where a rich middle-aged momma’s boy lost his wife. As they go to his house, his sister falls for Adithya at first sight. They try to get more information out of the husbands as to what happened.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 89 - 30th March 2018
episodesList.summary: Commissioner Gogol is still sick and Manav is trying to convince him that there must be something fishy about the wife missing case. Meanwhile, Adithya is off trying to get more information on the family.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 90 - 2nd April 2018
episodesList.summary: Commissioner Gogol is still sick and asks for co-operation from Ayesha and her mother, Nina to catch Manav and for this there will be free publicity for them and their restaurant.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 91 - 3rd April 2018
episodesList.summary: Manav is meeting the bride undercover as a potential groom. Adithya is there too as the waiter, while Dolly serves the role of Manav's mother. With this undercover op, they plan to expose the bride and her devious plot. Watch to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 92 - 4th April 2018
episodesList.summary: When Dolly denies harboring any romantic feelings for Manav, Manav decides to get married on the rebound; a newly-wed man lodges a complaint after his wife goes missing the day after their wedding. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 93 - 5th April 2018
episodesList.summary: When Dolly denies harboring any romantic feelings for Manav, Manav decides to get married on the rebound; a newly-wed man lodges a complaint after his wife goes missing the day after their wedding.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 94 - 6th April 2018
episodesList.summary: This time the police guys receive a unique problem where a wife comes to the station and says that her husband calls her Sister. Husband says that he's being tortured by a joker who forces him to call his wife sister or he'll beat him up.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 95 - 9th April 2018
episodesList.summary: Manav is scared of the Hunterwali who has been terrorizing him recently. Adi is met by three people who want to lodge a complaint. But, the three people reveal that they have been sent by Hunterwali to keep Adi engaged. Is Manav in trouble?

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 96 - 10th April 2018
episodesList.summary: Adi points the gun at Hunterwali. He is surprised to learn that Aisha has dressed up as Hunterwali. Aisha reveals that she received a call and the real culprit is threatening her. Adi assures her that she is safe and resumes investigation. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 97 - 11th April 2018
episodesList.summary: In order to catch the joker, Gogol holds a press conference and proclaims that he has apprehended Hunterwali and the Joker’s case is closed. Hearing this the joker gets irked and decides to make his presence felt. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 98 - 12th April 2018
episodesList.summary: Manav meets a woman. The same woman has also met Adi. After returning home, Adi wakes up to a sound and comes outside to find the same woman. Similarly, the woman also meets Manav at his home. What is the mystery behind this mysterious woman?

episodesList.title: Partners - Trouble Ho Gayi Double - Episode 99 - 13th April 2018
episodesList.summary: Dilruba’s plan is working as Prema questions Keshav’s character seeing him getting close to Jwala. Keshav tries to explain but in vain. Finally, Dilruba decides to end the drama and asks Jwala to put a ‘The End’ to the short story. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Slipper Thief
episodesList.summary: Manav is accused of stealing slippers from a temple. Manav decides to pay a visit to the temple. People catch hold of Manav and accuse him of stealing slippers. Meanwhile, Adi is worried that Manav is accused of stealing slippers and decides to prove his innocence.

episodesList.title: The Kidnapper
episodesList.summary: Adi is accused of kidnapping a child. But, Adi pleads innocence. Gogol sees the video which shows Adi kidnapping a child and questions Adi. Is Adi the kidnapper?

episodesList.title: Swachh Bharat
episodesList.summary: Manav has taken upon himself to make sure the city is clean. He chases a man who is throwing waste on the streets, unaware that he is a wanted criminal. The wanted criminal escapes from Manav’s feeble hands. Will Manav be able to catch the criminal?

episodesList.title: Swachhata Mission
episodesList.summary: A woman arrives at the police station and accuses Manav of cheating her. While this matter settles another begins. The wanted criminal who Manav let escape, is determined to teach the cop a lesson. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Blackmail
episodesList.summary: Manav is blackmailed by a wanted criminal after he is caught peeing in a public place. The criminal shoots Manav’s video and threatens to make it viral. Even when Manav yields to the criminal’s demand, the video is sent to Adi and Gogol. What happens next,

episodesList.title: Manav The Guilty
episodesList.summary: Manav is shown the video where he is seen peeing in public. He tries to tell Gogol and Adi that he is innocent. But, Manav is seen as the one who has shamed the department. How will Manav prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Adi’s New Challenge
episodesList.summary: As Adi apprehends Manav’s blackmailers, another criminal outs a challenge before the police department. A criminal known as Mr. P threatens Adi and Manav and dares to break the law if need be. How will Adi catch Mr. P?

episodesList.title: Gogol is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Mr. P’s men kidnap Gogol outside the police station and confine him in an isolated spot. Adi learns that Gogol has been kidnapped and starts the search operation. Manav too is on the search for Gogol but using different tactics.

episodesList.title: Gogol is Rescued
episodesList.summary: Tonight on Partners Double Ho Gayi Trouble, Commissioner Gogol Chatterjee is kidnapped by Mister P, and his fellow partners hits Mister P’s place to rescue Gogol in disguise of Bhangra dancers. Aditya and Manav make fun of Gogol behind his back and Chamko records them on action. Watch what happens next!

episodesList.title: The Dress-up Game
episodesList.summary: In this episode of Partners Trouble Ho Gayi Double, both Aditya and Manav wants to impress Chamko, for a marriage proposal. While one dresses up as an yogi baba another as a bhangra dancer. Watch how the story unfolds on the full episode!

episodesList.title: Adi Becomes Ronaldo
episodesList.summary: Adi takes on a new identity and meets Chamko. Adi, who is now Ronaldo, wants to foil Manav’s plan. When Chamko insists that she is going to South Africa, Adi fears that he will lose to Manav and will be forced to pay for Manav’s food expenses. Who will Adi make sure Manav loses to him?

episodesList.title: Choti Cutter
episodesList.summary: Chamko has got to know that Aditya and Manav had taken up disguises to impress her. Manav and Aditya fight over the bathroom time and Aditya decides he needs a new partner. A Choti Cutter a new criminal is on the run, who is chopping off women’s hair. What will happen next,

episodesList.title: Don't Let Your Hair Down
episodesList.summary: The Choti Cutter is out on the run and his victim is Netaji's wife Lalita. Netaji and his Wife has come to the police station to meet Commissioner Gogol, he is threatening Gogol that if the Choti Cutter is not caught then Gogol has to go bald. Manav and Aditya take up this case.

episodesList.title: Neena’s Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: A constable with the initials D.I.G heads to the police station and fools everyone into thinking he is a DIG officer. Choti Cutter attacks on Neena’s restaurant and chops of one of her staff’s hair. Neena gives Gogol an ultimatum.

episodesList.title: Choti Cutter Attacks Again
episodesList.summary: Aditya doubts that Chamko might be the Choti Cutter but his doubts circle the drain when Chamko is attacked by the real Choti Cutter. Manav gets a threat call from the Choti Cutter and finally a female officer in the Police Station becomes the next victim.

episodesList.title: The Choti Cutter Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Aditya and Manav finally get a hold of the Choti Cutter. While the culprit sets up an intricate plan to attack on Neena and fails miserably as the police officers come to the rescue. Gogol gets to keep his hair and Chamko reveals she was under a wig.

episodesList.title: The Child In Manav
episodesList.summary: Three men rob a bank and while trying to escape bump into Manav. While trying to nab the robbers with the help of Chamko, Manav gets hit on the head. After regaining consciousness in the hospital, Manav starts acting as a child.

episodesList.title: Manav The Eight Year Old
episodesList.summary: Manav loses his memory an now he thinks he is an eight-year-old kid. Gogol and Aditya is worried about the recent bank robbery and Aditya tries to find any trails that can lead up to to the culprits. Manav creates chaos at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Manav is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Manav is kidnapped and confined in a desolated spot. Adi blames Chamko for Manav's misfortune and claims that she is involved with the robbers. Chamko manages to get her hands on a gun and threatens the police . Is Chamko involved with the robbers?

episodesList.title: Chamko's New Problem
episodesList.summary: Adi and Manav decide to create trouble for Chamko so that she leaves the town. Manav calls Chamko and pretends to be her admirer. Chamko receives numerous bouquets as appreciation, which irritates her. Will Chamko find out that Manav is behind the act?

episodesList.title: Manav On The Phone
episodesList.summary: Someone is calling up Chamko and she isn’t liking it at all. Chamko complains to Manav and Aditya about the random calls, but what she doesn’t know is, that it’s none other than Manav. Aditya dresses up again in his futile mission to impress Chamko.

episodesList.title: Manav's Death
episodesList.summary: Manav manages to fool Chamko, who believes that he is dead. Adi convinces Chamko to run away and assures that he will take the blame for Manav’s murder. While Manav and Adi are celebrating the absence of Chamko, she arrives and learns the truth. What will be Chamko’s reaction?

episodesList.title: Manav is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: A new villain in town threatens Adi and Manav. Chamko takes Manav to a fighting match. Later, Manav is kidnapped and Chamko has no clue about his whereabouts. Adi questions Chamko about Manav but she offers little clues. Where is Manav A Desai?

episodesList.title: Adi's New Task
episodesList.summary: After Adi successfully frees Manav from the kidnappers, he has no time to rest as Gogol assigns him another task. This time, Adi has to apprehend Harsh. But, before Adi can catch Harsh he has to woo Harsh's daughter. Will Adi manage to catch Harsh?

episodesList.title: Adi's Unplanned Wedding
episodesList.summary: While an undercover Adi is trying to woo Sonia, Harsh's daughter, in order to get to the gangster, at home he has a new problem to deal with. Adi's uncle pays a surprise visit and is shocked to see Chamko. In order to save Adi, Chamko pretends to be Adi's wife. How long will Adi put up with this act?

episodesList.title: Adi's Undercover Operation
episodesList.summary: Gogol arrives at Adi's house. Adi's uncle is made to believe that he is Adi's father-in-law. Later, Adi goes undercover to meet Harsh, pretending to be the boyfriend of Harsh's daughter.

episodesList.title: The Don is Busted
episodesList.summary: Adi is expecting the arrival of his uncle but he finds Harsh, the most wanted don, standing at the door. In a secret undercover operation, Adi, Manav, and Gogol manage to apprehend Harsh and take him into custody.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Mughal-e-azam
episodesList.summary: Chamko is part of a play, Mughal-e-Azam and she is playing the role of Jodha Bai. During the rehearsals of the play, an accident takes place, leading the director to speculate that his heroine's life is under threat. But, the director is unsure which heroine's life is in danger. Thus, Adi and Manav decide to become a part of the play to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Manav: The Method Actor
episodesList.summary: Manav is influenced by the director and gets into the character of Akbar. Even on duty Manav recites dialogues from the play. While Manav is busy learning the nuances of acting, Adi is busy solving the case. Will Adi get his first lead in the case?

episodesList.title: Akbar In Love
episodesList.summary: Manav, who is playing the character of Akbar, is trying to get close to the heroine's mother as part of the investigation. Similarly, Adi is flirting with the heroine in order to solve the case before the culprit executes his plan. But, the culprit is one step ahead as he attacks the heroine.

episodesList.title: Where's The Bomb?
episodesList.summary: Manav is influenced by the director and gets into the character of Akbar. Even on duty Manav recites dialogues from the play. While Manav is busy learning the nuances of acting, Adi is busy solving the case. Will Adi get his first lead in the case?

episodesList.title: The Twin Brother
episodesList.summary: Gogol is planning to take a holiday but his leave is canceled by his superiors. He is determined to go on a Goa vacation and asks his twin brother, Kogol, to act like him and take his place in the office for a few days. Meanwhile, a notorious gang is planning to kidnap Gogol.

episodesList.title: The Thug Brother
episodesList.summary: Gogol fulfilled his father's dream by becoming a police commissioner but his twin brother Kogol is a crooked thug who doesn't believe in the law system or the right way of life. However, their affectionate brotherhood and the Yin Yang combo is a must-watch.

episodesList.title: Breaking Character
episodesList.summary: Chamko suspects that the man pretending to be Gogol isn't the one he claims to be. She decides to test Kogol, which leads her to confirm her suspicion. Meanwhile, Adi and Manav are beginning to raise doubts about Gogol's mysterious change in character.

episodesList.title: Excuse Me Please!
episodesList.summary: Adi, Manav, and Chamko form a pact with Gogol's brother and agree to keep the Goa trip a secret. Meanwhile, Manav is having a bit of a trouble with his nose lately and is constantly sneezing on anyone who dares to go near him. In the midst of this trouble, Manav has to catch a notorious criminal.

episodesList.title: Manav’s Time’s Up
episodesList.summary: Manav is afraid of Sanki Pathan’s madness and fears the gangster will attack him. Later, Manav visits a doctor and learns that he will live only for a few days due to an illness. What will Manav do now?

episodesList.title: Love Triangle
episodesList.summary: Manav is devastated after finding out that he has only a few days to live. Before his final days arrive, Manav decides to propose to Chamko. Meanwhile, Adi too is having feelings for Chamko.

episodesList.title: Manav Embraces Life
episodesList.summary: Manav finds out that he won't be dying any soon and learns that the medical report was fake and it was set up by Sanki Pathan. Manav informs Adi that Sanki Pathan tried to fool him and decides to take matters into his own hands and confront Sanki Pathan.

episodesList.title: Gogol In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Neena makes a surprise entry at the police station and barges into Gogol's cabin. She is shocked to see Gogol with another woman, unaware that Gogol is out on a holiday. Gogol's brother tries to dodge the situation but fails and Neena leaves the cabin in tears.

episodesList.title: The Child In Manav
episodesList.summary: Three men rob a bank and while trying to escape bump into Manav. While trying to nab the robbers with the help of Chamko, Manav gets hit on the head. After regaining consciousness in the hospital, Manav starts acting as a child.

episodesList.title: The Date
episodesList.summary: Adi reads Chamko's message on Manav's phone. He gives Manav a laxative and makes sure Manav answers nature's call instead of Chamko's and goes to meet Chamko. Later, a new threat targeting the cops arises. Now, the cops themselves become a threat.

episodesList.title: The Hit List
episodesList.summary: Pinky seeks help from Manav and asks him to save her life. When Manav arrives at Neena's house, Neena informs Manav that Adi is after her life. Manav and Adi convince Neena that Adi will not kill her. Then, Neena shows them a letter which claims that Adi wants to kill her. Who has sent Neena this letter?

episodesList.title: The Retro Queen
episodesList.summary: Chamko sends Manav and Adi on an assignment to find her missing grandmother. Adi is afraid Manav will beat him in the race to find the grandmother. He fears come true as Manav finds the grandmother in the middle of a tv shoot.

episodesList.title: The Supposed Grand Ma
episodesList.summary: An imposter woman clamming to be Chamko’s granny comes for a visit. Adi and Manav compete to prove their worth in front of the woman, thinking she will let Chamko marry one of them.

episodesList.title: Manav’s Mission
episodesList.summary: Manav wants to get the necklace for the imposter grand ma, by hook or by crook. Hoping that he’ll eventually end up with Chamko. Gogol’s doppelganger finds it difficult to manage the department.

episodesList.title: The Real Truth
episodesList.summary: Chamko knows about the real truth about the fake imposter nani, but the nani knows that the Gogol at the office is an imposter as well. In the mean while some one has called for an old age home service to drive her away.

episodesList.title: The Lungi Gang
episodesList.summary: Chamko hands over the necklace to Adi and Manav and asks them to give it to Gogol. Later, Kogol is worried as he has to be present at a press conference. When the media ask questions about the notorious Lungi Gang, Kogol is enraged and challenges the leader of the gang.

episodesList.title: Aditya is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: The Lungi Gang has kidnapped Aditya, and now its up to Manav to rescue him, but when the criminals call Manav to tell him that Adi is kidnapped, Manav doesn’t believe it, and when he does, it’s pretty late!

episodesList.title: The Assassin
episodesList.summary: Manav becomes the assassin and follows the orders of the gangster. He sets a trap for Kogol but ends up falling in it himself. Then, Manav decides to kill Kogol and sneaks into his house. Kogol sees Manav and confronts him. In an ensuing scuffle, Manav stabs Kogol, which is witnessed by Chamko.

episodesList.title: Busting The Gang
episodesList.summary: Manav stabs Gogol and informs the gangster that he has killed the commissioner as per the deal and now he should release Adi. The gangster fails to keep his end of the deal. And then, Kogol, who was part of the plan, arrives with a police force to nab the gangster.

episodesList.title: Floor Test
episodesList.summary: Seeing Venugopal's closeness with Neena, Kogol calls up Gogol and gets some information about Venugopal from him. Later, Venugopal asks Kogol to provide security to his MLA's as his party members are being threatened by the opposite party ahead of the floor test. Manav and Adi's home is turned into a guest house to provide security for the MLA's.

episodesList.title: The Endless Sleep
episodesList.summary: Manav wants to confess his love to Chamko but doesn't get the opportunity due to the MLA's staying at his house. Adi too has something to say to Chamko. Sensing trouble, Manav gives Adi sleeping pills and makes sure he sleeps through the night. While Manav doesn't get the opportunity to confess his love that night, at dawn, it is discovered that all the MLA's are missing.

episodesList.title: The Sleeping Pills
episodesList.summary: The new criminal in town has a new way to capture his victims. Feeding them sleeping pills. Chamko finds a bottle around Adi and Manav’s place. There is also a press conference at the police station and finally Manav gets hurt.

episodesList.title: Manav's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Adi is confined in an isolated spot and Manav, with the help of Chamko, free Adi from captivity. Meanwhile, Bose thinks he is following Kogol but learns the hard way that Kogol has tricked him. Kogol manages to keep his identity - and his affair - a secret for now. But, how long can Adi and Manav keep the MLA's secure?

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer
episodesList.summary: A blackmailer is exploiting men, using their darkest secrets against them, leaving them no choice but to act as per his will. Meanwhile, Manav learns that Adi is going on a date with Chamko. His plan to spoil the date succeeds and Adi decides to take revenge on Manav.

episodesList.title: The Secret
episodesList.summary: Manav receives a paper on which the blackmailer has written: "I know your secret". This paper changes hands from Manav to Chamko to Kogol and finally lands in the hands of Bose. Everyone is hiding a secret and after seeing the paper, they are all afraid their secret will be out.

episodesList.title: Blackmailing The Blackmailer
episodesList.summary: Kogol informs Adi and Manav that someone is blackmailing him. Adi and Chamko find out that the blackmailer knows no secrets and is merely creating a suspicion in their minds. They decide to play the blackmailer's trick on himself and call him up to put their plan into effect.

episodesList.title: The Dead Body
episodesList.summary: Adi apprehends the blackmailer who had created nuisance in the police department. Manav is enraged to know that the blackmailer knew no secrets and took him for a ride. While one case is closed another one begins. Kogol asks Adi to bring a dead body found at the crime scene to the police station. Why is Kogol asking for the dead body?

episodesList.title: The Trunk
episodesList.summary: The whole police department is going crazy over a dead body being delivered. Moreover, there is a V.I.P coming for a visit to the police station. More fun and humour waits in tonight's episode!

episodesList.title: The Missing Dead Body
episodesList.summary: All hell breaks loose when the dead body goes missing. The politician waits for the dead body to arrive as Adi tries to find it. Somehow the dead body ends up being at a marriage function where everyone thinks that its the groom's dad. What will happen next in this madness?

episodesList.title: The Dead Body Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Adi pursues the dead body from place to place and finally find it in a marriage function but gets into another trouble at the marriage. On the other side, the politician is getting restless at the police station and decides to leave. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Crown
episodesList.summary: Kogol is burdened with the responsibility of taking care of Victoria's crown, worth millions of dollars, before the grand exhibition. Later, Shanno asks Kogol to get the real crown for her. Chamko too expresses the desire of getting her hands on the crown to Adi. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Who Took The Crown?
episodesList.summary: Both Adi and Kogol's better halves want Victoria's crown just once on their heads, Kogol decides to replace the crown for just one day and get it to Shanno but gets into trouble after he forgets to switch off the CCTV cam while replacing the crown. What will Kogol do now?

episodesList.title: Painting The Future
episodesList.summary: DIG's friend, the painter, can predict the future with his paintings. Kogol doesn't believe in it initially but when the painter predicts that Kogol will remove his shirt, the exact occurs a few minutes later. Later, DGP Jagmohan arrives to inspect the CCTV footage and check the safety of the crown. Kogol is worried that DGP will find out that he has replaced the crown with a fake one.

episodesList.title: A Disaster In The Making
episodesList.summary: The police officers have been invited to a birthday party at a hotel. Also invited is Mayuri, a dancer. While at the hotel, Mayuri meets her estranged father. Neena has accompanied Kogol to the hotel but she is enraged seeing Shanno. While trying to romance Shanno and escaping Neena, Kogol remains unaware of the disaster that is brewing at the hotel.

episodesList.title: The Secret Formula
episodesList.summary: Gyandev's secret formula is under threat of being leaked. Even though Gyandev has got various offers, he has declined them. Later, during a party, Kabri in an inebriated state nearly ends up revealing that he isn't Gogol. Then, Adi comes to know that Gyandev has been murdered.

episodesList.title: The Murder Mystery
episodesList.summary: Gyandev's murder mystery continues to grow more and more confusing as the footprints found in his room turn out to be Malvika's. Ad believes that Malvika didn't commit the murder so he tries to find out the CCTV footage of that night but as it turns out, the CCTV footage goes missing. Who killed Gyandev?

episodesList.title: Another Murder
episodesList.summary: While the murder mystery of Gyanchand is getting more and more confusing, Adi follows the trail to the Secretary Mr. Dubey. But when Adi and other get to Dubey's room, they find his dead body there. Who is killing these people? Will Adi be able to solve this one?

episodesList.title: Suicide or Murder?
episodesList.summary: Not long after Adi proves that Mukesh murdered Gyandev for financial gain, a fresh case falls on Adi's lap. Film director Akhil is found dead under mysterious circumstances. It is perceived that Akhil committed suicide. But, the crime scene investigation reveals that someone murdered Akhil.

episodesList.title: The Mystery
episodesList.summary: The mystery behind Akhil's murder continues to confuse Adi as Adi finds out Rajan's wife having an affair with Akhil but later he finds out that Akhil was blackmailing Rajan's wife with some videos and photos. Could that be the reason he was murdered?

episodesList.title: The Case is Solved
episodesList.summary: Adi solves the murder of Akhil and provides evidence to put Rajan behind bars. The commissioner is stunned after knowing that Rajan, a blind man, can commit a murder. Later, Chamko arrives at the police station with a buffalo and claims that a magician has turned Manav into the buffalo.

episodesList.title: The Buffalo
episodesList.summary: Chamko enters the police station with a buffalo and claims that a magician in a fare turned Manav into a buffalo when they both went to the fair to get an ice cream. Adi and the Commissioner are shocked to see that so Adi sends DIG to investigate the magician but things go sideways when they reach there.

episodesList.title: Tracking The Magician
episodesList.summary: Adi tries to track the magician after the magician turns Sundari Ji into a chicken. First Manav is turned into a buffalo and then Sundari gets turned into a chicken, the police station gets turned into a zoo. The magician then leaves a letter for Adi challenging him to find him.

episodesList.title: The Magician's Last Trick
episodesList.summary: Adi finds out that the magician is an ex-police officer. Adi informs the team that the magician kidnapped Manav and didn't transform him into a buffalo. Then, Manav, Sundari, and Bose arrive at the police station with the magician who had kidnapped them and thus closes the case.

episodesList.title: The Last Wish
episodesList.summary: Manohar Kaka meets Adi and informs him about his uncle's last wish. Adi and Chamko visit Adi's ancestral property to celebrate his birthday. Adi's colleagues surprise him at the party. Later, Lolita, Bose's wife, disappears. What is the last wish of Adi's uncle and where is Lolita?

episodesList.title: The Haunted House
episodesList.summary: The cops search for Lalita, Bose's wife, in the supposedly haunted house. Then, Neena finds a blood-stained saree, which belong to Lalita. Things get stranger than fiction when Adi finds the skeletal remains of his uncle. Where has Lalita disappeared and is the house haunted?

episodesList.title: The Skeleton
episodesList.summary: Adi still cannot find Lolita Ji and everyone is scared in the haunted house. Adi finds the skeleton of his uncle in his room which the servant has been protecting all these years. Things turn even more bizarre when Bose turns out dead with a sword stabbed through his heart. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Revenge Prank
episodesList.summary: Adi still cannot find Lolita Ji and everyone is scared in the haunted house. Adi finds the skeleton of his uncle in his room which the servant has been protecting all these years. Things turn even more bizarre when Bose turns out dead with a sword stabbed through his heart. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Case Takes a Turn
episodesList.summary: The case of the unknown skeleton, which has left everyone clueless, is about to get solved thanks to Adi's relentless investigations. Adi decides to visit the mansion to piece together the missing clues. Adi finds out that the skeleton is 50 years old and the person died due to a heart attack. But, the case takes a turn when Adi finds a shocking evidence about the skeleton.

episodesList.title: Dead Man's Diamonds
episodesList.summary: Bose produces a pair of shoes as evidence. Adi realizes that the shoes will lead them to the culprit. Later, Adi comes to the conclusion that the culprit stumbled upon the dead man's shoes, which contained diamonds. The culprit sold the diamonds and then started his own business. How will the 50-year-old mystery be solved?

episodesList.title: The Property Dispute
episodesList.summary: This time Inspector Aditya receives a case of property dispute where the owner of the house is kicked out with his entire family after a goon has taken over his property by force. Adi starts the investigation but soon realizes that the case is more tangled and complicated than it seems.

episodesList.title: Budding Romance
episodesList.summary: DGP orders the Commissioner to find Shanno. If he fails to find Shanno, then the Commissioner will lose his job. Meanwhile, Chamko seeks tips from Shanno in order to impress Adi and compel him to say those three magical words.

episodesList.title: The Breakthrough
episodesList.summary: Adi and DIG are still confused when they can't find any clue against JS in the case. Later on, somehow they get to know that JS is an expert in laundering fake papers to hijack properties so both DIG and Inspector Aditya go undercover to solve the case.

episodesList.title: Confusion
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya believes that he has solved the property dispute case after arresting JS for document fraud but doesn't realize till later on the mistake he made while investigating the case. What will happen now? Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Living With a Stranger
episodesList.summary: Avinash makes a startling claim that the woman living in his house isn't his wife, Aarti. Adi and Manav refuse to believe Avinash as the evidence and eye-witness testimony proves that Aarti is Avinash's wife. Is Avinash telling the truth?

episodesList.title: The Cctv Footage
episodesList.summary: Adi is unsure who is the criminal: Avinash or Giriraj. The final clue lies in the CCTV footage. After seeing the CCTV footage, Bose claims that Giriraj received Aarti at the station but she wasn't the woman who claims to be Avinash's wife.

episodesList.title: The Confession
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya gets a clue against Avinash so he plans a set-up for Avinash to confess his crime and as a result, Avinash crumbles under pressure and admits everything. Later Inspector Adi and Inspector Manav receive a consignment to transfer a terrorist from one jail to another but something is bound to go wrong during the transfer.

episodesList.title: The Bomb
episodesList.summary: Inspector Adi and Manav are assigned with a task to transfer a terrorist from one jail to another but on the way, Adi receives a call from someone claiming to have planted a bomb in the police station and tells Adi to transfer the terrorist to another location or he'll blast the bomb. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Patriot
episodesList.summary: The bomb disposal squad finds it difficult to diffuse the bomb. Meanwhile, Malik escapes from the police convoy and arrives home. Adi and Manav follow Mailk to his home and overhear Malik making a confession that he has been wrongly accused.

episodesList.title: The Haunted Temple
episodesList.summary: Inspector Adi and Inspector Manav overhear Malik's confession to his family and then Adi proves in front of the media how Anshul Malik was wrongly accused and framed. Later Adi receives a case of a haunted temple where three people went to make a documentary but later the dead bodies of two people were found out with the third one MIA.

episodesList.title: Inspector Aditya Reporting
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya receives the case of the cursed temple and gets there to solve the case and prove that the curse story is false. But when he gets there, he experiences some weird and mysterious things. Adi and DIG are also attacked by a stranger.

episodesList.title: The Mystery Deepens
episodesList.summary: The mystery around the cursed temple deepens after Inspector Aditya and DIG spend a night there. Weird things start happening around them as they remain confused. The mystery deepens even more after Kamini, the girl who went there to make a documentary, turns up alive. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Mystery Solved
episodesList.summary: The mystery behind the cursed temple is almost solved as Inspector Aditya raises the curtain over the electric shocks from the ground. He also claims that he has found the real culprit behind the theft of the jewel and waits for them to come to the temple at night.

episodesList.title: An Attempt to Murder
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya finally solves the mystery around the cursed temple and arrests the culprit behind the entire charade. Inspector Manav receives a case of an attempt to murder of a guy who claims that he almost died to the potholes on the road and wants to file an FIR against the road contractor.

episodesList.title: The Bomb
episodesList.summary: A person comes to the police station and wants to file an FIR of an attempt to murder against a road contractor as he almost died after falling on the road due to a pothole. Later Inspector Aditya receives a call about a bomb planted somewhere in the city. Are these two incidents connected somehow?

episodesList.title: The Audio Clip
episodesList.summary: The entire police department is in chaos after the attack on Commissioner Gogol and the audio clip that came before. Manav believes that he knows who the culprit behind the attack is and calls them to the station for interrogation. Chamko finds a clue in the audio clip that may lead to the terrorist.

episodesList.title: 14 Hours and Counting
episodesList.summary: Manav interrogates Bose and asks him to confess but Bose claims innocence. The CCTV footage reveals that the bomb was planted at 2 AM. After watching the footage, Adi meets the Commissioner and claims that he is the terrorist.

episodesList.title: The Ancient Statue
episodesList.summary: Inspector Manav reads his horoscope in the morning and finds out that he is going to be haunted by something from his past. Later he stops a heist where he saves an ancient statue from getting stolen. Little does he know that the ancient statue is exactly what's going to haunt him for the coming days.

episodesList.title: Statue Comes to Life
episodesList.summary: The statue that Inspector Manav saved during the heist comes to life and haunts Manav. After a little investigation, Manav and Aditya come to know that the statue is actually cursed and belongs to a king in Bhavanipur. So both of them travel to Bhavanipur to meet this king. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Gogol's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Manav A. Desai is horrified after seeing a tall man standing behind him. Meanwhile, Kogol is busy investigating the mystery surrounding Shanno. He reads his father's dairy and finds information relating to Shanno. Is Shanno Kogol's sister? Watch the episode and find out.

episodesList.title: The Ancient Man
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya and Inspector Manav work together to solve the mystery behind the ancient statue and its protector and plan to bring out the truth in front of everyone. They capture the protector of the statue and start investigating him. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: A Threatening Letter
episodesList.summary: The heads of two different Dahi Handi groups get threatening letters just before the festival of Janmashtami stating that the winner of the Dahi Handi breaking challenge will get his skull crushed so they approach Inspector Aditya and file a complaint regarding the letters. Inspector Aditya decides to take part in the challenge himself. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Innocent Until Proven Guilty
episodesList.summary: Bose suspects that the Commissioner is involved in the Dahi Handi case. Then, Adi meets Kogol and informs that he has reached a conclusion in the case. He decides to organize a Dahi Handi breaking ceremony and reveal the real culprit before everyone.

episodesList.title: Manav's Previous Birth
episodesList.summary: Manav doesn't like the idea of Chamko and Adi being together and decides to stop it from happening. Meanwhile, a woman meets Kogol and claims that he has an affair with her. Later, Manav gets a letter in which the identity of his son is revealed.

episodesList.title: Manav's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Adi warns Chamko about Manav, who believes that he was killed in his previous birth. Manav seeks revenge on DIG and Adi for the sins committed in the previous birth. Manav believes that he was tortured by DIG and Adi in his previous birth and plans to take revenge.

episodesList.title: Surrender
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya and Inspector Manav work together with Commissioner to capture the smuggler who was manipulating Manav's mind. Later famous underworld don Danny Digital's accountant comes to the station and surrenders and wants to help the police catch Danny. Is he speaking the truth or is it Don's plan?

episodesList.title: Manav is Shot
episodesList.summary: Danny Digital intends to kill his accountant Raghu who snitched him to the police so Inspector Aditya and Inspector Manav try to protect him by putting him in a special cell. Danny Digital somehow gets some robotic mice inside the police station and shots Inspector Manav. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Danny Digital's Rats
episodesList.summary: After Inspector Aditya figures out that it was Danny Digital's robotic mouse who shot Inspector Manav, he plants rat traps all around the police station. Finally, the rats are trapped and so is Danny Digital as he tried to get one of his rats in the special cell where his accountant Raghu was being kept. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Hostage Situation
episodesList.summary: A guy comes to the police station with his gang and makes Inspector Aditya and others his hostage and claims that he has planted bombs in the police station and is looking for a treasure that he planted under the headquarters fifteen years ago. Watch the episode as Inspector Aditya, Kogol and others try to escape the hostage situation.

episodesList.title: The Gold
episodesList.summary: After much digging, a bag full of gold biscuits is found. Adi saves the day by busting the gang that claimed to have planted a bomb inside the police station. With the criminals caught, will the bomb go off?

episodesList.title: The Dead Man Talking
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya and Inspector Manav come across a case of a dead man who talks to people from his grave and often whistles at women when they pass by. So they decide to see the grave themselves and go there at night.

episodesList.title: Building Up The Suspence
episodesList.summary: After the case of a talking dead body is filed in the station, Inspector Manav, Bose and DIG are given the task of finding out the truth behind the mystery by visiting the grave at night. Inspector Manav, DIG, and Bose are pretty sure that they heard the voice from the grave so Inspector Aditya decides to dig up the grave. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: The Missing Locket
episodesList.summary: Adi presents the evidence to the commissioner. Two photographs, one taken after the skeleton was dug up and the other before the burial. One key element missing from the second photograph is the locket. Will the locket help Adi to solve the case? Watch the episode and find out.

episodesList.title: Killer Price
episodesList.summary: Manav and Adi are facing the heat due to the order by a minister. In the midst of the surge in prices, Manav and Adi find it difficult to catch thieves. The minister pays a visit to the police station and orders Adi-Manav to catch the thieves as soon as possible.

episodesList.title: Laying The Trap
episodesList.summary: Police officers Adi and Manav are doing everything to clear the air among the charade that has been happening as they arrest another police officer taking a bribe from Mannu Mungfali but later Adiyta realizes that the police officer was framed so they decide to go undercover to catch Mannu Mungfali red-handed.

episodesList.title: Caught Red-handed
episodesList.summary: Inspector Aditya's plan to catch Mannu Moongfali red-handed seems to be working after he agrees to invest his own money in the film. Inspector Manav disguised as a film director lays out a trap for Mannu Moongfali. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Promotion
episodesList.summary: DIG is suspected to have taken a bribe but he claims innocence and assures that he isn't a traitor. Meanwhile, Adi learns that an intelligence officer is arriving. Manav is jealous of Adi as he learns that Adi will be getting a promotion.

episodesList.title: The Lie Detector
episodesList.summary: Miss Sandra comes from special branch to do an inspection in the police station. So to impress her Inspector Manav pretends to be Inspector Aditya so Sandra connects him to a lie detection machine for her inspection. But is Sandra really from the special branch or is she someone else?

episodesList.title: Gogol's Secret
episodesList.summary: DGP informs Inspector Aditya that the Intelligence Bureau has informed him that the commissioner sitting in the Police station is a fake. Inspector Aditya informs Inspector Manav and Chamko that Kogol's secret is out and they need to get the real commissioner back. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: The Imposter
episodesList.summary: DIG is gathering evidence to prove that Kogol is an imposter. DGP interrogates Kogol but fails to get the truth out. A DNA test is carried out and the results prove that Kogol isn't an imposter. How did Kogol manage to do the impossible? Watch the episode and find out.

episodesList.title: A New Beginning
episodesList.summary: After Inspector Aditya gets transferred to a new police station in Khataarpur, he gets there and is introduced to some men of a famous goon Bhaiya Ji. Kogol and Gogol's third identical looking brother, Commissioner Phogol welcomes him to the police station. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

plotHtml: Aditya Dev and Manav A Desai are two policemen who work under Commissioner Gogol Chatterjee. They are very different but slowly start to become good friends. Dev falls in love with Ayesha Nadkarni, who is a lawyer and Desai is in love with Ayesha's younger sister Dolly Nadkarni. They both live with Neena Nadkarni, their mother, a widow, and an old friend of Chatterjee. The story revolves around these characters and the different cases the policemen solve, with a focus on the comedic and entertaining situations which ensue. Later both men fight over Gogol's niece, Chamko
tagline: Aditya Dev and Manav A Desai are two policemen who work under Commissioner Gogol Chatterjee.

title: Porus
summary: Porus is an Indian Hindi-language historical drama television series based on the Battle of the Hydaspes, visualizing the lives of Porus, ruler of the Paurava Kingdom in India, and Alexander the Great, the king of Macedonia. It aired from 27 November 2017 till 13 November 2018 on Sony Entertainment Television. Another historical drama, Chandragupta Maurya, is a seamless continuation of it. The show was created by Siddharth Kumar Tewary of Swastik Productions. It is the most expensive show on Indian television, having a budget of about INR 500 crores (roughly US$60 million).
reception:
The show was hailed as 'visually captivating' by India Today.
Pinkvilla called it the television version of the film Baahubali.

articleSections.title: Story of Porus (Puru)
articleSections.text:
In 350 BCE, A Persian trader, Darius enters India intending to conquer it due to its wealth and prosperity. Two rival Indian kingdoms, the Pauravas (of the Puru tribe) and Takshashila (of the Bharat tribe) decide to end their enmity with a political marriage of the king of the Paurava Kingdom, Bamni and Anusuya, the younger sister of Ambhiraj, the king of Takshashila. Unlike her brother Ambhiraj, who cares only for his kingdom, Anusuya dreams of a united India. Bamni reveals that he married Anusuya to avenge his elder brother and Prime Minister, Shivdutt's insult by Ambhiraj which leaves her heartbroken. However Darius manipulates her by telling her to avenge her insult by attacking the Paurav Kingdom with Ambhiraj's help. Anusuya tells his intention to Bamni who doesn't believe her. Later, Bamni realizes his mistake and starts afresh with Anusuya. They oust Darius from the kingdom. Anusuya becomes pregnant and the astrologer says that their son will be the future of this country and bring honor to the ancestors.
Later Darius conspires with Ambhiraj and Shiv Dutt, breaks the peace between the two kingdoms, and forces Anusuya to flee. During her escape, she gives birth to a son, Porus (native name Purushottam, nicknamed Puru). Shiv Dutt tries to kill Anusuya and Porus by throwing them in River Jhelum. However, the Commander-in-Chief of the Paurava Kingdom, Ripudaman saves Porus and raises him in the Dasyu Kingdom, made up of pirates. Meanwhile, Darius (who later becomes the emperor of Persia) manipulates Bamni into becoming his trade partner to gradually steal India's wealth, leaving a heavy Persian influence on the Paurava Kingdom. On Shiv Dutt's suggestion, Bamni marries Kadika, the sister of Shiv Dutt's right-hand man and Paurava general. Samar Singh. and has a son, Kanishk.

articleSections.title: Story of Sikander (Alexander)
articleSections.text: In 350 BCE, Queen Olympias of Macedonia insults King Philip, resulting in the latter raping her. To avenge this insult, Olympias proclaims their son, Alexander, as the son of Zeus (King of the Greek Gods) who will rule India.

articleSections.title: Porus and Sikandar's meeting and aftermath
articleSections.text:
During Porus's trip to Persia, he meets Alexander and challenges him to come to India and go back to Paurav Kingdom. Alexander arrives in India, vassalising Ambhiraj and thus capturing Takshashila. Porus, who was in Takshashila at that time after escaping from the Paurav Kingdom with Bamni who was injured by Shivdutt, escaped from there safely along with Chanakya and made an act of Porus being dead. Chanakya invites Alexander to Porus's coronation ceremony and visits the Paurav Kingdom Alexander is shocked to see Porus alive and pledges to take revenge for this insult. Kanishk escapes imprisonment and he and Sumer ally with Alexander.
Alexander declares war with the Pauravas which lasted for months. On Porus and Laachi's marriage, Kanishk's men interrupt the ceremony, and Anusuya kills Sumer as she learns of his betrayal. Laachi asks for justice from Porus. Kanishk later tells the truth to Porus and Bamni which proves Anusuya innocent but is killed by Alexander. Dasyus allies with Alexander to attack Pauravas but later realizes their mistake and goes back to Paurvas but Laachi's mother, Mahanandini is killed off. Chanakya kidnaps Olympia and brings her to Paurav Kingdom. She performs black magic on Porus and Anusuya but fails in her attempts due to which she is on her deathbed but is saved by Chanakya. Alexander learns of Olympia's abduction and attacks Pauravas on both sides with the help of Ambhiraj. Ambhiraj kills off Anusuya and Porus takes revenge by killing Ambhiraj after which his son Ambhikumar and his mother become his enemies.
Both sides suffer heavy losses during the war, with Porus losing Bamni and Hasti. Eventually, Alexander is victorious in the Battle of the Hydaspes in 326 BCE and captures Porus, but impressed by Porus's bravery, he returns his kingdom to him, ends his campaign, and starts his journey back to Macedonia. Porus and Laachi has a son, Malayketu. On his way back to Macedonia, Alexander dies under mysterious circumstances in Babylon in 323 BCE leaving behind Roxane who was pregnant. The same year, Porus and Laachi are assassinated in a group attack by Ambhiraj's vengeful son Ambhikumar and Alexander's former general Seleucus, though Malayketu survives. In his final moments, Porus entrusts the future of India to Chanakya.
