title: Punar Vivah – Ek Nayi Umeed
summary: Punar Vivah – Ek Nayi Umeed (International Title: Married Again-a new hope) is an Indian Hindi-language soap opera that aired on Zee TV. It replaced Punar Vivaah and premiered on 20 May 2013 airing on weekdays. It went off air on 29 November 2013.
plot: Two individuals, Raj Jakhotia and Divya Malhotra fall in love at a teen age, but some circumstances lead them to separate.

articleSections.title: 10 years later
articleSections.text:
Divya is now a popular TV actress, who returns to meet Raj. She learns that Raj is married to Sarita (Srishty Rode). Divya thinks that Raj has moved and she decides to marry Gaurav (Ayaz Khan).
She does not know that Raj and Sarita, even after ten years of marriage, have not consummated the relationship. Raj still loves Divya. Sarita challenges Divya: before marrying Gaurav, Divya has to make Raj love Sarita. Divya accepts this and comes to Raj's house to stay, trying her best to bring him close to Sarita. But the efforts fail and Divya goes away because she does not want to be responsible for breaking Sarita's marriage.
Feeling that he has been very unfair to Sarita, Raj decides to be a good friend to her and help her find happiness with a new partner. Raj fixes Sarita's marriage to Vikrant Suryavanshi (Eijaz Khan), who is a rich widower and his little son, Abhimaan, adores Sarita and wants her to become his mother. Meanwhile, Raj suddenly realizes that he loves Sarita and tells her about his feelings. She breaks her engagement and returns to Raj. However, when Raj's younger sister gets into trouble, Sarita is forced to ask for Vikrant's help who agrees on condition that Sarita marry him. Having no choice, she agrees. Raj is bitterly disappointed.
Vikrant and Sarita get married. Divya makes an re-entry. Raj visits Divya and slips an engagement ring onto her finger to prove to Sarita that he has moved on. When Raj discovers the truth behind Sarita's marriage to Vikrant, he asks her to elope with him but she refuses. Sarita falls in love with Vikrant but owing to a misunderstanding Vikrant becomes upset with her assuming she still has feelings for Raj. Raj sees the error of his ways and gets back together with Divya. Vikrant finally realises Sarita loves him but Sarita is accused of plotting the murder of Kajal and is arrested.
Vikrant realises that Sarita is innocent and helps her escape from the police. While they are on the run, they take refuge in Raj and Divya's house. Divya ultimately realises who the real killer is; Sarita is released. Vikrant, Sarita, Raj and Divya all live happily ever after.

title: Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara
wikiTitle: Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara
summary: Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series produced by Rajshri Productions. It aired from 18 June 2012 to 1 November 2014 on Star Plus. It starred Disha Parmar and Nakuul Mehta as Pankhuri Gupta Kumar and Aditya Kumar.
plot:
Pankhuri Gupta is a simple girl from Kullu. Aditya Kumar, a rich boy in Mumbai, does not like relationships, having seen his parents Avantika and Harish separated for twenty years.
Purushottam Deewan (Aditya's maternal grandfather), a wealthy businessman, visits the Guptas in Kullu, determined to have Aditya marry Pankhuri.
Instead, Avantika fixes Aditya's engagement with Latika Bafna, who only wants the Deewans' money. Latika frames Aditya for taking advantage of her, but Pankhuri proves his innocence and rebukes Latika for conspiring against Aditya. After the incident, Aditya and Pankhuri become best friends. Pankhuri's parents fix Pankhuri's marriage to Shivam Mehta. Latika tries to ruin the wedding, prompting Shivam to leave. Aditya steps in and marries Pankhuri, and Avantika eventually wholeheartedly accepts her as her daughter-in-law after seeing her unconditional efforts to reunite her with Harish. Rubel, Avantika’s brother Anuj's son returns to India. He is a spoiled brat who hates Aditya and wants the family business and property, and marries Latika to do so. Avantika’s sister-in-law, Sheela and Latika plan and brainwash Anuj for property and make him acquire the power of attorney. They together plot against Aditya and Pankhuri and make them oust the Deewan house. They later fire Shanky, the family’s caretaker. Kaira, Anuj's daughter, hates Purushottam thinking he killed his wife Kaushalya. However, it is revealed that at a young age, Aditya was accidentally responsible for the death of Kaushalya who was in a state of coma. After learning the truth, Kaira apologises to Purushottam. The Deewans are reunited after many ups and downs. Anuj starts showing love and cares for his father Purushottam and his sisters, Avantika and Preeti by handing the reins of the business to Avantika and Aditya, that he had usurped. Preeti marries Sameer Deshpande, whose mother was a former nurse for the Dewan family.
Purushottam dies peacefully after uniting his family with Pankhuri's painstaking efforts. Purushottam's younger brother Manik and his family invite themselves to live in Deewan Mansion after the former's death.
A pregnant Latika joins Manik and his wife Manorama in their ulterior plans and undergoes an abortion but feigns a miscarriage blaming Pankhuri. Aditya is jailed and framed for possessing fake notes and illegal drugs, and is compelled by the wicked Manorama to divorce Pankhuri. Manik and Manorama soon reform after Manorama is paralyzed in an accident. Rubal divorces Latika, and falls in love with, and marries Payal. Pankhuri and Aditya remarry; Kapil (Manik's son) is arrested, and Kaira marries Varun.
The family reunites with Aneesha (the late Kaushalya's younger sister) who returns from Australia after decades. Vikram (Varun's elder brother) wants to use Kaira for revenge on Deewans as a decision by Avantika affects him negatively. The family eventually settles the problem. Aditya and Pankhuri argue. While she goes to Kullu, they patch over the phone just before disappearing in a landslide.

articleSections.title: 2 years later
articleSections.text:
Harish meets Pankhuri's lookalike, Ayesha on a trip in Lucknow and uses Ayesha to convince Aditya that Pankhuri is no longer alive, failing, as Aditya realizes Ayesha is not Pankhuri. Ayesha falls in love with Aditya but keeps her feelings to herself, aware that Aditya only loves Pankhuri. Ayesha's mother Nilofer forces Aditya to marry Ayesha after Ayesha's image is tarnished by a photographer Arif.
Aditya later marries Ayesha to save Ayesha’s image; Avantika soon accepts Ayesha. Pankhuri is revealed to be alive and is returned to the Deewan mansion in a coma. Upon waking, she reveals being abducted for jewelry. Ayesha later leaves to pursue her dream of becoming a designer, accompanied by Aneesha, who considers Ayesha as her daughter. Avantika's past affair is revealed when her illegitimate son Ayush comes to live with the Deewan family.
Eventually, Harish accepts Ayush as his stepson. The show ends on a happy note with Pankhuri turning pregnant and everyone in the family reuniting and rejoicing: thus, fulfilling the dream of being a united and happy family that the late Purushottam Deewan had dreamt of.

title: Pillai Nila
summary:
Pillai Nila is a 2012-2014 Tamil-language soap opera that  aired on Sun TV. The show premiered on 23 April 2012. It aired Monday through Saturday. The show starred Shamitha Shreekumar, Divya Padmini, Shyam Ganesh, Shreekumar, Neha Menon and Shanthi Williams. It was replaced by Chandralekha (Tamil serial) which was replaced by Ilakkiya (Tamil serial).
The show was produced by Saregama and directed by V. Sadhashivam, with screenplay by A. Jawahar. Pillai Nila is the fight between two good friends, Hema and Kokila, for Baby Nila. The show last aired 4 October 2014 and ended with 679 episodes. The show was re-telecastied from 5 May 2025  at 10:00AM (Indian Standard Time).
plot:
Kokila and Hema are best friends who are thick as thieves. Unfortunately they break up due to their love over Nila. While Kokila hails from a rich family, Hema is lower in status. Kokila and Hema's brother Santhosh are in love. Kokila gets pregnant with his child and they try to elope but Santhosh is killed by Kokila's relatives. After his funeral, Hema breaks her friendship with Kokila as she caused her brother's death. Years roll by and Hema is married to Shekar, and they have two children, Nila and Nithin. Kokila is married to Ramkumar who is sweet but his mother is one evil lady. As the two families live in Chennai, Kokila and Hema eventually meet but Hema is still angry. Nila eventually suspects that she is not the daughter to Shekar and Hema and try to find her real parents with her brother Nithin and the son of the house owner Illango's help. Kokila finds out Nila is her daughter with Santhosh, who was told that the child died during childbirth and a clash occurs between Hema and Koila. Ramkumar and Shekar try to meet up to solve the issue with Ramkumar wanting Nila for Kokila's sake and Shekar not wanting to give Nila as he loves her dearly as a daughter even though really she is his niece.
Though this is the main line of story, a number of minor characters and stories associated with Nila are intermingled in the series. Nila stays with Kokila and Ramkumar and loves them like her parents and the couple reciprocates it. Suspicion creeps in the mind of Nila when she overhears the conversation between Sharadha and Ramkumar. Nila mistakenly accuses Ramkumar guilty of an affair with Sharada and being the father of Hari, who is actually her nephew.

title: Phir Subah Hogi
summary:
Phir Subah Hogi (International title: Breaking Free) is an Indian soap opera series that was being aired on Zee TV from 2012 to 2013. It was mainly about the Bediya community of the Bundelkhand region, Madhya Pradesh. It was shot in Wai village near Mahabaleshwar.
The show was dubbed in English and aired on Zee World on DSTv channel 166.
plot:
In a village in India, live the Bednis, a community in which young women and girls dance before rich men (the landlords) who pick up the girls of their choice. Sugni, a girl who does not like this custom, tries everything possible to stop it. She states the importance of belonging to only one man. Because of her bravery, a landlord named Vikram Thakur Singh falls in love with her. They plan to marry even though everyone opposes it, including Gulabi, Sugni's mother. Gulabi discovers that Riva, Vikram's wife, is still alive (she was believed to be dead after a car accident a year ago). Gulabi tries to caution Sugni who does not believe her, being blinded by love. Gulabi tells Aditya, Vikram's nephew, about the fact that Riva was still alive and they manage to expose Vikram to Sugni on their wedding day.
Heartbroken, Sugni decides to return to being a Bedni. When she tries to sell herself, Aditya buys her as a servant in their house. Vikram becomes possessive and tries to divorce Riva so that he can marry Sugni, but fails. Riva then suggests to Sugni that she should marry Aditya so that Vikram would come back to her. Later, Aditya and Sugni decide to get married. At this same time, Vikram's mother, Maa Thakur, arrives with his sister-in-law, Suman, and her husband. When Maa Thakur discovers that Aditya is going to marry Sugni, she gives her consent. But on their marriage day, Vikram reveals that Sugni is a Bedni. At first, Maa Thakur despises Sugni and tries to disown Aditya for marrying a dancing girl, but later agrees to have them isolated in the house. Everyone blames Sugni for breaking the family's unity.
Even after her marriage to Aditya, Vikram lusts after Sugni and manages to get a night with her after threatening to kill Aditya in a wrestling sport where knives are used. Aditya learns about this and begins to hate Sugni, but takes her back after clearing the misunderstanding. In the meantime, Vikram's youngest sister, Kuhu, marries Digvijay, the son of Vikram's enemy, Jwala Thakur Singh. Digvijay doesn't love Kuhu and instead wants Champa, Sugni's friend, after raping her. Sugni tries to reveal this fact to the family, but fails. She later deceives Digvijay into exposing himself. Maa Thakur starts liking Sugni. Vikram, going to the extreme, plots to kill Aditya, and convinces Aditya and Sugni to spend some time at a house. Later, Vikram realises his mistake and tries to save Aditya, but Sugni gets shot instead and falls down a cliff. Overcome with guilt, Vikram wanders away into the unknown.
Six months later, Suman takes over the mansion and makes Digvijay and Jwala Singh owners as well. Vikram walks into a city that is full of courtesans, among whom is a girl named Chulbuli, who looks like Sugni. Vikram meets Chulbuli and tries to convince her that she is Sugni. Chulbuli is dating Divakar. Vikram discovers that the kotha owner and her son, Bunty, are trying to do something to Chulbuli. He wonders why a hooded man keeps on giving them strange medicines. On the other hand, Chulbuli gets strange, faint memories about her past.
Back at the mansion, Riva starts playing mind games with Suman and gets her look-alike, Jamuniya, to pretend to be Suman whenever she is out. Riva manages to transfer the property back to Maa Thakur. Vikram discovers why the kotha owner had been giving Chulbuli the medicines: she wanted to give Chulbuli a new life by using the medicines to make her forget about her past. Vikram discovers how Sugni was rescued from the river she had fallen into by some local fishermen. Vikram then takes Sugni back to the mansion. Riva discovers that Vikram is still in love with Sugni and so divorces him. Aditya comes back and he and Maa Thakur tell Vikram to marry Sugni. Sugni is feeling stressed as her memories are flooding back to her. Vikram and Sugni get married. During the seven rounds around the sacred fire, Sugni remembers doing this before and regains her memory. Sugni is convinced by Aditya that her marriage to him was never meant to be. The wedding of Vikram and Sugni has finally taken place.

episodesList.title: Episode 94

episodesList.title: Episode 99
episodesList.summary: Gulabiya tells Dhanuma that he is apprehensive about Sugni as Aditya may not stand against Vikram Singh as he is his uncle. Dhanuma tells Gulabiya that she would help her only if she assures her that Sugni would leave from the mansion.

episodesList.title: Episode 100
episodesList.summary: Sugni tells Aditya that she had decided to leave from the mansion as Reva does not want her to stay. Reva gets furious when Vikram Singh stops Sugni and announces that she would not leave from the mansion.

episodesList.title: Episode 101
episodesList.summary: Gulabiya feels bad when she learns that Sugni is staying in the outhouse and not Aditya's mansion.Aditya reminds Sugni that since he had performed her sardhakai, she had to stay in the outhouse. Aditya tells Sugni that he wanted her help as he wanted to cure Reva.

episodesList.title: Episode 102
episodesList.summary: To protect herself from rain, Sugni goes to take shelter in a hut. Sugni gets surprised when Vikram Singh arrives in the hut and is about to kiss her.

episodesList.title: Episode 103
episodesList.summary: Sugni feels disgusted when she spots Reva's brother staring at her. Gulabiya tells Sugni that she is going to Mumbai as the government has recognized rai dance as one of the main dances of India. She states that she was selected to showcase the dance performance in the city. Sugni gets elated on hearing it.

episodesList.title: Episode 104
episodesList.summary: Reva tells her brother Niranjan that she is tired of acting insane in front of Vikram Singh and his family. She states that she hoped that Sugni would never be able to return in Vikram Singh's life after her sardhakai. She fears that Vikram Singh would leave her and start living with Sugni. Reva gets irritated when Niranjan starts praising Sugni on her beauty. Niranjan assures Reva that Sugni would not interfere in her life.

episodesList.title: Episode 105
episodesList.summary: Amrita gets stunned when Gulabiya tells her that Aditya had performed Sugni's sardhakai. Aditya holds himself responsible for Sugni's plight. Concerned about Sugni's life, Aditya tells her to leave from the village and start her life afresh. Sugni replies that she cannot be selfish as he had paid Rs 20 lakhs to her family. She states that she does not mind serving him as a maid but would not leave from the village.

episodesList.title: Episode 106
episodesList.summary: Aditya feels insulted when Niranjan asks him whether his and Sugni relationship's was temporary or lifelong. He also mockingly tells Aditya that he would not mind accepting Sugni after Aditya leaves her. Aditya gets furious and is about to hit Niranjan. Reva arrives at the spot and stops Aditya. Sugni helps Barfi in repairing his bicycle. Before leaving, Barfi manages to make Sugni smile for a while.

episodesList.title: Episode 107
episodesList.summary: Niranjan gets shocked when he learns that Vikram Singh wants to divorce Reva. Vikram Singh believes that Sugni is still in love with him. Reva tries to get closer to Vikram Singh; however Vikram Singh pushes her away.

episodesList.title: Episode 108
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh gets furious when Reva insults Sugni. Reva regrets her decision of bringing Sugni in the mansion. Vikram Singh tells Reva that he would never come back to her. He further states that he would soon divorce her. Karthari asks for his share in the money which they received after Sugni's sardhakai. Sugni tells Gulabiya that she feels protected where Aditya is around her. She decides to inform Aditya that Amrita knew that he had conducted her sardhakai. Sugni tells Reva that she has no feelings for Vikram Singh.

episodesList.title: Episode 109
episodesList.summary: Reva tries to compel Sugni to get closer to Aditya. Reva believes that Vikram Singh would accept her if Sugni gets intimate with Aditya. Concerned about Amrita and Aditya's relationship, Sugni refuses to follow Reva's orders. On hearing Sugni's statement, Reva insults her. Vikram Singh argues with Reva for insulting Sugni. He states that he wanted to marry Sugni. He further adds that he would be divorcing Reva. Vikram Singh points the gun at Sugni and forcibly takes her along with him. Niranjan and Reva chase Vikram Singh's car.

episodesList.title: Episode 110
episodesList.summary: Sugni jumps off the jeep. Vikram Singh takes Sugni to a temple and reminds her about her promise. Sugni refuses to accept Vikram Singh. Meanwhile, Aditya finds Reva and Vikram Singh's divorce papers. Gulabiya and Reva reach the temple. Gulabiya threatens to kill Vikram Singh. Vikram Singh gets shocked when Aditya refuses to support him.

episodesList.title: Episode 111
episodesList.summary: Sugni gets furious when Vikram Singh shoots Gulabiya. She threatens to kill herself if Vikram Singh did not leave the temple rightaway. Concerned about Sugni's life, Vikram Singh leaves from the temple. Aditya's mother gets shocked when Reva and Niranjan inform her about Vikram Singh's crime. Aditya's mother informs the duo about her mother's arrival.

episodesList.title: Episode 112
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh calls Niranjan and orders him to take away Reva. Vikram Singh apologises to Sugni for shooting Gulabiya. He later realises that he was dreaming about Sugni. A furious Gulabiya expresses disappointment to Aditya. To prove his innocence, Aditya decides to marry Sugni.

episodesList.title: Episode 113
episodesList.summary: Kathari and his family get shocked when they learn that Vikram Singh has shot Gulabiya. Aditya and Sugni admit Gulabiya in the hospital. Aditya's mother informs Vikram Singh that Reva had locked herself up in a room. Vikram Singh manages to break the door. He gets apprehensive when he finds Reva conscious. Vikram Singh scolds Reva that he cannot accept her as he is in love with Sugni. He further insults Reva. Reva argues with Vikram Singh. Vikram Singh states that he would divorce Reva.

episodesList.title: Episode 114
episodesList.summary: Kathari and Hukum go to Vikram Singh's mansion and beg Aditya's mother to financial support them. Vikram Singh comes to visit Gulabiya in the hospital. Gulabiya mocks Vikram Singh when he apologises for shooting her. While leaving from the hospital, Vikram Singh overhears the doctor talking to Sugni. He gets shocked as the doctor was addressing someone as Sugni's husband. Out of curiosity, Vikram Singh asks Sugni who was her husband. Vikram Singh gets shocked he learns that Aditya is Sugni's husband.

episodesList.title: Episode 115
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh angrily questions Aditya why he betrayed his trust by marrying Sugni. He further threatens to kill Aditya. Sugni pushes Vikram Singh away from Aditya and warns him to stay away from her husband. Aditya tells Sugni that Vikram Singh is furious; however he would never harm him. Before leaving, Vikram Singh tells Sugni that he would see to it that she and Aditya never get united. Sugni and Aditya go to Vikram Singh's mansion. Reva and Aditya's mother get shocked when they learned that Aditya had married Sugni. Aditya states that very soon he and Sugni would again get married in front of the society. Vikram Singh, too, arrives in the mansion. Just before Vikram Singh could splash water on Sugni's face, Ma Thakur arrives in the mansion and stops him.

episodesList.title: Episode 116
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh and his family welcome Ma Thakur in the mansion. At first, Ma Thakur gets furious when Aditya introduces Sugni as his prospective wife but later agrees. Ma Thakur tells Aditya that she wants to meet Sugni's family. Aditya lies to Ma Thakur that Sugni is an orphan. Reva gets elated as Sugni was going to marry Aditya. Vikram Singh gets irritated when Ma Thakur states that hence forth she would take decisions on behalf of her family. The next day, the pundit fixes Sugni and Aditya's marriage date in the coming week. Gulabiya comes to visit Sugni. Ma Thakur overhears Sugni addressing Gulabiya as her mother. Ma Thakur informs Gulabiya that she was told that Sugni is an orphan. Gulabiya gets shocked on hearing it. Ma Thakur further questions Sugni about Gulabiya.

episodesList.title: Episode 117
episodesList.summary: Varsha asks a certain person to call Purvi and informs her that Varsha is in Bundelkhand. Without wasting time, Purvi informs Manav and the inspector about Varsha's location. Meanwhile in Bundelkhand, Gulabiya lies to Ma Thakur that Sugni is an orphan and she addresses her as her mother as she took care of her since childhood. Gulabiya feels bad when Ma Thakur states that she hates Bednis. Sugni fears that if Ma Thakur learns about the truth, she would stop her marriage. Aditya assures Sugni that he would handle the situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 118
episodesList.summary: Sugni along with Aditya and his family participate in a hawan. Compelled by Vikram Singh, Gulabiya forcibly performs the raai dance during Sugni and Aditya's engagement ceremony. Ma Thakur and Aditya's mother gets furious while Sugni and Aditya are left shocked. Gulabiya tells Ma Thakur that she performed the raai dance as she wanted to bless Sugni. Ma Thakur warns Gulabiya that next time she would not tolerate such behaviour. To handle the situation, Aditya lies to Ma Thakur that Niranjan must have called the Bednis to perform. Later, Sugni expresses her anger at Vikram Singh. Vikram Singh tries to make Sugni realise that she would not be happy with Aditya. He also tries to compel Sugni to stop the engagement but fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 119
episodesList.summary: Aditya feels bad for Amrita as he is going to get engaged to Sugni. During the engagement ceremony, the engagement ring does not fit in Sugni's finger. Vikram Singh mockingly states that the ring is not of Sugni's finger size. He tells Ma Thakur that he has a ring which would fit in Sugni's finger. Aditya hesitantly the ring and puts it on Sugni's finger. Late at night, Sugni goes out of her room to bring water. She gets terrified when Vikram Singh pulls her towards him. In fear, Sugni drops the jug. On hearing the noise, Aditya's aunt comes out of her room. Vikram Singh leaves before Aditya's aunt could spot him.

episodesList.title: Episode 120
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh smartly wipes off Sugni's mehendi which had 'A' designed on it. He points out to Sugni that her palm now has 'V' designed on it. In anger, Sugni slits her hand and states that she has removed Vikram Singh out of her life. Aditya's aunt informs Ma Thakur about Sugni's injury. Ma Thakur enquires with Sugni about her injury. Sugni smartly handles the situation. Later, Vikram Singh injures his hand. During one of the marriage ceremonies, Vikram Singh gifts bridal attire to Sugni. Sugni refuses to accept it. Sugni tells Vikram Singh that Aditya had already gifted bridal attire to her and she wanted to wear that for her wedding. Ma Thakur gets elated to see Vikram Singh's involvement for Aditya's marriage. She announces that Sugni would wear the attire which Aditya had brought for her. Vikram Singh gets elated when he receives a call from a certain person. The certain person informs Vikram Singh that he had reached the village. Vikram Singh had decided to foil Sugni and Aditya's haldi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Episode 121
episodesList.summary: Sugni gets shocked when Amrita arrives for her mehendi ceremony. Amrita gets the shock of her life when she learns that Aditya is going to marry Sugni. Ma Thakur questions Aditya about Amrita. Reva introduces Amrita as Aditya's friend. Later, Aditya tries to make Amrita understand his reason for marrying Sugni. However, Amrita refuses to listen. Amrita tells Aditya that Vikram Singh had invited her to come to the village. Sugni feels awkward when Ma Thakur introduces her and Amrita. Ma Thakur asks Vikram Singh to click Sugni, Amrita and Aditya's photograph on his phone.

episodesList.title: Episode 122
episodesList.summary: Ma Thakur asks Vikram Singh to click Sugni, Amrita and Aditya's photograph on his phone. Amrita secretly holds Amrita's hand as Vikram Singh is clicking their photograph. Aditya's aunt deliberately drops food on the floor. Sugni gets upset when Ma Thakur asks Gulabiya to clean the floor. Sugni stops Gulabiya and cleans the floor. Ma Thakur complains as Sugni cleans the floor. Sugni states that Gulabiya had taught her that no work is big or small. Ma Thakur gets impressed with Sugni and praises her. Vikram Singh notices that Amrita is wearing the ancestral ring. Aditya smartly handles the situation. Amrita gets upset when Ma Thakur asks her to remove the ring. Late at night, Sugni angrily questions Vikram Singh why he is instigating Amrita to reveal the truth to Ma Thakur. While conversing with Vikram Singh, Sugni accidently falls in the pond.

episodesList.title: Episode 123
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh saves Sugni. Ma Thakur and the other family members get apprehensive when they realise that Sugni is missing from the mansion. The family gets shocked when Vikram Singh along with Sugni enters the mansion. Vikram Singh informs the family that Sugni accidently fell in the pond. Amrita realises Sugni is trying to take her position in Aditya's life. She asks Sugni to leave Aditya. Amrita tells Sugni that Aditya is marrying her only to fulfil her promise. Aditya slaps Amrita when she insults Sugni. Ma Thakur tells Sugni that she would address her as 'Pari' as she is very innocent and understanding. Gulabiya is happy to see Ma Thakur expressing her love for Sugni. Sugni tells Ma Thakur that Gulabiya has always been with her throughout her life. A sad Sugni tells Gulabiya that Aditya slapped Amrita.

episodesList.title: Episode 124
episodesList.summary: Manav, Archana and Tejaswini get apprehensive when they fail to follow Varsha. Manav informs Archana and Tejaswini that he has contacted the Mumbai Police and they would come to Patna for their assistance. Balan informs Vishnu and Varsha that Tiwari would handle Purvi's kidnapping case. He states that Vishnu would have to go to Mumbai. In honor of Vishnu, Balan and villagers carryout a procession throughout the village. Tejaswini calls Manav up and informs him that she saw Vishnu and his gang members in the vicinity. She gets shocked when she spots Varsha with them. Manav and Archana get shocked when Tejaswini informs them about Varsha. Archana believes that Varsha had come to know that they were following her and so she hired Vishnu and his gang members as she wants them to stay away from Soham. A villager informs Tejaswini, Manav and Archana that the procession proceeded towards the grounds to celebrate the success of Jhumeri's son. Manav believes that they would find Varsha in the midst of the crowd.

episodesList.title: Episode 125
episodesList.summary: Amrita angrily asks Sugni to give her the sindoor box. Aditya's aunt instigates Reva against Sugni. She adds that Ma Thakur had given the ancestral necklace to Sugni. Kathari and Laxmi come in the mansion to meet Sugni. Just before the couple could reveal about their relationship with Sugni, Gulabiya handles the situation. Sugni gets upset as she recollects the conversation wherein Amrita had insulted her. Hukum and Lagariya decide to keep the ancestral necklace. Sugni requests them not to take the necklace as Ma Thakur had given it to her. Sugni gets apprehensive when Ma Thakur asks her about her relationship with Hukum and Lagariya. Sugni smartly handles the situation. Sugni manages to hide her relationship with Tinkle from Ma Thakur. Aditya's aunt decides to inform Ma Thakur about Aditya and Amrita's argument.

episodesList.title: Episode 126
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh continues to instigate Amrita against Sugni. Ma Thakur gets shocked when Amrita informs her that she is in love with Aditya. She states that she has accepted the fact that Sugni has taken her place in Aditya's life. Vikram Singh gets shocked on hearing it. Before leaving, Amrita apologises to Sugni. She also gives Sugni a necklace. Ma Thakur hopes Amrita gets a perfect life partner in future. Gulabiya thanks Amrita for saving Sugni's life. Amrita tells Aditya that she would always wait for him. She also tells Vikram Singh that she sacrificed her love for Aditya's happiness. Later, Sugni rages at Vikram Singh as he wanted to stop her marriage. She further states that she would attend the kuldevi puja.

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh tries to make Sugni recollect the time when they were head over heels in love with each other. Sugni tells Aditya that she could not keep the necklace which Amrita had given to her before leaving. Aditya asks Sugni to keep the necklace with her. Aditya's aunt, Seema tells Sugni that she wants to wear the ancestral necklace which Ma Thakur had given to her. At that time, Ma Thakur enters the room and rages at Seema for wearing the necklace. Seema mockingly insults Lagariya when Sugni takes her blessings. Sugni tells Gulabiya that she wants to reveal the truth to Ma Thakur as she could not bear the family ill-treating her. Gulabiya stops Sugni. The family leaves to go to the kuldevi mandir. Ma Thakur tells Sugni that the lamp should not extinguish until the puja is accomplished. Sugni has difficulty in keeping the lamp from extinguishing.

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Sugni gets apprehensive as she recollects the conversation where in Vikram Singh stated that he would stop her from performing the kuldevi puja. Ma Thakur asks the pundit to commence the puja. Gulabiya is happy as Sugni would be living her dream. In the middle of the puja, Aditya receives a call from a certain person. The person informs Aditya about Vikram Singh's accident. On learning Vikram Singh's accident, Sugni and Aditya rush to the accident spot. Gulabiya slaps Sugni when she states that she is still in love with Vikram Singh. Aditya tells Sugni that he understands her concern over Vikram Singh's accident. Gulabiya mockingly tells Vikram Singh about the puja which Aditya and Sugni were performing in the mansion. Vikram Singh gets apprehensive when he sees Sugni and Aditya performing the puja. Vikram Singh decides to go to any extent in order to be with Sugni.

episodesList.title: Episode 130
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh gets irritated when Reva states that Sugni does not care about him. Reva tells Vikram Singh that she would never leave him as she wants to maintain her position in the mansion. Sugni recollects the moment when Gulabiya slapped her. Aditya manages to cheer Sugni's mood. He tells Sugni that she must never lose hope and always be happy. Their conversation gets interrupted when Vikram Singh enters the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh mockingly tells Sugni that she would not be happy without him. Vikram Singh asks Aditya and Sugni to come with him to the temple as he wants to tell them about a certain thing. Vikram Singh takes Aditya and Sugni to the same temple where Aditya had decided to marry Sugni. Aditya gets shocked when Reva states the Thakurs could have an affair with Bednis and so she has no objection towards Vikram Singh and Sugni's relationship. Gulabiya gets furious when Aditya refuses to marry Sugni. Sugni returns the chain which Amrita had given her. She tells Aditya that she from hence forth she would fight on her own. She makes it clear to Vikram Singh that she would never be with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Gulabiya rages at Lagariya and the rest of the family as she knew that they were more concerned about Sugni not marrying Aditya than Sugni's plight. Hukum learns that Gulabiya and Sugni would be leaving from the village. He locks the door and immediately goes and informs Vikram Singh about it. Gulabiya and Sugni manage to escape from the house. Gulabiya and Sugni notice Vikram Singh and so they walk along with a crowd. Aditya saves Sugni when the police attack the crowd. Vikram Singh manages to find Sugni and Aditya. Vikram Singh gets into an argument with Aditya when he decides to accept Sugni. Vikram Singh gets shocked when Sugni aims the gun in his direction.

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: Vikram Singh gets shocked when Sugni aims the gun in his direction. Sugni asks Aditya not to interfere in between. Sugni gets shocked when Vikram Singh sadly states that he would never come in her way. Ma Thakur tells Aditya and Sugni that Vikram Singh is not in the mansion. Reva tells Niranjan that in order to maintain her position in the mansion, she tried to convince Aditya not marry Sugni. Ma Thakur expresses her concern over Aditya and Sugni's marriage. Aditya wants to tell Ma Thakur that he could not marry Sugni.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Aditya informs his mother that Vikram Singh had promised Sugni that he would never come in her way. He adds that he wanted to tell Ma Thakur that he could not marry Sugni. Sugni gets upset when she finds the pair of earrings, which Vikram Singh wanted to gift her, in her room. Reva notices sadness on Sugni's face and believes that she is feeling sad as Vikram Singh had decided to stay away from her. She believes that Sugni and Vikram Singh's feelings may change with time and hence decides to conduct Sugni and Aditya's marriage as soon as possible. Aditya is not able to tell Ma Thakur about his decision. He later realises that he is in love with Sugni.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Sugni gets elated when Aditya brings food for her. Their conversation gets interrupted when they hear Ma Thakur's voice. Aditya's uncle informs the family that few villagers found Vikram Singh's jeep and belongings in the forest. Reva assures Ma Thakur that Vikram Singh would return before Sugni and Aditya's wedding. Sugni is left confused as Reva is more concerned about the wedding than Vikram Singh's safety. Late at night, Sugni gets apprehensive about Vikram Singh's safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: Aditya decides to inform Sugni about his feelings, however is not able to tell her. Aditya also realises that Sugni still loves Vikram Singh. Ma Thakur tells Aditya and Sugni that they must postpone their marriage until Vikram Singh returns. Reva complains to Niranjan about Sugni's interference in her life. Ma Thakur gets furious when Champa arrives in the mansion. She angrily asks Sugni how she is related to Champa.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: Niranjan orders his henchmen to find Vikram Singh and kill him. Aditya tells Ma Thakur that he and Sugni are going in search of Vikram Singh. Reva calls Niranjan up and angrily asks him to find Vikram Singh. Vikram Singh goes to a Bedni's house and shares his plight with her. Reva tells Ma Thakur that she too wants to go in search of Vikram Singh. Reva tells Aditya that she would come with him from the subsequent morning.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: Reva tells Ma Thakur that she would go in search of Vikram Singh from the subsequent morning. Aditya realises that Reva is expressing false concern over Vikram Singh's absence from the mansion. The next day, Reva, Aditya and Sugni go in search of Vikram Singh. Sugni manages to find about Vikram Singh's location. Reva informs Niranjan about Vikram Singh's location. Aditya and Sugni get apprehensive when their car breaks down. On their way to the village, Aditya falls on the ground. Niranjan reaches the village however does not notice Vikram Singh.

episodesList.title: Episode 139

plotHtml:
In a village in India, live the Bednis, a community in which young women and girls dance before rich men (the landlords) who pick up the girls of their choice. Sugni, a girl who does not like this custom, tries everything possible to stop it. She states the importance of belonging to only one man. Because of her bravery, a landlord named Vikram Thakur Singh falls in love with her. They plan to marry even though everyone opposes it, including Gulabi, Sugni's mother. Gulabi discovers that Riva, Vikram's wife, is still alive (she was believed to be dead after a car accident a year ago). Gulabi tries to caution Sugni who does not believe her, being blinded by love. Gulabi tells Aditya, Vikram's nephew, about the fact that Riva was still alive and they manage to expose Vikram to Sugni on their wedding day.
Heartbroken, Sugni decides to return to being a Bedni. When she tries to sell herself, Aditya buys her as a servant in their house. Vikram becomes possessive and tries to divorce Riva so that he can marry Sugni, but fails. Riva then suggests to Sugni that she should marry Aditya so that Vikram would come back to her. Later, Aditya and Sugni decide to get married. At this same time, Vikram's mother, Maa Thakur, arrives with his sister-in-law, Suman, and her husband. When Maa Thakur discovers that Aditya is going to marry Sugni, she gives her consent. But on their marriage day, Vikram reveals that Sugni is a Bedni. At first, Maa Thakur despises Sugni and tries to disown Aditya for marrying a dancing girl, but later agrees to have them isolated in the house. Everyone blames Sugni for breaking the family's unity.
Even after her marriage to Aditya, Vikram lusts after Sugni and manages to get a night with her after threatening to kill Aditya in a wrestling sport where knives are used. Aditya learns about this and begins to hate Sugni, but takes her back after clearing the misunderstanding. In the meantime, Vikram's youngest sister, Kuhu, marries Digvijay, the son of Vikram's enemy, Jwala Thakur Singh. Digvijay doesn't love Kuhu and instead wants Champa, Sugni's friend, after raping her. Sugni tries to reveal this fact to the family, but fails. She later deceives Digvijay into exposing himself. Maa Thakur starts liking Sugni. Vikram, going to the extreme, plots to kill Aditya, and convinces Aditya and Sugni to spend some time at a house. Later, Vikram realises his mistake and tries to save Aditya, but Sugni gets shot instead and falls down a cliff. Overcome with guilt, Vikram wanders away into the unknown.
Six months later, Suman takes over the mansion and makes Digvijay and Jwala Singh owners as well. Vikram walks into a city that is full of courtesans, among whom is a girl named Chulbuli, who looks like Sugni. Vikram meets Chulbuli and tries to convince her that she is Sugni. Chulbuli is dating Divakar. Vikram discovers that the kotha owner and her son, Bunty, are trying to do something to Chulbuli. He wonders why a hooded man keeps on giving them strange medicines. On the other hand, Chulbuli gets strange, faint memories about her past.
Back at the mansion, Riva starts playing mind games with Suman and gets her look-alike, Jamuniya, to pretend to be Suman whenever she is out. Riva manages to transfer the property back to Maa Thakur. Vikram discovers why the kotha owner had been giving Chulbuli the medicines: she wanted to give Chulbuli a new life by using the medicines to make her forget about her past. Vikram discovers how Sugni was rescued from the river she had fallen into by some local fishermen. Vikram then takes Sugni back to the mansion. Riva discovers that Vikram is still in love with Sugni and so divorces him. Aditya comes back and he and Maa Thakur tell Vikram to marry Sugni. Sugni is feeling stressed as her memories are flooding back to her. Vikram and Sugni get married. During the seven rounds around the sacred fire, Sugni remembers doing this before and regains her memory. Sugni is convinced by Aditya that her marriage to him was never meant to be. The wedding of Vikram and Sugni has finally taken place.
tagline: In a village in India, live the Bednis, a community in which young women and girls dance before rich men (the landlords) who pick up the girls of their choice.

title: Paartha Gnabagam Illayo
summary: Paartha Gnabagam Illayo was an Indian Tamil-language soap opera starring Kushboo Sundar, Seenu, Delhi Kumar, Dr. Sharmila, Mercury Sathya and Bharath Kalyan. It aired on Kalaignar TV from 5 March 2012 to 31 July 2014 on Monday through Thursday at 21:30PM (IST) and The show was shifted to 20:30PM (IST) time Slot for 472 Episodes. The show was produced by Avni Telemedia and director by N.Priyan. The Family series received positive feedback from viewers and was a huge hit.

title: Punar Vivaah – Zindagi Milegi Dobara
summary: Punar Vivah – Zindagi Milegi Dobara (transl.  Remarriage Will Give You Life – Again) is an Indian soap opera that aired on Zee TV from 20 February 2012, replacing Bhagonwali-Baante Apni Taqdeer till 17 May 2013. The show was set in the city of Bhopal and revolved around characters Yash and Aarti. The first season concluded on 17 May 2013 and a second season titled Punar Vivah – Ek Nayi Umeed with new lead characters and a new storyline, replaced it from 20 May 2013.
plot:
It is the story of two individuals, Yash and Aarti. Based in Bhopal, Yash Scindia is a wealthy widower living with his two daughters Payal and Palak. Aarti is a divorcée and lives with her son Ansh. Yash is a wedding planner.
Aarti's in-laws and Yash's family want the two lonely hearts to get united in marriage. Aarti's in-laws decide to let Yash's family believe Aarti has been widowed like Yash. Yash and Aarti get married for the well-being of their children and Aarti soon makes place for herself in Yash's joint family. Yash, however, continues to live with memories of his first wife Arpita. On a trip to Mumbai, Yash and Aarti come closer and Aarti confesses to him that she has fallen in love with him. Soon, Yash cuts short the vacation and they return home where Yash declares he has no relationship with Aarti and refuses to speak to her. After several days, Aarti is still clueless till she faints and is informed she is pregnant. She recalls that after consuming bhaang at a temple, they consummated their marriage and Yash feels guilty for betraying his former wife and blames Aarti. Aarti finally confronts Yash and refuses to accept that the act of consummation was one-sided. She starts living with him again for the sake of their families but maintains a distance from him and hides her pregnancy from everyone.
Complications arise in Aarti's pregnancy but she chooses to leave with her son Ansh and boards a bus. Meanwhile, Yash's aunt discovers Aarti's pregnancy and the entire family finds out but only after Aarti has left. She meets with an accident and she and Ansh reach the hospital with help from her first husband Prashant. Yash sets out looking for her and Prashant discovers that Aarti is married to Yash. Yash and Aarti finally reunite at a mazaar and Yash and Aarti return home with Ansh as Prashant looks on. Meanwhile, Yash's younger brother Prateek and his wife Paridhi continuously argue about Paridhi's work hours as she goes off on shoots and her disregard for the family. Paridhi gets drunk for a shoot and sleeps with her producer who starts blackmailing her. In an altercation, Paridhi inadvertently hits him and he dies. Paridhi confides in her mother who tells her to stay quiet about all the events.
An ailing Prashant returns to his parents but is diagnosed with advanced stage cancer and requires a bone marrow transplant from his biological son Ansh. Prashant's mother Shobha is forced to ask for Aarti's help and they manage to get Ansh's bone marrow for Prashant's treatment whilst keeping it a secret from Yash and his family. Prashant is cured and refuses to leave home even as Aarti finally tells Yash about him and how while she was pregnant with Ansh, Prashant selfishly left her for another woman. Yash falls in love with Aarti but believes she would want to return to her first love Prashant but Aarti sets out to prove that she loves only Yash even as Prashant decides to get her back. Prashant's aunt exposes Aarti's past before the Scindias who are shocked and unforgiving at first till Yash defends her. Aarti and Yash are banished to another part of the house and Yash's father instructs the family to sever ties with them and their children.
Prashant decides to plot against Yash and Aarti to separate them. However, eventually, Yash and Aarti reunite with the family and Yash brings Akash to the family. This creates tensions and Gayatri starts hating Yash who is revealed to be Suraj Pratap's son with his other wife Radha and was swapped at birth with Akash who is actually Gayatri's biological son. Akash and his wife Ishita have designs on the Scindia wealth and influence Gayatri who disowns Yash. Suraj Pratap instead, names Yash as the sole heir to his wealth. A fight breaks out between Akash and Yash and Gayatri is grievously injured. At the hospital, she finally realises her mistake and apologises to Yash and Suraj Pratap as she dies in Yash's arms.
A month later, Akash and Ishita manage to turn the family against Radha with only Yash and Aarti supporting her. They make Suraj Pratap and the family realise her value and Suraj Pratap decides to marry her to give her her rightful place. After he gets into trouble with his thug friends, Akash has a change of heart when Aarti rescues him and saves his life.
New complications arise after Aarti and Yash's son Aayu is born but someone kidnaps him soon after. The culprit is revealed to be Ishita. Ishita becomes obsessed with Yash creating problems between him and Aarti. They don't talk to each other for months after losing Aayu. Aayu returns to the family as an orphan who is adopted by Prateek and Paridhi. Aarti feels a strange connection with the baby and finds comfort in him. Aarti soon discovers the truth about Ishita and together with Yash, she gets Aayu back; however, seeing Paridhi's sad face, Aarti and Yash decide to give Aayu to Prateek and Paridhi. Ishita comes back and kidnaps Aayu again. However, Yash saves Aayu and gets Ishita arrested as the show ends. The Scindia family introducing the new characters for Season 2.

episodesList.summary: Concerned about Yash's health, Pankaj tells Vidhi that he could not trust Aarti any longer. Vibha tries to make Pankaj understand that Aarti too is worried about Yash and hence they must support her.

episodesList.summary: Maya red-handedly catches Ansh stealing money from the locker. She goes and complains to Suraj Pratap and the rest of the family about it. The family gets surprised when Ansh and Palak inform them that they stole the money for Yash's treatment.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 140 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Yash gets upset when he learns that Palak, Payal and Ansh had gone along with Aarti to the Dubey residence. Suraj Pratap tries his best to ask Yash what had happened in Mumbai, however Yash refuses to answer.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 141 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Bhanwari calls Vidhi up and informs her about a certain thing which was probably the reason why Yash was upset. Satyadendra warns Shobha that he would inform Yash about the truth, if Aarti does not arrive along with Ansh. Aarti decides to help Prashant by taking Ansh for the bone marrow transplant operation. She feels guilty as she had to hide the truth from Yash. Later, Aarti gets apprehensive when Yash comes outside the hospital. Meanwhile, the doctor expresses his concern over Prashant's operation. Shobha tries to contact Aarti but fails. Aarti had accidently dropped her phone because of which it stops working. Concerned about Prashant's life, Satyadendra calls Yash up and asks him to meet him. He asks Yash not to inform Aarti about their meeting. Shobha breathes a sigh of relief when Aarti arrives with Ansh at the hospital. Satyadendra meets Yash in a cafe and tells him that he wants to tell him about a certain thing.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 197 - Full Episode

Ansh agrees to help Prashant. Satyendra tries to confront Yash by telling him the truth about Prashant. Just before Satyendra could reveal the truth, he receives a call from Shobha. Shobha asks Satyendra not to inform Yash about Prashant. The doctor informs Satyendra that the first stage of the transplant has been completed. Satyendra breathes a sigh of relief when he learns that Prashant's condition was stable. Maya learns from Ansh that Aarti had purchased gifts for the Scindia family. Aarti feels guilty about hiding the truth from Yash. At first, Aarti decides to confront Yash but later she thinks that it was not the right time to do the needful.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 198 - Full Episode

Prashant convinces Satyadendra to attend the dinner party which the Scindias have organized. After the laxmi puja, Yash convinces Aarti to come with him. Arti, Yash along with Prateik, Paridhi and the children have fun while bursting the crackers. Prashant feels sad as he could not spend time with Ansh on Diwali night. Yash spots Prashant in the market and invites him to come to his residence to celebrate Diwali.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 199 - Full Episode

Aarti feels guilty about it and decides to tell Yash the truth.

Maya points out that Prashant had Ansh's photograph in his wallet.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 201 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Maya points out that Prashant had Ansh's photograph in his wallet. Prashant smartly handles the situation. Later, Aarti apologizes to Yash as she spoke rudely to his friend.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 202 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Shobha learns from Aarti that Ansh went for his school picnic and would return after three days. Aarti and Prashant get apprehensive when their car breaks down. The duo is also unable to contact anyone. Aarti believes that Yash must be getting worried for her.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 203 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Prashant tells Aarti that Yash loves her a lot; however he is not able to express it. The detective informs Yash that he found Paridhi's MMS. Yash is left confused as he does not know how he would inform Prateik about Paridhi's MMS. Gayatri rages at Aarti when she returns home late in the night. Aarti informs the family that she went to meet Ansh. Paridhi feels awkward as Aarti did not inform the family that she took Ansh to the hospital. Yash decides not to inform Aarti about Paridhi's MMS.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 204 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Yash is disappointed as Aarti did not notice the surprise that he had planned for her. Aarti is feeling guilty. The family asks Yash if he had any evidences to save Paridhi, on which Yash informs them that those evidences are of no use to them.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 205 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Prateik assures Paridhi that he would make sure that she does not fall in trouble. Yash, Prateik and Pankaj go to the civil court. Coincidently, Yash asks the same mechanic to repair the car, whom Aarti and Prashant had hired to repair the car, the previous night. The mechanic inadvertently mentions that he had fixed the same car the previous night. He also tells Yash that a woman and a man had asked him to repair the car. While heading towards his room, Yash recollects the conversation wherein the detective said that a married woman could not always be faithful to her husband.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 206 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Yash gets surprised when he finds the room decorated. He also gets elated to see that Aarti had specially prepared dinner for him. Yash feels guilty for doubting on Aarti. Aarti gets apprehensive as recollects the conversation wherein Shobha told her not to inform Yash about her being a divorcee. She further feels guilty when Yash states that they have never lied to each other. Yash gets furious when Aarti backs Paridhi.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 207 - Full Episode

Prashant decides to tell Yash the truth.

Ishita however, feels delighted with the fact that Aarti fails to recognize her own son. Aakash announces the family, about their company receiving a good wedding contract. He further informs them about their visit to Mumbai. Aarti breaks down into Yash's arms after learning about his visit to Mumbai. They however, resolve their differences. The family cherishes their time together at the dinner table. Ishita however, stays annoyed watching Yash's affection for Aarti.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 315 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Aarti and Paridhi cherishes their time with the baby. Aarti realises the baby's illness. She asks Paridhi to get him some medicines. Ishita tries to provoke Paridhi against Aarti, by indicating Aarti's immense affection with the baby. Paridhi gets annoyed and slaps Ishita. Ishita however maintains influencing Paridhi against Aarti for a while. The Sindhia sons feel sad on leaving their house, prior their visit to Mumbai. Paridhi feels jealous after watching Aarti, claiming her right over the baby. Ishita makes use of the situation and tries to influence Aarti against Paridhi. Radha and Aarti hence, defends Ishita.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 316 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: the Sindhias make their visit to Mumbai. Yash and Aarti recollect their memories of love, in the city. They however, stay saddened thinking about Aayu. Aarti watches Ishita, when Ishita tries to provoke Paridhi against Aarti. Aarti furiously walks towards Ishita, but, Maya stops her midway and settles the situation. Maya further, warns Ishita to beware of Aarti. Ishita stays unaffected about Maya's warning.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 317 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Aarti starts getting bothered about Ishita's behaviour over the days. She tries to figure out the instances that connected her with Ishita and the once that, created problems in Aarti's marital life. She however, decides to keep her bother a secret to Yash, unless she comes to a suitable conclusion with proper evidence. Aarti, later witnesses Aakash and Ishita's quarrel. Inshita informs Aakash about him, being a medium for her to reach her love interest. Aarti further indulges in a serious argument with Ishita. She informs Ishita about her understanding of Ishita's actions from the past hence, ruining Aarti and Yash's marital life.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 318 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Aarti gets furious on Ishita, after noticing Ishita's various attempts to ruin Aarti's life. Ishita on the other hand, panics in fear but, pretends to stay innocent. Aakash appears after their quarrel ends, but Aarti and Ishita prefer to keep their agitation for eachother, under wraps. Both Aarti and Ishita decide to stay alert, with a motive to fight back and win their battle against eachother.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 319 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Yash hides his meeting with Ishita from Aarti, in order to hire a detective to find Aayu. Ishita also gives a fake reason and makes her way out from the mother's day celebration with the family. Ishita tactfully mixes a medicine in Yash's drink in order to make him drowsy. Aarti on the other hand, stay bothered about Yash's absence from the celebration. Ishita brings Yash in a room, in his drowsy state and starts undressing him.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 320 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Aarti takes the help of the female that helped Ishita in the past, for stealing Aayu. Vidhi also notices Aarti and the female's conversation. Aarti rushes towards the hotel, to protect Yash from Ishita. She catches Ishita red-handed and brings Yash to his consciousness. Aarti informs Yash about Ishita, being Aayu's kidnapper. Ishita gets furious on Aarti and tries to snob her with a knife. Yash however, prevents Ishita from harming Aarti. Aarti and Yash make their way towards the Mukti asylum to find Aayu.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 321 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Ishita informs Aarti about Paridhi's adopted kid, to be Aarti and Yash's son Aayu. Aarti and Yash further informs about the same to the Sindhia family. They allot the responsibility of Aayu to his real mother Aarti. Paridhi on the other hand, feels ignored and saddened for losing Aayu. Ishita fumes in anger for losing Yash. She decides to return to Yash's life with a motive to ruin Aarti's peace.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 322 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Surajpratap informs the family about a wedding invitation from Sohanlal who has bought their house in Bhopal.Aarti teases Yash saying that he would not be able to join as he was busy in work. Yash too plays along in front of Surajpratap and says that he would not be able to attend.Yash and Aarti reminisce the initial days before and after their marriage. They recollect the ups and downs faced by their relationship and how they sailed through it together.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 323 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Pratik and Paridhi take Aayu to the hospital, for his vaccinations. Paridhi innocently, hands the baby to a nurse, to proceed with the baby's vaccination. The nurse happens to be hired by Ishita. Ishita rushes towards the car, with Aayu in her arms. Yash and Pratik notices Ishita and hence, follow her.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 324 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Yash, Paridhi and Pratik follow Ishita on her way to a go-down. Ishita threatens Yash of killing Aayu, if he refuses her proposal of marrying him. A female appears at the venue, at the very moment and saves Aayu from being hurt. Aarti and the other family members cherish their memories while leaving the Sindhia house.

episodesList.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 325 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Divya meets Yash at his event in order to return him his bag that was exchanged with hers. Yash realises Divya to be the lady that helped him, to protect Aayu from Ishita. Aarti on the other hand, attends Sarita's wedding, who eagerly awaits the arrival of her soon to be groom Raj. Yash on the other hand, develops his friendship with Diyva. Divya informs Yash about her love interest Raj. Yash and Aarti get stunned after realising about Raj to be the common love interest of bother Sarita and Divya.

plotHtml:
It is the story of two individuals, Yash and Aarti. Based in Bhopal, Yash Scindia is a wealthy widower living with his two daughters Payal and Palak. Aarti is a divorcée and lives with her son Ansh. Yash is a wedding planner.
Aarti's in-laws and Yash's family want the two lonely hearts to get united in marriage. Aarti's in-laws decide to let Yash's family believe Aarti has been widowed like Yash. Yash and Aarti get married for the well-being of their children and Aarti soon makes place for herself in Yash's joint family. Yash, however, continues to live with memories of his first wife Arpita. On a trip to Mumbai, Yash and Aarti come closer and Aarti confesses to him that she has fallen in love with him. Soon, Yash cuts short the vacation and they return home where Yash declares he has no relationship with Aarti and refuses to speak to her. After several days, Aarti is still clueless till she faints and is informed she is pregnant. She recalls that after consuming bhaang at a temple, they consummated their marriage and Yash feels guilty for betraying his former wife and blames Aarti. Aarti finally confronts Yash and refuses to accept that the act of consummation was one-sided. She starts living with him again for the sake of their families but maintains a distance from him and hides her pregnancy from everyone.
Complications arise in Aarti's pregnancy but she chooses to leave with her son Ansh and boards a bus. Meanwhile, Yash's aunt discovers Aarti's pregnancy and the entire family finds out but only after Aarti has left. She meets with an accident and she and Ansh reach the hospital with help from her first husband Prashant. Yash sets out looking for her and Prashant discovers that Aarti is married to Yash. Yash and Aarti finally reunite at a mazaar and Yash and Aarti return home with Ansh as Prashant looks on. Meanwhile, Yash's younger brother Prateek and his wife Paridhi continuously argue about Paridhi's work hours as she goes off on shoots and her disregard for the family. Paridhi gets drunk for a shoot and sleeps with her producer who starts blackmailing her. In an altercation, Paridhi inadvertently hits him and he dies. Paridhi confides in her mother who tells her to stay quiet about all the events.
An ailing Prashant returns to his parents but is diagnosed with advanced stage cancer and requires a bone marrow transplant from his biological son Ansh. Prashant's mother Shobha is forced to ask for Aarti's help and they manage to get Ansh's bone marrow for Prashant's treatment whilst keeping it a secret from Yash and his family. Prashant is cured and refuses to leave home even as Aarti finally tells Yash about him and how while she was pregnant with Ansh, Prashant selfishly left her for another woman. Yash falls in love with Aarti but believes she would want to return to her first love Prashant but Aarti sets out to prove that she loves only Yash even as Prashant decides to get her back. Prashant's aunt exposes Aarti's past before the Scindias who are shocked and unforgiving at first till Yash defends her. Aarti and Yash are banished to another part of the house and Yash's father instructs the family to sever ties with them and their children.
Prashant decides to plot against Yash and Aarti to separate them. However, eventually, Yash and Aarti reunite with the family and Yash brings Akash to the family. This creates tensions and Gayatri starts hating Yash who is revealed to be Suraj Pratap's son with his other wife Radha and was swapped at birth with Akash who is actually Gayatri's biological son. Akash and his wife Ishita have designs on the Scindia wealth and influence Gayatri who disowns Yash. Suraj Pratap instead, names Yash as the sole heir to his wealth. A fight breaks out between Akash and Yash and Gayatri is grievously injured. At the hospital, she finally realises her mistake and apologises to Yash and Suraj Pratap as she dies in Yash's arms.
A month later, Akash and Ishita manage to turn the family against Radha with only Yash and Aarti supporting her. They make Suraj Pratap and the family realise her value and Suraj Pratap decides to marry her to give her her rightful place. After he gets into trouble with his thug friends, Akash has a change of heart when Aarti rescues him and saves his life.
New complications arise after Aarti and Yash's son Aayu is born but someone kidnaps him soon after. The culprit is revealed to be Ishita. Ishita becomes obsessed with Yash creating problems between him and Aarti. They don't talk to each other for months after losing Aayu. Aayu returns to the family as an orphan who is adopted by Prateek and Paridhi. Aarti feels a strange connection with the baby and finds comfort in him. Aarti soon discovers the truth about Ishita and together with Yash, she gets Aayu back; however, seeing Paridhi's sad face, Aarti and Yash decide to give Aayu to Prateek and Paridhi. Ishita comes back and kidnaps Aayu again. However, Yash saves Aayu and gets Ishita arrested as the show ends. The Scindia family introducing the new characters for Season 2.
tagline: It is the story of two individuals, Yash and Aarti.

title: Parvarrish
summary:
Parvarrish  is an Indian soap opera that aired on Sony TV. The show premiered on 21 November 2011 and ended on 14 August 2013. 
The serial is about two families having different ways of raising their kids. The story focuses on the lives, morals, and rituals of the families.
plot:
Parvarrish primarily revolves around two families who are relatives: the Ahluwalias and the Ahujas. It focuses on the troubles they go through in bringing up their children and the lessons they learn from these experiences.
Sweety Ahluwalia is very strict with her children, Rocky and Ginny, to the point where they get frustrated with her and secretly rebel. Although she constantly scolds them and complains about their studies, she considers them her life. With her supportive husband Lakvir Singh, she tries to provide them with the best she can.
On the other hand, Sweety's younger sister, Pinky Ahuja, wants to take care of her children, Raavi, Raashi and Sunny by being friends with them. However, her overreacting nature often suffocates her kids and creates problems in the relationship she shares with them. She often finds a supportive friend in her caring and loving husband Jeet.

articleSections.title: Sequel
articleSections.text: In May 2015, it was announced that the show would return with a sequel. In September 2015, it was announced that actors like Sangita Ghosh, Sandeep Baswana, Vinay Jain and Gautami Kapoor would star in the sequel. The sequel began from 23 November 2015 and ended on 7 July 2016.

title: Parichay: Nayee Zindagi Kay Sapno Ka
wikiTitle: Parichay: Nayee Zindagi Kay Sapno Ka
summary: Parichay – Nayee Zindagi Kay Sapno Ka (transl.  Introduction of Dreams of new life), simply known as Parichay, is an Indian soap opera that aired on Colors TV from 9 August 2011 to 16 March 2013. The show is produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor under their banner Balaji Telefilms.
plot:
Kunal Chopra lives in an apartment with his parents and his siblings, Gaurav, Anand and Raveena. Once a career-oriented and successful lawyer, Kunal has lost his zest at life and considers himself a failure, resulting in him not doing anything and Gaurav becoming the sole breadwinner. Kunal joins a law firm under Advocate D.K. Thakral but refuses to take up a case given by Thakral on moral grounds, leading him to be fired. Kunal later joins a construction company but is also fired due to Thakral's actions. On the other hand, Siddhi Malik is living with her brother Kapil and sister Khushboo. Ten years later, Anand graduates from law school. Siddhi and Anand fall in love and are set to marry. However, a day before the marriage, the Chopra family learns about the demise of Anand in a bomb blast. Kunal marries her to make his grieving mother happy, breaking his already deteriorating relationship with Thakral's daughter, Richa. He later finds his life changing for the better through Siddhi's arrival. Later, Kunal has Raveena married to Vikram, the brother of Gaurav's wife, Seema, despite Raveena being in a relationship with Richa's brother, Rohit.
Kunal and Siddhi consummate their marriage, however, Kunal, thinking that the act of consummation was one-sided, figures that Siddhi is not happy in the marriage and still harbors feelings for Anand, and files for divorce, shattering Siddhi, who finds herself in love with him. Seema encourages Siddhi to make Kunal realize his love for her. Meanwhile, Richa, conspiring to separate the couple, falsely accuses Kunal of raping her at a party, leading to which Kunal, initially fighting the case himself, is forced to transfer the case to Siddhi. Siddhi is then kidnapped by Rohit and injured in the process, but manages to win the case. She and Kunal later confess their love for each other during a family trip to Ujjain. Siddhi is then revealed to be pregnant. Meanwhile, Kunal catches Gaurav in an affair and banishes him from the family.
After an argument in which Siddhi leaves Kunal, she unknowingly crashes into Rohit in an accident with her car. Richa and her father blame Siddhi for his death, while Kunal decides to prove her innocence. Thakral, however, manages to trap Kunal, and he is sent to jail. Rohit is later revealed to be alive. Siddhi, Vikram, and Raveena get hold of him, but Richa, swearing revenge on Siddhi, kills her own brother, who testified against her earlier in Kunal's rape case. Richa strikes a deal with Siddhi, who agrees to sign the divorce papers and behave rudely towards the Chopra family. Siddhi accuses Kunal in the court of murder, but Richa proves him innocent and Siddhi as the culprit. Siddhi is incarcerated, and a heartbroken Kunal promises to never interfere in her life again. While in jail, she meets Sulekha Diwan and delivers male twins. Richa steals the first twin and convinces Kunal that Siddhi wanted to kill him. Upon discovering this, Siddhi asks Sulekha to give the second baby to the Chopra family. Sulekha initially complies, but when she learns that Kunal is planning to marry Richa, she returns the baby to Siddhi. Kunal ultimately decides not to marry Richa.
9 years later, Siddhi, who is released, thinks that Kunal is happy with Richa, so she decides to move on, goes through a makeover, and is shown to be living with Sulekha and her son, Abhay Diwan. Kunal, now losing trust in everything, was back to drinking, gambling, and fighting. The twins, both named Anand (after the Chopras' deceased younger son), grow up. The elder Anand Chopra lives with Kunal, while the younger Anand Diwan lives with Siddhi and is raised as a spoilt brat. Anand Chopra, tired of seeing Kunal in a dire state, convinces him to fight a case. On the day of hearing, Kunal spots Siddhi after nine years. The elder Anand is selected for a dance competition, and Kunal sells his gold medal that he earned from a law school to pay for the fees. During the competition, the elder Anand meets his younger brother. After the competition, Siddhi and Kunal come face to face. Both end up working in Abhay's firm, in which Kunal is forced to work under her. Siddhi later realizes that Kunal and Richa are not married. Meanwhile, the two Anands realize that they are both twins and vow to reunite their parents. Abhay sends Siddhi on a trip to Bangalore to solve some legal issues, during which Kunal and Siddhi come close to each other. Kunal and Siddhi decide to start a new life with their children, but Kunal sees Siddhi marrying Abhay and decides to avoid her. Abhay files for custody of the kids, and Thakral fights his case, while Kunal fights for his children. In the court, Siddhi speaks favorably of Kunal, angering Abhay. Kunal sees Abhay strangling Siddhi, but she tells him not to interfere in her personal matters. Afterwards, the court declares Abhay and Siddhi's marriage invalid, as Kunal and Siddhi haven't divorced yet, and orders them to live under one roof for six months. The twins try their best to bring their parents together, but to no avail. Siddhi tells Kunal that she married Abhay as he would threaten her with killing the younger Anand. However, Kunal refuses to believe this. Meanwhile, during a trip to the mall, some robbers attack it and keep Siddhi at gunpoint. Kunal saves her, but in the process, they shoot the younger Anand. Abhay pays for his operation and reminds Kunal that he is a loser. Kunal pledges to change his life. Afterwards, he and the twins learn that Siddhi is injured in a blast, but are unable to find her. Kunal later discovers that Abhay kidnapped Siddhi and has him arrested. Kunal and Siddhi reunite, and the show ends with the Chopra family recovering their mansion.

plotHtml:
Kunal Chopra lives in an apartment with his parents and his siblings, Gaurav, Anand and Raveena. Once a career-oriented and successful lawyer, Kunal has lost his zest at life and considers himself a failure, resulting in him not doing anything and Gaurav becoming the sole breadwinner. Kunal joins a law firm under Advocate D.K. Thakral but refuses to take up a case given by Thakral on moral grounds, leading him to be fired. Kunal later joins a construction company but is also fired due to Thakral's actions. On the other hand, Siddhi Malik is living with her brother Kapil and sister Khushboo. Ten years later, Anand graduates from law school. Siddhi and Anand fall in love and are set to marry. However, a day before the marriage, the Chopra family learns about the demise of Anand in a bomb blast. Kunal marries her to make his grieving mother happy, breaking his already deteriorating relationship with Thakral's daughter, Richa. He later finds his life changing for the better through Siddhi's arrival. Later, Kunal has Raveena married to Vikram, the brother of Gaurav's wife, Seema, despite Raveena being in a relationship with Richa's brother, Rohit.
Kunal and Siddhi consummate their marriage, however, Kunal, thinking that the act of consummation was one-sided, figures that Siddhi is not happy in the marriage and still harbors feelings for Anand, and files for divorce, shattering Siddhi, who finds herself in love with him. Seema encourages Siddhi to make Kunal realize his love for her. Meanwhile, Richa, conspiring to separate the couple, falsely accuses Kunal of raping her at a party, leading to which Kunal, initially fighting the case himself, is forced to transfer the case to Siddhi. Siddhi is then kidnapped by Rohit and injured in the process, but manages to win the case. She and Kunal later confess their love for each other during a family trip to Ujjain. Siddhi is then revealed to be pregnant. Meanwhile, Kunal catches Gaurav in an affair and banishes him from the family.
After an argument in which Siddhi leaves Kunal, she unknowingly crashes into Rohit in an accident with her car. Richa and her father blame Siddhi for his death, while Kunal decides to prove her innocence. Thakral, however, manages to trap Kunal, and he is sent to jail. Rohit is later revealed to be alive. Siddhi, Vikram, and Raveena get hold of him, but Richa, swearing revenge on Siddhi, kills her own brother, who testified against her earlier in Kunal's rape case. Richa strikes a deal with Siddhi, who agrees to sign the divorce papers and behave rudely towards the Chopra family. Siddhi accuses Kunal in the court of murder, but Richa proves him innocent and Siddhi as the culprit. Siddhi is incarcerated, and a heartbroken Kunal promises to never interfere in her life again. While in jail, she meets Sulekha Diwan and delivers male twins. Richa steals the first twin and convinces Kunal that Siddhi wanted to kill him. Upon discovering this, Siddhi asks Sulekha to give the second baby to the Chopra family. Sulekha initially complies, but when she learns that Kunal is planning to marry Richa, she returns the baby to Siddhi. Kunal ultimately decides not to marry Richa.
9 years later, Siddhi, who is released, thinks that Kunal is happy with Richa, so she decides to move on, goes through a makeover, and is shown to be living with Sulekha and her son, Abhay Diwan. Kunal, now losing trust in everything, was back to drinking, gambling, and fighting. The twins, both named Anand (after the Chopras' deceased younger son), grow up. The elder Anand Chopra lives with Kunal, while the younger Anand Diwan lives with Siddhi and is raised as a spoilt brat. Anand Chopra, tired of seeing Kunal in a dire state, convinces him to fight a case. On the day of hearing, Kunal spots Siddhi after nine years. The elder Anand is selected for a dance competition, and Kunal sells his gold medal that he earned from a law school to pay for the fees. During the competition, the elder Anand meets his younger brother. After the competition, Siddhi and Kunal come face to face. Both end up working in Abhay's firm, in which Kunal is forced to work under her. Siddhi later realizes that Kunal and Richa are not married. Meanwhile, the two Anands realize that they are both twins and vow to reunite their parents. Abhay sends Siddhi on a trip to Bangalore to solve some legal issues, during which Kunal and Siddhi come close to each other. Kunal and Siddhi decide to start a new life with their children, but Kunal sees Siddhi marrying Abhay and decides to avoid her. Abhay files for custody of the kids, and Thakral fights his case, while Kunal fights for his children. In the court, Siddhi speaks favorably of Kunal, angering Abhay. Kunal sees Abhay strangling Siddhi, but she tells him not to interfere in her personal matters. Afterwards, the court declares Abhay and Siddhi's marriage invalid, as Kunal and Siddhi haven't divorced yet, and orders them to live under one roof for six months. The twins try their best to bring their parents together, but to no avail. Siddhi tells Kunal that she married Abhay as he would threaten her with killing the younger Anand. However, Kunal refuses to believe this. Meanwhile, during a trip to the mall, some robbers attack it and keep Siddhi at gunpoint. Kunal saves her, but in the process, they shoot the younger Anand. Abhay pays for his operation and reminds Kunal that he is a loser. Kunal pledges to change his life. Afterwards, he and the twins learn that Siddhi is injured in a blast, but are unable to find her. Kunal later discovers that Abhay kidnapped Siddhi and has him arrested. Kunal and Siddhi reunite, and the show ends with the Chopra family recovering their mansion.
